Abyss Demon (深淵の悪魔) is a demon summon from Mass for the Dead.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

A muscular demon with the bare-bone head of a ram with black wings sprouting from the back.
Personality

Abyss Demon possesses the intelligence to speak human language and strength to crush rocks. He combines obedience that faithfully carries out its life in the service of Demiurge and Momonga. Ferocious in that, if he considers those as an enemy, he will crush them without mercy. Abyss Demon may look like a thug, but he has a prudent mind and can sense an enemy's power. He is not without his insecurities, as after surviving a near-death experience from fighting Blue Roses, he became agitated and fearful of their faces. To nurse his damaged psyche he has continuously told himself, and others, that he was invincible.
Background

One of the subordinates summoned by Demiurge during the Great Tomb of Nazarick's crisis.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Abyss Demon appears alongside his superior Demiurge on the 6th Floor after sweeping through wiping out the Chaos Beasts. He listened to the Floor Guardian's theory concerning the fissures on the 6th and 10th Floors and the possibility that they were connected. It was his summoner's belief that the randomness of the Chaos Beasts' attacks were part of some intelligent design. Abyss Demon was shocked at such a possibility that there was someone out there that could possess such power. Though he was relieved of his worries by Demiurge that all this was just pure speculation.[2]

In order to obtain resources to promote and revitalize Nazarick, Momonga launches an asset acquisition plan. However, the mine for resource acquisition secured by Demiurge, become threaten when word is received that a teams of adventurers led by Blue Roses is coming. Abyss Demon aids Demiurge in turning the mind into a dungeon. The theme for the dungeon is decided as a place for demons, and Abyss Demon is installed as the nominal boss. While the minions placed by the demons kill the weak adventurers, they fail to stop Blue Roses. Abyss Demon is forced to confront them as the lord of the dungeon.

Demiurge using his abilities from afar, temporarily increases Abyss Demon's defensive stats to make him seemingly invulnerable. In the end, he allows a killing blow to hit him and is defeated by Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra's weapon, Kilineiram using [Dark Blade Mega Impact]. The demon is severely injured and near defeat, but before the adventurers land a killing blow, agents from Nazarick, working undercover as adventurers, secretly activate poison gas that emits seemingly from Abyss Demon's body. The adventurers quickly evacuate the mine, whilst Abyss Demon is rescued and taken to Nazarick to be resuscitated by Demiurge. After being healed by his summoner, he is traumatized by the experience at the hands of the humans. Though he was defeated, the mission was a success as the mine is now indefinitely free from human interference.[3]

Eventually a quake occurred in the vicinity of the hidden mine, revealing several untouched underground caverns filled with precious ores. This new area was surveyed and explored by Demiurge, Solution Epsilon, Sebas Tian, Slimeko, the protagonist. After the survey, the Abyss Demon was granted to rule the area, nominally promoting him as an Area Guardian, an honor that he took with pride.[4]

Abyss Demon continued to work under the service of Demiurge, often acquiring human material for the Floor Guardian's projects. For instance, he abducted two bandits and gave them to Demiurge to be used to breed more Enhanced Treants for Nazarick's security network.[5]

On one of his routine duties in clearing away random monsters from his dungeon, he was assisted by Shalltear Bloodfallen. Everything went accordingly until Shalltear received a [Message] from Solution Epsilon of Albedo plan to seduce Momonga. In fury the Floor Guardian rushed out of the mine, leaving behind the confused demon.[6]

For the protagonist's upcoming mission to rescue Gazef Stronoff, Abyss Demon met with the homunculus and his adventurer team and escorted them to the Crack in the Great Forest of Tob for training.[7]

Abyss Demons is later seen as part of the demon forces of the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth. While the Evil Lords actively participated in the campaign to exterminate thirty thousand Chaos Beasts, Abyss Demon was kept in reserve to intimidate the observing humans. His presence does not go unnoticed by Lakyus who suspects he was revived by Jaldabaoth.

The Abyss Demon finally took an active part in Jaldabaoth's scheme when the protagonist, who was really Pandora's Actor in disguise, interfered with the execution of Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix in city square of E-Rantel. Abyss Demon was ordered by Jaldabaoth to eliminate the adventurer, but was quickly defeated despite his bluster on being invincible.[8]

Much later after his defeat, Abyss Demon was suspected by the Blue Roses to be behind the rise in undead in a mine near Re-Blumrushur. Together with the protagonist's team they found that the mine was being used as a ritual site by Zurrernorn and they believed he was the mastermind. However, the mastermind of the death cult's presence was seemingly to be Evil Lord Greed who fought the adventurers on behalf of his traumatized comrade.[9]

After Demiurge returned from the Abelion Hills with ore of adamantite from a newly discovered mine, Abyss Demon went to meet Demiurge on the 7th Floor to talk about planes for the mine's management. There he found Demiurge with Evil Lord Envy and Evil Lord Greed having an artistic block on how to proceed with making a statue of Momonga. Demiurge asked Abyss Demon on his opinion on one sample of his work, which the demon found to be beautiful, but was shocked to learn it was merely one of 83 prototypes. However, Abyss Demon could not provide anything constructive as he lacks a truly artistic eye, which caused the Floor Guardian to call Albedo for her opinion. When Albedo arrived and reviewed Demiurge's progress, she was able to give him some insight on his block and also inspire him to resume. Abyss Demon observed in stunned awe at his superior and the Overseer Guardians dynamic in creating the final iteration of the statue. Later at the National Foundation Day Ceremony, Abyss Demon attended the event and stood among the subordinates in the Throne Room of Fake Nazarick.[10]

At the time of the retaking of Nazarick from Enhela Read Gahi, the Evil Lords, Wrath, Greed and Envy, were recalled from remote areas such as the Abelion Hills to participate in the dungeon conquest. In the meantime, Abyss Demon was assigned to take over their management duties.[11]

At the time of a competition in the Amphitheater to determine who should temporarily replace the undead guards during a festival, Demiurge being entry four was about to call his candidate. Albedo assumes Demiurge will recommend the best under his command. If that's the case...the three Evil Lords should be excluded, as they are like symbols of fear when Jaldabaoth attacked E-Rantel. Similarly, the Abyss Demon would be excluded due to his similar status.[12]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Abyss Demon belongs to the sub-type of demonic beings known as devils, ones who are the intellectuals of the race.
Active

Abyss: Inflicts physical damage on a single enemy.
Angel Killing: Increases damage a single enemy of the "Angel" species.
Body Strengthening: Increases physical attack power.
Duplicate Slash: An attack that gives the damage to a single enemy.
Main Equipment

Halberd
Relationships

Demiurge

Abyss Demon's summoner, and due to that he is loyal to him. He also listens to his summoner's theories on the origins of the Cracks. While he does not understand the hypothetical questions regarding the phenomena, he also shares Demiurge's wariness of that the Cracks could be a form of attack by some unseen mastermind.

Momonga

Momonga being Demiurge's master is also loyal to him.

Blue Roses

The Abyss Demon fought the group of adventurers and became terrified of them after they nearly killed him.

ADVERTISEMENT
Trivia

Abyss Demon is the second summoned character in Mass for the Dead.

entries.name: Aggresiel
entries.content:
Aggresiel appears to be a young tan girl, sharp teeth and blue sapphire eyes, with long platinum hair that reaches past her waist and two small natural wing-like appendages protruding out the side of her skull. She appears to resemble a knight, wearing a metal visor atop her head, a white blouse with a dark red vest, dark black arm sleeves, and two dark red belts with gold buckled. Her footwear seems disproportionate to her small body as they are massive armored boots with steering handles.[1]
Personality

Aggresiel is described, when she is happy to have sparkling eyes and gets a ragged breath when excited. She appears to have a sisterly bond with her associates, who affectionately refer her using chan (ちゃん) as a form of endearment. Aggresiel also appears to be very optimistic of the future and her sisters plans, having no doubts that things can go wrong.

The girl appears to be very confident and sometime gets carried away in her excitement. Fundamentally she is a carefree girl who smiles. According to herself she is not a very outspoken person but values a dialogue. She claims to also have good tuition which is normally reliable.

Aggresiel appears to have great admiration for the guild of Ainz Ooal Gown and their associates, as they were the people her creator idolized in YGGDRASIL.

Despite her childish behavior Aggresiel is actually perceptive and intelligent when it comes to people, indicating she has a lot of experience. And can be serious, when the situation calls for it.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Little is known about Aggresiel, save that she lives with five other girls who she considers as her sisters: Billiophia, a twin pig-tailed girl, a spear-wielding girl, a wheelchair bound girl and a lethargic girl that is seen sleeping on a pile of some unknown objects. Which together they make up the group called the Mercenary Knights.

Though later it is revealed that she is a creation of someone from YGGDRASIL who was a long-time admirer of the guild Ainz Ooal Gown who recorded their mighty deeds in a series of documents. At one point she and her sisters came in possession of the documents, about the heteromorphic guild. These tales greatly made an impression on the Mercenary Knights, but more so on Aggresiel.

According to her claim, she and her sisters operate "inside the Crack", traveling to various worlds, taking on different roles and identities, where they are Mercenary Knights, in another workers, etc. The current world which her sisters are in is one where there is a minimal presence of the Chaos Beasts, at least compared to the New World.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
A month after the defeat of Enhela, Aggresiel returned to the domicile and shared with her sisters with some exciting good news. The news was guessed by one of her sisters, that being the death of Enhela.

Her sisters took the news in satisfaction as the uncertain threat was now gone. Aggresiel then put up the proposal in asking her sisters their permission to contact the great guild, which the idea was unanimously agreed to by most.

Once she got her sisters approval, Aggresiel planned to get started right away, commenting it's all for the sake of a good conversation. That being said, since Aggresiel was accompanied by Billiophia to make arrangements.[2]

Aggresiel and Billiophia made their way to the Baharuth Empire, finding themselves in Arwintar. Though they lacked money and were getting hungry and attempted to find work. They managed to meet with the merchant Osk, and pleaded to for him to hire them as fighters at the Grand Arena, claiming themselves to be bounty hunters. Although the merchant was doubtful of them, his aide, Headhunter Rabbit convinced him otherwise.

Aggresiel and her sister were set to fight on the last day of Go Gin's comeback training matches. They were to have a friendly match against two members from Silver Thread Bird: Freivalds and Fan Long. Aggresiel and her sister were regarded as newcomers, but they surprised the crowd with their physical strength and skill and won the match. Although there were a few complaints from those in the crowd, who were hoping that the adamantite adventurers would lose, which the Aggresiel found rude as it was a good match. This allowed Fan Long to strike a conversation to explain about the behind the scene bets and credited her as being strong.

When Freivalds praise her and Billiophia for being stronger than expected, Aggresiel proved her awareness of Freivalds and his team's reputation of being the slayers of the Radiant Crawler and the best adventurers in the Empire. After the end of the match, she and Billiophia went to Osk to receive their payment and shortly left the arena.

Their next destination turned out to be the Singing Apple Pavilion where they ate with some workers. At the end of the meal, they headed to the lodging facility prepared by the Empire for the representatives of the Sorcerer Kingdom. Their approach was noticed by the Shadow Demons lurking about. However, Aggresiel and Billiophia shocked the demons, when they addressed them directly, displaying that the women could perceive them despite their abilities of stealth. Aggresiel and her sister demanded an audience with Prime Minister Albedo. The Shadow Demons seeing that the pair were unfazed, got clarification from their mistress on how to proceed, permitted the women to pass into the room where the Overseer Guardian and the protagonist were waiting.

At their introductions, Aggresiel expressed how grateful she was for the members of the Sorcerer Kingdom were sparing her some time and introduced herself and her sisters as being members of the Mercenary Knights. The name of the group, only elicits a response of confusion from Albedo as she was not aware of such an organization in the Empire.

Aggresiel hearing this commented out loud that this may explain why that she and her sister were unable to find work, before Billiophia urged her to focus on the conversation at hand. The girl then apologized and explains that she and Billiophia were currently working at the Grand Arena for pay, which the Sorcerer Kingdom delegation had no doubt witnessed.

Upon hearing Albedo's name, Aggresiel became greatly exhilarated with the Prime Minister, lauding her elegance and dignity, before Billiophia reminded her to focus. Though the knight could not help herself as she was in the presence of one of the people who they admired for so many years.

When Billiophia commented that Albedo was studying Aggresiel's armor her younger sister told her that she should have removed though. Though Aggresiel claimed she cannot remove them just as Billiophia could not remove her nails. She apologized to Albedo telling her that the equipment was just as much as a part of her and it was not her intention to bring a weapon to their meeting.

In response to Albedo asking if this was a way to evoke interest from her, Aggresiel commented that the Prime Minister possessed your keen insight. And that she was a fitting person for the protagonist to serve. This brought surprise from Albedo that the girl knows of the protagonist, to which Aggresiel explains she has been watching her for a while now and was impressed by her leadership on the ground.

Billiophia commented to Aggresiel that the other party must think that they were spies, and told her older sister to stop acting suspicious, which the leader of the Mercenary Knight apologizes again, assuring the other party that she truly just wanted to talk.

The Sorcerer Kingdom party then asked questions on their identities and how they could be part of some organization that does not exist. Having expected these questions and the Sorcerer Kingdom's incredible intelligence network, Aggresiel clarified that the Mercenary Knights were not fictional. In fact they were beings who traveled to various world and took on different identities.

After Albedo realized that Aggresiel and Billiophia were being like the protagonist, that they came from "inside the Crack." Though the knight clarified that they actually called it the Corridor. Aggresiel hearing from Albedo's words, she proud that she was convinced. Furthermore, she noted that it appeared the protagonist shared the same ancestry as them and was happy to be able to interact with a kindred spirit.

This still caused Albedo and the protagonist to still wonder that they had been spying on the Sorcerer Kingdom of a prolonged time. Aggresiel and Billiophia stated that it was not the case, stating that they took notice due to the commotion that followed involving the realm, after a priest named Enhela from the Slane Theocracy got deeply involved. Aggresiel confirmed that from his "presence," the priest was also a kindred but was using some evil power.

At the mention of the mad priest, the protagonist was worried that Aggresiel and her people were in contact with him. Aggresiel denied this as the people of the Theocracy, which proclaims human supremacy, were incompatible with her sisters. In fact she was very much offended by the priest and was glad he had been eradicated.

Having said her piece, Aggresiel asked if Albedo and the protagonist still had doubts about her and Billiophia. Still the members of the Sorcerer Kingdom had questions of what world they came from. Aggresiel provides she and her sisters came from a world where they have adventured all over, but now find themselves in a world where there is a minimal threat from the endless monsters that appear from the Cracks.

The monster that Aggresiel mentioned are the Chaos Beasts...however, even in such a world, it is slowly heading towards destruction. Hence the reason for Aggresiel coming to the protagonist and Albedo as she and her sisters were hoping that they could share their wisdom from the people of the Sorcerer Kingdom, who are guiding the humans of the current world in a positive direction...and lend their strength.

Of course, the knight was not talking about doing something right away and first would like to build a friendly relationship first. To show her sincerity she gave them a toothy smile, though Billiophia informed her it was having the opposite effect. Aggresiel believed her was being a bit too stiff, reminding her that they were in the presence of the people who may be the members of the guild they admired and read about for years.

In response to Albedo and the protagonist's questioning looks about the word "guild", the girl elaborated that her sisters possess documents that recorded the great deeds of a certain guild. And while in the Chaos Zone, Aggresiel claimed she spotted the protagonist and members of the Sorcerer Kingdom. Despite the lack of proof, from that moment Aggresiel believed that the group were from the legendary guild, however the girl's intuition told her so.

Albedo still needed more proof to confirm what Aggresiel said, and asked her to tell her more about this guild she believed the Sorcerer Kingdom was associated with. At that Aggresiel to provide Albedo the information, which involved reciting a series a series of facts about the guild, such as managing to defeat a punitive force of 1,500 people, was a guild made up of only heteromorphic species like her sisters, fought off against righteous hunters of other races, had a World Champion and World Disaster within their ranks, and was called Ainz Ooal Gown and was led by a guildmaster named Momonga. All these words were from her creator, who was a long-time admirer of the famous guild of Ainz Ooal Gown.

The stunned reaction from Albedo and the protagonist pleased Aggresiel who sensed that they were beginning to believe her words. The girl still assured Albedo that she meant not to make her uneasy. She was aware that Albedo's organization. now called themselves the Sorcerer Kingdom to hide their identities, but she and her sisters understood and were aware about keeping things discrete with this kind of information. Aggresiel expressed how long she wanted to meet her creator's idols who she also idolized.[3]

The members of the Mercenary Knights apparently left afterwards, and Albedo and the protagonist passed their message to Momonga and the rest of Nazarick.[4] In the meeting Aggresiel conveyed that she and her sisters were of another world. And that they wished for cooperation with the Sorcerer Kingdom. At the same time she left Albedo and the protagonist a warning, saying things in the Womb Corridor or the Crack were a little unsettling and turbulent. Unfortunately, she doesn't know exactly what will happen, but she thinks that people from the Sorcerer Kingdom may still have a chance to enter, so she would like to ask for their caution. That said she told them to be careful, as the situation in the Womb Corridor was probably because of some reckless priest from the Theocracy.

Sometime later a second meeting was schedule. The protagonist along with Shall and Doppel-Slimeko met Aggresiel and Billiophia in Arwintar at the Singing Apple Pavilion. There Aggresiel welcomed the representatives of the Sorcerer Kingdom, while enjoying a dish of pork stew that the inn served. Given that the shop had a lot of eyes watching, Aggresiel agreed with her sister Billiophia to change locations. The two guided the contact team to where they were staying. On the way to the place, Aggresiel and Billiophia demonstrated how well they knew the merchants in the Cnetral Market, by engaging with them in their banter. To explain why they were so familiar with the locals, Aggresiel explained that it was part of their mission in gathering information from a new world through ordinary people.

Once the group arrived at the room, Aggresiel complained it being too plain to entertain guests, and wondered if she and her sister should have taken the offer from Osk to board in one of his rooms he provided. Although Billiophia told her that they should not rely on Osk too much. The girl agreed that their main purpose was to keep a low profile. Talks then began between the two groups. Aggresiel took an interest on Shall. And based on her looks guessed that the other girl was some sort of princess, citing she and her had something in common, as Aggresiel admitted that she was a princess knight and thought they should be friends.

Aggresiel wasn't wrong though was surprised that Shall revealed herself as Shalltear Bloodfallen, a Floor Guardian of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. But Aggresiel and her sister were more shocked by the implications of Shalltear's words, that Nazarick still existed. Billiophia was the first to react with such enthusiasm, which Aggresiel for a change had to apologize for her passion to their guests. The sisters were understandable of why the Sorcerer Kingdom would be discreet on such information, Aggresiel bellieved that their meeting was fate.

In the continuing dialogue, Aggresiel expressed a desire of wanting to see Nazarick for herself. But saw that the Sorcerer Kingdom still did not trust them, explaining Shalltear's presence in the meeting, as a deterrent if there was any hint of hostility. During the talk, Shalltear asked the sisters if they had any information on her creator Peroroncino. While the name was not familiar, Aggresiel stated that there was a mention of a sniper in Helheim from the book Billiophia had received from their creator. Aggresiel and Billiophia were then questioned about any information they had on YGGDRASIL, such as World Items, though the information was only brief and not concrete. However when the protagonist mentioned information on a specific World Item, one that can exert mental control over an opponent who is immune to mental effects, Aggresiel inferred that she and Billiophia might know something but would reserve that for later negotiations.

Aggresiel and Billiophia would receive more shocking information from the contact team who informed him that a member of Ainz Ooal Gown, Momonga, was alive. The news thrilled them that one of their creator's idols was active. By then suspicion between the two groups had lessen and they were enjoying teatime together, drinking chocolate drinks. In their casual conversation, Aggresiel looked forward to a start of a cooperative relationship. The contact team then as a show of trust revealed Lupusregina Beta and CZ2128 Delta who were working undercover as workers in the Empire under the identities of Regi and Shizuni.

Aggresiel recognizes CZ, as being one of the people who were abducted inside the Womb Corridor. The leader of the Mercenary Knights admitted to seeing her while she traveled the Womb Corridor and was aware of the rescue operations by the humans. And that she wanted to assist but was advised against such action by Billiophia as the knights wanted to avoid the attention of Enhela.

When Aggresiel is asked by the if the sisters left the human abductees in the Womb Corridor because there was low danger to them by the Chaos Beasts, Aggresiel believed it was fine for now, though admitted that the Womb Corridor was getting unstable. She was relieved to hear that all of Nazarick's associates were rescued.

While talking to Lupusregina and CZ who were to be their contact with the Sorcerer Kingdom, Aggresiel was surprised to hear that their boss was Zero, as she and Billiophia were aware of him, or at least another version of him in another world. Aggresiel and Billiophia then explained the nature of the Cracks/Womb Corridors and that they were roads to other worlds that were similar but not quite. Once the two parties understood that they were dealing with the concept of parallel worlds, the protagonist then disclosed about the threat of the Mimics that emerged from the Cracks.

From what Aggresiel and Billiophia knew from their observation of the Womb Corridors, they had a theory that the Mimics were a result of the Calamity of Cracks and that the constant travel use of the Cracks caused the anomalies to overload and produce copies of the abductees. And while she didn't think that simply rescuing the real one would stop the spawning of the Mimics, she suspected that they were being born somewhere within the Womb Corridor.

When the protagonist shared that there were rumors of a strange group in the Katze Plains with suspicions that they were Mimcs, Aggresiel wondered these suspected Mimics returned to the Crack or dispersed elsewhere. The two groups had a bad feeling that E-Rantel would be targeted by these monsters and so together decided to head there and investigate.

Just as the group were heading out of the city, they were caught up by Headhunter Rabbit who was looking for Aggresiel and Billiophia, requesting them to fill in at the Grand Arena after some fighters chickened out of a match with a Skeletal Dragon. Unfortunately Aggresiel and Billiophia could not do it as they were on a special task, so Regi and Shizuni volunteered to take the job.

Aggresiel and the joined teams then journeyed to E-Rantel. A detour was made to the Tob Forest, where Aggresiel voiced her disappointment in being unable to see Lupusregina and CZ in action at the arena. Still she decided to take the opportunity to enjoy the sight of the natural forest. She and Billiophia found the ruins of Carne Village, where she lamented on the destruction, but believed it was inevitable given how close it was to a Crack. The protagonist offered the sisters to meet the survivors of the village in E-Rantel, though the knight dismissed the offer as there was no need to indulge in her and Billiophia's sentimentality. To her, letting people know about the upcoming potential new crisis that could pose a new threat to the world, and dispeling people's doubts too priority.[5]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Aggresiel apparently has some sort of sensory ability that enabled her to sense the life force of a person. For example, she was able to notice that Enhela's presence vanished, which allowed her to deduce he was dead.

Aggresiel's true power is unknown, but she is shown to be physically strong enough to defeat an adamantite adventurer.
Main Equipment

Leg Armor: Aggresiel's main equipment which are a pair of metal armored legs, that are used as bludgeoning weapons in combat. According to the wearer, they cannot be removed and are as much her feet to her.
Broadsword: Aggresiel appears to be equipped with a sword clipped behind her back.
Relationships

Enhela Read Gahi

Aggresiel apparently saw Enhela as an enemy and celebrated his death upon learning of his demise and even praised his killers. Though they originated from the same ancestry, being from the Sea of Possibilities, she detested his association to the Theocracy and it human supremacy. Furthermore she viewed his as a danger due to his meddling of the Cracks and possessing a dark power.

Di

From the dialogue with the other characters, Di appears to have a sisterhood bond with Aggresiel and the other girls in her team.

Billiophia

Billiophia is Aggresiel's younger sister and also second in command of the Mercenary Knights. Despite being older, Aggresiel keeps Billiophia's counsel close, as the bookworm girl keeps the energetic Aggresiel on track in her duties.

Osk

Osk is Aggresiel's current employer, working as a fighter in the Grand Arena. Initially Osk did not take her seriously, having no interest in her body-type as a warrior, but was proven wrong later on after Headhunter Rabbit told him otherwise and seeing her skills in a match.

Headhunter Rabbit

Heahunter Rabbit was the person who convinced Osk to hire Aggresiel and her sister Billiophia. This was due to unconsciously sensing that who dangerously strong they were.

Freivalds

Aggresiel fought Freivalds in the Grand Arena. Though they were opponents in a friendly match, he recognized him for his reputation. Likewise the adventurer did not take his loss too bad, unlike his other companions who berated and wanted to make friends with the girl, even trying to find Aggresiel and her sister to socialize.

Fan Long

Fan Long was the opponent of her sister Billiophia who she defeated. After the match they maintained a cordial conversation, with the beastman giving credit to the girl for being strong.

Albedo

Aggresiel has shown nothing but admiration to Albedo, an associate of the guild she has long admired. Though understanding the Overseer Guardian's suspicions about her, Aggresiel makes it clear she wants to be truthful and assure that she and her sisters are no danger to her or Nazarick.

Protagonist

Aggresiel sees that the homunculus was from the same ancestry as them. Though she appears to respect him given he is an associate of Ainz Ooal Gown.

Agu is described as fairly young so his height is a bit shorter compared to a full grown goblin.
Personality

An earnest and curious young demi-human. He was the smartest in the tribe and had a respectful demeanor to strong people.
Background

Agu stated that he is the fourth son of Ah, the chieftain of Gigu.
Chronology

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Agu was being chased by a barghest and almost died from blood loss but he was saved by the Goblin Troop. Nfirea used the Purple Potion to heal him as only that potion would allow him to recover from his mortal wounds. Initially, Agu was suspicious of the purple potion possibly being a poison and showed hostility. Intimidated by Enri's goblins, Agu reluctantly consumed the potion and recovered from his wounds.

After they returned to the village, Brita and Nfirea asked Agu about the situation in Tob Forest. He was running away from the minions of the Giant of the East and told them about the Monument of Ruin. He was then warned to respect Enri, to stay away from Lupusregina Beta and to not harm anyone from Carne Village.

He was only the one to convince them that the ogres only work for goblins of their tribes and that feeding them would keep them from eating humans. The ogres were then subjected to thinking that the tribe leader was Enri to keep them in check in case anything happens to the goblins, suggested by Jugem as a countermeasure of the ogre heeding the goblins only.

When an attack came to Carne Village, Agu provided assistance to the village militia, delivering alchemical liquids to slow the advance of the Giant of the East's forces.[1]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
During the attack on Carne Village, Agu and his tribesmen along with Brita escorted the women and children to the Great Forest of Tob, while the men, goblins and ogres stayed behind to fight against the Crown Prince's Army.[2]

Agu is a hobgoblin, an offshoot race related to goblins. As a hobgoblin, not only does he possess higher physical abilities but also intellect too. This enables him to communicate clearly to humans compared to his goblin kin.
Relationships

Goblin Troop

Agu believes the Goblin Troop to be some tribe that were subjugated by Enri. Seeing as they are stronger warriors than his tribe could ever hope to produce, he adheres to their leadership and wisdom.

Enri Emmot

Customary to goblin custom where the weak obeys the strong, Agu acknowledges her authority due to the number of powerful goblins under her command.

Amanomahitotsu (あまのまひとつ) is one of the original founders of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creator of Shihoutu Tokitu and the Chief Blacksmith.

Amanomahitotsu's game avatar appearance was that of a heteromorphic crab-like monster, similar to a fiddler crab. A type that has an orange-yellow color with four hands, one of which was a giant crab claw as well as wearing goggles and smithing attire.
Personality

Like Touch Me, Amanomahitotsu shares the same passion for the hero genre and had a huge love for creating and smithing items.[1]
Background

During his time in YGGDRASIL, Amanomahitotsu joined the Nine's Own Goal, which later became known as Ainz Ooal Gown. Alongside his two guild members from the crafting classes, he stayed behind as sentries at the entrance of the Great Tomb of Nazarick when it was raided by the newly formed guild.

When their members were few in numbers and that everyone had no other choice but to fight, he abandoned his blacksmith class levels. However, after his guild successfully conquered Nazarick, he ultimately rebuilt himself into a crafting specialist. He had a habit of often consuming food that had buffing effects.[2] At one point in time, he gave the Ring of Mastery Wand to his friend Momonga before quitting the game.[3] And was known to go out of Nazarick with his guildmates to collect materials.[4]

After YGGDRASIL released the Powered Suits into the game, Amanomahitotsu had procured one after learning that even those with manufacturing-based job levels could enter combat with them. Apparently he was secretly quite confident because he happens to also played aerial combat games before. However, the moment he used the Powered Suit in combat against Peroroncino, he got easily wrecked by the latter during a mock battle between the two. After that, the suit was never seen or used by him ever again since that time.

Amanomahitotsu created two NPCs for the Great Tomb of Nazarick, one being the Head Chef, who he charged in protecting the Canteen on the 9th Floor.

Chronology

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Ainz after discovering that Red Drop had in their possession a Powered Suit, he recalled that the Treasury should two or three in its contents. Among them belonged to Amanomahitotsu.[5]

The Half Elf God-kin Arc

Main article: The Half Elf God-kun Arc
When Ainz Ooal Gown paid a visit to the canteen with his entourage, the Head Chef personally greeted and offered to make a feast worthy of the Supreme Being. Despite Ainz's protests he insisted as doing less would disgrace the name of his creator.[6]

Abilities and Powers

Amanomahitotsu is a blacksmith and the leader of the guild's crafters. He had levels in crafting classes. Like the other members that had crafting classes, Amanomahitotsu took levels in basic combat classes, so he could handle any problems to a certain extent. Because his build contained crafting classes, Amanomahitotsu felt that he was a burden during dungeon assaults.
Main Equipment

Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown: It allows the user to freely teleport between every room inside Nazarick. Every member of Ainz Ooal Gown was required to wear this ring.
Ring of Mastery Wand: This ring allows the wearer to make one wand usable by anyone regardless of class. However, it has a one-hour cool-down before it can be used on a different wand. Also, it has drawbacks like draining the wearer's mana.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Touch Me

Just like Touch Me, he is a fellow fan of the transforming hero genre.

Chief Blacksmith

The NPC Chief Blacksmith was designed as his apprentice and assigned to do blacksmith work.

Peroroncino

Amanomahitotsu and sparred with Peroroncino each other in a mock battle, ending in the former's defeat.

Nishikienrai

After Amanomahitotsu's Powered Suit failed in a fight, Nishikienrai suggested to the craftsmen to play Aberage instead.

Shihoutu Tokitu

Trivia

Amanomahitotsu is named after the Japanese god of the forge, metalcraft, and blacksmithing.
Amanomahitotsu and the other guild's crafters typically preferred to adventure by themselves.[7]
In Blue Planet's planetarium show, an image of Amanomahitotsu was used to represent the constellation and myth of Cancer.[8]
In Overlord: The Undead King, Shihoutu Tokitu sought to pay homage to his creator by creating a menu item that reflected the blacksmith in the Supreme Being Collaboration Café. At first thinking to cook Fried Crab Claws or Crab Shell Gratin, the cook settled to making a cake that resembled Amanomahitotsu's hammer.[9]

Ampetif Cocco Doll (アンペティフ・コッコドール) was the leader of the slave trafficking department of the criminal organization Eight Fingers. He was freed from by his comrades during Re-Estize's Destruction to rejoin the organization that is now under the control of Nazarick.

A skinny man, with eyes filled with lust, like those of a snake trying to determine if the prey would fit inside his mouth.
Personality

Cocco Doll appears to be either bisexual or homosexual, as he asked Succulent to capture Climb with lewd intentions and four of the Six Arms talking about giving Tuare to him as a "gift".
Background

Ever since Princess Renner's success in outlawing slavery, Cocco Doll's slave trafficking has been in decline. This has forced his department to hide their presence deeper in the Re-Estize Kingdom's underground.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Cocco Doll along with the executives of Eight Fingers meet in an undisclosed location to discuss various issues affecting the organization. He requested Zero's security services, the Six Arms, to reinforce his already declining slave trafficking division.[1] Later as when Sebas, Climb, and Brain broke into the brothel, Cocco Doll and Succulent cross paths with one of the intruders at the secret exit of the brothel and he recognized that the intruder is Climb, the Golden Princess's personal bodyguard. He then persuades Succulent to capture him alive instead of taking his head and use him as leverage against the Golden Princess as well as his own personal pleasure.

After Succulent's defeat at the hands of Brain Unglaus, Cocco Doll was knocked out by Sebas Tian from the back. The two criminals were captured, and they were subsequently handed over to the authorities.[2]

Later, during Eight Fingers meeting the organization heads talked about Cocco Doll's capture, but did not see fit to replace him nor bail him out of jail due to other priorities.[3]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
Cocco Doll is mentioned to have been still in jail due to losing his power as an executive of Eight Fingers during the demonic disturbance in the Royal Capital. The remaining members considered his current state fortunate as compared to them.[4]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
When the prisoners kept captive in the capital were freed to be drafted in to the army to fight the Sorcerer Kingdom, during the chaos and confusion of those few days, Cocco Doll had been rescued and brought to a mansion owned by Eight Fingers. The head of the slave department was thankful for his colleagues in bribing the prison guards to protect him while he was incarcerated and sparing him from the draft, though he was suspicious of their generous actions. When he finally met with Hilma Cygnaeus, Prian Polson, Olin, and Noah Zweden his suspicions were confirmed as they behaved very differently to how they were in the past. He openly accused them of being monsters but the group told him that they were this way due to the hell they experienced. Clueless to what they were talking about, he soon received his answer when Shalltear Bloodfallen arrived to transport the chosen people from the Re-Estize Kingdom to a new home in the Sorcerer Kingdom. After Shalltear guided the new citizens through the [Gate], she also took Cocco Doll with her intending him to have a session with Kyouhukou. Cocco Doll pleaded to his fellow Executives to save him, but the group sadly apologized and watched him be dragged through the portal, knowing what he'll go through before returning to them.[5]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Cocco Doll was one of the remaining members of the Executive Council that remained in what was left of Eight Fingers. The syndicate was stripped out its power by the backing nobles looking to liquidate their assets to aid in a national crisis of the Catastrophe, the other Executives had either been arrested or retired. With him and Zero only left, both formally declared Eight Fingers to be over at the last committee meeting. After leaving he mentioned that he would probably be working at a brothel.[6] It was later revealed that Cocco Doll had relocated to E-Rantel, operating as the new boss of the Black Market. He operated a inn that was actually a brothel which was managed by Isabella. He ironically was an unknowing pawn by his partner Isabella as she was really a demon that used the brothel to sate her lust for blood killing its employees. However his downfall came when his business attracted the attention of Sebas Tian and Saint Clementine. In addition Hilma ratted him out on his criminal activities and whereabouts leading the authorities to come after him.[7]

Abilities and Powers

As one of the top executives of Eight Fingers, Cocco Doll has full authority to do as he pleases in the organization relating to slave trafficking.
Relationships

Zero

Cocco Doll and Zero are both members of Eight Fingers syndicate thus their relationship is strictly work-related. Cocco hired Zero in order to make sure his slave trade isn't exposed. When Zero learned that Cocco Doll was arrested he thought he should apologize to him for what happened as this would harm the reputation of Six Arms.

Succulent

Succulent was the one sent from Six Arms to guard Cocco Doll. However, due to the situation, he did not always follow Cocco Doll's orders.

Climb

Cocco Doll thought of violating Climb before cutting his head off and sending it to Renner as a twisted gift.

Hilma Cygnaeus

Cocco Doll seems to have some prior history with the prostitute as she referred him by his first name, calling themselves 'partners'. However after he returned to the fold of Eight Fingers, he was suspicious of her and the others' generosity in getting him out of prison. His suspicions were confirmed when he saw how much she and the other Executives' personalities had changed. Cocco Doll would later understand that the others served new masters after he was taken to Nazarick.

Arche Eeb Rile Furt (アルシェ・イーブ・リリッツ・フルト) was the magic caster of the worker group Foresight who volunteered to investigate a mysterious tomb. She was also a former noble of the Furt Family and studied at the Imperial Magic Academy.

Appearance

Arche was a young woman in her adolescence with a petite build, short bob cut blonde hair with straight bangs, and blue eyes. She possessed an elegant beauty and delicate, doll-like features.
Personality

Arche was a genius young girl amongst the magic casters in the imperial magic academy. On the other hand, she was more of a silent hard worker than just being a talented person. She was almost close to fully reaching the limits of her growth potential.
Background

Arche was born to the noble Furt family of the Baharuth Empire. After discovering her potential in magic, she enrolled in the Imperial Magic Academy to further her studies as a magic caster and was praised as a genius, since she had learned spells a tier higher than rest of her peers. Furthermore, she possessed a innate talent similar to the Imperial Court Wizard and the academy’s headmaster, Fluder Paradyne. Both of said attributes eventually reached Fluder’s attention and earned her place among his group of apprentices, the Chosen Thirty. Her life, however, changed following the ascension of Emperor Jircniv to the throne. Her family was among many whose noble status had been stripped away after they were deemed incompetent in the young emperor’s eyes. Even so, because they refused to accept their new reality, her parents repeatedly borrowed money to continue the lavish lifestyle as if they were still nobles and they fell into debt, much to Arche’s frustration and disgust.

Following the emperor’s purge, she left the academy, much to Fluder’s disappointment. With no other options, she was forced to become a worker, desperately taking up job after job, some presumably illegal, to repay her family's constant debt. It was during this time that she joined Foresight, a worker group led by Hekkeran Termite, to take on more co-op missions, eventually proving herself to be an important member of the group.
Chronology

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Arche and Roberdyck Goltron returned and met up with Hekkeran Termite and Imina. Hekkeran asked about the moneylender they had seen earlier to Arche. She confessed that her family was in debt due to the extravagance of her parents' spending habits. Considering Arche's circumstances, though they deny that they are worried about her, Foresight decided to accept the quest from Count Femel to investigate the large tomb. Arche later returned home and scolded her father for wasting money as if they were still nobles. She then went to see her younger twin sisters and decided to get away from home and take her sisters with her when she finished the quest.[1]

Arche and her companions soon arrived and discovered a huge amount of treasure in one of the four affiliated tombs. She and her companions venture deeper into the underground tomb, and, as they expected, found more treasures along the way. However, they were then teleported to the 6th Floor's Colosseum and ended up meeting the master of the tomb, Ainz Ooal Gown, and some of the Floor Guardians. Desperately, Hekkeran tried to deceive him, but Ainz saw through his lies and fought them as a warrior. Later, Ainz decided to fight them as a spellcaster. Originally not sensing any magic coming from Ainz, after Ainz took off one of his rings, the tremendous amount of the power she was able to sense caused the terrified Arche to vomit, not only once, but twice. She then warned her comrades that they had to run or they would all die. After Hekkeran ended up being paralyzed by Ainz and knowing that they're outmatched against Ainz, Imina and Roberdyck told her to escape, telling her that her sisters needed her, while they would stay behind and hold off Ainz for her.[2]

Arche tried to flee through forest surrounding the colosseum whilst being chased by one of the Floor Guardians, Shalltear Bloodfallen. Her pursuer repeatedly taunts her as her attempts to attack and evade prove futile. While fleeing, she encounters what she believes is a barrier. Shalltear eventually cornered her and reveals that the barrier is actually a wall and that they are underground. Overwhelmed by this revelation and knowing there is no escape, she decided to make one last attack on her pursuer, only for Shalltear to stop her attack and restrain her. While holding Arche in an embrace, Shalltear told her that Ainz had ordered her to be killed mercifully so that she would not suffer. In her final moments, all Arche could think of was her twin sisters whom she dearly loved and fainted from mental shock after Shalltear reveals her true form before being subsequently killed. Afterwards, her corpse was harvested for resources: Entoma took her voice, Demiurge her skin, several undead her limbs, a Silk Hat Demon her head, and the leftovers became food.[3]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Arche came to E-Rantel with her comrades and hired by Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix. They trained with other workers at the Quarry under the command of Zero and Six Arms. Though some of her comrades loathed with work with a few characters.[4] Arche and her team participated in a plan to cull the Chaos Beast horde approaching E-Rantel. The Bloody Emperor used the workers to lure the horde of Chaos Beasts into a trap. Arche was among those that fell into the trap. The magic caster was the last to be dissolved her last thoughts going to her younger sisters.[5]

The girl's death would eventually reach her family who were unaware of her whereabouts at the time. News of demise would be passed to the Furt Family when an imperial messenger delivered Arche's payment for her posthumous service. Her death affected her father greatly, finally snapping him out of his false reality and accept that he was no longer a noble. In her death the money from Arche's last job was enough to pay the family's debt and also convince him to be wiser with spending and direct his focus on pursuing a path of revenge on the emperor.[6]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

By adventurer standards, Arche was equivalent to a mithril-rank adventurer, which made her a very capable arcane magic caster as she was able to cast 3rd tier spells despite her young age, which earned her an apprenticeship with Fluder Paradyne, who is regarded as the strongest wizard in the Baharuth Empire. In addition, she possessed an innate talent called the "All-Seeing Eyes", which allowed her to see the tier of a magic caster. Though initially as a student she cultivated her magical talents for academic purposes, she further honed them for combat by necessity after joining Foresight and, with her scholarly background, proved to be invaluable to their survival on several occasions.

While Fluder believed Arche had the potentially to be his peer, if not surpass him, she almost reached the limits of her growth potential.[7]
Job Classes

Reinforce Armor: A spell that raises the target's defense.
Relationships

Furt Family

Sir Furt & Madame Furt

Arche, unlike her parents, did not think highly of her lineage after losing her nobility status. In a way, because of that, she was able to easily adapt to their new status as commoners after they were removed from their position and high status during the Blood Emperor's purges. She hated her parents very much, who were unable to accept the reality that they were heavily in debt.

While they would continue to live in a prodigal lifestyle by spending money recklessly, which constantly put the family into financial trouble every single day, she went out of her way to clear up or even reduce their debt as a worker. She was disgusted with how they resorted to borrowing money from shady, possibly criminal places without her consideration. Based on these circumstances, Arche was forced to become a more driven person in life over the course of her parents carelessness, due to her now being the main provider for her family and set her sight's on earning enough to settle their debts once and or all. With that kind of mindset, Arche thought hopefully that there would be a day where she would be able earn enough money and remove their financial troubles once and for all.

However, despite her constant reminders to her parents to accept their new reality as commoners and move on, their complete obliviousness and ungratefulness to her sacrifices and efforts to keep them feed and taken care of caused Arche to instead resolve to abandon them completely once she paid off their debt and move away from them together with her younger siblings.

Ureirika and Kuuderika

Arche loved her sisters very dearly. They were her main motivation of becoming a worker and she worked tirelessly to ensure they were provided for. She thought that protecting the cheerful smiles of her sisters was her responsibility. After their parents proved themselves beyond reason, Arche planned to run away with her sisters to live elsewhere, away from their parents and their growing debt.

James

James was the butler of the Furt Family ever since Arche was a child and, as such, was a long time acquaintance of Arche, as he served her as her butler. James himself showcased a strong sense of loyalty towards Arche, as seen where despite the Furt family falling on hard times with the removal of their status as nobility and loss of their wealth, and therefore could no longer continue paying James for his services, James still continued to work for them as their sole remaining staff and continued to assist Arche in caring for her parents and younger sisters while she worked to pay off their debt. James himself was the only truly responsible adult in the Furt house hold while Arche was away on jobs, with him being primarily responsible for handling the accountancy of Arche’s earnings, calculate the needed money to take care of the family’s living expenses and paying back their debts, caring for Arche’s younger sisters and parents, and try to control her parent’s useless spending habits, all the while attempting to squeeze in his own salary in the money Arche herself earned. James supported Arche’s plans to abandon her parents due to their money problems and was making plans to help her live independently with her younger sisters once she settled their remaining debt.

Foresight

Hekkeran Termite

Hekkeran was Arche's comrade, leader, and friend. Hekkeran agreed to let Arche have the entire prize of the mission to pay her family's debt, saying she could always repay him later. He was willing to sacrifice himself to buy time for Arche and his comrades to escape from the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

Roberdyck Goltron

Roberdyck was Arche's comrade and friend. He showed displeasure when he heard about Arche's parents, saying that they should hear the voice of God, or perhaps his fists first. Roberdyck agreed in letting Arche have the entire prize of the mission to pay her family's debt, saying she could always repay him later. He was willing to sacrifice himself to buy time for Arche to escape from the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He tried to ask Ainz to be merciful with her, but failed, with Ainz instead ordering Shalltear to hunt her down and kill her mercifully.

Imina

Imina was Arche's comrade and friend. Imina agreed in letting Arche have the entire prize of the mission to pay her family's debt, saying she could always repay her later. She was willing to sacrifice herself to buy time for Arche to escape from the Great Tomb of Nazarick, saying she still had her sisters to take care of.

Others

Fluder Paradyne

Fluder was Arche's teacher in the Imperial Magic Academy. He believed that she had the potential to eventually reach his rank. However, she decided to drop out after her nobility was stripped, making her teacher feel shame for her. Not wanting to see her potential wasted, Fluder made several attempts searching for her, to no avail.

In an ironic twist of fate, Fluder unknowingly played an indirect role in her death, as she was among the worker groups he had sent, through proxy, to test Nazarick’s defenses at Ainz’s behest. Arche and her sisters’ tragic fates would have been avoided had she turn to her former mentor for help as Fluder was willing to provide for her in exchange for her continued apprenticeship.

Ainz Ooal Gown

Because of her innate talent, she could see Ainz's magic power. She was overwhelmed with fear and hysteria once she saw his true power, saying that word "monster" wasn't enough to describe him, and that she and Foresight didn't have any chance of defeating him.

Trivia

In the Web Novel, she became Shalltear's sex toy and she also teaches Ainz how to dance.[8] She was also given the privilege to later live life as a civilian in a log cabin on the 6th Floor with her sisters.[9]
In the Web Novel, Arche was Jet's senior and the one who inspired him to study magic at the Imperial Magic Academy. She also developed the Brand of the Thief and had the opportunity to enter the Ministry of Magic.[10]
Maruyama stated on his website that, after Arche failed to return, her parents sold both her sisters into slavery to start paying off their debts. The two eventually died from overwork. Overall, entering Nazarick despite the warning signs was only Arche's second mistake. Her first one was not taking her sisters and fleeing from her family sooner, especially since the Imperial Magic Academy would've likely taken her back without any fee due to her talent.
In Mass for the Dead, though Arche was declared dead in the aftermath of being dissolved in the Melting Pot, for some reason she was spotted in the space beyond the Crack wearing Chaos Adaptive Equipment. However it is unclear whether she really Arche herself or some "other being

"Sixth floor’s Guardian Aura Bella Fiora, at your command."
— Aura's Introduction
Aura Bella Fiora (アウラ・ベラ・フィオーラ) is a dark elf and one of the twin Floor Guardians on the 6th Floor in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She is the older twin sister of Mare Bello Fiore and was created by Bukubukuchagama. As a beast tamer and ranger, she is capable of controlling magic beasts and is a master of guerrilla warfare.

Appearance

Aura is a boyish looking child with dark skin and pointed ears, a signature trait of the dark elves. She has golden hair and heterochromia, her left eye blue and right eye green. She wears reddish-black dragon scale leather covered by a white and gold vest embroidered with the sigil of Ainz Ooal Gown. Below it, she has a matching set of white trousers and gold plated shoes, and around her neck is an acorn necklace emitting golden light. She is equipped with a whip around her waist and a giant, decorated bow on her back. In addition, she wears a watch given to her by Ainz, which has her creator's voice recorded on it.
Personality

Unlike her brother Mare, Aura is a very cheerful, boyish girl who is often straightforward and blunt with her remarks. She dominates over her brother, often dragging him around and telling him what to do. At first glance, she does not appear to get along with Shalltear and will usually get into small quarrels with her, but in reality, the two of them are quite close as if they are true sisters. She also inherits this from her creator.

Aura also has a collector's spirit when dealing with creatures. In the New World, she wishes to add any new unfamiliar creature she finds into her collection of beasts. However, Aura's behavior and actions when talking about Kyouhukou's cockroaches, and later, when Ainz orders her to deliver Hekkeran and Imina to Gashokukochuuou, shows that she has a fear of insects and other such creatures, which is unusual, given her role as a beast tamer.

Like all NPCs of Nazarick, Aura is completely loyal to Ainz and will sacrifice everything for his sake. She carries out her duties with great zeal and will give up on her own interests if she is ordered to. She misses her creator Bukubukuchagama dearly and enjoys hearing her voice from Ainz's watch. However, she can be outspoken about Ainz's perverse action. According to Maruyama, since Aura inherit some of the heart of Bukubukuchagama, Aura was the kind who would act in the same manner as her creator who might speak up to the little brother’s friend.[2]
Background

Aura was created by Bukubukuchagama, and much of her personality is based upon her creator's circumstances in real life. Her dominance over Mare is most likely stemmed from her creator Bukubukuchagama's belief that younger brothers should listen to and obey their older sisters.

Whenever they had to visit the other Floor Guardians for fun or do other things, Aura and her brother would always tell each other where they were headed. That was because the two were assigned to guard their Floor together by order of the Supreme Beings.

As Aura tends to go patrol the forest in the meantime, it was Mare's duty to watch over the Amphitheater for the time being. If her brother intends to leave the location, Aura is the primary person Mare needs to inform about his reason for leaving.
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
After Momonga teleports to the 6th Floor, Aura takes notice of his presence and jumps down from the Colosseum to greet her master respectfully. She then calls for her brother Mare to also pay his respects, but when he takes too long, she gets angry and begins reprimanding him. Momonga is not bothered by Mare's actions at all, telling Aura to forgive her brother and forget scolding him. Aura admits that she felt bore because there hadn't been any intruders lately to fight against. She had trouble finding someone who can keep sparring with her for more than five minutes. When her master suggested that there is Mare who is worthy of her time to fight with, she sighs and unintentionally activated her skill that caught Ainz's attention. It was to this point that Aura immediately apologizes to her master upon noticing what she had just done and canceled her skill shortly thereafter. Although she knows his undead status was what prevents him from being affected by her mind-affecting skill, she felt it would be rude top have the effect be noticed by her master, hence the deactivation. She informs her master Ainz that he was within her skill's effective radius. When her master said that her skill should not have an effect on people from the same group or guild, she shows concern whether Ainz got it mixed up with the ability to freely change the range of one’s skills.

Wondering why Momonga has come to her floor in the first place, Aura was shocked to hear from her master that he is on her floor to do some training and perform various experiments with his magic and staff. Under Ainz's order, she was given the task of using other effects from her skills which she did on the Moonlight Wolves summoned forth by him using the Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown much to her confusion and his curiosity. She was allowed to use her skill on these creatures along with her master within its radius. Responding to his next experiment appropriately, Aura has her servants bring a scarecrow for him to test his magic on. When Momonga asks if she wants to fight his summoned primal fire elemental, she agrees to do it and waits for him to summon the entity. During the summoning of the elemental, she and her brother was being protected and shielded by her own servants, the Dragonkins from its fire effect that was unleashed along the way. After her master summoned it and letting her do whatever she wants with it, she enthusiastically charges in while dragging Mare with her so that they can fight together side by side. When she and her brother finally defeated the elemental, she returns to Momonga's side and thanking him for giving her an opponent who can make her work her hardest to beat. Feeling tiresome and sweating after the battle, she and his brother were given a drink of water by Ainz to help the two energize. After witnessing the generosity and kindness from Ainz, Aura can't help but whisper that perhaps her master was not as scary as she thought he would be. Aura wonders if she and her brother were the only two who her master is nice to much to her delight while he patted her lightly on the head.

At the same time, the Floor Guardian to arrive before everyone else except she and Mare was Shalltear who later got into an argument with her. Aura would spat out several kinds of insults at the vampire including her fake chest, successfully provoking the latter to become anger by the former's harsh words. Before long, Cocytus arrives and Momonga decided to order both Aura and Shalltear from continuing this verbal exchange any longer. Once every other Floor Guardians after Shalltear finally arrive at the Amphitheater, Aura later joins them in a formal salutation toward Momonga. Together, they collectively pay their respects and admire the powerful presence their master has. She along with her brother Mare are given the order by Ainz to work together on camouflaging the Great Tomb of Nazarick using their own means or anything else they can find from other floors.[3] After the meeting was over and Momonga left, she share the same sentiment as Mare, thinking that her master's Despair Aura emanated by him was squashing her flat. Nonetheless, Aura informs her fellow Floor Guardians that she believes Ainz was a benevolent master around herself and Mare, stating how he was kind enough to offer the two a drink of water that made her colleagues jealous towards them. When Albedo started a heated argument with Shalltear, Aura was suggested by Demiurge as she is a fellow woman like them, it is her job to settle and resolve their dispute peacefully.[4]

The Emissary of the King Arc

Main article: The Emissary of the King Arc
Aura spots a Death Knight approaching the Gigantic Tree and realizes it is a messenger of Ainz. She allows him entry into the tree, giving it a Minimum ring, allowing it to shrink and enter. The dark elf girl calls Mare to get out of bed, while she gives the undead a tour of the tree. Once Mare arrives and greets the Death Knight, they sit down to listen to Ainz's relayed questions. Upon hearing the undead's questions from their master, Aura sees that her brother is confused, but nonetheless believes Ainz has a reason. On their interpersonal relationships, Aura states she has her brother, animals, and female Floor Guardians as company. She answers for Mare, stating that he is a bookworm and hardly goes out. She berates him to make friends, to which Mare meekly agrees. He is recommended by Aura to start with the librarian, Titus Annaeus Secundus, since they have similar interests. On the topic of their desires, Mare wants some plant monsters to raise to protect the floor, as opposed to Aura wanting a new magical beast that can fly.[5]

The Guardians' Vacation Arc

Main article: The Guardians' Vacation Arc
When Ainz calls for a meeting, Aura figures it was about an enemy attack on the tomb. However, upon learning that his master orders them to have a vacation, Aura tells her master that she is fine and doesn't need to rest much to the latter's insistence that the former obeys. Hearing his reason that she is require to have enough rest and nutrition while growing up, this encourages Aura to make harsh remarks indirectly at Shalltear. She provoke Shalltear further, stating that a hundred years from now, she will have already develop big breasts before the vampire could.

While spending her time with the Guardians in private, Aura was deeply stress not knowing what is troubling their master Ainz. She ask them to move on to the next topic, suggesting others to remind which one of the 41 Supreme Beings' words will they be discussing for this meeting. Learning that it was the words of Herohero they had to analyze carefully over health exam, Aura figures "the liver was red" meant that any red-blooded living creature had a red liver. Aura promised the other Guardians that she is willing to do anything as long as it is for their master Ainz.[6]

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
After Ainz reads Aura's report, it is shown that they have not yet made contact with YGGDRASIL players nor have they found any trace of them. She has done a search of the forest near the Great Tomb, and she has found a lake among the foothills of the mountain range at the end of the forest.[7]

While Ainz masquerades as an adventurer, Aura is given the task of investigating and controlling the interior of the Great Forest of Tob. At the same time, she has to gather up any lifeforms who are willing to join Nazarick along with setting up the construction of a warehouse for resource storage and emergency shelter.[8]

After Ainz and Narberal enter the Great Forest of Tob with Nfirea and the Swords of Darkness, Aura is shown to have been following behind the two ever since then. On the other hand, she is ordered by Ainz to lure out the Wise King of the Forest and have it attack them. In order to reach her intended destination of where the beast is at, she regroups with her pets Fenn and Quadracile to carry out the task. Upon arrival at the creature's hideout, with her special breath skill, she easily manages to direct and aggro the Wise King of the Beast straight toward them.

Although she wanted to make that creature as her own familiar, Aura refrains from doing it for the sake of Ainz's order as it takes precedence first. She ponders whether it was fine for her to take the creature's pelt after it dies by the hands of her master. When the creature surrenders to Ainz, Aura offers a suggestion where they should kill it and take its hide to make a great pelt. Much to Aura's regret, her master allows the creature to live and pledge its loyalty to him.[9]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
As Ainz proceeds to engage Shalltear in a death battle, Aura and Mare have been ordered to monitor the area. She was also supported by Eyeball Corpses summoned by Ainz to help her with the targeting duties and keeping their surroundings occupied. Having been given World Items for protection, the two are given the additional order of withdrawing when the enemies appear.[10]

While Ainz had a death match with Shalltear, Aura was using her ranger skill [Sky Eye] from afar to keep a close watch over how the battle between the two unfolds. Right before Shalltear lands the killing blow on Ainz, Aura releases one of her skills, making Shalltear feel a sense of hostility from her and hesitate in her attack. This in turn, allows Ainz to regain the initiative and emerge victoriously.

When the battle was over, Aura dispelled [Sky Eye] and silently chastise Shalltear's stupidity for allowing an undead like herself who is supposed to be immune to mind-altering skills end up becoming mind-controlled by the enemy. Since her brother did not know who was the victor of the battle, she informs him that their master have emerge victorious. According to her brother Mare, Aura was upset and in a bad mood upon having to see Shalltear be forced by the enemy to take up arms against their master.

Before the revival of Shalltear, agreeing with Demiurge's sentiment, Aura and the other Floor Guardians beg Ainz to never get in harm's way again and to allow them to handle any future incidents that may come. After Shalltear was resurrected back to life, Aura beckons Ainz to give the vampire a good scolding which she rightfully deserve for all the trouble caused by her until now. Once that matter was taken care of, Albedo reports to Ainz that Aura have discovered a Lizardman Village where they can then plan their next move on.[11]

The Show Must Go On!

Main article: The Show Must Go On! Arc
In the Great Forest of Tob, Aura begins making preparations to build a second Great Tomb of Nazarick. Noticing that her brother Mare is becoming uncomfortable around her, she asks why. Mare is afraid that she is having thoughts in seceding from Nazarick. Aura states that isn't the case, Ainz arrives and he explains that the structure that Aura is building is a fake tomb to detract invaders. Based on the work she had done so far, Ainz is willing to give Aura a reward for her hard work, though she initially refuses. However, due to his continued insistence about it, she consents, but only if the other Floor Guardians receive something similar.

In a meeting with her peers and master, she requests a taming room to train her animals. Later on, Aura and Mare notice a gathering of the NPCs around a bulletin for try-outs for the role of Juliet in a play hosted by Ainz. Aura declines to participate as she doesn't want to get involved in Albedo and Shalltear's shenanigans. The day before the auditions, Aura is approached by both female Guardians, who offer her high-level artifacts for her vote. Aura ultimately votes for Shalltear, and when Albedo finds out and attempts to get her to admit her guilt, the dark elf states she has evidence of the illicit bribes from both Guardians. Demiurge is informed of this, resulting in the disqualification of both women from the competition.[12]

The Sealed Evil Tree Arc

Main article: The Sealed Evil Tree Arc
Aura and Hamsuke accompany Ainz to retrieve a rare herb in the northern region of the Great Forest of Tob. The trio encounter a dryad named Pinison Pol Perlia. Through her, Ainz learns of the awakening evil treant, Zy'tl Q'ae. After Zy'tl Q'ae has fully awakened. Aura, along with other Floor Guardians, are ordered to fight together against Zy'tl Q'ae and to secure the herb for Ainz's adventurer quest from the Adventurer's Guild.[13]

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Overlord II EP01 082
Aura Having Lunch
During the morning, Aura is seen giving out orders to a contingent of golems and elder liches in constructing a warehouse in the northern part of the Great Forest of Tob. With her watch's alarm going off, she decides to take a break for the time being. As a result, she tells her coworkers to return back within an hour or so after her break time is over. In the meantime, Aura is served by Pestonya a hamburger with two pickles, french fries with the skin on, and a cola as requested by the former.[14] After Cocytus loses the war against the lizardmen, she participates in a meeting with the rest of her fellow Floor Guardians about the former's defeat. Before the meeting began though, Aura came across an unknown entity within their ranks which was Victim, a fellow Floor Guardian like them introduced by Demiurge upon asking. During the meeting, she and her brother Mare both cried after seeing how Ainz forgives Shalltear for her betrayal
