Foire is described as a young woman with yellowish bobbed hair and green eyes. Like all the homunculus maids, she wears a maid uniform, though the hem of her skirt is shorter than that of other homunculus maids.
Personality

Foire has a cheerful and outgoing personality. She likes to lie, though she is not good at lying at all. Thus, her friends just neglect her lies commonly.
Background

Foire along with her fellow homunculus maids were created by Whitebrim, Herohero, and Coup De Grâce.
Chronology

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Foire and her fellow homunculus maids are having a break in a diner. Lupusregina Beta appeared from nowhere and started a chat with them. They started a competition to see who was able to give the best title to Ainz.[1]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
In Mass for the Dead Foire was killed by whatever attacked the Great Tomb of Nazarick when it manifested in the New World. The maid was later revived up had an unfortunate encounter with a strange pumpkin that was grown in Nazarick. Foire thinking it to be edible, she brought it to the canteen on the 10th Floor for the cook to prepare. It latched unto her head and turned her into a berserk monster before the Floor Guardians burned the parasitic plant away restoring her to normal.[2]

When Nazarick had visitors that emerged from the Crack, Foire got into an argument with one of them, as the other was a maid and wished to clean the room herself. The situation was diffused by Pestonya who directed them to focus their energies on doing a cleaning competition. The competition ends up becoming a collaborative effort and the two become friends.[3]

When Shalltear Bloodfallen became acting strangely, Momonga curious to what was going on, inquired the maid if she could shed some light on the situation. Sadly Foire could not provide any further information.[4]

Another group of visitors from another world arrived in Nazarick, Foire and the protagonist were in the canteen eating their meal when they observed that one of the visitors had an appetite like a homunculus. Later she served batches of kinako bread for one of their guests to try so that the Head Chef could perfect dish.[5]

The maid would find herself working with Albedo who was on a temporary assignment as a maid for the 9th Floor. At the same time she would be part of a training drill involving the 9th Floor going on lockdown in the event of an intruder.[6]

Foire would be present in the canteen when another group of other-worlders appeared in Nazarick. Though unlike the previous groups that came, the leader was a paranoid and overly cautious, casting suspicion over the maids like Foire when they were enjoying their meals.[7]

The maid would act as an attendant to Momonga during one of his meetings with Albedo and Demiurge to discuss the impressive items possessed by a so-called hero of the shield. While Momonga wanted to avoid a conflict with the hero especially with the strange phenomena that was happening, both demons believed Momonga had some ulterior motive for befriending their new guests. Momonga confused by their subtle sinister behavior asked Foire, who watching the dialogue, if she had any idea what they were inferring, but even the maid was at a loss. Foire continued to watch the events play out as Momonga and the Floor Guardians monitored the visitors via a Mirror of Remote Viewing. When a new batch of strangers attacked the hero of the shield, Foire raised as question as to why the latter was being targeted.[8]

Foire would also participate in the Nazarick project known as "Valentine" which involved using non-buff food items of Valentine Chocolate to make into chocolate dishes. She worked with her fellow general maids and entered the Chocolate Layered Cake as their dish to be judged on whether it could be used as a diplomatic gift for dignitaries.[9]

One day when she was having lunch with Cixous and Lupusregina in the canteen, Foire and her fellow maids were among the first to witness the first show of LittleMass. After the idol group's debut she continued to follow the idols' events that were being hosted throughout Nazarick.[10] When the idols began to distribute commemorative items, Foire was seen on line getting her merchandise signed by the idols. Since Cixous was absent as she was being interviewed by Momonga on her live idol show experience, the maid asked if it was possible to acquire a signature for her friend. Sadly it was not allowed as such items were only released during limited time hand shake events. Foire would later be called upon by Momonga to give her account of the event. And later she would enjoy the final moments of the second campaign with her co-workers at the Amphitheater. Once the entertainment sow was done, the hard work put into the idol show motivated Foire and the maids to strive to work harder to repay Momonga and the Floor Guardians.[11]

At the time of the "Nazarick Swimsuit Athletic Meet", Foire was among the maids that cheered the teams participating in the competition. Due to seeing Shalltear Bloodfallen's overwhelming power to be the keystone that defends Nazarick, the maid chose to cheer for Red Group. When the competition ended in a cumulative tie, Foire and her fellow maids accepted the results and viewed it as a intense but fun game, commending both teams on their efforts.[12]

When Nazarick began its first formal Halloween Festival, Foire was a bit apprehensive of the idea, given her harrowing experience with the Pumpkin Monsters. The nearing date of the event caused her to lose her appetite at the canteen, though Cixous, Lupusregina and CZ managed to cheer her up citing the good she did when she was under the control of the invasive monsters. And that her experience helped Nazarick become more prepared. Later she was tapped by Albedo to help develop a new easily produced chocolate confection to meet the demand of the citizens of E-Rantel. For the entire length of the festival, Foire acted as Momonga's attendant as he watched the defense training of the event. Once the training was over, the Halloween Festival concluded with the NPCs gathering in the pumpkin patch on the 6th Floor.[13]

While conducting a "general cleaning" of Nazarick, Foire and Cixous stopped by the kitchen where the Head Chef gave them some mochi that was prepared on the orders of Albedo to further her study of "New Year". The two maids encountered Momonga and his party who reacted with apprehension of the offered mochi, in fear that it was an indicator that another "New Year" event was imminent. However once misunderstandings were cleared up with the maids profusely apologizing for making their superiors worry, the naivete of the two maids on the holiday caused Momonga to rethink his stance on meeting the event with caution, but instead embrace it leading to the creation of the Kakushigei Tournament. Foire along with the other general maids were present for the tournament and enjoyed the spectacle as part of the audience in the Amphitheater.[14]

The maid would join the effort to prepare for the Sorcerer Kingdom’s National Foundation Day Ceremony.[15] Foire would work to finish in time for the deadline. Sebas Tian noticing her and Cixous's weariness ordered them to rest despite their eagerness to work. On the day of the event she was present with the other general maids at the ceremony in Fake Nazarick and served food at the banquet. When the Sorcerer King Momonga Statue was unveiled she found that her fellow maids Cixous and Lumière were crying at the sight of the art piece.[16]

Foire attended the live idol show featuring the return of LittleMass. She and the general maids witness not only their favorite idols Alkaline and Acidity but a new idol named Neutrally The introduction of the new character resulted in the renaming of the idol group to LittleMasStar and while the change was unexpected, Foire and the maids came to adore the new idol and new cloth tag dolls and lottery prizes that came with the idol campaign.[17]

Whilst having a meal at the canteen, Foire talked to Cixous about the rumored new area that was being constructed on the 9th Floor. Though all the two knew about it was that it was a entertainment facility, they still hoped to be given the chance to use it once it was done.[18]

Foire and Cixous eventually made time to go to the new area, Casino Resort Nazarick, and played the games there with the instruction of the elder liches manning the tables. There Foire witnessed Cixous play roulette and double her winnings from 10 chips to 20 chips. She and Cixous met with Lupusregina and CZ who commented on the casino being very popular as well as the installed fan and refrigerator which the maids claimed to be useful items, making their stay at the casino more enjoyable.[19]

During the New Year's event, Foire fell under the holiday's mental influence and began working with the general maids and Head Chef to prepare New Year dishes. After the influence was broken, Foire joined the maids and the rest of Nazarick in celebrating New Year's by watching live performance of LittleMasStar with Narberal and Lupusregina acting as guest stars.[20]

Foire and Cixous would later serve a tea party hosted by Aura for Yuri and Pestonya to talk about the upcoming plan to create a new chocolate product. The two general maids were included in the discussion as they brought the recreated dishes of the previous prototypes to help brainstorm. When the New Valentine's Plan was started, the maid helped to create new flavors for the candy in Golden Chocolate In A Bottle.[21]

Cocytus would approach Foire and Cixous after being put in charge of developing a new "chilled chocolate" dish. The maids were surprised by the Floor Guardian's placement as the one leading the project, but obliged to be interviewed and told him about the previous four chocolate dishes that were made at a taste party when chocolate was being researched in Nazarick. The interviewed stopped when Pestonya brought snacks of monaka for Cocytus's break and asked the maids to resume their duties. Later Foire was mentioned to be busy preparing recreations of the four chocolate dishes for Narberal to try, who was assisting Cocytus. At the reenactment of the taste party, Cixous spoke on behalf of Foire who was on duty serving Momonga, about the chocolate cake that they had devised for Narberal's benefit. The maid was present when Cocytus and Narberal released the Chilled Chocolate Confectionary before Momonga.[22]

In an emergency operation to create a new batch of luxurious chocolates for a noble's party, Foire assisted the Pleiades in preparing a special batch of Natural Forest Chocolate.[23]

At the inception of the Bard Plan, a rock music venue was held on the 9th Floor in a corridor for the general maids. Foire and Cixous were present watching CZ and Narberal play their rock music. Foire and the other maids enjoyed the show and pointed to the group that their band lack a name. Later at the next venue in the bar on the 9th Floor, Foire and Cixous came up with a name for the rock band: Βγδth. For the rest of the plan, Foire followed the appearances of Βγδth, cheering them on as they appeared around Nazarick and finally witnessing them face off against LittleMasStar in a final live show.[24]

Foire was a frequent visitor of Casino Resort Nazarick, where she developed a competitive streak with Cixous. When the event "Rare Item Acquisition Day" was being organized, she and Cixous were invited by Mare at his betting strategy lecture to help their fellow general maids familiarize themselves on the easy tactics and games. At the event it was revealed that it would held for a three day period for the general maids, with the Pleiades being reassigned to fulfill the duties of their junior, Foire and her peers were worried of their jobs being taken but were given assurances by the Pleiades it was only temporary and that the event was for their enjoyment. At the betting tables, Foire made use of Martingale's Method, involving making gains through short-term decisive gains through betting it all. She and Foirewere nearly tied with each other and aimed to win the life-sized Momonga Plushie. At the last game Cixous won over ten thousand chips and was expected to cash her gains for the prize. In the end Cixous choose friendship and instead used her chips to acquire two novelty mugs for her and Foire, who likewise did the same using her remaining chips.[25]

At the time of New Year’s Eve, Foire and Cixous helped decorate the 9th Floor. Once they were done the two maids were told by Pestonya to help the Head Chef prepare dishes for the holiday.[26]

To celebrate the success of the rescue mission of the members of the Pleiades from the Chaos Zone, a celebration was held in the Amphitheater. Foire along with Cixous assisted in making preparations for the banquet.[27]

Foire was the maid on duty in the Round Table Room when the Floor Guardians and Momonga were monitoring the state of the three kingdoms being affected by the mists of miasma. When the disembodied voice of Kuyō rang out through the dungeon, Momonga gave orders for all Floor Guardians with a Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown to evacuate the dungeon as it was possibly compromised. He then ordered Foire to escape herself and spread the word to all the other general maids.[28]

Unfortunately Foire was the only general maid to safely evacuate. Due to her being the most vulnerable person, Momonga had Shalltear's remaining 1st Floor subordinates to guard the homunculus in case Enhela planned to use her in his nefarious plot. In the meantime he the Floor Guardians and the Pleiades executed a plan to retake Nazarick.[29]

A year later after Enhela's defeat, Foire was seen accompanying Pestonya and Cixous in the 9th Floor when the were approached by Momonga, actually Pandora's Actor, and the protagonist. None of the maids in their interaction with "Momonga" were aware of his real identity and chatted with their supposed liege. After the interaction, before returning to her duties, Foire felt that the humans were so lucky to be ruled by such a wonderful person.[30]

By New Year’s Day the maid was seen laying down a banquet feast for the holiday for the many guests that arrived at the Amphitheater.[31]

Foire is mentioned to do inspections of Momonga's bath with Éclair to check on Miyoshi's cleaning which is always impeccable. At a cherry blossom viewing to celebrate the Defense Tree's contributions to the defense network, the maid attended the event with several general maids, she and her peers were greeted by Momonga. When asked by their liege if they were having a good time, the maid said she was just happy to be able to attend the event.[32]

Foire's abilities and class are generally at level one. Like all of the homunculus maids, she has a racial penalty called Increased Food Consumption, due to which she needs to eat a lot of food.

Freivalds is the leader of Silver Thread Bird. At one point, he and his team slew the Radiant Crawler, an amazing feat that cemented their saga.
Chronology

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
In the Imperial capital city, Freivalds and his team were hired as bodyguards by Emperor Jircniv to protect him during a secret meeting with the emissaries of the Slane Theocracy and High Priests of the Empire at the Colosseum.

After the match between the Sorcerer King and the current Martial Lord, he and his team decide to move to the Karsanas City-State Alliance.[1]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
A year after the defeat of Enhela Read Gahi, at the behest of Osk, Freivalds and Fan Long participated in a friendly match at the Grand Arena against two female newcomers. Initially wanting to go easy on them, after hearing that Emperor Jircniv was secretly in attendance, decided to give a show to show his and Fan Long's skills.

The match ended in the newcomers victory. Despite the loss, Freivalds admitted to their opponents that they were stronger than expected. When their opponents knew of his team's reputation, Freivalds was proud that the two foreign women knew his team and was about to provide a song, but was stopped by Fan Long.

Upon regrouping with the rest of Silver Thread Bird, his teammate Keila no Södersten complained that he was giving too much glory away to the newcomers even if it was just a friendly match. Though in Freivalds defense it could not be helped as the women were stronger than expected.

Soon Osk and Headhunter Rabbit joined the conversation and revealed what scant information they had on the mysterious characters. After learning that the women just took their paid and left the arena. Having heard that the women were hungry prior to meeting Osk, Freivalds thought they may have gone to the Singing Apple Pavilion and wanted to head there for a social gathering with them. Though this idea was rejected by his teammates, causing the bard to be despondent and whine that they were being so cold.[2]

Freivalds and his team participated in the Chocolate Cup event at the Grand Arena, defeating a Skeletal Dragon in a match.[3]

It includes the new standalone characters that had a first-time appearance in the game. Meanwhile, the old characters had a different role and fate than from the main storyline in the official books. For that reason, it has no connections to the canon story materials of Overlord Light Novel series. The content that you had read here are based on the Overlord mobile game.



Frozen Giant (フローズンジャイアント) was a unique Chaos Beast that appeared in Mass for the Dead. Later more copies of the monster, called Ice Chaos Beasts, would appear from another Crack.

Appearance

A humanoid creature that visually resembles a golem, composed of a sphere ice armored body, with a grill that is vaguely like a grin. It is supported by a two smaller chunks of snowballs and its limbs are of equally spherical ice balls. The entire body is frozen with large chunks of ice and held together by roots. It has a featureless humanoid head that is attached to the large spherical body with a protruding icicle.
Personality

The monster showed very little signs of intelligence. Though the monster would be best described as a berserker, since it attacked anything that approached it, even other Chaos Beasts.
Background

From what CZ2128 Delta was able to deduce, a Crack had emerged into existence within a closed icy cave in the northern regions of the Azerlisia Mountains. Due to the enclosed area, the Chaos Beasts that were produced from the portal were unable to escape. However due to the contaminated miasma from the Crack, this affected the earth around it.

Somehow a lone Chaos Beast became encrusted with the soil and snow, turning it into a giant monstrosity. The new monster proceeded to destroy its brethren, seeing them as threats and then going dormant once the monsters were neutralized by it. Later on, the monster would go on to awaken and resume its aggression when the Crack regularly continued to produce Chaos Beasts into the world for it to destroy.

The cycle continued to repeat within the enclosed cave. Eventually, the repeating battles collapsed a part of the structure of the ice cave which led to opening it to the outside. With the world open to them, a few Chaos Beasts managed to slip past the giant and escape from the cavern.
Chronology

Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
The creature's constant blows on the emerging Chaos Beasts in the cavern resulted in it inadvertently creating a steady stream of cold air that blew from the cave and into the mountains, which soon on evolved into a cold wave that began to drive the native monsters from the northern peaks to the base of the mountains. The monsters seeking shelter targeted the village of the Green Claw, where the various lizardmen tribes were gathering to unite in response to the new changes in the world. While the monsters were not problem for the warriors of the lizardmen, the reptilian demi-humans were unprepared by the cold front that followed their attackers. The cold weather began to spill from the mountains and into the wetlands, bringing winter to the area and threatening the natives. Cocytus who was stationed at a nearby resource mine for Nazarick, quickly came to the aid of the lizardmen.

The chieftains and Floor Guardian united and managed to stay off the attacks thanks to Cocytus's intervention and the reinforcements from the skeleton miners. Using the little remaining Heatstones in the area, Cocytus managed to save Nazarick's allies from freezing to death, but sensing this was an abnormal situation, Cocytus sent a call for help to his master Momonga. Momonga having received the call, sent out three members of the Pleiades: Lupusregina Beta, CZ2128 Delta, and Entoma Vasilissa Zeta to lend their aid to the Great Lake and to investigate the incident. Upon arriving at the area, the combat maids discussed with the tribal leaders of the lizardmen to learn exactly what transpired. According to Cocytus and Zaryusu Shasha just before the monsters started migrating and the cold wave hit, a cave-in at the mine had occurred. And from the testimonies of the druids of the tribes, the maids were able to piece together that the answer to the cold wave laid north, past where the mind was located.

After following the mine path, the maids then crossed into uncharted territory where they came upon a desolate icy wasteland. They encountered various Chaos Beasts that seemingly emerged after a gust of wind blew out. The three's journey led them to a cave where they found the Crack within and also the Frozen Giant in dormancy. Lupusregina believed that the construct was harmless due to its adorable appearance. Once she attempted to approach it, the giant rose to attack her. The maid narrowly missed it, but it was enough to convince the maids that diplomacy could not be use to reason with the monster.

Entoma seeing no reason to hold back, launched herself at the giant, only to be knocked back. CZ, ordered her sisters to stay back, and demonstrated that the giant only responded and attacked when they were in close range. The maids believed that they would have ample time to solve the situation, when the Crack activated and Chaos Beasts appeared. Observing that the giant targeted the Chaos Beasts, and that its blows were causing cold air to blow out from the cavern, they deduced that the giant was the cause of the cold front.

To have less distraction while destroying the giant, the maids eliminated the Chaos Beasts first. Since using fire attacks was believed by Lupusregina to be ineffective in melting away the frozen body, CZ advised that she target the roots holding the entity together. A plan was made so that CZ would act as a target while Lupusregina would attack it from behind where it was vulnerable.

The three maids defeated the monster and proceeded to melt it down. Originally thinking that the creature was some sort of golem, they were surprised when they found that the core of the giant was actually a Chaos Beast all along. The destruction of the Frozen Giant ended the cold front and abnormal weather, allowing the temperature at the wetlands to return back to normal.

The existence of the giant was reported to Momonga and the other Floor Guardians. From their accounts, Demiurge is surprised to learn that the Frozen Giant was some sort of freak accident created from the contaminated soil. Since its discovery that the miasma could not just affect creatures but the earth, all Crack sites within Nazarick were being re-investigated to see if similar phenomena occurred.[1]

Some time before Shalltear was brainwashed, the Floor Guardian visited the Crack where the Frozen Giant appeared in the Azerlisia Mountains. Though the unique Chaos Beast was previously defeated, the Crack which it originated was an area of interest to Nazarick. After the berserk Chaos Beast vanished, the Crack acted oddly in that it did not spawn regular Chaos Beasts, but exact multiple copies of the Frozen Giant which were then named Ice Chaos Beasts. Evil Lord Envy was posted at the site to contain the monsters and supervised Shalltear, Lupusregina and two Vampire Brides engage the Chaos Beasts for training purposes.[2]

A year after the establishment of the Quadripartite Alliance, and the death of Enhela Read Gahi, Evil Lord Envy reported that there several Ice Chaos Beasts roaming the Azerlisia Mountains, originating from some yet unknown Crack. Aura, Mare and Lupusregina were dispatched to locate the Chaos Beasts and the Crack. By chance they encountered Antilene and her companion Rei from the Theocracy. The dark elves approached the pair while Lupusregina went invisible and tailed the group.

After learning that the pair were in the mountains to train, the twins offered to join them on a hunt of the Ice Chaos Beasts. After the hunted the two groups parted amiably. Aura and Mare passed on the information of the new Crack to Demiurge who learned some interesting new facts about this new type of Chaos Beast. The Crack that spawned the Chaos Beasts were designated to be a new hunting ground. Given the danger the Chaos Beasts presented, the Sorcerer King ordered the information be passed to the dwarves of the Dwarf Kingdom.[3]

Abilities and Powers

Under bizarre circumstances the Frozen Giant was an amalgam of snow and ice debris centered around a Chaos Beast entity. It displayed impressive strength, in that a single blow from it is enough to create powerful wind pressure.

Despite its formidable power, it does have a few weaknesses. The giant only attacks and targets enemies that are within a few feet of it nearby. Once outside of its range, the giant will simply fall asleep. Additionally, a flaw in its structure were the vines that held most of its limbs it place. Though the ice entombed body made it impervious to fire attacks, the vines were still susceptible to damage.

The new iterations that have emerged since original mark the birth of a new type of Chaos Beast. These Chaos Beasts are born somewhere in the soil, emerging from it, covered in soil contaminated by miasma. While they do no exude the cold temperatures like the Frozen Giant they are much stronger. In truth the cold air that the Ice Chaos Beast emits changes depending on the amount of soil it is surrounded by and the degree of contamination.

Similarly, the quality and quantity of contaminated soil affects the number of Chaos Beasts that appear from the Crack.[3]
Active

Giant Hail Hammer: An attack which shoots out large icicles from the ground where the arm hits and attacks the whole area.

Gagaran (ガガーラン) is an adamantite ranked adventurer and a warrior from Blue Roses.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Usually mistaken for a man, Gagaran is an extremely muscular woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes. She is rarely seen without heavy crimson plate armor and her mighty war pick. On her head rests a silver tiara, likely enchanted.
Personality

More than her strength, she emits a profound atmosphere of reliability, almost a "big brother" feeling that makes her extremely appreciated in the team. She has the highest respect and desire to help other people of the members of Blue Rose.

Unlike most humans, Garagan holds no prejudice against non- or demi-humans. She has even professed disgust at the Slane Theocracy's practice of exterminating whole communities of other races. However, Gagaran has no inhibition when it comes to fighting and killing dangerous non-humans who have proven themselves a menace.

A proclaimed hobby of hers is picking "fresh cherries", referring to young, virgin men. Whenever such men affirm sex with her would be enjoyable, even in jest, Gagaran would immediately overpower and drag them into a room with her. This is a fate Climb often has to avoid.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Gagaran has a self-anointed nickname of "Lovely Warrior Full of Mystery", which stems from her past before joining Blue Roses, a mysterious period she does not like to talk about, even with her friends. She saved the then would-be adventurer Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra, which led her to become one of the initial members of Blue Rose. She lost to Gazef Stronoff during the Grand Tournament held to decide the King's bodyguard.

Gagaran had fought numerous battles with the Sunlight Scripture. During those encounters, she developed a distaste for the religious fanatics due to their cold-hearted nature in slaughtering innocent demi-humans.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Gagaran refuses to accompany Lakyus to visit Princess Renner due to her dislike of formal events. She and Evileye decide to go to one of the highest class inns in the Kingdom. She sees Climb and they have a conversation with him. They talk about Martial Arts, magic, and the new adamantite adventurer team, Darkness, with Climb. She then encourages Climb to work towards his goal of being a better bodyguard for the Princess.[1]

She later joins in the operation to attack several bases belonging to Eight Fingers alongside the rest of her party. Before heading out, she talks to Brain, possibly to see if he was trustworthy enough to protect Climb, who was heading with the famed swordsman to another location. During the attack, she and Tia encounter a monster dressed like a maid and eating human flesh. After a short conversation, Gagaran realizes that the maid could endanger civilians and attacks. She is easily subdued but was saved by the intervention of Tia.

Despite having support from Tia, the two adventurers try to defeat the monster, but fail. Before they can be eaten, Evileye intervenes. With Evileye's help, they finally defeat the insect maid. As they attempt to finish her off, however, another monster arrives and interrupts them. Evileye immediately tells Gagaran and Tia to flee while she holds the demon off. Before Gagaran and Tia can get far, the demon summons black flames, which kills them instantly. Their bodies are later recovered by Evileye with the help of Darkness. Gagaran and Tia are resurrected, but are urged to stay out of the next battle because of their depleted strength.[2]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
In a conversation between Renner and Blue Roses, it is shown that Lakyus is helping Gagaran and Tia to recover the experience they lost when they got killed by Jaldabaoth by constantly placing themselves in danger.[3]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
She is present at the meeting with the delegates from the Holy Kingdom Liberation Army along with the other members of Blue Rose. During the meeting, Tia and Tina make fun of Gagaran's huge physique, much to her annoyance. She then borrows a flask of water from Neia Baraja to pour a drink for her companions present in the meeting. Later, when Paladin Order Grandmaster Remedios tries to recruit Blue Roses to their cause by saying that all they need to do is wait in the rear and help with healing magic, Gagaran is the first to call Remedios out for her bullshit. She reasons that this is because the envoys don't have the luxury of doing that in the first place. When Gagaran is told by Tia that the statement said by one of the envoys, Gustav, to be true, she feels dumbfounded to hear her companion actually trust and believe the paladin's words at face value.[4]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
When Blue Roses is invited to a meeting location by someone unbeknownst to them, Lakyus suggests that that there isn't any need for all of them to participate together. Because Lakyus is meeting up with her uncle, Azuth Aindra, Gagaran shows her understanding of why Lakyus did not want to invite them into the meeting, saying that there must have been a lot for the two of them as family members to discuss in private. Nonetheless, this doesn't stop Gagaran and the rest of Blue Roses from joining their leader in the secret meeting arranged by their unknown client, later revealed to be the Black Scripture. She is concerned whether the Black Scripture have resorted to violence or threats in recruiting almost all of the adventurers in the Kingdom to join the Theocracy, to which the latter says they did not.[5]

Later, when the capital Re-Estize is already surrounded by the Sorcerer Kingdom's forces, Gagaran and the rest of Blue Roses meet up with Renner, Climb, and Brain in the palace. When Evileye suggests to Lakyus that they have enough time to drink some tea together, Gagaran is forced to follow along with her ploy. While Gagaran states that she wants to drink a large amount of tea, this makes Lakyus believe that they are looking to simply drink Renner's tea out of kindness for the princess, who offers it to them. With Lakyus not equipped with any combat-related gear and successfully drugged, she and Tia immediately spring into action and attack her, with Gagaran repeatedly throwing heavy punches at her leader.

While Lakyus is weakened by whatever effect the drug from the tea has on her, Gagaran and Tia continue attacking their leader aggressively until the latter is weak enough to be put under mind control by Evileye's spell, [Charm Person]. Under Evileye's order, Gagaran opens the window and lets some air into the room to contain the smell of Lakyus' blood from spreading. Once Lakyus heals herself and Tina returns, she and the other members of Blue Roses leave to help their leader retrieve her equipment in the inn before proceeding to teleport away from the Royal Capital.[6]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
While having a meal at a local bar with Tia, Gagaran notices Zero and Peshurian pass by. When learning about their shady past and how they were seemingly turning over a new leaf from Tia, Gagaran found it ironic as Tia could relate.[7] Later at Princess Renner and Lakyus's orders, the adventurer shadowed Climb in the refugee camps near the Royal Capital. When the bodyguard was about to be mugged by thieves she stepped in and saved him. Together they brought the thieves to the proper authorities.[8]

Gagaran later attended a meeting at the palace with Lakyus and Evileye. There, with the exception of the Evileye, the members of Blue Roses spoke with Princess Renner. The topics the three women discussed were over the changes in the world such as the Cracks, Chaos Beasts, and Contaminated Beasts that were plaguing the three nations and the culmination of the Tripartite Alliance. Though hopeful that the three nations were cooperating with each other in these dangerous times, she knew that there was a lot of work to be done. As the meeting progress Gagaran feeling bored decided to stretch her legs and bother Evileye who was in the library. The big woman dragged her magic caster friend out to grab a drink, but not before finding Climb and having a brief spar with him. Later at a bar she met with Brain and tried to flirt with him but was politely turned down, but they shared a gregarious time with each other. Once she and Evileye finished their drinks they were back to the palace, where Lakyus, Tina and Tia were waiting to inform them of their new job from the Kingdom which involved eliminating monsters from a mine.[9][10]

The mine being near E-Rantel, gave Gagaran the opportunity to observe the recovering city. Before they took on the princess's mission, Gagaran tagged along on a personal task of Lakyus. This was prompted, when a couple of adventurers from the Swords of Darkness mentioned about the possible location of the sword Hyumilis, Lakyus eagerly wanted to know more about the details. After learning about the sword's whereabouts, Lakyus claimed to the silver ranked adventurers that it was dangerous as the sword was cursed which Gagaran vouched for her to be true. Despite the warnings of the adamantite adventurers the Swords of Darkness came with them. The adventurers followed the trail and found the sword but it turned out to be just an item that was infested with a monster.[11]

Gagaran would participate in a large scale monster subjugation assignment from the royal family to clean out an abandoned mine. Blues Roses alongside the protagonist and Slimeko journeyed into the caverns to find it not just filled with monsters but also demons. More strangely the entire layout of the mine was altered leading the adventurers to suspect something dark was afoot. From the evidence left behind the adventurers deduced that some sort for demonic summoning happened and the demons turned on their masters. Rather than retreat the adventurers insisted on pressing on to eliminate the threat. Gagaran soon reached the deepest part of the mine and came face to face with Abyss Demon who was powered by magic making him near invulnerable. Despite the odds the adventurers defeated him, but as the demon lay dying, he triggered a mechanism that caused the mine to be filled with poison gas. Forced to retreat Blue Roses escaped the mine disappointed that they were unable to acquire the mine for the Kingdom.[12]

Gagaran and her team would encounter the protagonist, Surako and Soi when the two adventurer teams worked together at the request of Princess Renner to find the cause of the string of kidnappings in E-Rantel. The teams worked together to organize a sting operation using Suarko as bait which led to the capture of a suspect that Gagaran then brought to the authorities. The man confessed about Zurrernorn to be behind the kidnappings, leading the adventurers to the E-Rantel's Cemetery where they found Six Arms to be working for Khajiit Dale Badantel. In the ensuing fight, Gagaran defeated Malmvist. In the end the adventurers defeated the cultists and arrested all of the members of Six Arms save for one.[13]

With only one member of Six Arms still at large, Gagaran worked with her team to locate Zero before the criminal could cause an incident during the conference of the Tripartite Alliance. Blue Roses were unable to find any trace of him, making Gagaran ask where he could be. When a horde of Chaos Beasts threw the city into a panic, Gagaran joined in the defense of the city to protect the residents whilst the protagonist and his team engaged the leader of the horde.[14]

On a mission to acquire much needed armors and weapons from a dwarf named Tsuibayaya, Gagaran's team met with the protagonist, Suarko and their comrade Narberal Gamma who were also looking for the dwarf. Since they were looking for the same being the two teams decided to collaborate. Their search took them to the beach near the village where the dwarf lived. They found the dwarf but to her annoyance the dwarf refused to help them until he acquired the scales of the Legendary Mermaid for his masterpiece. The adventurers ultimately decided to seek the mermaid for him and in exchange the dwarf loaned several sets of swimsuits to Blue Roses save for Gagaran as he had none to give her. Following the clues to the local legend the adventurers determined who and where to summon the mermaid. The Legendary Mermaid as it turned out was a male and a hermit that was confused as why they wanted his scales but agreed to give them unless they battled him. Gagaran immediately accepted the challenge to her comrade's dismay. After the demi-human was defeated, the merman gifted his scales to Gagaran thanking for the battle and also reminding him of his long gone lover. With the scales, Tsuibayaya used them to create the Sage's Swimsuit which he offered Gagaran to wear as he deemed her the best model for his work. Though he results were mixed by her friends, Tsuibayaya was overwhelmed by the fulfillment of his work that he gave the item to her.[15]

On another assignment by King Ramposa III, she and her team worked with the protagonist in locating a missing Gazef Stronoff. The two teams tracked Gazef's last whereabouts to a remote cave in the north. There they had to fight against two Spear Chaos Beasts that guarded the entrance. Only by working together and with the aid of Brain Unglaus were the adventurers able to vanquish them.[16] Once the entrance was opened, Gagaran and her team stood guard outside while the protagonist led his team into the dark to search for the Warrior Captain.[17]

When the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth and his minions began to ransack E-Rantel, Gagaran and Blue Roses rose to fight them off. In the battle her team caught the attention of the Demons Maids with Lupusregina Beta coming to face her. She and her comrades were too far away to help a hostage Emperor Jircniv but saw the person who appeared to be the protagonist save the Baharuth emperor. She was among the people in the crowd that celebrated protagonist's victory over Jaldabaoth.[18]

Once the construction of the new section of E-Rantel was complete, repairs to the city were still proceeding in the aftermath of the demons' attack. To raise the morale of the resident and recruit more adventurers in the Kingdom, Gagaran's team answered the protagonist's invitation to participate in an adventurer tournament. A day before the start of the tournament, she met with the protagonist and Suarko to give thanks at the city square. There she hoped that the Buddha was smiling down upon them.[19] Gagaran fought in the first exhibition match against her teammates Tina and Tia, which led to her victory. Though she defeated the twins the duo claimed that they were going easy on her out of respect to Lakyus. In the tournament Gagaran grew interested in the two newcomers Shall and Ku. She would later join her team in fighting the pair in the seventh match and later fought the "Dark Warrior" as part of the finale of the event.[20]

Gagaran would join her team and the protagonist in investigating Re-Blumrushur to see if Marquis Blumrush was responsible for a string of disappearances of brides seeking to answer his solicitation to be his wife. Gagaran and the others busied themselves in collecting testimonies from the victim's families. Gagaran and the others would be approached by a desperate soldier seeking aid to eliminate undead that infested the mine near the city. Though the adventurers had priorities, the protagonist convinced them to help since could. The undead appearing in the mine turned out to be related to their investigation as they found that the undead were amassing due to the remnants of Zurrernorn conducting their rituals using the captured brides as sacrifices which utterly disgusted Gagaran. The adventurers killed the cultists and later found Evil Lord Greed at the scene. Since he was present it led the members of Blue Roses to believe that Blumrush was associating himself with the Demon Emperor. After the mine collapsed, Gagaran and her friends enjoyed their victory and also found began teasing Evileye on how cute she looked in her bridal gown.[21]

Some weeks after the protagonist saved the city, Gagaran was with Blue Roses at the cave where they saved Gazef Stronoff. She worked with the members of the Royal Army and E-Rantel Magic Research Institute in setting up a cordon to prevent Chaos Beasts from leaving the underground cave network.[22]

Gagaran and her friends were away from E-Rant, to fulfill a job to bring back a noble’s son from a gambling hall. Lakyus and Evileye had to wear bunny girl costumes to infiltrate the hall, though the former needed to wield a gavel as part of her uniform. To help her friend correctly wield the unfamiliar weapon, Gagaran gave her pointers when they practiced against some Chaos Beasts.

Gagarpur (ガガルップル) is a Avaricious Frog and one of Aura's pets.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Gagarpur is described as a giant frog with distorted features; having rows upon rows of dirty yellow teeth and eyes like that of a lecherous middle-aged man.
Personality

It is unknown what kind of personality Gagarpur possesses.
Background

Gagarpur is one of Aura' pets that is usually kept in the 6th Floor of Nazarick
Chronology

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
During the Sorcerer Kingdom's invasion of the Royal Capital, Gagarpur was part of Aura' menagerie of pets that climbed the city's walls. The appearance of her and her fellow magical beasts terrified the city guards who fled in terror. Though the other beasts had yet to receive orders to hunt and chase down their prey, Iris went on ahead and used her Petrifying Roar, killing all the humans in the vicinity. This earned her a beat down by her peers for the noise she caused. The frog was the only beast that refrained from attacking her. Due to Gagarpur's slowness it resorted to riding on the back of a Basilisk to join its master and peers in invading deeper into the capital. Following Aura' lead they caused mayhem and destruction as they leapt from roof to roof, heading to the Magician's Guild.

The group encountered a group of six warriors and an old man barring their way to their destination. Aura after killing their leader with an arrow, order her pets to slaughter the rest.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Gagarpur is noted to be a level 58 monster. However it appears it lacks in speed thus it requires aid in traveling.
Relationships

Iris

It seems to be more forgiving than his peers, as it did not engage in the bullying Iris when she made an error.

Aura Bella Fiora

Though the frog is a pet of Aura, its master considers the beast to be slow.

Trivia

Given that its level is at 58, the lowest of the monsters under Aura's control, save for Hejinmal, its possible that Gagarpur is the weakest monster in her menagerie.

Gargantua (ガルガンチュア) is the 4th Floor Guardian of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Unlike the other Guardians, it is not a Custom NPC but a bonus won by Ainz Ooal Gown.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Gargantua is an ultra-large stone golem, with a height of over 30 meters. Zaryusu describes this golem as a two-armed, two-legged colossus that seemed to be carved out of stone. Its arms and legs are chunky, so it may look cute if one disregards its size. While so, its round eye sockets and chest are glowing with red lines that permeate from its chest, like a heart.
Personality

As a mindless construct, Gargantua has no personality or will of its own. Therefore, it is not able to freely move without being commanded by Ainz to do so.
Background

Gargantua is not one of the Custom NPCs made in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, but a part of the game system.[1] The guild members gave Gargantua the position as one of the Floor Guardians in their dungeon. Gargantua usually settles at the bottom of the lake located on the 4th Floor of Nazarick.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Sealed Evil Tree Arc

Main article: The Sealed Evil Tree Arc
Upon discovering Zy'tl Q'ae, Ainz noted that the treant is larger in size than even Gargantua.

When the Floor Guardians arrived at the Great Forest of Tob under Ainz's order, Shalltear acknowledged that it is a rare chance to see all of them together. However, Mare dismisses her notion, since Victim is not around to be with them on this special occasion. Accepting Mare's answer, Shalltear believes that may be the case as Gargantua is also not present with them.[2]

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Overlord II EP04 086
Gargantua being deployed.
Gargantua was activated at Ainz Ooal Gown's order. It is one of the Floor Guardians in the group to scare off the lizardmen, first by its gigantic appearance and then it strength, by throwing a large boulder onto the surface of the frozen lake.

The boulder thrown by Gargantua was where Ainz Ooal Gown had placed his throne on while present alongside almost all the Floor Guardians except Cocytus. After finishing its task, the golem immediately vanished from their vicinity presumably having returned to the Great Tomb of Nazarick.[3]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
At the National Foundation Day Ceremony, Albedo announced that all the Floor Guardians were present with the exception of the golem.[4]

The Floor Guardians is briefly mentioned by Cocytus, in his self-deprecating speech of how insignificant he felt at being in charge of Nazarick's defenses in comparison to the other Floor Guardians making strides in E-Rantel for the Sorcerer Kingdom.[5]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Shalltear Bloodfallen is called "The strongest Floor Guardian except Strategic Siege Golem, Gargantua." Thus, it makes sense that Gargantua is even more powerful than her. However, as Gargantua does not have a will nor intelligence of its own, this comparison might be meaningless. At the same time, Gargantua possesses the highest amount of stats among the Floor Guardians including Shalltear and Mare.
Trivia

Gargantua'a name is a variation on the word "gargantuan," meaning colossal, massive, titanic, etc. Gargantua is also a giant from French literature and name of a Kaiju by Toho.
According to Maruyama's conversation with the interviewer, his reason for making Gargantua is to make it fight a company of golem cavalry led by an alliance of countries in the middle of the continent.[6]
Maruyama stated that before Gargantua there was no Floor Guardian assigned to the Underground Lake.[7]
When Gargantua made its manga version debut in Comp Ace, somehow it was depicted having three bodies. This was later corrected in Overlord Manga Volume 07.
Due to the golem lacking a mind of its own, the Area Guardians on the 4th Floor don't report their concerns directly to Gargantua, and instead deliver them directly to Ainz Ooal Gown.[8]
In Mass for the Dead, the developers released an Assault Theater "Colossus Sleeping in the Underground Lake".[9]
According to a movie pamphlet that was released with Isekai Quartet The Movie -Another World-, Gargantua is a name that was given to the golem by the members of Ainz Ooal Gown as it was originally called "Strategic Siege Golem".

"Sorcerer King Ainz Ooal Gown! My name is Gazef Stronoff, the Warrior-Captain of the Re-Estize Kingdom! I formally request a duel with you!"
— Gazef Stronoff to Ainz Ooal Gown.
Gazef Stronoff (ガゼフ・ストロノーフ) was the Warrior Captain of the Re-Estize Kingdom and King Ramposa III's personal bodyguard. He met Ainz at Carne Village and developed a mutual respect for him. Unfortunately, they later became enemies when the Kingdom and the Sorcerer Kingdom went to war with each other, where he met his end at the hands of the Sorcerer King.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Gazef was a muscular man of around thirty years old and he had southern blood in his veins. He appeared to have a sunbathed dark face with noticeable wrinkles, short, trimmed, black hair, and black eyes that were as sharp as a sword.
Personality

Gazef was loyal to his King and the Kingdom. He was a strong-willed man who was willing to sacrifice his life in order to protect the people of the Kingdom. He showed respect and admiration to those under his command.
Background

Gazef Stronoff was born as a commoner in a frontier village and later became a mercenary. Gazef had a chance encounter with Vesture Kloff Di Laufen, a former adamantite-ranked adventurer, who taught him his extraordinary swordsmanship. He entered the grand tournament to acquire the King's trust and became his personal bodyguard after becoming champion by defeating Brain Unglaus.

As the Kingdom's strongest warrior, he was extremely famous, commanding the respect and admiration of all those who know his name. Though only nobles could become a "Knight" in the Kingdom, Gazef commanded his own "Warrior Troop" instead.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
Gazef was ordered by King Ramposa III to investigate and hunt down the imperial knights that were attacking villages around the Kingdom. He encountered a ransacked village and ordered his men to send the survivors to E-Rantel. His vice captain warned him that it was a trap, but Gazef disregarded his warning and continued the pursuit.[1]

Later, Gazef arrived at Carne Village and met the mysterious magic caster named Ainz Ooal Gown, who saved the village from the attacking knights. He then thanked him for saving the village. However, Gazef's subordinate informed him that the village was surrounded by unidentified figures and he realized it was a trap.

Once he found out that the Sunlight Scripture of the Slane Theocracy was targeting him, he requested Ainz to protect the village in his stead while he faced them in battle. He engaged the Sunlight Scripture in a fierce battle and used his martial skill to fight against them, but he was overwhelmed by their magic. He taunted Nigun Grid Luin, boasting that there was still someone stronger than him in the village and prepared for his imminent death. However, he was then teleported to the village storage house along with his men. He asked the village chief where Ainz was and was told that he disappeared in front of him. Gazef then realized that his life was saved by switching places with Ainz.[2]

After Ainz defeated the Sunlight Scripture, Gazef thanked Ainz for saving his life, his men, and the village. He asked Ainz if he was willing to travel with them back to E-Rantel. He also suggested Ainz to speak with him in the Royal Capital if they met again.[3]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
Gazef safely returned to the Royal Capital and was welcomed back by King Ramposa III. He reported to the King and great nobles about Ainz and how he saved Carne Village. In addition, this included having saved his life and his Warrior Troop from certain death while the nobles showed contempt for the suspicious magic caster.

After the meeting was over, the King apologized to Gazef for sending him on a dangerous mission without proper equipment and wanted to thank Ainz Ooal Gown for saving his loyal and most trusted aide. He ensured the King that Ainz was a virtuous man and he would likely be satisfied with just those words. He and the King then encountered Princess Renner and Climb and Gazef told Climb that he needed to improve his swordsmanship in order to protect Princess Renner under any circumstance.[4]

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Overlord II EP06 087
Gazef welcoming Brain into his home.
Gazef found Brain Unglaus in an alley in the Royal Capital. He was surprised to find such a skilled swordsman acting suicidal, wanting to keep him alive. Hoping that Brain would join the Kingdom, he offered Brain a place at his house.[5]

Gazef joined with Blue Roses, Brain Unglaus, and Climb in Princess Renner's operation against Eight Fingers, but their plans quickly changed with the appearance of Jaldabaoth and his demon army, who had just invaded the Royal Capital. Gazef's mission was to protect the King and the royal family from danger. Despite this, the king decided to aid the adventurers and Gazef was ordered by the King to fight and help the adventurers defeat Jaldabaoth.[6]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
When the Kingdom received an official declaration of war from the Baharuth Empire, Gazef was shocked by Ainz Ooal Gown's participation. Though many of the nobles believed that one magic caster was of little consequence, Gazef saw the danger as he knew how powerful Ainz is first-hand, and the Empire and Theocracy had recognized Ainz's strength.[7]

Later on, at the battlefield, Gazef made amends with Marquis Raeven, who recognized him as a patriot to the Kingdom. Gazef's warnings came to fruition in the most horrific way possible, as Ainz's first and only move in that "battle" was a horrific spell that single-handedly wiped out 70,000 people out from the Royal Army and summoned five Dark Young to trample 100,000 more. Though his instincts told him to flee amidst the chaos, he chose to stay behind to cover the King's escape. As a result, he briefly clashed with a , and even though he survived, he was unable to damage it.

On the battlefield, Gazef stood alongside Brain and Climb as the Sorcerer King granted them an audience with him. Ainz offered to cease the senseless slaughter only if the Warrior Captain would swear his allegiance to him. Gazef, however, refused, and instead requested a duel with him. Gazef also expressed a desire not to be resurrected following the duel. Ainz granted his requests and as soon as the duel started and before Gazef could act, Ainz casted a time-stop spell, followed by an instant death spell. Ainz honored Gazef's sacrifice by ceasing the attack on the Royal Army and wanted to have the body properly cleaned before handing it over, but allowed Brain and Climb to reclaim the body as-is after Brain stated that it wouldn't be necessary.[8] Ainz also told them that due to the nature of the instant death spell he used, low-level resurrection spells would not be able to bring Gazef back.

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
From a conversation between Renner and Tina, it can be inferred that Ramposa III tried to have Lakyus revive the deceased Gazef. However, due to Ainz's spell invalidating low level resurrections magic, it ended up being unsuccessful.

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
In the aftermath of the Catastrophe which led to the signing of the Tripartite Agreement and the formation of the Tripartite Alliance Gazef Stronoff worked to help his king during the trying times. The Kingdom though was suffering from a shortage of manpower making sending reinforcements to deal with the Chaos Beasts difficult. It began to adversely affect E-Rantel where the new international alliance would be based in. Gazef struggling with the issue, was later met by Climb who informed him that Brain Unglaus was in the Royal Capital. A solution having appeared before him, Gazef hurried into the city and located Brain and asked for him to take a posting at E-Rantel. His rival agreed to help out in the fortress city's defense in exchange for a duel with Gazef, which the Warrior Captain agreed to do at a later date. Once he returned from his search for Brain and getting his cooperation, he informed his king of he good fortune. As a thank you for solving the problem, Gazef also sparred with Climb at the train grounds.[9][10][11]

The Warrior Captain would eventually come to E-Rantel to help bolster its defenses. He worked with the city officials such as Mayor Panasolei Gruze Day Rettenmaier and Saint Clementine to maintain order in city. It was during one of the conferences with the leaders of the city that he learned of a new adventurer and his quick rise to platinum rank. The Warrior Captain listened to his colleagues theories on the foreigner who believed him to be an agent from another country, though Gazef would advise they not dwell on it as the new character was a boon to the city. When a situation involving mutated slimes was discovered in the city's sewers, Gazef assembled with the other factions of the city to find the culprit. Suspicion was cast on Hilma Cygnaeus and the protagonist due their shady backgrounds, but both were cleared of charges when it was pieced together that the slimes' mutations were caused by runoff water from the Pharmacist's Guild's herb cultivation field. To deal with the slime infestation in the sewers Gazef wanted to head down there to exterminate them, but was dissuaded by the mayor as the Warrior Captain was too valuable to the Kingdom. Instead he allowed the protagonist and his friend Suarko and Soi handle the situation.[12]

At the second summit for the Tripartite Alliance, Gazef served as an escort to King Ramposa III alongside the protagonist and his adventurer team. When the strength of the Kingdom was question by Emperor Jircniv and the possibility of losing control of E-Rantel to the Empire, Gazef and the adventurers participated in a mock battle against the Empire's selected warriors. In the battle Gazef helped his allies defeat Nimble Arc Dale Anoch and Zero. The last opponent was Fluder Paradyne who he fought with Soi to defeat, but the two were nearly defeated by the wizard when Enhela Read Gahi called off the match to address an emergency situation of a horde of Chaos Beasts approaching E-Rantel.[13]

After the horde was wiped out, Gazef Stronoff and a group of his warriors had seemingly vanished. It was later revealed by the royal family of the Kingdom to the protagonist that the Warrior Captain led a contingent of the Warrior Troop to locate the Crack that spawned the horde that attacked the city. He and his men tracked the horde's path north where a cave was discovered connecting to an underground network. Gazef and just established a base camp deep with the caverns and set the royals regular reports but for some reason ceased all communication. With Gazef being a pivotal part of the nation's defense and strength the king hired the protagonist and Blue Roses locate and possibly rescue the Warrior Captain.[14]

The protagonist's team followed traces of Gazef's men and deduced that the Warrior Captain's base was attacked by monsters native to the cave network. During the attack a cave-in happened causing their escape path to be blocked and their magic casters to be killed preventing them from returning to the surface and calling for help. A few days before the rescue team arrived at the cave, Gazef and his men were forced to go deeper and deeper by monsters and their own will to complete their mission, which was to locate the Crack. Many of Gazef's men were killed either by a monster or infected by the miasma turning them into Contaminated Beasts, which forced their comrades to kill them as an act of mercy. As the bodies began to pile up their dead turned into the undead and attacked their former comrades, driving the troop deeper. Despite the losses Gazef was urged by his men to press on so that their sacrifices would not be in vain. Eventually Gazef reaches the cavern that holds the Crack, but he is the only one alive and succumbed to the miasma poisoning becoming feral. By the time the protagonist and his team find him Gazef lost all ability to reason and began to attack them with his Martial Arts. The Warrior Captain was defeated thanks to Shall, after short battle but before they could retrieve him, Gazef's unconscious body was almost taken by a mysterious creature in the cave. Once it was defeated, Gazef was returned to E-Rantel for treatment at a secret facility.[15]

The Warrior Captain was interned at a laboratory and headed by Nfirea Bareare who had yet to find a way to cure the contaminated Gazef. Gazef's Stronoff's absence from the frontlines at E-Rantel, saw Marquis Boullope to bring his forces to make out for the loss. Though the Baharuth Empire began to take the opportunity to bring the entire Imperial Army to make a statement on the supremacy and greater role it should play in the Alliance. The protagonist having saved the Warrior Captain was offered to name his reward which the former requested the administration rights to the city of E-Rantel. Meanwhile the cave that was discovered by Gazef was cordoned off by the Alliance, however the underground caves that held the Chaos Beasts was breached by the Pleiades allowing them to escape and march to E-Rantel.[16]

Once the protagonist was granted the title of Guardian of E-Rantel and the new ruler of the city, he formed the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute to uncover the mysteries of the Catastrophe. Also contained at the facility was Gazef Stronoff where he was overseen by Fluder in hopes that a cure could be made to finally cure him.[17]

On the protagonist's visit to the institute, Soi once again battle the bestial Gazef to allow Fluder and Nfirea to gather data. From their observations, Gazef's primitive impulses seemed to be declining, and his physical condition was stabilizing for some reason. The two researchers were unable to ascertain which treatments they were giving him led to his stability, though planned to conduct tests on other Contaminated Beasts to pinpoint which clinical trails were effective.[18]

Gazef was confined in the institute, with repeated experiments involving combining Chaos Beasts and slime done by Sophie in an attempt to replicate the same conditions as the Melting Pot. Alas they all ended in failure, but Sophie and the other researchers were still determined to collect as much data from their failures.[19]

After some time a cure still had not been developed yet and Gazef Stronoff remained a feral beast, however Fluder Paradyne believed that a cure was close at hand after Sophie Noia learned of an intriguing development with the Melting Pot.[20]

In the midst of E-Rantel being invaded by an influx of Chaos Beasts from numerous Cracks throughout the city, the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute cam under attacked. Through the efforts of Sophie and Nfirea, Gazef Stronoff was finally cured. Around the same time a Spear Chaos Beast breached the defenses of the institute, killing everyone save for Soi, Fluder and Nfirea. The protagonist bringing Yuri, CZ and Slimeko were unable to defeat the monster, forcing Nfirea to set Gazef free. To the amazement of all Gazef not only regained his mental faculties but displayed enhance speed and strength beyond what he was capable of before and after he had been contaminated. Using these new abilities and his Martial Arts, Gazef fought on equal footing though was unable to kill the Chaos Beast as he was only using a replica of Razor Edge. However that was remedy after Brain and Climb arrived at the site to deliver the sword to the Warrior Captain. But before Gazef could deliver a killing blow, a Crack formed directly in the room taking Fluder as well as the protagonist and Slimeko.[21]

Some months after the attack on the city, Gazef was considered missing in action by the Kingdom and assumed dead. However in reality, the Warrior Captain was sent to the "other side" of the Crack. Due to his detoxification of the miasma, Gazef did not suffer any ill effects to be rendered unconscious like the rest of the taken. He was not alone and met up with the protagonist. The Warrior Captain protected the weakened hero long enough for the latter to reach a nearby Crack and escape. Rather than escape with the adventurer, Gazef chose to stay behind to search for the king, the crown prince, Brain and Climb.

What passed for a month in the New World, a single day transpired, and Gazef soon met up with a returned protagonist with his rescued teammates Soi and Surako. In the time they were apart, Gazef managed to recover the bodies of Ramposa III and Brain. Sadly he was unable to retrieve Barbro's as it was too badly damaged and Climb's body as nowhere to be found. Having found who he needed, Gazef decided to escape with his charges and back into the Kingdom, wishing the protagonist luck in studying the "other side".[22]

Once back in the Re-Estize Kingdom, Gazef's reappearance and rescue of the king caused a stir in the political spectrum of the nation, especially among the nobles who were trying to take advantage of the situation. For the Quadripartite Alliance meeting, Gazef was given authority by the recovered king to act as the nation's representative. Before the meeting started, the Warrior Captain met with the team of Darkness as he was curious to know how the group were still in E-Rantel when they were trapped in the Chaos Zone together with him around the same time ago when the disaster in E-Rantel happened.

He was given an explanation that time flowed in the Chaos Zone differently, that after the protagonist and him first encountered each other upon waking up in the realm, and went their separate ways, the protagonist returned back to E-Rantel, where he found several weeks had passed after the disaster happened. He later returned to the "other side" of the Crack, once preparation allowed him to rescue Surako and Soi, where he re-encountered Gazef saving Ramposa III and Brain. It was there they departed again, as the protagonist claimed he wanted to stay behind to study the environment. And also claimed that when the group tried to exit the Chaos Zone, their exit point took them to the past when the disaster in E-Rantel was occurring. To avoid a time paradox limited knowledge was made to Prince Zanac and the public.

Gazef not really understanding the explanation accepted it, as he trusted the protagonist, and knew such information could cause chaos in the Kingdom. Another question he raised was the protagonist's ability to operate in the Chaos Zone, which he was told was due to the protagonist being contaminated and later cured, just as Gazef. Gazef noted that ever since he recovered from being contaminated, that his strength was far beyond what he was before, and thinking that now that he has the same constitution as the protagonist was now on par in fighting beings such as the Demon Emperor. His enthusiasm was curbed by the protagonist who warned him that there may be some restrictions with his new abilities. Before heading out to the meeting, Gazef noted the odd scene of the Sorcerer Kingdom's undead were now protecting the living and that how it became normalized.

At the meeting with the other representatives, Gazef speaking on behalf of the Kingdom alongside Lakyus addressed the meeting by providing first a brief history of what happened to him, starting with the events in the Northern Cave. When the talk reached the part of how he was able to function on the "other side" of the Crack, questions arose of how the Warrior Captain was able to do so, which lead to the disclosure of the Sorcerer Kingdom's top secret experiments and research on a cure to decontaminate Gazef.

Gazef then addressed the larger issue, rescuing those thought dead after the disaster that struck E-Rantel, as he attested that many people were still alive and unconscious. He solicited aid from Blue Roses, the Baharuth Empire, the Sorcerer Kingdom and the Slane Theocracy to launch a rescue operation, to which the entirety agreed. Gazef was shocked to learn that the protagonist and him were not the only ones who had the ability to traverse the "other side" unaided, as Enhela disclosed could, and proved it by revealing that he rescued Ian and Nigun. Given Gazef witnessed Enhela effortlessly dispel Fluder Paradyne's magic at the exhibition match when they first met, it made sense as to why the priest was so strong.

After preparations were done in mass producing adaptive equipment for the Four Kingdom Rescue Team, Gazef attended a pep rally organized by the Alliance to boost morale. After the speech made by the representatives of the Sorcerer Kingdom, Aura and Mare, Gazef expressed support of them. He was later seen at the feast venue provided to the participants of the operation.[23]

At the start of the operation, Gazef provided the assembled adventurers, soldiers, knights and priests on an orientation of the world beyond the Crack, warning them of it temporal instability and that the aim of this first mission would be to save a hundred people. Gazef then led everyone into a Crack he used to escape, that was located some way away from the city. He led the army in crossing the Crack and began reviving the people on the "other side" to bolster the army's numbers to save more people. While fighting the Chaos Beasts, members of the rescue team such as Nigun and Brain commented on the increased power of the Warrior Captain, from his abnormal strength and crimson eyes and skill in effortlessly taking down many Chaos Beasts.

Later when the army completed in saving a hundred people, a horde of giant-sized Chaos Beasts marched against the Four Kingdoms Recue Team, Gazef acted as a shield for the army, and allowed the miner Sebas to be the vanguard to punch a hole through the mass and lead everyone through the Crack to safety. Upon reaching home soil, Gazef thanked the humble Sebas for his help.[24]

Gazef received urgent news from the Sorcerer Kingdom via the protagonist that enormous amounts of miasma were spilling in from Cracks in every major city in the Tripartite Alliance. Since their unit was the only military force in the area, the joint international force hurried to the alliance's capital to save what they could. Upon reaching territory of E-Rantel. Nigun reported that his scouts have confirmed that the soldiers of the Kingdom had turned feral from inhaling the miasma.

At the outskirts, Gazef drew a plan with his allies to infiltrate the city, avoid the clusters of miasma while evacuating those who were still sane from the city. Since he was already immune to the poisonous gas, Gazef decided to venture alone without a team to rescue anyone he could, intending to use the blessing the experiments from the Sorcerer Kingdom had given to their fullest.

He regrouped with the other rescue teams at a shelter where he was surprised to find Fluder Paradyne, Sophie Noia and Nfirea Bareare, all alive in their midst, with a plan to cure all the afflicted. When asked to gather the corpses of those too badly damaged to be revived, the Warrior Captain agreed to assist on behalf of the bereaved families.[25]

A month later the situation in E-Rantel had greatly improved. Gazef was seem coordinating with the military representatives of the Alliance. After he ended the meeting and left, it was noted by all present that the Warrior Captain had yet to return to his normal self. Despite now being one of humanity's greatest fight forces, Gazef seemed more burdened and fatigued, combined with him still mourning the death of King Ramposa III who died just recently.[26]

A year later, Gazef conducted another rescue operation into the Chaos Zone, jointly with members of the Quadripartite Alliance. After dispatching the Chaos Beasts in the area, Gazef came to check on the members of the Black Scripture, 11th Seat and Cedran if they needed any assistance. However the two Scripture members had finished dealing with their opponents. A horn was sounded though alerting the rescue team that new foes were approaching. Gazef requested the two to follow him to engage the new horde of Chaos Beasts approaching, which they complied.[27]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Gazef Stronoff was considered to be the Kingdom's strongest warrior, exceeding adamantite class adventurers. He could, in fact, be considered the Kingdom's final trump card. Though Gazef was extremely talented with the sword, he had yet to overcome the barrier to reach the Realm of Heroes.

Gazef Armor
Gazef fully equipped with the Kingdom's Treasures.
Job Classes

Fighter
Mercenary
Champion
Martial Arts

Body Strengthening: A Martial Art that increases one's muscle strength.
Enhanced Magic Resistance: It increases the user's resistance to magic effects directed towards themselves.
Flow Acceleration: An art that temporarily accelerates the workings of the user's nerves, increasing one's attack speed and movement speed. The downside to it, however, is the extreme exhaustion that builds up in the user's mind.
Focus Battle Aura: By pouring the user's fighting spirit into their weapon, this art endows normal weapons with effects equivalent to those of magical weapons. With these weapons, it is possible to break through the special defenses of races such as angels.
Fourfold Slash of Light: The precursor to the Sixfold slash of light, it allowed Gazef to slash nearby enemies four times with one swing of his sword. He learned this move from Vesture, who put his theory into practice. This attack is as fast as light.
Instant Counter: An art that forcibly returns the user to their attack stance after they are thrown off-balance by a previous attack. It's effective for dodging enemy attacks, but puts a large burden on the user's body.
Magical Weapon Enchantment: A Martial Art that activates any magic weapon's enchantments the user has currently active.
Mental Enhancement: It increases the users' mental abilities to increase focus and thinking during battle.
Possibility Sense: Allows the user to detect their chance of victory against a target.
Sense Weakness: Allows the user to detect any possible weaknesses in a target.
Sixfold Slash of Light: An art that allows the user to slash as fast as light nearby enemies six times with one swing of their sword. This art releases six strikes of light that, even though they may be powerful, can't be directed. This is why the user only casts this when fighting against groups. It is a favorite killing move of tremendously powerful enemies, which Gazef used as his trump card. However, it carries a great burden, so much so that each use takes as much focus as three regular arts, and the user's body is greatly exhausted.
Main Equipment

Holding the position as Warrior Captain, Gazef had the right to wear the Kingdom's five treasures. Knowledge of four of the five treasures have been made known by the Sunlight Scripture:

Amulet of Immortality (Formerly): Provides regeneration.
Gauntlets of Endurance (Formerly): Grants endless stamina or fatigue immunity.
Guardian Armor (Formerly): Made of extremely hard steel or adamantite. Enchanted with magic, it can protect the wearer from lethal blows.
Razor Edge (Formerly): A magically enchanted sword capable of cutting through armor like paper.
Other

Rigrit's Ring (Formerly): An artifact of the Thirteen Heroes given by former member Rigrit Bers Caurau, a ring that temporarily boosts the wearer's abilities by five levels when activated.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Ainz Ooal Gown

Gazef saw Ainz as a friend to the Kingdom after he saved Carne Village and his own life from the Sunlight Scripture. He highly respected Ainz and considered the magic caster to be stronger than him. But at the same time, Gazef also developed fear of the mighty magic caster due to his overwhelming victory over the enemies that had utterly decimated Gazef and his troops. Gazef also felt that while Ainz Ooal Gown was not a heartless man, he was no ordinary good Samaritan and would showed no mercy to those that opposed him.[7]

Prior the battle at Katze Plains, Gazef tried to defend his savior when the nobles suggested capturing him and he wanted to avoid making an enemy with a powerful magic caster who might be comparable to Fluder Paradyne.

His fear of Ainz Ooal Gown's power was proven to be true at the Massacre at Katze Plains. Despite seeing the slaughter of his countrymen, the Warrior-Captain still managed to maintain a civilized conversation with him. Gazef was even comfortable with allowing Ainz to examine his sword, knowing full well that he was a fearsome undead, but was not a dishonorable thief.

After his death, Ainz still retained his full respect for Gazef and used him as a the golden standard when evaluating the character of warriors in the New World.
