Hejinmal talking to himself.
Hejinmal (ヘジンマール) is the first son of Kilistran Denshusha and Olasird'arc Haylilyal, the White Dragon Lord of the Azerlisia Mountains.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

As a result of Hejinmal spending long hours from reading books, his eyesight has decreased. Hejinmal resorts to wearing a pair of small spectacles he found to compensate. Due to the lack of exercise, his body is noted to be fat by his own father, though it is still more powerful than most living beings that exist in the New World.
Personality

Despite being a dragon, Hejinmal is very timid and would always consider running away almost every single time when faced with a problem. He shows great interest in seeing the world outside so he is always locked up in the library of Feo Berkana, reading and learning about it through books.
Background

Hejinmal was born between Olasird'arc Haylilyal and Kilistran Denshusha. However, unlike his parents and siblings, he was not good at fighting, didn't possess a strong body for a dragon and had a cowardly personality. Hejinmal spent most of his time in the library reading books. Thus Hejinmal was a source of embarrassment for his parents.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
Hejinmal wasn't particularly thrilled about the prospect of being handpicked to become the one to deal with the intruders, considering he was never a fighter, to begin with. He even shivered when he thought just what the intruders would do to him should he be defeated. Hejinmal knew deep in his heart that his father had actually given up on him as he had never shown any sort of qualities that his father would be proud of, compared to his other siblings.

Just as he was swimming in his own negative thoughts, his enhanced senses caught the presence of incoming individuals. It didn't take long for him to spot the four figures at a distance, thanks to his draconic sight. He first recognized a dark elf, Aura Bella Fiora, among them. Then, he was shocked to see Ainz Ooal Gown, mistaking him as an Elder Lich, accompanying the group as that type of undead was known to be immune to cold and has the spell of Fireball. Fire was the racial weakness of the Frost Dragons, and an Elder Lich had both the immunity and the most powerful weapon to use against him. Then, his nose caught something else in the air. The value of the equipment worn by both the dark elf and the Elder Lich was beyond anything he had ever come across. That made him even more wary of the intruders and prayed that they had actually come to discuss in a sociable manner.

Hejinmal then approached the group and politely asked that they state their reason of coming to Feo Berkana. Ainz was not amused to see a dragon such as he to make an appearance and contemplated whether this was actually a trap. As the undead continued with his assessment of the situation, Hejinmal grew more afraid by the minute. Just as Ainz started channeling his magic, the welled-up fear within Hejinmal burst out of confinement and the Frost Dragon immediately begged with all his might that his life be spared, surprising Ainz. And later, Aura would make him her pet magically that sent chills down his body, causing the young dragon to pee by accident. Hejinmal's action disgusted both Aura and Shalltear while desperately making up an excuse for what he did. Upon swearing loyalty to Ainz Ooal Gown, Hejinmal tells everything he knows about the Frost Dragons and how capable his father is as a Dragon Lord.

Afterwards, he brought Ainz and Gondo into the throne room and proclaimed to his father and his father's concubines that Ainz would rule over them now. He watched as Ainz used Grasp Heart to kill his father. With the death of the Dragon Lord, he was ordered by Ainz to bring all the books in the palace to him. He along with his family later moved to the Sorcerer Kingdom where they act as a delivery system.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Active

Freezing Breath
Passive

Enhanced Senses
Relationships

Ainz Ooal Gown

Ainz spared Hejinmal, believing him to be a rare specimen due to his unusual physique. Being the subordinate of his own master, he is very afraid to incur the Sorcerer King's wrath and chose his words carefully. Made doubly so, when he witnessed how his father was killed in an instant by the spell of his new liege.

Upon becoming the Sorcerer King's subject, the young Frost Dragon have ever since been listening intently to what Ainz speaks about as the undead walked. Taking note of it, Hejinmal was undoubtedly certain that his knowledge and instincts were the most valuable thing in the New World.

Aura Bella Fiora

Hejinmal is assigned to become Aura's pet dragon. He is terrified of the dark elf after he has been shown that Aura possesses immense power that nearly caused him to die from shock and wet himself.

Olasird'arc Haylilyal

Hejinmal's relationship with his father was rather strained, as the former was more interested in reading and learning about the world, than training to become stronger. As a result, Hejinmal did not even grieve for his father after Ainz killed him.

Kilistran Denshusha

Hejinmal's biological mother. Though Hejinmal feels a kinship towards her because they share the same bloodline, he does not care enough for her to risk his life for her. Despite that, he asked Ainz to spare her.

Munuinia Ilyslym

While Munuinia thinks lowly of him, she capitalized on their family ties by answering Ainz's question of who was Hejinmal's mother first. However, the other two concubines also made this claim, leaving Ainz baffled at their declaration. The Sorcerer King quickly jumped to the conclusion that they are individually the mother who "bore," "raised" and "cared" for him. As such, Ainz decided that to stay true to his promise, he would have to spare all three of the Dragon Lord's wives. Though it should be noted that Hejinmal did not help his "mother" out of mere sympathy alone, but to use it as leverage against her in the near future.

Hekkeran Termite (ヘッケラン・ターマイト) is the leader of Foresight and also a worker. He and his worker group volunteered to explore and investigate the mysterious large tomb.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Hekkeran has blonde hair and blue eyes, has a healthy skin color that has regularly been exposed to sunlight. He wears chainmail in which a metallic jingling can be heard coming from beneath his clothes, which sounded like it is caused by the friction of chains.
Personality

Hekkeran has a cheerful and easy-going personality and he likes money that he saved up. An indescribable charm can be felt emitting from the man which seems to be able to attract other people to him. He has an invigorating smile that contains his excitement and displays a lot of confidence. However, he dislikes people who try to intimidate him and prefers to be directly to the point instead of talking in circles.
Background

Hekkeran is the fourth son of a merchant family, he aimed to become an adventurer. However, he becomes a worker instead. As a worker, he was commissioned to be a part of the Empire's subjugation of the undead in Katze Plains, where the annual war between the Empire and the Kingdom takes place.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Hekkeran had just returned to the Singing Apple Inn where he found his lover, Imina, rudely approached by a man looking for Arche. Imina refused to disclose the location of her friend as the person also refused to tell her his business. Hekkeran Termite eventually came and scared the man away. 

Arche and Roberdyck Goltron returned and met up with Hekkeran Termite and Imina, where it was revealed that the man looking for Arche was a debt collector and the dire financial situation of her family.[1]

Foresight took on a request made by Count Femel, after meeting the noble at his residence, along with the gathered worker parties, Hekkeran immediately took on a disliking for the leader of Tenmu, Erya Uzruth due to his mistreatment of his elven slaves.[2]

When they entered the depths of the mysterious Large Tomb, their party fought against hordes of undead who caught sight of them.[3] They eventually triggered a trap, transporting them to the Colosseum on the 6th Floor to be pit against the master of the Large Tomb. Hekkeran attempted to bluff his way into Ainz's good graces by stating that Foresight was sent by his comrades. However, his lie was seen through by Ainz and thus invoking his wrath. Much to his shock, Ainz turned out not just a competent warrior but also a magic caster of unmatched caliber. He was nearly finished off had it not been for Imina's intervention, but he eventually fell to Ainz's negative touch. Hekkeran and Imina were later sent to Gashokukochuuou's residence.[4]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Hekkeran came to E-Rantel with his comrades and hired by Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix. The team trained with other workers at the Quarry under the command of Zero and Six Arms. Though some of his comrades loathed with work with a few characters.[5] Hekkeran and his team participated in a plan to cull the Chaos Beast horde approaching E-Rantel. He was killed after being dissolved by slime acid as the Bloody Emperor used the workers to lure the horde of Chaos Beasts into a trap.[6]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Hekkeran is a veteran worker and fencer, whose leadership abilities are recognized by other senior worker teams. He's well-equipped with two swords on his waist and covered within the handguard, a hidden blade underneath the sheath. He also has a mace and an armor-piercing dagger hoisted behind his waist. His combat capability is equal to that of Mithril ranked adventurers.
Job Classes

Limit Breaker: Increases the number of martial arts that the user can use at once. It comes with a drawback later.

ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Imina

Hekkeran and Imina are team partners and lovers. It is hinted that he and Imina had recently started dating each other through his conversation with Roberdyck. When he and Roberdyck were thinking about what they'll do if Foresight disbanded, Hekkeran was reminded by his friend that it was something that he shouldn't consider alone.

During Foresight's duel with Ainz, although Hekkeran as the leader of the group should secure the survival of the majority, his feelings for the half-elf were so strong that he risked his own life to save her and let the formation of the group be broken.

Arche Eeb Rile Furt

Hekkeran cared for Arche as a comrade and friend. This is seen with how he was concerned to learn the young woman was in debt.

Roberdyck Goltron

Hekkeran and Roberdyck have been friends for a few years. Hekkeran trusts him enough to ask for advice when he is uncertain of what to do.

Parpatra Orgrion

Hekkeran has known Parpatra for a good time and he, as many others, respect at the old man for his experience and his decision of keep going as a worker until now. He refers kindly to him for his nickname of "Elder."

Erya Uzruth

Hekkeran instantly despised the human supremacist for his inhumane treatment of his elven slaves. Even feeling Erya would be trouble to the safety of the Worker groups during their investigation of the tomb.

Herohero (ヘロヘロ) is a guild member of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creator of Solution Epsilon and one of the creators of the Homunculus Maids groups that work in Nazarick.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Herohero is an Elder Black Ooze, one of the strongest slime-type race. His appearance is merely a mass of a black, sticky substance. His tar-like surface roils and writhes continuously, never staying in one shape for more than a second.
Personality

Herohero has a polite and humble personality. He enjoyed the game a lot, hoping there would be a sequel like YGGDRASIL II which was unheard of by Momonga. This way, he thought that they could someday meet up and play together like they used to do as a guild.

However, he tends to also act bitter when faced with a daunting lifestyle and is not afraid to speak out about it to Momonga. Herohero is willing to go so far as to vent it openly for his friend to listen concerning the struggle he has been going through all this while. Herohero admitted that he was the type who does not easily complain much in real life in comparison to in the game. Because of that, Herohero is apologetic for this kind of behavior to Momonga.

Due to being overworked and fatigued by his job, Herohero confused this with being old.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Herohero Emblem
Herohero's Emblem
At some point, while playing YGGDRASIL, he joins the Nine's Own Goal clan. After the dissolution of the clan, he would later become part of the Ainz Ooal Gown guild and helped his fellow members successfully conquered the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

As one of the four remaining guild members left who is active in Ainz Ooal Gown, Herohero has chosen to log in to YGGDRASIL during its final day before the shutdown for the sake of spending a short amount of time together with Momonga.

In real life, he was said to be a salaryman who is being chased by his work in a black company.

At point point he even missed a guild meeting order to do a apology press conference.[2] Herohero has not retired from playing YGGDRASIL, but he has not logged in to the game for about two years. According to his friend Momonga, Herohero had stopped actively playing the game right after he changed his job. Momonga considered Herohero to be part of a black-hearted enterprise as he described it due to the harsh workplace his friend was placed in and worked under daily.

Apparently, Herohero's job took a great toll on his body in the World of 2138 as he had been overworking himself while taking on various tasks overtime. His job tends to exhaust him greatly, making him feel a sense of fatigue and sleepiness after arriving home from work. In a way, Momonga considers such stress and fatigue to have been detrimental enough to Herohero's real life body. It was to the point wherein which he had to pay a visit to the doctor and check for any signs of illness through examinations made with that professional. The author Maruyama noted how if he doesn’t take sleep inducing drugs, Herohero won't be able to sleep soundly or peacefully.[3]

At some point Herohero heard some hot news about some new updates in YGGDRASIL, including new areas and even mosquito audio. While talking to Momonga and Ulbert, he felt he was getting old due to his declining memory and reflexes, though his comrades told him it was just his job wearing him down.[1]

Furthermore, he is implied to have taken health exams to see what the status of his condition was. This was hinted at during a meeting held among the Floor Guardians and Sebas Tian, concerning Ainz's supposed sickness in reference to Herohero's words they remembered he spoke about.[4] It seems that when Herohero is unable to sleep or nap, he plays YGGDRASIL as an alternative.[5]

Herohero and his companions, Momonga, Peroroncino and Ulbert were victims of one of Luci★Fer's pranks when he ambushed them with his golem in the Treasury, in which it chased them until they gave it the materials that they had collected.[6]

On days where he was tired out from his job, Herohero would try to relax by dressing his NPC Solution Epsilon in a bunny costume which he collected.[7]

Despite his fatigue, Herohero still chose to go out of his way and respond to the e-mail Momonga had sent him and logged in to YGGDRASIL before the game closed down. When logging on, Herohero spoke about how happy he was to reunite with his friend one final time, prior to saying their goodbyes and as he was practically falling asleep, went offline afterward.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
Herohero is one of the four remaining guild members of Ainz Ooal Gown to return to YGGDRASIL before its shut down. He talked with Momonga about the current status of the guild and the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Herohero was thankful that they were able to enjoy the game to its fullest, and bids farewell to Momonga as he was logging out.[8]

Given that he was online so close to the forced logoff time, Momonga thought that Herohero might have been sent to the New World too.[9]

When considering the options of joining nations such as the Re-Estize Kingdom, Ainz noted that he was not the least bit interested on becoming part of a black-hearted enterprise like the one Herohero was working for.[10]

The Emissary of the King Arc

Main article: The Emissary of the King Arc
When Cocytus sends his sentry to guard his master the entire day without any relief, Ainz thinks the Floor Guardian's action would put any unethical company to shame. During that moment, Ainz's last farewell with Herohero during the final day of YGGDRASIL before it shut down was still fresh on his mind. Ainz considered the possibility that if Herohero had not been run ragged from work, and was healthy and mentally fresh, he might be standing here with him by his side right now in the New World. Ainz could not fathom the thought of allowing his own subordinates to be forced into such a situation which robbed Herohero of all his vitality.

Ainz noted that there were many players who gave up gaming because of the drastic change in their living environment. He went on reminiscing on the fact that Herohero did not cancel his account, but knows that he retired from playing YGGDRASIL. In that regard, Ainz believed that Herohero would not had left his items behind in the Great Tomb of Nazarick and permitted him he was free to do whatever he pleased with them.

Remembering how worn out Herohero is from work, Ainz was planning a heart-to-heart talk with the Floor Guardians if there is anything troubling them on the job. Ainz did not want the NPCs to end up in the same horrible situation as Herohero was in real life.

In his mind, Ainz admits to himself about promising to not let Herohero's circumstance appear in Nazarick. However, with a sense of guilt, Ainz thinks that he have committed a grave sin, an unforgivable mistake upon seeing Albedo's sleeping place.[11]

Ainz Raises Money Arc

Main article: Ainz Raises Money Arc
Ainz recalled the fact that Herohero would get mad whenever someone from his guild racked up more overtime pay than their regular salary.[12]

Ainz's Ambition Arc

Main article: Ainz's Ambition Arc
In the past, Ainz once heard from Herohero about the company he was employed at. There was someone who committed suicide by jumping off of a building. Herohero had mused the idea that maybe things would not have gotten to such a state if the suicidal person in question had the chance to blow off steam earlier.[13]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
When Ainz decided to turn the Sorcerer Kingdom into a utopia. In his mind, he made a special vow to Herohero, where he would not be a terrible ruler like the boss of a black-hearted enterprise.[14]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Ainz presumed that Solution must have hid his Miyoshi because she was obeying some wish of Herohero. After hearing Solution's plea to Ainz of wanting to clean his body, he declined her request. He reasoned with her, that it was because she was an NPC created by Herohero. Ainz told Solution that he would feel ashamed to face Herohero if she were to commit such a lewd action on him. He considered her to be a daughter to Herohero and didn't want his former friend to get upset at him because of that.[15]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
When Ainz took notice back of old world labor contracts never being honored, he made an oath to not let anyone end up like Herohero. Considering the harsh experience his friend Herohero had to go through in life, Ainz planned to draw up a contract with fair terms, in which the Regency Council of the Dwarf Kingdom would respect; such as letting the runesmiths focus on development and the like, among other things.[16]

The Half Elf God-kin Arc

Main article: The Half Elf God-kin Arc
During Ainz’s duel with Decem Hougan he believed that Herohero could probably take on the Elf King’s summon.[17]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Herohero's race is an Elder Ooze, which is famous for their specialty in acid-type attacks. While his job class is filled with monk-type classes, it is not very good at damage dealing. However, its powerful acid is very effective in PvP and PK battles, dissolving the enemy player's equipment. His class levels strengthened his corrosive abilities, to the point where they could even break immunities. In a way, this traumatized his enemies.

As a slime, Herohero has a sensitive motion detector which senses vibrations within a 100-meter radius. However, the downside was that Herohero could not use optical vision without a magic item. Herohero described it being spooky since as a slime, he was unable to see beyond his radius of sight, considering a ranged enemy can attack him unnoticed. Still, Herohero finds his motion detector to be very useful.

Besides his gaming skills, Herohero was a skilled programmer, able to program his nanomachines using macros.[18]
Main Equipment

Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown: It allows the user to freely teleport between every room inside Nazarick. Every member of Ainz Ooal Gown was required to wear this ring.
Unnamed Magic Item: It allows Herohero the ability to have human optical sight, something which slimes do not normally have.
ADVERTISEMENT
Relationships

Momonga

Momonga is Herohero's friend and one of the four remaining members of Ainz Ooal Gown, who were still playing YGGDRASIL. He returned to the guild to see the status of the Guild and Nazarick and thanked Momonga for making the game more enjoyable for them before logging out.

Solution Epsilon

Herohero was the one who created Solution Epsilon to be a member of the Pleiades. It seemed apparent that Solution was willing to give up on cleaning Ainz's body after heeding her master's thoughts concerning Herohero's attitude towards such behavior. As such, like the other NPC's its likely that Solution reveres and respects Herohero the most out of the Forty-One Supreme Beings and is the one she holds her loyalty to first and foremost.

Decrement

Decrement's AI routine were programmed by Herohero.

Hilma Cygnaeus (ヒルマ・シュグネウス) is the leader of the drug trade department of the criminal organization Eight Fingers.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Hilma is described as a woman with sickly pale skin who wears white clothing. She has a snake tattoo that crawls down her right arm starting from her shoulder blades and holds a pipe that gives off poisonous, purple fumes. She also wears purple mascara and lipstick, as well as thin garments that gave her the decadent aura of a high-class prostitute. However, after being tortured by Kyouhukou, she was traumatized and would later lose the ability to eat solid food, which caused her to become extremely thin. She now looks like an old lady rather than a "high-class prostitute."
Personality

Before her ill-fated run-in with Nazarick, Hilma was a proud of being a high-class prostitute and used those skills of hers to blackmail the nobles, along with other people in power, to the service of Eight Fingers. After Hilma was interrogated by Kyouhukou, she became a miserable woman who has become mentally broken and in constant despair from the horrible torture she has suffered, to the point that simply asking about her experiences causes her to feel sick. She would go so far as to betray her comrades in Eight Fingers and has become utterly subservient to Nazarick.

Ironically, Hilma's experiences of being tortured and put to work under Nazarick actually made her a much more humble person and more empathetic towards the suffering of others. This was the case when Hilma was able to actually empathize with others who have gone through similar suffering as herself. Due to this torturous turn of events that had happened to her alongside them, she now sees her fellow Eight Fingers executives as no longer rivals or potential enemies. Rather, she considers her colleagues as actual comrades and friends in arms instead of rivals, leading Hilma to become much less brutal, manipulative, and cruel to her subordinates. Hilma's sudden change in demeanor actually shocked Christopher Olson on how understanding she was during his meeting with her and the other leaders of Eight Fingers, a way of thinking in stark contrast to her previous behavior.

Upon actually meeting the Sorcerer King, Hilma came to become genuinely loyal to him due to seeing how respectful and rational minded he was in comparison to his servants who simply enjoyed tormenting humans. This made Hilma admire him and consider him a merciful leader who would treat her immensely well if she does well in her tasks, thus making her more motivated to accomplish her work with a new zeal. Hilma herself is shown to have now seemingly developed the same religious faith the NPC's of Nazarick have towards Ainz.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Hilma was a former high-class prostitute who used her skills and intelligence to climb to the top of the underworld. After becoming the head of the drug dealing department, she started building ties with the first sons of noble houses, who had status and connections, but were powerless in politics and economically dependent of the head of their house. She lured them to the parties at her mansion and offered a place where they could satisfy their egos, along with drugs and beautiful women. That way, Hilma waited until they ascended to the power, then used their relationship to blackmail the nobles and put them under her control.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Hilma and the other executives of Eight Fingers meet in an undisclosed location to discuss various issues affecting the organization; one of which being the attacks on her drug trade department, but they don't yet know who the perpetrators are. Zero offers to lend a hand to Hilma, but she turns down his offer and continues their meeting with the assembly discussing the newest adamantite adventurer team, Darkness.[1]

Later, Hilma's mansion is attacked by Nazarick during the Demonic Disturbance (itself a cover for Nazarick to capture her). After waking up and encountering the intruders, she attempts to attack Mare Bello Fiore with her Viper’s Tattoo, but Mare easily crushes it with his bare-hand.[2] She is then crippled by Mare, taken to the Black Capsule, and tortured by Kyouhukou. As a result of the torture, she willingly betrays the Eight Fingers by revealing their meeting place to Aura Bella Fiora.[3]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
Since the Eight Fingers raid, she has been unable to eat solid food and has become thin and frail. Hilma helps Philip organize a ball in the Royal Capital, but because his family lacked the resources needed to organize a ball, Philip accepts her offer to rent a large estate and invite guests to entertain Albedo.

In truth, she is just using him and the rest of the new noble faction as a means to further destabilize the noble faction and cripple the royal government even further as preparations for the Kingdom's annexation under Albedo's orders.[4]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
Hilma's tutelage of her ward, Philip, has taken a toll on her mentally. When word spread that Ainz Ooal Gown was dead, Philip believed that he would be able to marry Albedo and, in doing so, take over the Sorcerer Kingdom. His sheer idiocy causes her to wail on the floor in front of her colleagues. Her comrades attempt to console her and urge her to continue, though the former prostitute still demanded a transfer from her assignment.[5]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Hilma is dragged to a summon by two Death Knights under orders from Albedo to clarify why the incident with the carriages happened and whether she had any knowledge of it Ainz, using [Dominate] on her, was able to clarify that she had no knowledge of the operation that was carried out by the noble under her charge, all the while trembling in terror and stuttering her words in fear of her life.

Since she did not willingly betray them or had no prior knowledge, she is given mercy and spared from any harsh treatment. Hilma is instead ordered to come up with solutions to rectify the problems that have occurred as a result of the noble's action under her charge. Hilma then bows her head to the floor, thanking Ainz for his mercy, continues to swear her undying allegiance to him, and leaves the room immediately to carry out her new assignments.

Upon being transported to Noah Zweden’s mansion, Hilma is quickly confronted by her colleagues, who had arrived out of concern for her well-being. However, she reassures that nothing bad has happened to her like last time. She informs her colleagues that the Sorcerer King is not as terrifying as she thought he would be, but a master who they can reason with and be given mercy from. She encourages everyone to work even harder for the Sorcerer King and show loyalty to their master from now on. Afterwards, she begins seeking assistance from various sources for the task she had been given by the Sorcerer King.[6]

Later, when the Sorcerer Kingdom have begun their march towards Re-Estize. Hilma and the other Executives are ordered to choose about a thousand people from the Kingdom to be spared and taken to a safe location. While they wait with their followers in one of their mansions for an envoy to extract them, the other Executives become worried that they would not be rescued before the Kingdom's destruction. Hilma remains stead-fast in her conviction that the Sorcerer King will send someone for them. After Cocco Doll is brought into the room, the former notices their odd behavior and appearances and wonders if they are impostors or planning to kill him. When they refuse to respond, it made him all more suspicious. Hilma does not deny anything. After Shalltear Bloodfallen arrives and takes the Executives and their followers to a new village in the Sorcerer Kingdom, Cocco Doll is taken away by the Floor Guardian. Hilma, knowing what fate awaited him, quietly apologizes to her colleague. Though she and the rest of her friends know that Cocco Doll's fate is unavoidable, they believe that he will survive and join them.[7]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
After the Catastrophe and the emergence of the Cracks, Eight Fingers disbanded due to the crack down on all illegal activity by the nobles. Hilma later reformed and relocated to E-Rantel and gained a high-ranking position at the Pharmacist's Guild thanks to her knowledge on drugs. She would later return to Re-Estize and tried to invite her former colleague Zero and Six Arms to work as mercenaries at the city, but her offer was declined.[8]

Hilma's reputation as a former Executive of Eight Fingers would still linger among the populace of E-Rantel though she continued to use her skills for the city. The protagonist and his team were later hired by Hilma to retrieve soil samples from Carne Village to allow for the creation of a herb cultivation project that Hilma was working on with Lizzie Bareare. Later Hilma and the protagonist were brought before the city officials of E-Rantel. Due to the abnormal rise in the numbers of Sanitary Slimes and their aggression, Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra suspected that Hilma was responsible for the change, as the slimes contained heavy doses of alchemical solution which could only be accessed by a high ranking member of the Pharmacist's Guild. Given Hilma's shady past suspicion was cast over her and the protagonist own history of obtaining herbs for her were also brought to light. Hilma maintained that she was innocent stating her current project kept her busy from even concocting such a devious plan. It was determined that Hilma was telling the truth as the rising numbers of slimes was just as accident. The slimes were being feed runoff water that originated from her herb cultivation field which caused their aggressive mutation.[9]

After the second summit of the Tripartite Alliance, Hilma delivered herbs requested by Lizzie. When she inquired the need for such materials, Lizzie declined to offer a reason, though the former criminal suspected that the herbs were being gathered in anticipation for someone very important and in dire need for medical attention.[10]

Hilma would also provide information on one of her former associates Cocco Doll, who had become a crime boss of the Black Market. She provided the authorities led by Saint Clementine on his illicit operation allowing them to arrest him and eliminate the corruption in E-Rantel.[11]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

As one of the top executives of Eight Fingers, Hilma has full authority in the drug trade department and is able to do as she pleases in the organization relating to the drug trade. She is also one of the few capable of correctly perceiving Mare's gender, despite how the latter's appearance and clothing make him look like a girl. Hilma can tell a person’s inner thoughts by the fluctuations in their voice, their expressions, and their partialities. This wasn't some unusual ability, but just something she had picked up over time with experience on the job.

More so, due to Hilma's way of carefully manipulating and blackmailing those in her parties and festivities to entertain the Kingdom's nobility and first born heirs in order to gain leverage over them, Hilma has successfully gained immense secret political power over the Kingdom's hierarchy. In a way, Hilma happens to hold quite an immense influence and resources within both the Re-Estize Kingdom's official government and its various underground organizations. This can be indicated as she possessed enough power to skillfully arrange and create a New Faction for the Sorcerer Kingdom without many being able to tell that she was the true leader, founder, and power behind the faction. Hilma also possesses enough resources to easily acquire high level equipment with little trouble, as seen where she gave Philip a new set of high level armor.
Main Equipment

Viper's Tattoo: A magic snake tattoo that can materialize and come to life to attack at the wearer's command, the snake would then inject powerful toxins to kill its victim.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Eight Fingers

Like other executives of Eight Fingers, Hilma uses other executives as a way to promote their own power within the Eight Fingers and the Kingdom. However, due to differing views, Hilma had no qualms about selling them out to Nazarick if it was to end the suffering of torture.

After becoming slaves of Nazarick, all of them started to view each other as true friends who have endured the same pain and are bounded to the same fate, showing that the other executives have forgiven Hilma for selling them out, understanding the consequences of defying the Nazarick's inhabitants. As shown after Hilma’s interrogation regarding her charge’s foolish actions, the other executives showcase genuine concern for her and are glad that she was sparred.

Ampetif Cocco Doll

Even prior to being enslaved by Nazarick, Hilma has always possessed a friendly relationship with her fellow Eight Finger Leader, Coco Doll, due to their similar backgrounds. She also had a prior relationship with him in presumably the prostitution industry, where the two work together to reach their individual goals prior to joining the Eight Finger executives. He refers to their relationship as one of "Partners".

Later, after he is liberated from prison and saved by Eight Fingers during the final Siege on the Royal Capital in the Fall of the Re-Estize Kingdom, Coco Doll is able to immediately notice that something is wrong with Hilma due to her incredibly skinny frame and deeming it impossible that she would starve herself that much due to knowing how much effort she places in looking "elegant", further emphasizing their close relationship. Later, Hilma feels guilty at not been having been able to save him being dragged off by Shalltear to have his "Black Baptism" and is later hopeful that he would survive and join them in becoming servants (slaves) to Nazarick.

Philip Dayton L'Eyre Montserrat

Philip was one of the newly promoted nobles whom Hilma manipulated by feeding his ego. Because of his delusional behavior and naivety, she viewed him as the "ultimate fool." At the same time, the foolish noble was a great source of frustration and distress to Hilma, since she feared that the idiotic acts of Philip would cost her her life too.

Her fears would later prove themselves to be justified, as thanks to his foolish actions in attacking the supply caravan meant for the Holy Kingdom, she was summoned by Albedo and brought before Ainz to explain Philip's actions. However, upon her appearing completely clueless about what action she was charged for and her own dumbfounded expression at the situation, Hilma herself was nearly sentenced to being tortured to death by the Sorcerer King's aids, causing her to curse Philip due to his stupidity. But, in the end, she was spared harsh reprisal thanks to Ainz's mercy. Eventually, upon the Final Siege to the Royal Capital and Hilma having successfully evacuated the Royal Capital with her subordinates, their families, and her friends, Hilma was shown to have now completely abandoned and forgotten about Philip as she left him to his fate.

Albedo

Albedo is the one to whom Hilma reports directly on the Eight Finger's operations. Hilma's view of her, like all members of Nazarick, is of one absolute terror. Hilma is especially careful to avoid upsetting Albedo, to the point where she doesn't even think about telling her about Philip's idea of marrying her, for fear of what Albedo might do.

Ainz Ooal Gown

The Sorcerer King is her master, and thus she respects, but also greatly fears him. When she was brought in for interrogation in front of him, all Hilma could do was cower in fear and did everything in her power to keep herself alive, as she was certain he would kill her for the actions of the noble under her. However, Ainz showed her mercy and, in doing so, she felt very thankful for his mercy and has further strengthened her loyalty and allegiance to him. Hilma is looking to try her very best to make it so that she and her companions could become direct subordinates under the Sorcerer King. She views him as the type of master who would reward someone based on their performance and not treat his subordinates unreasonably.

Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.



Igor Rokerlen (イーグ・ロキルレン) was a noble from the Re-Estize Kingdom and a member of the New Faction.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Igor Rokerlen was an imposing and sturdy figure, described as a man that was thick in every dimension.
Personality

Though Igor was a physically menacing man, he couldn’t hold his own opinions without getting swayed by others. For social gatherings, Igor had to switch from two personalities, as his natural language was so unrefined that none of the nobility would dare be caught using that language.
Background

The noble had inherited his position, in the aftermath of the Massacre at Katze Plains. Soon after gaining his position, he became friends with Baron Montserrat and Baron Delvin in the New Faction. He was among the third and fourth sons of his family.
Chronology

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Baron Rokerlen and Baron Delvin going out for drinks at an establishment encountered Baron Montserrat. Joining him they shared mugs of pale ale. Rokerlen offered the leader of the New Faction a plate of nuts and drank in a rambunctious manner. Later they shared their woes on the struggles they have been facing as noblemen, specifically in their lack of funds coming from their demesnes. They agreed collectively that the fault not laid with them by their 'incompetent' peasants they commanded. Philip lamented on the current situation if nothing changed then all he could do was wait for a bad harvest so the price of grain would go up. When Delvin brought up, Philip's territory, Wayne interrupted him and whispered that even if a bad harvest occurs, the price won’t necessarily rise. He informed him that there was a huge amount of cheap grain being transported from the Sorcerer Kingdom to the Kingdom.

Having acquired the intel from a trustworthy source, the baron told Philip the Sorcerer Kingdom had stored large quantities of grain in warehouses owned by the merchants in the capital. He didn't know much about the exact details other than the fact that the grain was there for storage only and that the Sorcerer Kingdom had already paid for the storage fee. Additionally, the grain was being casted with [Preserve] to prolong its shelf-life and undead workers were being used on farmland. The food though was being transported to another location, as food relief, to the Roble Holy Kingdom which was still recovering from the attack from Jaldabaoth. It was from this information that Philip concocted a scheme to drive the price of grain up, by stealing the stockpile from the Sorcerer Kingdom which he invited Wayne and Igor into his plan.

Once Philip left, the two secretly begun to conspire on how to deal with the former's plan of raiding the Sorcerer Kingdom's caravan of grains while looking to come up with a proposed plan of their own.

While helping to carry out the battle plan, both Baron Igor and Delvin later met up with Philip at their destination, a patch of road in his friend’s demesne. There, they suggest to Philip about using the Crane-Wing Formation to ambush the Sorcerer Kingdom's caravan. The two inform Philip that each of them have brought around 75 soldiers with them to their intended location. Igor's and Wayne's forces will be covering the side flanks while Philip have his 50 soldiers advance first. The left flank is the direction where Igor's forces will be at as well as it being where Philip and his soldiers are going to retreat to. Considering that Philip's plan is to set up an ambush in the forest, Igor and Wayne have already prepared such a place where twigs, weeds, and whatnot have already been cleared out ahead of time. This was done so that it could allow them to form a successful retreat on horseback. Although the operation is a success for Philip, neither Igor nor Wayne were expecting it to turn out that way.[1] The fate of the baron is later revealed towards the end of the war with the Sorcerer Kingdom when Philip drunkenly brooding in his depression is visited by Albedo who presented him a box containing the heads of Wayne and Igor.[2]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

According to himself, Rokerlen cannot find any appeal in alcohol, only drinking in social events when needed. Though Igor might be more athletic than the average person, he was completely outmatched in terms of intelligence.
Relationships

Philip Dayton L'Eyre Montserrat

Igor was one of the few members of the New faction that chose not to distance themselves from Philip. He even allowed the other noble to call him by his first name. While at first appearing they are on mutually good terms, but in reality, he despises and resents him for being the head of the faction as well as the sheer idiocy he shows.

Wayne Delvin

Rokerlen's land neighbored Delvin's thus it was a common sight for them to be working together. While it was unusual for neighboring lords to be friendly with each other, but since they were the third and fourth sons of their family, they weren’t indoctrinated with animosity from the past. That was why they were so close.

Hilma Cygnaeus

Both Himself and Wayne are suspicious of Hilma with her supporting Philips exploits in controlling the New Faction and actually suspect that she might be the real one who is controlling things behind the scenes and possibly might be working with the Eight Fingers organization and prefer not to get involved with her if they can.

"I am the Lich serving the Supreme Being, Iguva. If you forfeit now, I will grant you a painless death."
- Iguva=41's declaration.
Iguva=41 (イグヴァ=41) was the field commander of the undead army that was sent to annihilate the lizardmen tribes but was instead defeated by them.

Appearance

Iguva=41 was a hideous undead magic caster that reeks of death and decay. He wore an old and luxurious robe that covered his body of skin and bones.
Personality

While Iguva=41 was very arrogant, he did not underestimate his foes. With complete and utter devotion to Ainz, he tried to do whatever it took to complete his creator's orders.
Background

Iguva=41 was a corpse that Ainz Ooal Gown turned into an Elder Lich as part of an experiment. He was part of the undead army commanded by Cocytus that was deployed to fight the lizardmen tribes.
Chronology

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Eight days later at the beginning of the battle between the lizardmen and the undead, he is kept in reserve on Ainz's instruction. After the lizardmen destroyed the undead army, Cocytus, acting as the army commander, authorizes his deployment on the field.

Overlord II EP03 105
Iguva=41 using Fireball
Upon ordering his Blood Meat Hulks to attack the three tribal chiefs who're protecting the lizardmen army's flank, he uses his powerful Fireball spell against the army's main force, forcing it to pull back. A suicide attack by five elite lizardmen Head Warriors only reaches halfway before being annihilated.

While so, a second attack is made by Zaryusu Shasha, Zenberu Gugu, and Crusch Lulu hiding behind Rororo. The hydra is protected by protective and healing spells plus the freezing ability of Frost Pain is finally brought down. However, it is not before he allows the three lizardmen heroes to reach striking distance of Iguva=41. The Lich summons four Skeleton Warriors to guard himself until they were eventually engaged by Zenberu Gugu and Crusch Lulu in battle. As a result, this allows Zaryusu Shasha the chance to face the undead magician one on one in close combat.

Overlord II EP03 151
Iguva=41 Defeated
After a drawn-out battle, the lizardman, battered by the Lich's spells, engages one last time with his Frost Pain's special ability, creating a thick cold fog, and half-blindly striking through it. That strike finally puts his sword through Iguva=41's head, ending him once and for all. Before finally dying, Iguva=41 begs his creator, Ainz Ooal Gown for forgiveness in failing to defeat the lizardmen.[1]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
When word reached Momonga about Six Arms conducting a large scale undead subjugation in the Katze Plains, he believed that the movements were related to Shalltear being mind-controlled by a third party. The information on the workers actions were acquired by an adventurer named Igvarge who's adventurer team had defeated a elder lich commanding a Ghost Ship. The adventurers were all killed when they defeated the elder lich. Interestingly Six Arms was seeking the elder lich as well, but not to kill it but to tame it. To find out what the workers from the Baharuth Empire were up to, Momonga recovered the Ghost Ship and used one of the discarded bodies of the adventurers to create a new elder lich he named Iguva=41.

Iguva=41's mission was to encounter the workers who were looking for the undead. His goal was to gain a seat in their inner circle and to learn all he could about their plans. Due to the members of Six Arms being familiar with working with one of his kind, Iguva assimilated well as their new magic caster.

In conjunction he would be assisted by Lupusregina Beta and CZ2128 Delta going under the names of Regi and Shizuni. The duo would be recruited by Six Arms to complete their six-member team. Due to his powers being necessary, Iguva was privy to Zero's meeting with a trio including two nobles and a merchant that sought to depose Emperor Jircniv. The trio wished to establish a smuggling route to the Slane Theocracy via the Katze Plains to acquire slaves and weapons to bolster their forces in preparation for a rebellion. The elder lich was to act as insurance to safely cross the undead infested land. Once he was informed of the true plan, he passed the information to Regi and Shizuni who relayed it to the echelons in Nazarick.

Iguva continued his position as a new member of Six Arms professionally and on the day of scouting out the new smuggling route used his Ghost Ship to travel the route with his new companions to ensure it was safe. He cautioned Zero that while his powers of the undead were impressive he still had trouble against Death Knights and Skeleton Dragons. The latter proved to be no issue after one appeared, intentionally by Momonga, and Regi and Shizuni were able to prove their ability by fighting it.

The next day Iguva would steer his ship into the fog again, leading carriages of the anti-Jircniv faction along the smuggling route to meet their partners in the Theocracy. The convoy though was intercepted by the Four Imperial Knights. Zero and the two members of the original Six Arms revealed that they had sold out the nobles and their workers in exchange for Zero's to be given the rank of an Imperial Knight. While the workers hired by the nobles sided with their current employers, Iguva, Regi and Shizuni remained loyal to Zero and fought the workers. After the fight was over, Iguva captured all the ones that tried to escape and turned them over to the knights. However, he and the other two new members worried that their usefulness was outlived and prepared for another fight, but their concerns proved to be unneeded as Zero had no intention of turning on them given their skills and usefulness.

While it was expected that New Six Arms would be dissolved once Zero was be promoted as a member of the Four Knights, it was delayed as Zero still needed to prove himself in a physical test against one of the current members. Thus, Iguva remained a member of Six Arms, serving as a spy to monitor the developments within the Empire. Momonga later would order him to patrol and monitor the Katze Plains and at the same time to assist the protagonist when he was called upon.[2]

Later when the Adventurer's Guild was suffering from public relations accusing it of being a greedy organization that care only for profit, to appease the masses and showed that the guild cared for the adventurers that lost their lives in the field, Guildmaster Pluton Ainzach wanted to display the deceased adventurers' relics at the guild. One in particular being Igvarge's and his team of Kralgra mithril plates. Since Iguva was made from the corpse the deceased adventurer, Regi and Shizuni were sent to ask the lich if he still possessed his plate, but the lich was clueless to his origins. The trio then searched the Ghost Ship for the plate to no avail.

Six Arms left Iguva behind when they went to go to the Katze Plains after hearing about the protagonist's aim to collect adventurer plates in the area. The reason why the lich was not asked to go was that the workers wanted to keep the shares of the reward as five instead of six. Later Iguva was contacted by Nigredo to rendezvous with Six Arms at a Skeletal Dragon nest where his teammates were busy securing the hoard after working together with Darkness. His presence came as an unexpected surprise to the workers, though Zero accepted his explanation for hearing the ruckus of killing the dragon throughout the plains and decided to investigate. As they needed quick transportation to collect their loot, Zero accepted Iguva's offer to move the treasure agreeing to a split of six ways.[3]

Regi and Shizuni were out reselling daily household magic items in E-Rantel, Iguva left at the base of Six Arms, provided alibis for their long absence to the human workers. Later when Zero showed concern that the worker team could split again, Malmvist and Peshurian being his long time comrades promised not to abandon him. In his case Iguva added support to remain with Zero, stating it was a profitable relationship due to being able to infiltrate a human city and gain new sources of magic. The elder lich then was present when the two women returned bringing news that their resale venture was a bust as the Sorcerer Kingdom was developing new magic items for daily use.[4]

Sometime after the event known as the Calamity, news reached New Six Arms that a Halloween Festival will be hosted in E-Rantel. Regi wanting to check it out decided to head there and Zero who wanted to participate in the mock battles to showcase his strength, then had Iguva prepare the Ghost Ship to take him and Regi to the event.[5]

Later when New Six Arms contracted another job from Emperor Jircniv to provide security for the Halloween Festival hosted in Arwintar, Iguva was told to remain at the hideout by Zero. When his team arrived back, Iguva commented that they must have been successful in their task. Sometime later when Regi announced that she may have located the missing Shizuni, the lich was the first in the team to voice a response to this news.[6]

When Regi and Shizuni showcased the electric guitar at New Six Arms hideout and their idea to promote and sell them as music items in the Empire, they had less than stellar reactions from the humans. Iguva though claimed that the sound the guitar made was stimulating to the undead.[7]

Again, at the Katze Plains, Iguva along with his team, watched as a group of former aristocrats fled from the Empire who were allowed to do so at the order of Zero. After Zero explained his reasons of why he let them go to create a facade that he was committing treason against the emperor by allowing his enemies to escape, he directed Iguva to steer the Ghost Ship away from the area to one where they could hunt some stray undead.

Later Iguva participated in plan to capture all the members of the Anti-Imperial Faction at a party. After Regi and Shizuni retrieved the incriminating Blood Oath and escaped from the venue, Iguva appeared before the pursuing guards to inform them his undead had captured their employers.[8]

A year after the defeat of Enhela Read Gahi, Iguva was at the hideout of his team. The undead lost a bet with Peshurian, after Regi and Shizuni returned from the Grand Arena, having been unable to get tickets into the event. They had been sent by Zero to try and get into the arena, to get more information on two suspicious people.

Since the team were making bets on the outcome of the newcomers' match, with the pot being used on drinking money, Iguva betted on the strangers losing. The team were then assigned a request to clear out the undead to ensure the safety of the Katze Plains, Iguva questioned if they want to wipe out the undead not under his control in that area. It turned out that the area needed to be cleared up for the safety of the delegation from the Quadripartite Alliance. An idea was proposed by Malmvist to use Iguva's undead attack the carriage of the delegation and orchestrate a rescue incident, but it was rejected by Zero as he did not want to embarrass himself or implicit the emperor.[9]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Iguva=41 is a level 22 monster. But owing to a skill held by his creator Ainz Ooal Gown that buffs summoned undead, his stats have been increased significantly beyond his level. Iguva=41 believes himself to be a far superior creation compared to the automatically-spawning Elder Liches in the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

As an undead, he was unaffected by Frost Pain's ice damage ability.

In the Web Novel, according to Ainz Ooal Gown, this commanding lich who led the Army of Death was the strongest undead monster he has created with his [Create Low Tier Undead] skill.[10]
Active

Fireball: A 3rd tier spell that allows the caster to summon a large fireball that is used for attacks.
Lightning: A 3rd tier spell that shoots a bolt of lightning.
Scare: Induces fear into the opponent.
Magic Arrow: A 1st tier spell, that shoots light arrows against a target.
Summon 4th tier Undead: A 4th tier spell that Summons four Skeleton Warriors.
Negative Touch: Through physical contact, Iguva=41 uses his racial skill as shown by grabbing Zaryusu's throat. Thus, negative energy then flowed into his target's body, robbing the lizardman of his vitality.
Relationships

Ainz Ooal Gown

As his personal creation, Iguva=41 has undying loyalty towards him and would die for him. When he dies, he apologizes to Ainz for failing to defeat the Lizardmen.

Cocytus

Iguva=41 served as Cocytus's commander during the attack on the Lizardmen.

Lizardmen Alliance

Iguva=41 saw them like insects that should be squashed for the glory of Nazarick.

Imina (イミーナ) is a half-elf worker and member of Foresight. She and her companions volunteered to explore and investigate the mysterious Large Tomb.

Appearance

Imina is a half-elf, a hybrid of a human and an elf. She has a very slim body. Be it the chest or waist area, there are no curves on her body. If looked at from far away, it won’t be surprising if people mistook Imina as a man rather than a woman.
Personality

Due to a humiliating past experience, where she was attacked by a monster near a body of water, she avoids swimming thereafter.
Background

Imina is the result of a union between a male elf and a human woman. Her father seems to have outlived her mother.
Chronology

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Imina was asked to watch over the Singing Apple Inn by the barkeep while her comrades were out. She was rudely approached by a man, who was looking for Arche. Imina refused to disclose the location of her friend as the person also refused to tell her his business. Hekkeran Termite eventually came and scared the man away. 

Arche and Roberdyck Goltron returned and met up with Hekkeran Termite and Imina, where it was revealed that the man looking for Arche was a debt collector and the dire financial situation of her family.[1]

Foresight took on a request made by Count Femel, after meeting the noble at his residence, along with the gathered worker parties, Imina immediately took on a disliking for the leader of Tenmu, Erya Uzruth.[2]

When Foresight entered the depths of the mysterious Large Tomb, their party fought against hordes of undead. They eventually triggered a trap, transporting them to the Colosseum on the 6th Floor to be pit against the master of the Large Tomb.[3] She comforted Arche after her friend experienced a traumatizing revelation when she evaluated Ainz's power. She was the second person to become a prey to his negative touch. Imina and Hekkeran were sent to Gashokukochuuou's residence.[4]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Imina came to E-Rantel with her comrades and hired by Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix. There she trained with other workers, though she was disgusted at having to work with characters such as Erya, and would go on a drunken tirade to her friends at a bar.[5] Her team was hired by the Baharuth Empire and Imina participated in a plan to cull the Chaos Beast horde approaching E-Rantel. Having been placed under the command of Zero and Six Arms they fought to delay the monsters at the Quarry. However, she was killed after being dissolved by slime acid as the Bloody Emperor used the workers to lure the horde of Chaos Beasts into a trap.[6]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Imina is a ranger that excels in perception and awareness of her surroundings. She possesses an innate talent which allows her to float well in water and tend not to sink. However, it does not guarantee that she will not.
Job Classes

Ranger
Rogue
Bushwhacker
Main Equipment

Bow and Arrow
Relationships

Hekkeran Termite

Hekkeran is Imina's comrade and also her lover.

Roberdyck Goltron

Imina and Roberdyck have great trust in one another and fought together against Ainz in the end.

Arche Eeb Rile Furt

Imina deeply cares for Arche and acts as an older sister, pitying her friend's misfortune, seeing it unfair for one girl to bear the debt of her ostentatious parents.

Erya Uzruth

Due to witnessing first-hand, the belligerent worker's attitude toward non-humans, the half-elf has nothing, but mere disdain for him.

Increment (インクリメント) is one of the forty-one Homunculus Maids that are responsible for the various maid jobs on the 9th and 10th Floors of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Yamaiko, one of the three female members of Ainz Ooal Gown.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Like all the homunculus maids, Increment wears a maid uniform. In the Anime Increment's dark brown hair is cut in a pageboy style.
Personality

Increment sometimes talks aggressively. She prefers to eat in silence and read books during meal time.
Background

Increment was created by Yamaiko, while most other maids were made by Whitebrim or Herohero. Being made by Yamaiko, Increment can technically be Yuri Alpha's direct younger sibling.
Chronology

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Increment was eating quietly in the staff canteen, reading a book when her fellow maids: Cixous, Foire and Lumière came together for breakfast. Deciding that the canteen was getting too noisy for her taste, Increment left but not before reminding Cixous that it was her turn to attend to Ainz Ooal Gown needs and should hurry. Later it was Increment's turn to personally serve Ainz, and her master went on to an appointment to Spa Resort Nazarick with the other male Floor Guardians asked her to direct those looking for him to remain in his office.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Increment's abilities and class are generally at level one. Like all of the homunculus maids, they have a racial penalty called [Increased Food Consumption], in which the maids need to eat a lot of food.

Her maid outfit is equal to a high-class item, bringing her some defensive stats.
Relationships

Ainz Ooal Gown

Like all the homunculus maids, Increment is loyal to Ainz, and she will serve him well with her fullest effort.

Pleiades

Like all the homunculus maids, Increment thinks of the Pleiades as a kind of idol group, with CZ2128 Delta being the most popular among them.

Homunculus Maids

Increment appears to work professionally with her colleagues, though she appears to be somewhat of a loner and prefers a quiet space to read; likely due to gaining some of her creator's characteristics upon becoming real in the New World.

Yuri Alpha & Decrement

Both Yuri Alpha and Decrement are both Custom NPC's made by Yamaiko and as such similar to the other NPC's with the same creator, its likely that Increment also possess strong familial feelings towards the two of them. Though for Decrement, Increment feels that the other is a bit too nosey.[2]

Yamaiko

Yamaiko is one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings of the Great Tomb of Nazarick and Increment's creator. As such similar to her fellow NPC's, its likely that Increment respects and revers Yamaiko the most out of the Supreme Beings and withholds her loyalty first and foremost to Yamiko.

Herohero

Herohero is revealed to have played a role in developing Increment as he was responsible in helping create the maids whose names are based on computer terms. Furthermore the maid also appears to idolize the slime.[3]

Solution Epsilon

Since both were made by the same creator, Herohero, the two maids get along

Though the other beasts had yet to receive orders to hunt and chase down their prey, Iris went on ahead and used her Petrifying Roar, killing all the humans in the vicinity. Iris joined her master and peers in invading deeper into the capital to take over a few of the buildings. Following Aura's lead, she and the others caused mayhem and destruction, leaping from roof to roof, heading to the Magician's Guild.

Isabella (イザベラ) is a demon from Mass for the Dead.

Appearance

In her human form, Isabella appears as a busty dark purple long-haired woman with some streaks of white. She wears a golden necklace with a ruby, and a dark corset-like dress that reveals much of her cleavage and belly. On her hands she has cover sleeves. In her demon form, Isabella sprouts crude wicked horns and a pair of bat-like wings at her waist.
Personality

Though having a luscious appearance, Isabella hides a sinister nature. She is a sadistic demon that thinks of humans as nothing more than food or toys, taking delight in their misery and despair as she kills them during her feedings. The demon seems to be very confident on her abilities, deeming herself to be above those she considers prey.
Background

Isabella was an immigrant from outside E-Rantel. At one point she became a business associate with Cocco Doll and she received ownership of the Black Honeymooner from him, so the authorities would not suspect the criminal's involvement. All the while she has been the cause of several disappearances of employees at the brothel.
Chronology

Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Isabella was first introduced as being a hostess to Sebas Tian for all expense paid session at her brothel provided by his co-workers from the quarry. She guided the undercover Nazarick agent to a room and introduced him to a woman named Tuare. She later had a secret meeting with the original owner of the brothel and gave her report on the management of the "goods" in the shop. When Saint Clementine and the protagonist's team are pursuing one of Cocco Doll's minions, she cancels all the reservations at the shop due to the disturbance and tells Tuare and her employers to get ready to move.

Later, she is seen brutally torturing several of her female employees in her private dungeon while Tuare looks on in horror as she devours them one by one. The protagonist's team and Sebas Tian return to the brothel and discover the secret passageway leading to the sewers. Following it, they find a hidden room there where the team find Isabella and her victims. Based on the carnage and her glowing eyes, the protagonist and his comrades determine that she is not human. Having no reason to hide herself anymore, Isabella reveals herself as a demon. The sight of a native demon to the New World intrigues the Nazarick agents who then decide to capture her for their master. The demon tries to use Tuare as a hostage to force their cooperation, but she is knocked away from the girl by Sebas Tian with a punch. Angered by the attack, the demon swears to make the old man pay. Unfortunately, the demon finds herself at the butler's mercy as he proceeds to pummel her with punches. Shaken at how she could be so weak before this "human," Isabella used [Charm Person] and specially made incense on Sebas Tian. Believing that the butler is now seemingly under her power, she gloats at the adventurers that it's over for them. Before she can command Sebas Tian to attack his allies, Tuare places herself between Isabella and Sebas begging her to stop. Intrigued to her sudden boost in confidence despite ignoring all her co-workers pleas for help, Isabella sees that the girl has fallen in love with Sebas Tian.

Though she mocks at the girl's hypocrisy, the girl admits her own selfishness, but she is now willing to die to protect someone who cares about her. Unimpressed, the demon tells Sebas to get rid of her. To Isabella's utter shock, Sebas Tian merely strokes Tuare's head commenting on her bravery, revealing how he was never under her power in the first place as he was a heteromorph and not a human to begin with. The demon seeing herself totally outmatched attempted to escape into the sewers, with Soi in pursuit.

Later on, the official story told by the adventurers to the freed Tuare and the survivors was that Isabella escaped. Of course, it was nothing more than a fabrication to hide the fact that Isabella was captured by Soi, containing the demon in her slime body to be transported back to the Great Tomb of Nazarick for a proper interrogation on her unusual technique to enhance a simple spell.[1]

The memory of the demon would still be recollect by Tuare. Tuare being concerned for her friend who had also worked at the brothel, was a mother whose child had disappeared. Tuare remembered that Isabella didn't always throw out pregnant girls from the brothel. According to that demon, she made sure all the babies would be "taken care of". Though Tuare suspected that the demon had something more sinister involved for the women and children.[2]

Abilities and Powers

Isabella is able to take a human form to hide her horns and wings. The disguise is flawless however it can wear off, especially her eyes, when she is distracted from eating. Being a heteromorph she has displayed traits fitting for a demon, able to rip and shred human flesh with just her nails and bare hands.
Active

Charm Person: The spell could be caused by the charmed target to see the user as their best friend. And as their friend, the user's words had a certain amount of effect on that person. However, since this was only a low-level charm spell, it could not brain-wash the target.
Main Equipment

Incense: A sweet scent that Isabella specially made that enhances her [Charm Person] spell. The effect of this combination is so great that it cannot be resisted by magic or even an item and even pushes the limits of what the spell can do such as having a target obey to the point of committing suicide. The only drawbacks are that there is a time limit of controlling a target and that it cannot be used on the same person more than once.
Relationships

Cocco Doll

Isabella was a business associate of Cocco Doll and was aware of his past as the head of the slave trade department in Eight Fingers. She was cordial to him and kept him in the loop of his original property's operations during their secret meetings. However, it appears that the former Executive was in the dark on her being a demon or her activities in feeding on the brothel staff.

Sebas Tian

Originally thinking that he was just a nosey old man, after she faced him in battle, she realized how wrong she was about him. By her estimate he was at the peak of human potential in strength.

Tuare

To her human employee she saw her as just another food or toy to torment. Calling her a stupid girl that enslaved herself to a non-existent debt contract. She openly mocked Tuare for her lack of power and weakness in helping anyone.
