Leinas Rockbruise (レイナース・ロックブルズ) is the only female member of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Leinas has fair skin, green eyes and long blond hair with bangs covering the right side of her face and a beauty mark beneath her lower lip on the left side. She has a brown string tied around her head, and tied her hair back in a loose ponytail tied a few inches above the end. The right side of her face is described to be in a disgusting state due to a curse which causes it to secrete pus.
Personality

Leinas can be seen as formal but aloof, direct and blunt. She’s also self-serving because of her curse and the circumstances after, she made it her life’s goal in finding a cure and do anything to achieve it as she made it clear to Jircniv she only serve him because it is most profitable for her to do so, and will immediately abandon her position if someone else can provide her with what she wants.

Due to her disfigured face, she somewhat ashamed of it and is shown to be envious to the beauty of other women as she express displeasure whenever the men complimented the Pleiades' beauty.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Leinas was born to a noble family of the Baharuth Empire, where she earned a measure of fame and renown by defeating monsters and beasts around her family's domain. However, one day, she was cursed after she slew a monster, which disfigured the right side of her face. Knowing her appearance would bring shame upon them, her fiancé abandoned her and her family disowned her.

Afterwards, her only goal in life became to get revenge on those who wronged her and to find a way to cure her so-called "incurable" curse. Leinas's abilities and reputation eventually caught Emperor Jircniv's attention, who allowed her to have her revenge in exchange for joining his personal guard. She use her new position to request the Court Wizard, Fluder Paradyne to rid of her curse, but even his efforts fail to bring results.
Chronology

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Leinas was part of the envoy that escorted Jircniv to meet with Ainz Ooal Gown in order to make restitution for the invasion force by the worker groups. Leinas became paralyzed in fear and horror when she witnessed the Death Knights emerging from the fortress.

While meeting with Ainz, she was planning to run away from the envoy to save her own skin. However, the reason why she hadn't done so right away was due to the thought that the Death Knights might have preferred going after those who ran away instead.

Afterwards, she feasted with the rest of the envoy on the banquet that was prepared by several Death Knights and Pleiades. All the while, she expresses envy for the battle maids' beauty which was enticing the rest of the men present.[2]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
In the Imperial Capital, Leinas stayed behind to guard the Imperial Palace after Emperor Jircniv and two of her fellow imperial knights depart to the Colosseum. Thinking about Leinas's actions until now, Jircniv thinks that she is possibly planning to migrate to the Sorcerer Kingdom after raising her value in the eyes of the Sorcerer King.

Officially, Leinas stays in the Empire in order to repay the kindness Emperor Jircniv showed her. While the Emperor wanted to take the words Leinas says at face value, that was impossible for Jircniv as he doubts her loyalty. In fact, he knows that she is the least loyal of all the Four Imperial Knights and would likely betray him for the Sorcerer Kingdom.[3]

The Current Situation of Various People. A Prologue Arc

Main article: The Current Situation of Various People. A Prologue Arc
It was mentioned that there were two vacancies in the Four Imperial Knights, indicating that Leinas left the knight order.[4]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
After the Catastrophe and the formation of the Tripartite Alliance, Leinas volunteered to be stationed at E-Rantel that would serve as the capital of the military alliance. Though her colleagues suspected that Leinas wanted the post as E-Rantel was the safest place to be in the new dark age. In truth Leinas wanted to exploit the new information network that was being established within the three nations. It was her hope that a solution could be found to remove the curse on her face. When Leinas arrived at E-Rantel with Nimble, a young boy threw a stone at her as his father was killed by the Empire in the Annual Wars. Rather than punish the boy, Leinas encouraged the boy to stoke his revenge and wait patient before sending him off. The female knight then worked with Nimble to establish the Empire's garrison at the fortress city and win the trust of the people. When the forces of the Sunlight Scripture came to assist, she met with the commander, Ian Als Heim who impressed her with his strength. After Ian led some of the members of the Scripture to Carne Village to save it from Chaos Beasts and possibly locate a Crack, Leinas volunteered to bring reinforcements, in part to study the Crack for herself she believes that the phenomena may be useful in removing her curse which even Fluder Paradyne was unable to remove.[5][6][7]

Leinas would save Ian and his men in the depths of the Great Forest of Tob from the Chaos Beasts coming from the Crack. The knights would be introduced to the protagonist and his allies from Nazarick. During her time traveling to the Crack, she witnessed the protagonists' ability, greatly surprising her. After the mission was completed, Leinas picked up a few terms from the unknown faction such as the "Supreme One" which interested her. She and Ian would guide the protagonist and the remaining members of his party to E-Rantel.[8] Once back in E-Rantel, Leinas reported back to her camp to inform Nimble of the protagonist.[9]

Some time after the protagonist became an adventurer, Leinas would meet the undercover Nazarick agent again at the Free City of Vadis where the former assisted her and Nimble in escorting a caravan of supplies back to E-Rantel.[10] At the time of the summit meeting from the Tripartite Alliance, Leinas was stationed outside the city with Nigun Grid Luin and Ian to establish a defensive perimeter around the city. Their lines were attacked by a horde of Chaos Beast, and were pushed back. Nigun led a retreat of the priests and knights, while Ian and Leinas stayed behind to by the injured some time. The two were nearly killed by the alpha of the horde if it were not for the protagonist and his comrades.[11]

Leinas was present on the battlefield when a second horde of Chaos Beasts from the Northern Cave marched towards the city. Fighting with her peers she and the rest of the united forces of the Alliance succeeded in defeating the horde. However the horde was just a vanguard and a another one three times the sixth was approaching.[12] The knight witnessed her emperor make a deal with Jaldabaoth to have his demons slaughter the Chaos Beasts. Once the deed was done, the demon demanded Jircniv's life as payment which caused her and the other Four Imperial Knights to attack him and defend the emperor. Aside from Nazami Enec, who was killed, she and the remaining knights were defeated and rendered unconscious by the Demon Emperor.[13]

Weeks later, the protagonist arranged Leinas to unknowingly go on a date with an acquaintance of his. She was only told that the person was a friend of the protagonist and wished for her to show him around E-Rantel. During their time, Leinas unexpectedly received a compliment of her bangs hiding the right side of her face. However before they could get to know each other more, Leinas was knocked out by a phenomena that encompassed the entire city. When the Sunlight Scripture returned to E-Rantel, they found her and the inhabitants to be unconscious. She was quickly attended by Ian who found her collapsed on he street.[14]

Leinas having survived the confrontation with the Demon Emperor, experienced a blow to her pride and self-worth as did her fellow knights. It was only worse when Nazami could not be revived even with the aid of Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra's magic as the knight's body was too badly damaged. Upon returning to the imperial capital, rumors began to go abound about their failure in losing to the Demon Emperor. Though the worst of these rumors were directed at the emperor and how he was broken by the demon and left a shell of his former self. When Jircniv refrained from any action to correct these misconceptions, Leinas and her fellow Imperial Knights approached the listless emperor during a briefing on Zero's exploits. The trio urged Jircniv to come to his senses not just to reclaim his dignity but also theirs. To his amazement she learns that Jircniv had not resigned himself to the insults but had been sacrificing his reputation to lure out the Anti-Jircniv faction. Leinas was given orders to head out with the Imperial Knights to the Katze Plains where Zero, who was actually an undercover agent for the emperor, would lead the rebels directly to them and be arrested. Once all the conspirators were collected, Nimble informed Zero that the worker would be rewarded a place among the Four Imperial Knights after he defeated one of them. Though a time could not be scheduled due to the prisoner taking priority, Nimble told the former criminal to be ready for that duel. After he and his knights gave their report to the emperor they were dismissed. Given a moment to talk among themselves Leinas expressed her dislike of the idea for Zero to be one of the Four Imperial Knights.[15]

E-Rantel would face another attack, though this time from Chaos Beasts invading through Cracks formed right within the city. At the order of the emperor, Leinas and Nimble led a contingent of knights to the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute to protect the researchers. She along with Nimble were surprised to find the fugitive Fluder Paradyne there, however they decided to prioritize the safety of the researchers and contents of the institute first. The knights then headed to the lower levels where Sophie Noia and Nfirea Bareare were conducting their experiment. They should have been safe in the lowest floor, but a Spear Chaos Beast had teleported into the area taking all of them by surprise. The knights attempted to kill the Chaos Beast, but found their abilities to defeat it lacking and everyone on the floor save for Nfirea were slaughtered.[16]

After the attack on E-Rantel, Leinas's corpse was among those recovered by the Empire. Through the assistance of the Sorcerer Kingdom, Leinas was revived which caused her to be deeply greatly for.

When E-Rantel hosted its second Greetings and Victory Festival, Leinas and Nimble accompanied Jircniv to attend. The Imperial Knight wanted to come to the event to offer her gratitude to the "protagonist" for reviving her, but was unable to do so as he was busying talking to the Mayor Panasolei and Prince Zanac, introducing them to Shall, Ku, and Aura. This disheartened her, but she perked up when Jircniv suggested she could attract the protagonist's attention if she performed well at the dedication ceremony of the festival. The first match of the dedication performance had Leinas and Nimble square off against Narberal and Aura though the pair were defeated.[17] Additionally since her revival, she reported the fact that the protagonist was hiding Fluder at the institute, but the knight was ordered by Jircniv to forgot it happened.[18]

Sometime afterwards, Emperor Jircniv arrange Arwintar's own Greetings and Victory Festival. Leinas and Nimble escorted the imperial majesty to the Grand Arena where he was to give an address to the imperial citizens on the festivities. The three arrived at the arena without incident via carriage.[19]

During a meeting of the representatives of the Tripartite Alliance, Leinas accompanied Nimble who served as the Empire's representative. At the meeting when it was discussed by Gazef Stronoff that it was indeed possible to cross onto the "other side" and rescue the people trapped there, Leinas drew the question of how Gazef was able to do so as past attempts were met with failure. It was there she and the people in the room learned that Gazef was contaminated by the miasma and was recently cured through the secret research efforts of the Sorcerer Kingdom. And although Enhela wanted to cite the Sorcerer Kingdom for its lack of transparency on this development, she and Nimble sided with the protagonist due to personal and political reasons.

When a plan was made for the Four Kingdoms Rescue Team, the Theocracy revealed that it would be sending out Ian and Nigun, who were recently rescued by Enhela. Upon seeing Ian alive and well, Leinas was joyous to see him. Afterwards she had a personal meeting with Darkness, to offer her thanks to them and pass her gratitude to the Supreme One. Her gratitude was in part due to the curse on her face being removed after she was revived from death thanks to the Sorcerer Kingdom's magic. Having received permission from the emperor to be allowed to repay her debt, Leinas offered the protagonist her services should he ever need it.

A prelude to the rescue operation, Leinas and Nimble later escorted the emperor at a prep rally that was held for the volunteers of the operation. At the feast venue held later, the knight was seen as part of the Empire's delegation.[20]

During the expedition into the Crack, Leinas was shocked at seeing giant sized Chaos Beasts of specialized variants.[21] Later the rescue team rushed back to E-Rantel after receiving word from the Sorcerer Kingdom that enormous amounts of miasma were spilling in from Cracks in every major city in the Tripartite Alliance. Since their unit was the only military force in the area, the joint international force hurried to the alliance's capital to save what they could. On the way, Leinas talked to some members of the team who were starting to think E-Rantel was cursed due to the number of incidents it experienced.

To Leinas rather than seeing the incidents being the work of a curse, the knight saw them as attacks by Chaos Beasts, Invisible Calamities, and even Jaldabaoth, just inevitable events. And although news of the dire situation was received by [Message] from the Sorcerer Kingdom, Leinas didn't put too much faith in the magic as information could still be misinterpreted and expressed hope on her emperor's safety. At E-Rantel, Leinas joined Nimble and the imperial knights in working to contain the contaminated and restore order to the city.[22]

A month later, the situation in E-Rantel had stabilized. Leinas remained in the city and attended a meeting hosted by the Warrior Captain to conduct security and foreign expeditions. At the meeting, the female knight commented that thanks to the Sorcerer Kingdom, the training of those who have been strengthened through the contamination and its removal was progressing smoothly. Soon, the burden on her and her fellows as a fighting force should be lightened somewhat, regardless of the stress.[23]

A year after the defeat of Enhela, the female knight was escorting a delegation from the Quadripartite Alliance on an inspection tour of the Baharuth Empire. Whilst traveling through the Katze Plains from E-Rantel, Leinas while riding her horse next to the carriage carrying Prime Minister Albedo, King Zanac, Emperor Jircniv, the protagonist and Surako, entered inside to inform the representatives that they would be within imperial territory and would arrive within a few hours. After she answered Jircniv's question on any signs of suspicious people, the knight replied that they were not within range of the surveillance network. She then returns to her mount and rode alongside the carriage.

The carriage arrived in Arwintar, in front of the Grand Arena, where Leinas and the remaining Four Imperial Knights stood at attention for the emperor and dignitaries. She accompanied the delegation inside the arena to the VIP Suite. From the view of the match she saw that Go Gin was fighting in a match against a Skeletal Dragon. She added that the war troll after having been revived still gave people courage in the arena.[24]

Leinas was at the Grand Arena, guarding Emperor Jircniv at the VIP Suite with Nimble for the Chocolate Cup event.[25]

Much later, Leinas as members of the military leaders of the Quadripartite Alliance, were informed of the protagonist's encounter with the Mimics and how they were able to seamlessly appear as Nigun. Leinas grew worried that the monsters not only could replicate appearances but also their abilities of those they impersonated, admitting she wouldn't want to tangle with them.

Upon hearing that Shall had met with the protagonist a the Katze Plains, shortly after the Territory Guardian claimed to have encountered the Mimics, Leinas revealed some additional information from the Empire. It seemed that the emperor had been investigating a mysterious group that were lurking in the Katze Plains. Although the information on the group was nothing concrete and only a rumor gathered by workers. There was little information, and only speculation on whether it was news of another noble rebellion, remnants of Zurrernorn or even the new threat of Mimics. Thus the group decided to keep quite on the threat of the Mimics to avoid a panic.

To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. Lilynette Piani (リリネット・ピアニ) is a mithril class adventurer and a member of Four Armaments.

Appearance
A woman who irradiated a perverse aura. On her neck hung the holy symbol of the Earth God, which was sandwiched between her voluptuous bosom. Due to her physical appearance and her priestess garb, it was assumed that she was a prostitute who was accommodating her client’s fetish or something like that. She wears a priestess like nun robe having big breasts and purple lavender eyes with pink hair 

Personality

While being a priestess, Lilynette is well versed with the social circles of both adventurers and nobility. However, Lilynette is also a shotacon as she has a preference for young boys to the ages of twelve. Those around the ages of fifteen and above are considered too old for her. The priestess is also quite cunning and manipulative as she managed to convince Count Naeura to hand over their Holy Sword and acquire the youngest son to be her personal concubine to fulfill her desires. She also appears to be shameless of her behavior, never hiding her intentions out in public and even drooling about the object of her desire. She can also be seductive 
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Lilynette is a devoted priestess of the Earth God faith.
Chronology

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Lilynette was present alongside her teammates in E-Naeurl. She and her teammates along with the members who composed of the magic caster unit listened to the count's motivational speech for the upcoming battle. After the count promised to reward them handsomely, offering the money and the Five Colors Holy Sword up, Lilynette was interested. The count made a concomitant comment of wanting her to be his son's concubine. However, the priest wasn't offended and offered herself up of being his third son's concubine much to the embarrassment of her team. She even tried selling him the idea as it would guarantee him that the family heirloom would stay in the family.

When the rogue told fellow members of Four Armaments to consider running, Lilynette belittles him and says that since their opponents are undead, they shouldn't rule out the possibility of it appearing out from the ocean to thwart their escape. Lilynette was present to hear out her leader Scama's escape plan and route. The moment Scama agrees with the rogue on the idea of running away, she complains to the leader about not taking into consideration her happiness with the child. She and rest of Four Armaments were reminded by Scama to act according to the plan. More so, she and her companions are even told to jump down and try to break through the cluster of zombies if the worst was to happen.

Shortly thereafter, the discussion reaches its end when Lilynette and her companions moved to where their post is and awaited the enemies’ action. During the battle, she alongside her fellow adventurers and magic casters fought against a hoard of zombies and one powerful undead, casting [Fireball] at them in unison. Once it was about Scama's turn to prepare in facing off the strong undead, she would provide supports for her leader. Particularly, she buff the female warrior with divine spells like [Anti-Evil Protection]. Along the way, she even assisted Scama by using [Sunlight] against the dangerous undead.

Once the other strong undead appears by the Death Knight's side, she and her companions were order by Scama to retreat while the latter attempts to act as decoy. However, before all hope was lost, an unknown flying armor giant appear on the nick of time to save Lilynette and her companions from the Death Knight and the Death Warrior. After that armor giant have vanquish the two powerful undead, she was the first among her companions to recognize that it may be a member from Red Drop stopping by to aid them in their fight after seeing the former's adventurer plate.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT
Abilities and Powers

Lilynette appears to have connections to the Temple of the Four Great Gods. As a priestess serving the Earth God, she was able to make use of her connections with the Temple of the Four Great Gods to gather intel about Count Naeura and his family members. Lilynette performs such feat without the latter learning of this until she decided to outright explain some of it in great detail much to his displeasure.
Active

Anti-Evil Protection: A 1st tier spell used to defend against attacks from evil beings.
Fireball: A 3rd tier spell that allows the user to shoots out a big ball of fire that burns its target.
Fly: A 3rd tier spell that gives the caster the ability to fly.
Sunlight: A 3rd tier divine spell designed to both blind a target and deal damage to undead beings
Protection Energy Negative: Protects target from Negative Energy damage.
ADVERTISEMENT
Relationships

Scama Elbero

Lilynette was judged by her team leader as an honest and caring person to the point that she should make for a good bride. However, when she revealed her darker side, Scama found Lilynette's taste in young boys disgusting. Though the priest thinks her to be a fool of not falling for alluring unripen fruits.

Count Naeura

Lilynette, after manipulating him to offering his third son to her, started calling him father-in-law.

Lizzie Bareare (リィジー・バレアレ) is a pharmacist who used to operate in E-Rantel and the grandmother of Nfirea Bareare. When Nfirea was kidnapped by Zurrernorn, she made a deal with Ainz to rescue him in return for her services. Afterward, she moved to Carne Village.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Lizzie is an elderly woman with a face full of wrinkles and pure white, shoulder-length hair. She and her grandson share the same blue eyes.
Personality

Though a seemingly old woman, Lizzie Bareare is still quite sharp for her age. Highly knowledgeable about the makeup, properties, and lore of potions. She also has a demanding and fastidious personality. Her intense gaze gives other people the shivers.
Background

Renown throughout the city of E-Rantel, Lizzie Bareare holds the title as the city's best pharmacist.
Chronology

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Lizzie makes her debut when Brita, comes to her shop so as to appraise the recovery potion she received from Momon. Upon inspecting the potion and discovering its unique properties, she demands answers of the potion's origin. After explaining her excitement she attempts to convince Brita to sell her the potion. Nfirea however, suggests another alternative through the adventurer Momon. She allows him to travel and to hire Momon along with Swords of Darkness under the guise of restocking on herbs in Tob Forest, and at the same time befriending the stranger and to know how he acquired the potion.[1]

Lizzie encounters Momon, Nabe, and Hamsuke outside the Adventurer's Guild. She guides them to her shop only to discover that the Swords of Darkness have been killed and Nfirea had been kidnapped. Lizzie pleads to the two adventurers to rescue her grandson, conceding to give everything to Momon. In the aftermath of the E-Rantel Cemetery Incident, Nfirea is later rescued and Lizzie being gratefully indebted to Momon. She complies with Momon's request to supply him with healing potions for the indefinite future.[2]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Lizzie and Nfirea have relocated their operations to Carne Village at Ainz Ooal Gown's behest. There in one of the abandon houses, they spend their days crafting medicines for the frontier village. At the same time, the duo have also been conducting research on alchemical processes using various tools delivered by Lupusregina Beta. In an unknown territory, they both have forgone sleep and meals to discover new processing techniques for more effective healing potions. So far, the result of their labors have coalesced in the creation of a purple potion.[3]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
During the attack on Carne Village by the Crown Prince's Army, she remains behind to hide all the alchemical wares that she had borrowed from Ainz while her grandson escorted the women and children to the Great Forest of Tob.[4]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc
Spoiler Warning: Plot from the light novel details follow


Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Lizzie and her junior Hilma Cygnaeus at the Pharmacist's Guild hired protagonist and his team to retrieved soil samples from Carne Village to allow for the creation of a herb cultivation project that the two wanted to create in E-Rantel. The old woman also hired the adventurers to do another job, which was to retrieve some personal effects of the deceased Enri Emmot so as to help her grandson find some closure.[6]

After the second summit of the Tripartite Alliance, Hilma delivered herbs requested by Lizzie. When she inquired the need for such materials, Lizzie declined to offer a reason, though the former criminal suspected that the herbs were being gathered in anticipation for someone very important and in dire need for medical attention.[7]

Lizzie would care for Nemu whilst Nfirea acted as director of the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute. From Nemu she learned that a strange illness was affecting the children. When Nfirea finally returned home one night under mandatory leave, Lizzei welcomed her grandson. Due to the illness she noted that she had been busy in making medicines, though her potions did not seem to have any effect on whatever the illness was. She told Nfirea her theory that the disease originated from the demons that had attacked the city from Jaldabaoth's rampage. The two were joined the conversation who Lizzie urged the girl to tell Nfirea that her own friends were being affected. However Nemu instead begged Nfirea to rest due to his poor appearance afraid he would die if he did not. After Nfirea left to go to his room, Lizzie asked Nemu if what she said had anything to do with a talent, like sensing death, but Nemu told her that she was only afraid to be a burden to Nfirea and did not want to cause trouble for him and overwork him. In the end Nfirea did listen to the situation and launched a expedition to retrieve the Longevity Nuts to create an effective cure. After he left Lizzie and Nemu stayed awake to wait for his return.[8]

When E-Rantel was invaded by Chaos Beast via newly formed Cracks in the city, Lizzie was in the streets with Nemu, trying to flee. However the old woman seemingly vanished, taken by an invisible enemy attacking amidst the chaos.[9]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

Lizzie is a fairly strong magic caster. Her strength in magic is attested by even members of Zurrernorn, who were unwilling to confront her directly due to this fact. According to Khajiit, she is capable of using 3rd tier magic. A skilled potion-maker, she is well-versed in the creation of recovery potions and is able to concoct a variety of complicated potions.

Appraisal Magic Item: Identifies the item in which the spell is cast upon.
Detect Enchant: Detects and analyses the type of magic in which the spell cast upon.
Lightning: 3rd tier spell that fires a deadly bolt of electricity in a straight line. (In the Web Novel, she threatens Momon with it).
Relationships

Nfirea Bareare

Lizzie is Nfirea Bareare's paternal grandmother. As her only living blood relative, the old pharmacist cares deeply about the well being of her grandson. This is demonstrated as Lizzie was willing to sacrifice everything to Momon just for a chance to save him when he was kidnapped.

Momon

Initially, her interest in Momon was to understand where the mysterious traveler acquired the incredible recovery potion. At Nfirea's suggestion, she allowed her grandson to hire and befriend the dark warrior in hopes of uncovering his secrets. Later when Momon saves and heals her grandson, after he had been kidnapped by Zurrernorn, she becomes eternally grateful to Momon. She offers to supply him with the necessary recovery potions he needs for his plans.

Lupusregina Beta

Lupusregina Beta is the battle maid sent by Ainz to protect the village. She is the one responsible for delivering the alchemical items and apparatuses to the Bareares as well as commanding the stone golems. Lizzie is one of the four most important people in Carne Village that Lupusregina must protect and ensure they remain alive at all costs.

Theo Rakheshir

Theo is Lizzie's colleague in the study of the magical arts.

Loune Vermillion (ロウネ・ヴァミリネン) is a scribe and the secretary of Emperor Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Loune Vermillion is thin despite his age, with greying blonde hair in a bowl cut.

His attire composed of a dark brown robe with four vertical white lines on both front and back, with white frilly sleeves and collar, an amber belt and a pair of dark brown boots.
Personality

Loune Vermillion appears to a calm and sensible man characterized by his sense of duty and dedication to Emperor Jircniv. He also possesses strong conviction for his country, as shown when he did not attempt to shrink from his task when ordered to remain in the Great Tomb of Nazarick for an extended period, despite it being inhabited by numerous monsters antagonistic towards humanity.
Background

Not much info on his background has been revealed, however it has been known he has been the Emperor's personal secretary since he came into power.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Loune Vermillion traveled to the Great Tomb of Nazarick with his liege to apologize to Ainz Ooal Gown for the invasion by Count Femel's workers. The secretary would later remain in the hallowed halls of Nazarick to act as the Baharuth Empire's ambassador to the Sorcerer Kingdom.[1]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
Some time after the Baharuth Empire was vassalized by the Sorcerer Kingdom, Loune had returned from the Great Tomb of Nazarick. After Jircniv was sure that his trusted retainer was not comprised, Loune resumed his post as the emperor's trusted secretary. He presented Jircniv a report of the Sorcerer King's supposed death in the Roble Holy Kingdom. However, both he and his liege dismissed the report, commenting it to be absurd, given Ainz's power.[2]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Loune was mentioned by Jircniv when he approved Osk of a theater production "Guide to Humanity" at the Grand Arena. He promised that the secretary would sort out the paperwork for the funds.[3]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT
Abilities and Powers

Loune is highly praised as a skilled scribe, enough to serve the emperor directly, and few could match him in administrative ability.
Relationships

Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix

A loyal servant to the emperor and held him with respect, the old bureaucrat is willing to use himself as a shield to protect his liege. Jircniv likewise trusts Loune and consider him among his confidants.

Lukrut had a blonde hair and brown eyes that gives him a cheerful look. He wore a leather armor, and had a thin body with his long and skinny limbs gave him the impression of a spider.
Personality

Lukrut had a flirtatious personality when dealing with those of the opposite sex. He was an optimistic, even when faced with rejection and was tenacious in overcoming challenges of the heart. While seemingly acting like a buffoon, he was serious when the situation called and had a strong sense of duty as an adventurer.
Background

Not much is known of his background, except at some point he heard the tale of the Thirteen Heroes and their exploits and admired the Black Knight's exploits particularly. He later joined the Swords of Darkness with the aim to acquire the four legendary dark swords wielded by said hero.
ADVERTISEMENT

Chronology

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Lukrut and his teammates see Momon and Nabe, who are attempting to procure a job let both teams work together. However, the usual tasks were too underwhelming for Momon's favor, who wanted a harder task than the ones available for him. But when Nfirea Bareare came to make a direct request of Momon and name-dropped Carne Village, it made him think of the village he just saved from the Slane Theocracy's massacre attempt, and a compromise is made as Nfirea agrees to take both parties as his bodyguard.[1]

As they travel to Carne Village, the party is attacked by a large group of goblins and ogres. A battle plan is devised quickly, with Lukrut and his teammates pick off the goblins while Momon and Nabe would eliminate the ogres. As the fight proceeds, Lukrut quickly realizes that their fellow companions are no mere adventurers. He looks upon the two with awe, comparing their strength to the heroes of legend.

The journey proceeds smoothly after the encounter, but things are amiss as Nfirea realizes Carne Village is more fortified than usual. Sensing that something is wrong, Lukrut and his teammates advance cautiously but is ambushed by a large group of goblins, stronger than before. No fight breaks out as the goblins tell them that they have no intention to start a fight. In fact, it turns out that they are protecting the village under Enri Emmot's orders.[2] During their stay in Carne Village, he and his teammates are introduced to the Wise King of the Forest which Momon tamed.[3]

After completing the request, Lukrut and his teammates leave with Nfirea to his house to collect the reward. However, a sinister presence is already there, waiting for them. Lukrut is killed at the hands of Clementine and Khajiit Dale Badantel as he attempts to buy time for Ninya and Nfirea to escape. Lukrut along with Peter and Dyne are then turned into zombies and are later killed by Momon to free them of their fate.[4]

Lukrut was among the volunteers guarding the Cracks in E-Rantel with patrols composed of mixed united of the various military forces in the Alliance against the Mimics. He had the chance to meet Aggresiel and Billiophia, the two women who were supposedly the rivals of the adventurer Shall. The archer flirted with them much to his teammates embarrassment. And later helped prevent an invasion of Mimics composed of replicas of Nigun, Leinas and Brain.[5]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
A half a year after the event known as the Catastrophe that saw the emergence of the Cracks and appearance of the Chaos Beasts and Contaminated Beasts, Lukrut with his team went to collect herbs in the Great Forest of Tob. While heading to the nearby settlement of Carne Village, his team rescued a little girl named Nemu Emmot who was fleeing to get help to save the village from Chaos Beasts. The adventurers journeyed with her to the village to save what was left when they met the protagonist, Surako and Narberal Gamma. The two groups then decided to help one another and Lukrut and his team provided information on the current situation of the world. During the journey to the village, Lukrut tried to impress one of the members of the other party, Narberal Gamma, though she would ignore or belittle his attempts to woe her.

Together they managed to drive the Chaos Beasts and Contaminated Beasts off. Lukrut played a vital role in using himself as bait to draw the monsters away from the village and later giving them the slip. For that action Lukrut was finally acknowledged by Narberal much to his glee. When the members of the Sunlight Scripture led by Ian Als Heim arrived. Though the Scripture was not originally here to evacuate the villagers but on their own secret mission, Ian agreed to left some of his men to escort the villagers to safety to the city of E-Rantel. But the Scripture guides could depart, Lukrut and his friends went into the forest to search for the missing Enri Emmot, Nemu's sister, and Morgan. However it was too late for Enri as she was killed by a Quadruped Chaos Beast. The adventurers and Nazarick agents then traveled back to the village to bury her remains. Lukrut would part ways with the protagonist as he and his team would help the Scripture escort the villagers to the city. While traveling with the refugees, the convoy was attacked by a Giant Chaos Beast. Lukrut and his friends were nearly killed when the protagonist and his friends came to the rescue and managed to defeat it.[6]

Later while resting in the Adventurer's Guild in E-Rantel, Lukrut's team discussed a rumor on the location of one of the Swords of Darkness belonging to the Black Knight. The discussion attracted the attention of Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra who wanted to seek out the sword which was suspected to be Hyumilis. Even though adamantite adventurer explained that only she could safely wield it, the Swords of Darkness joined her and Gagaran on the quest to see the legendary weapon. In the end though it turned out to be just a monster infesting a magic sword.[7] Lukrut would again see Narberal in E-Rantel. The woman though had completely forgotten about him. Since the undercover maid was searching for information on hauntings around the vicinity of the Tob Forests, Lukrut's team provided their assistance by telling Narberal about the Harvest Festival and its significance.[8]

Some weeks after Jaldabaoth's attack on the city, Lukrut came with the Swords of Darkness to attend a morale boosting adventurer tournament at the invitation of the protagonist. Though the ranger was happy to assist and reunite with some one old acquaintances, he was looking forward to seeing Narberal. Sadly Surako informed him that the woman could not attend the the tournament due to other obligations.[9] Lukrut's disappointment in not seeing Narberal was soothed when he caught sight of the Soi, who his team were scheduled to fight. While ogling her, Soi made a change in the match to have the Swords of Darkness fight against her friends Shall and Ku. The sliver ranked team were defeated by the duo much to Lukrut's team's shock. Lukrut and with his team spent most of the tournament cheering on the newcomers in their matches. At the final match, to give the resident of the city a good show, the Swords of Darkness joined the other adventurers in fighting against the Dark Warrior.[10]

During the phenomenon that caused the land around E-Rantel to be bathed in a continuous day, Lukrut was in the city with his team. At the guild he and the Sword of Darkness met up with Darkness to discuss what could be the cause of the extended day. Lukrut though lamented that the continuing day killed the mood of the evening as it killed his dream to go out on a date at night with Narberal. After Clementine came over to ask the protagonist and his team to attend a consultation meeting to address the strange event, Lukrut and his team offered to help by gathering information from the other adventurers.[11]

Lukrut and his team saw the protagonist and Surako at the Adventurer's Guild where the establishment was busy selling chocolates and "Dark Warrior" theme dolls. There Lukrut commented the ever growing popularity of the protagonist based on the sales of the souvenirs distributed by the guild.[12]

He and hisr team were later seen at the guild in E-Rantel, receiving their reward after a job. Included in the reward was their chocolate and souvenirs. Lukrut noted that bag to be smaller and flatter compared to last time. This was due to the dolls normally given were replaced by cards for Great Adventurers, which Lukrut found to be good as it saved space to carry. Later the archer and his team were approached by the protagonist and Surako to ask what kind of improvements could be made to the current chocolate candy. When Ninya suggested that it would be more convenient for the candies to be cut into smaller pieces as then a little could be eaten at a time, Lukrut believed that it would be nice but then the chocolates would melt more easily.[13]

Lukrut and his team were interviewed by Soi and Narberal for the upcoming development of "chilled chocolate". The ranger was curious as to why Narberal was so interested in taking opinions, but accepted an explanation from Soi that she was doing it as a favor to the protagonist. For Lukrut he couldn't imagine that the taste of chocolate would change when chilled. In his honest opinion if the price for the new confection went up, it had better be worth the price. As for the texture, he wondered if chocolate not only tasted better when chilled but also burnt, to which Narberal answered that one can baked chocolate with lightning, which he assumed was a joke. A few days later the Chilled Chocolate Confectionary was released in E-Rantel, Lukrut tried it with his friends and found that chocolate tastes better even when it's cold.[14]

The Swords of Darkness were assigned by Ainzach to protect a warehouse near the Sewage Treatment Plant containing goods belonging to the Sorcerer Kingdom. Unfortunately the warehouse was compromised when Sanitary Slimes infiltrated the premises and ate the chocolate sweets stored there, causing their numbers to explode. The Lukrut and his team along with the guildmaster and protagonist and Surako had to deal with culling the monsters, forcing them to sacrifice the goods.[15]

For a raid on a slave broker base running an operation of trafficking children, Ninya volunteered for the assignment as soon as she heard about the heinous plot. The rest of the Swords of Darkness joined her. Lukrut knew that Ninya felt strongly about saving the children, as the situation drove close to her own past of her being unable to save her own sister from being sold into slavery. And even though Ninya regretted dragging her team on this assignment, Lukrut stated that they would not have let her gone alone. The adventurers were assigned to attack the warehouse where the children were being held captive and Lukrut used the map of the floorplan to direct his team.[16]

At the time when E-Rantel was facing an unprecedented crisis of several Cracks opening within its walls, Lukrut managed spot Nemu alone in the streets. Quickly eliminating the Chaos Beasts that were about to attack her, the archer took her under the protect of the Swords of Darkness. In the commotion, Lukrut spotted Yuri Alpha distantly on a street and mused that she looked similar to Narberal but was ignored by his comrades who were busy fighting for their lives. The adventurers took arms to defend the city and even though the odds were stacked against them they maintained hope that the protagonist would come through for them. However the team was met by a wave of invisible attacks from an unknown enemy that picked them off one by one causing them to vanish into thin air, the first being Lukrut. [17]

After the protagonist return from the Chaos Zone, it is presumed that Lukrut was transported there along with the other victims and incapacitated in the alien realm. Alas only Ninya was able to escape such a fate; believing her comrades to be gone Ninya contemplated on quitting as an adventurer. After the protagonist met and offered some words of encouragement, Ninya joked that while Lukrut would have appreciated those words, he most certainly would have enjoyed being praised by Narberal.

During expedition of the Four Kingdoms Rescue Team into the "other side" to rescue those who were originally presumed dead, Ninya participated and used the spare adaptive equipment to revive her teammates. Lukrut was the last of the group to regain consciousness and though he was confused by his surroundings and the presence of so many famous warriors around him, the archer was quick minded enough to know that they were in a serious situation. Lukrut contributed to the rescue operation of a hundred people, acting as a scout for the army. Upon seeing a horde of giant sized specialized Chaos Beasts, he rushed back to the army's camp to warn them of the danger.[18]

Later the rescue team rushed back to E-Rantel after receiving word from the Sorcerer Kingdom that enormous amounts of miasma were spilling in from Cracks in every major city in the Tripartite Alliance. Since their unit was the only military force in the area, the joint international force hurried to the alliance's capital to save what they could. Upon reaching the walls of the city, Lukrut was horrified to see hordes of feral looking humans and demi-humans affected by the noxious gas.[19]

END of NON-CANON content



ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Powers

As a silver ranked adventurer and ranger of the group, he had confidence in his archery skills. He had keen senses due to being a ranger that allows him to sense, hear, and see things that normal people cannot in a forest.
Main Equipment

Soft Leather Armor
Composite Longbow
Relationships

Momon

Lukrut was at first jealous of the fact that Momon had the company of the beautiful woman, Nabe. After seeing him in action however, he was simply awed at the latter's prowess as a warrior and accepted that someone like him should have a beautiful partner.

Nabe

Upon meeting the beautiful magic caster, Lukrut instantly fell for her, confessing his love. Unfortunately, due to Nabe's dislike of humans, she rejected him. However, despite her rejection he kept constantly flirting with her, much to her annoyance.

Peter Mauk

Peter was willing to punish Lukrut when the latter's antics went too far.

Ninya

Lukrut was willing to give his life to give Ninya a chance to escape and save her sister.

Dyne Woodwonder

Both shared a friendly competitive relationship. Dyne always insisted that he was stronger than Lukrut as a druid.

Lumière (リュミエール) is one of the forty-one Homunculus Maids that are responsible for the various maid jobs on the 9th and 10th Floors of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Lumière is described as a young woman with long blonde hair that shines mysteriously just like starlight and she also wears eyeglasses. Like all the homunculus maids, she wears a maid uniform.
Personality

Lumière has an elegant appearance and personality. Though during mealtime, Lumiere eats unnaturally fast.
Background

Lumière along with her fellow homunculus maids were created by Whitebrim, Herohero, and Coup De Grâce.
Chronology

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Lumière and her fellow homunculus maids are having a break. Lupusregina Beta appeared from nowhere and started a chat with them. They started a competition to see who was able to give the best title to Ainz.[1]

In the Anime, Lumière is the homunculus maid who serves Nfirea and Enri during their visit to Nazarick and before Ainz and Nemu return from the tour of Nazarick.[2]

The Half Elf God-kin Arc

Main article: The Half Elf God-kin Arc
Lumière attended to Ainz Ooal Gown in his study as he was approving several legal documents from Albedo. After Ainz had finished all his work, she went with him to the Amphitheater on the 6th Floor, There they were met by Aura Bella Fiora who at the request of Ainz gave him a tour of the Field of Flowers and then took him to the Gigantic Tree to see Mare Bello Fiore and the Elven Slaves. To talk in a comfortable atmosphere, Ainz took them to the Canteen where the maid helped to bring drinks for the elves.[3]

Lupusregina Beta (ルプスレギナ・ベータ, Lupusregina・β) is a werewolf battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Beast King Mekongawa.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Lupusregina Beta is a brown-skinned beauty with an athletic look and red hair tied in two long braids. She wears a maid uniform with short sleeves and long black gloves with a skirt that has a long slit on its left side, revealing thigh-high white stockings. She is equipped with an imposing black and silver scepter slung across her back.

The Light Novel shows Lupusregina wearing a garter belt with her stockings, while the Anime omitted it.
Personality

Lupusregina Beta has a very bright and outgoing personality but is able to act accordingly like a perfect lady. She is sociable and friendly towards humans. However, this is only a mask to conceal her brutal and cunning personality. She also enjoys making lewd jokes to people like Enri.

Lupusregina tends to use her 'Complete Invisibility' spell frequently in order to appear behind someone's back without being detected, as she loves to startle people. Yuri has claimed that Lupusregina can be as sadistic and evil as her sister Solution. The author Maruyama has stated on Twitter that during a full-moon at nighttime, she becomes a little bit crueler.[2]

Lupusregina is considered the friendliest of the battle maids by the Homunculus Maids. They also think that being approached by her is a sign of good fortune.

In the Web Novel, she is not a sadist, just a cheerful character who loves to eat.
Background

Lupusregina Beta was created by Beast King Mekongawa to be one of the battle maids, the Pleiades. They served as a last line of defense against intruders. However, because she is unlikely to be able to stand against enemy players who managed to come this far, her only real purpose was to distract the invaders until the guild members of Ainz Ooal Gown were able to fully prepare for their final stand in the throne room.
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
Lupusregina, along with her sisters, are ordered by Momonga to guard the entrance of the 9th Floor. She and the other Pleiades are on standby and waiting.[3]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Lupusregina is given a mission to spy in Carne Village and to protect three people in the village: Enri Emmot, Nfirea Bareare, and Lizzie Bareare. She visits the village with stone golems to help with the construction of the new wall. She is also the one responsible for delivering the alchemical items and apparatuses to the Bareares. She follows Enri, Nfirea, and the goblins when they explore the Great Forest of Tob in order to search for both herbs and information about the forest. She receives a newly developed potion made by the Bareares, and Nfirea wants her to report the news about it to Ainz. When Enri decides to make some drinks, she asks Lupusregina if she knows how to make delicious drinks. In response, Lupusregina claims that she knows how to, but she serves only the Supreme Beings as a maid and thus she does not help other people with chores and prefers instead to laze around.

Although the inhabitants of Carne Village decide to protect their village from the possible attacks of the army led by the Giant of the East and the Demon Snake of the West, Lupusregina suggests asking Ainz for help since he will easily solve the problem. However, Enri rejects her idea of asking help from Ainz a second time, stating that they should do as much as they can by themselves without depending on their savior too much. After hearing her answer, Lupusregina has a disappointed look on her face but says that they should work hard to keep the village safe. Once Ainz hears the news of Enri being present in E-Rantel, he scolds Lupusregina in his office for her carelessness and tells her to take her job seriously.

Afterward, Lupusregina talks with Enri about the matter of her being appointed to be the new chief of the village. Lupusregina gives her some advice, saying that it doesn't matter if Enri is the chief or someone else is the chief because she will mess up sooner or later. She says that there are only forty-one people who will never make a mistake and that there is no point worrying about what happens when Enri fails and that nobody is better suited for the job than her. Lupusregina also tells Enri that if the goblins can't save the village, they will prioritize her safety first. However, if she is the chief of the village, then this scenario will change as the village will become her property and they will fight to protect the village to the bitter end.

Shortly after, Lupusregina sees the villagers gathering in the village square because Enri has been appointed as the new chief. Yuri Alpha appears behind her and asks about Carne Village, saying that was the reason she got scolded by Ainz. Lupusregina says that a new leader has just arisen and wonders what kind of faces the villagers will make if they are attacked and everything is set ablaze, much to Yuri‘s displeasure. During the attack by monsters from Tob Forest, she saves Nfirea from the Giant troll and kills it.

Later, Lupusregina and Yuri escort Enri, Nfirea, and Nemu Emmot to Nazarick through teleportation as Ainz wants to give them a reward for the newly developed potion made by the Bareares.[4][5]

The Maid Tea Party Arc

Main article: The Maid Tea Party Arc
Lupusregina is absent from the monthly Pleiades report and tea party because she is busy over at Carne Village under Ainz's order.[6]

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom Arc
Lupusregina participates in Demiurge's plan to make Momon a lasting hero in the Re-Estize Kingdom. She plays the part along with the other battle maids to act as Jaldabaoth's underlings with her face disguised with a mask. She partners with Solution Epsilon and Entoma Vasilissa Zeta. They fight against Nabe and continue to do so until Jaldabaoth orders a retreat.[7]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Lupusregina, along with her fellow Pleiades, except for Narberal, encounters Dragon Hunt on the surface of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. They are sent to see if the Nazarick Old Guarders are able to capture enemies trying to escape from the tomb. To her and the other Pleiades' surprise, Dragon Hunt decides to stay and fight. She and her sisters try to cheer for the Dragon Hunt workers, but they are easily slaughtered by the Nazarick Old Guarders. Afterwards, Yuri orders her and the other maids to check if there are any survivors.[8]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Lupusregina and Yuri greet the delegation from the Baharuth Empire right outside of the borders of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Later on, Lupusregina returns to her post at Carne Village, whilst invisible, as she observes the attack by the Crown Prince. During the battle, she is surprised when Enri summons an entire goblin army to defend the village.[9]

After the attack on Carne Village, Prince Barbro's remnant army retreats back to Katze Plains until Lupusregina appears in front of them and tells the group that she has been observing their situation for a while now. Lupusregina summons thirty level 43 Redcap goblins and then orders them to kill everyone present before her. At the same time, she personally tortures Prince Barbro for half an hour before he dies from the torment.[10]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Lupusregina is present in the room she shares with Yuri and Narberal. Lupusregina is relaxing, eating a bag of potato chips when she notices how tense Yuri is as she has no work to do. Lupusregina's ungraceful eating habits attract Yuri's attention, who begins to lecture her on manners.

Accord to Yuri, Lupusregina's task is to observe and remain alert while preventing the leakage of the technologies developed within Carne Village, among other colorful tasks besides protecting Nfirea and the Emmot siblings.

Later on, she and Narberal approach Ainz to give Yuri a new task, presumably to get her off their backs.[11]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
Lupusregina arrives at Carne Village to inform Enri that she will not be around to visit them for a while. She explains that Ainz seems to have been defeated in battle and has died.[12]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc
While at Broken Tower, seeing that they had a couple of hours of free time, Momon took to opportunity to talk with Nabe about her hobbies along with the rest of her sisters.[1]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
Lupusregina is present in the log cabin during a meeting between Albedo, Demiurge, and her master. She pulls out a chair for Ainz to sit on and then kneels down on the floor while waiting for further instructions. When the two Floor Guardians act hostile toward one another, Lupusregina begins panting heavily out of fear.

As Ainz bows his head down on the table for forgiveness, the Floor Guardians order the maid to lift their master's head up. However, she rejects the Floor Guardians' order, apologizing to them while stating that she can not carry out that kind of action to her own master by force. While Ainz begins prepping up his plan with Albedo and Demiurge, Lupusregina stands by and whispers in amazement after what has transpired in this meeting.

Lupusregina is present with Yuri during Ainz Ooal Gown's secret conversation to Jaldabaoth. Later, at the appointed time for Ainz's duel with the Evil Lord and the Pleiades, Lupusregina is replaced by a Doppelgänger from the Erich String Orchestra so Ainz will not be restricted in holding back to kill.[13]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
At the time of the Great Tomb of Nazarick's transfer to the New World, Lupusregina Beta was among the NPCs that were killed in the transition. Momonga finding the dungeon in ruins due to the strange Cracks and overrun by Chaos Beasts quickly revived her and the Pleiades with magic. Unfortunately, the maid suffered a severe abnormal drop in levels since her revival as did the other NPCs that were brought back to life. When the protagonist appeared before Momonga who was suspicious on the identity of the homunculus, Lupusregina can be one maids that vouches on his identity as being a creation of Beast King Mekongawa.[14] After the protagonist leaves with a Redeem Slime summon and Narberal Gamma, Lupusregina is left with the remaining Pleiades in Nazarick. To rebuild Nazarick, more information was needed to determine the new phenomena that was now affecting the dungeon. Thus, Momonga had the maids train to prepare for a survey of the Cracks. When they were deemed ready Lupusregina and her sisters investigated the Cracks, fighting the Chaos Beasts to learn its secrets.[15]

To avoid Nazarick being detected, Lupusregina was assigned to work with Mare to disguise the surface of Nazarick. Whilst altering the terrain of the landscape, Mare's magic disturbed a nest of Forest Worms prompting Lupusregina and Aura to fight them. They also have a close call when a human scout approaches the area, but Lupusregina and her comrades quickly capture him to be interrogated.[16] Lupusregina with the rest of her sisters greeted Narberal Gamma upon her return from the outside world. From the doppelgänger she gained some insight on human society and started practicing on how to communicate with them by referring them as "maggots". It gained some attention from Sebas Tian and Momonga who intervene to correct some misconceptions and focus their training on hospitality.[17] The maid would also serve as a messenger, relaying various communications throughout Nazarick and monitoring the Crack in the Throne Room.[18][19][20]

Lupusregina would be asked by Cocytus to train with him, alongside Narberal Gamma. The two maids obliged and sparred with the Floor Guardian and were initially happy to help. But as the training became more intense, the two maids began to worry, bringing the issue to Albedo who notified Momonga. After Cocytus's session with the Overlord of Nazarick, the Pleiades members were poleaxed when Floor Guardian decided to allow for breaks.[21] While patrolling a Crack on the Throne Room with Yuri, Lupusregina noticed Yuri to have something on her mind, though the other maid stated that she was fine but in reality, was concerned with the discarded piles of debris. Accepting her words, Lupusregina excused herself, not knowing that Yuri would institute a plan to clean the piles on all the floors.[22]

While guarding the Crack on the 6th Floor, Lupusregina faced an increased number of Chaos Beasts coming from the anomaly. One nearly goes through the perimeter, but the maid managed to kill it before it got away. Though she believed it to be no issue, her laxity of the seriousness of subjugating Chaos Beasts angered Momonga who reprimanded her for not reporting the increase in monsters. The maid was pulled from patrol so that she could reflect on her actions. Disappointed in herself and wishing to get back in Momonga's graces, Lupusregina took Cocytus's advice to consult with the protagonist. From him the maid learned the concept of "Ho-Ren-So" and put all her effort in improving her work ethics. The next time she was assigned a task, Lupusregina impressed Momonga on her diligence that he forgave her for her previous blunder.[23] Her use of "Ho-Ren-So", causes Sebas Tian to have an idea to bringing an air of hospitality in Nazarick to provide a bit of relief to the work focused Floor Guardians. As part of his initiative, Lupusregina served to tea and snacks to Demiurge and Albedo while they were reviewing Nazarick's defense plan.[24]

Later Lupusregina posed as an emissary from a distant country and sold ores to E-Rantel from an abandoned mine near the city.[25] When visitors from another world came through the Crack on the 10th Floor, they were given sanctuary until Nazarick could find a way to return them back to their world. Meanwhile the visitors were asked to assist them in subjugating the Chaos Beasts that infested the Throne Room. One of the visitors, claiming to be a goddess, requested to be excused from the defense as it would require her to fight alongside the undead, which she had a phobia. Lupusregina who was chaperoning them permitted it.[26]

Lupusregina would eventually get to explore the outside world when Momonga called the Pleiades to explore an island that connected to Nazarick via an unstable [Gate]. To assist them, she and her sisters were given swimsuits by Pandora's Actor. With the protagonist and Slimeko's help, the maid and her sisters found that the island was once a base for a pirate crew. Upon discovering the base, the Nazarick agents came to fight several undead pirates. The team found a hidden port containing a wrecked ship. Once the wreck of the pirate ship was dredged up, they were attacked by a Giant Mollusk forcing the maids to fight together to slay it. The adventure though ended with the maids retrieving many abandoned valuables for Nazarick.[27]

The maid would also join Cocytus's team, Cocytus and the Pleiades, for the Nazrzick Fighting Tournament which became the winners of the tournament.[28] And also help to prepare for Nazarick's Christmas party, by making Christmas Cakes, though would annoy her sisters when she ate the ingredients.[29]

When a being named Shiramochi-ō placed a spell over Nazarick, causing all the NPCs within the dungeon to fall under a New Year's celebration. Lupusregina and her sisters were compelled to go to Fake Nazarick to serve as guards for a Chaos Zone that took shape there. Lupusregina and her sister Yuri were placed to guard a [Gate] behind the area called the Takemikazuchi Shrine that led to the replica of the Throne Room. They would not allow anyone to pass even Momonga unless they were challenged and defeated.[30] Momonga would defeat Shiramochi-ō though just before he met his end, the White Mochi King used the last of his power to turn back time, creating a loop of the events that saw Nazarick fall under his spell. Though in this new timeline, Lupusregina and her sisters challenged Momonga with a karuta game. The spell under Lupusregina would eventually be broken thanks to a repentant Shiramochi-ō sacrificing himself, though her memories while under the mental influence would be erased.[31]

Lupusregina and her sister Solution would be attending to some new visitors to Nazarick and escorting them outside its confines. They were alerted to a disturbance near the dungeon and found a stranger to be caught by the Enhanced Treants.[32] To prepare for a Yozakura, Lupusregina and her sisters prepared for the festivities, bringing the Chivalrous Costume for Demiurge, which caught Sebas Tian's attention.[33]

For a brief period, Lupusregina enjoyed the company of Albedo, who was starting her new routine as a general maid as part of her new hands on initiative to make Nazarick more efficient. She and Yuri helped their maid junior to learn the proper way to prepare tea. And later at Albedo's recommendation, participated in a training exercise to test the security of the 9th Floor.[34]

On a mission to investigate a lead of possible existence of players near a seaside village, Lupusregina joined the Pleiades in shadowing, the protagonist and his adventurer team. The mission soon developed into a collaborative effort with Blue Roses to assist a dwarf named Tsuibayaya in acquiring the scales of the Legendary Mermaid for his swimsuits. Due to the unexpected adamantite adventurers presence Lupusregina and the others had to act covertly without Blue Roses being the wiser. After the two parties separated to cover more ground to search the beach, Lupusregina and her sisters worked with the protagonist and his team to locate the place where the mermaid lived. Once the maids donned on their swimsuits, their search led them to a tide pool and the lair of the Legendary Mermaid. Lupusregina and the rest of Pleiades made themselves scarce to avoid Blue Roses becoming aware of their presence. After the Legendary Mermaid was fought against, the scales retrieved, and Blue Roses gone, the protagonist had Lupusregina and all the Pleiades dress in their swimsuits before Tsuibayaya to cement his cooperation to work for Nazarick.[35]

In a series of hauntings that began to occur in the Tob Forests, the cause was believed to be the work of evil spirits that were unappeased due to the absence of the Harvest Festival. To cleanse the forest of the spirits, the protagonist organized a festival with the Pleiades in the ruins of Carne Village. However the festival was attacked by what seemed to be a [astral entity that arrived invisible, though Lupusregina that to her ability was able to see through it and point it out to her allies. The entity turned out be a fox girl named Kyuko who was at first hostile to the Nazarick denizens as she believed that they were enslaving Hamsuke. Once the misunderstandings were cleared up, Kyuko willingly joined Nazarick before joining in the festivities. Lupusregina commented on the new addition to their ranks with Yuri at the sidelines and was surprised to hear her sister say that the fox reminded her of someone in Nazarick.[36]

The maid's healing abilities among others were called upon by Momonga, to heal a guest from another world who defeated a powerful entity known as the Grim Reaper.[37] During the next phase of Nazarick's plan to take control of the Tripartite Alliance, Lupusregina and Yuri snuck into the quarantine area around the Northern Cave that housed a Crack and possibly thousands of trapped Chaos Beasts. To release the growing hordes, the maids broke the cavern walls to lead the monsters to the surface.[38] Later Lupusregina acted as one of the Demon Maids of Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth. After the Demon Emperor made a deal with Emperor Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix to save E-Rantel, at the cost of the latter's life and the riches of the city, many of the citizens resisted the deal. To punish the humans that were resisting the plundering, Lupusregina and her sisters moved into to slaughter the city guards. In response members of Blue Roses rose to fight back.[39]

After news about Miyoshi spread and that he was Momonga's bathing attendant, Lupusregina and many of the female NPCs petitioned to Momonga to allowed to challenge the Sapphire Slime for the position. To give them an opportunity to have the chance the Miyoshi Cup was created to determine if any of the participants had what it took to be a bathing attendant. The event also served as a way to select women that were needed to create a harem so as to activate a dangerous golem in Spa Resort Nazarick so CZ could disarm it. Lupusregina was among the finalists to be selected for the harem, but as for who would be the bathing attendant, Momonga defeated all of the participants in the final test thus allowing Miyoshi to go unchallenged.[40]

After Nazarick received a priority [Message] from Cocytus that the Great Lake area was being frozen by a abnormal cold wave and threatening to freeze the lizardmen and driving the native monsters from the northern monsters, Lupusregina alongside Entoma and CZ were sent to determine the cause of the weather change. Before they left they were given Christmas Costumes to protect them from the frigid temperatures. They made their way towards the northern mountains following the source, on occasion fighting beasts that were trying to escape for the cold. The maids finally came to a cave where the found a Crack and the Frozen Giant that was continuously bashing anything that emerged from the phenomena, its strength creating the wind pressure that was creating the cold front. The monster proves to be very formidable but Entoma was able to deduce a weakness in its structure allowing the maids to set fire on it and cause to crumble. To draw its attention CZ used herself as bait long enough for Lupusregina to set fire on the vines holding the thing together. After their successful mission the group returned to Nazarick just in time for the second Christmas party.[41]

Some old visitors to Nazarick returned to the dungeon and were being harassed by an evil clone of one of their associates. In a plan to seduce the clone and seal her power, Lupusregina participated in a plan to set up a Cat Café where she and Lupusregina used several cats to appeal to the clone and set the mood for the date.[42] During this time Lupusregina befriended a new face among the guests of Nazarick

Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.



Madame Furt was the tentative name of a former noble of the Baharuth Empire. She was the mother of Arche Eeb Rile Furt, Ureirika, and Kuuderika.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Madame Furt was described as having a beautiful face of a noble and wearing well-made clothing that befitted a noble's status. In the Anime Madame Furt is a blonde-haired woman is a beige dress.
Personality

Madame Furt had a leisurely attitude even during tense situations and is shown active love and care for both her husband and daughter, Arche. As seen where she attempted to diffuse their fight and stop it from escalating further.[1]

However despite her care for her family, it's been shown that similarly to her husband, Madam Furt still delusionally clings to her "pride" as a noble woman. She refuses to accept her family's fall from grace, and continues to enjoy the excessive lifestyle of luxury and excessive money wasting. All the while, not caring the slightest about their family's incredibly large debt and money crisis due to neither her or her husband having any jobs or skills to support themselves or their children.

This behavior is fully seen where she considers a five gold coin perfume bottle as "cheap" and a necessity for a "proper noble woman" to have, despite her daughter's constant reminder to her to only buy food, water, clothes and other necessities for survival instead.
Background

Madame Furt was a fallen noble after the ascension of Emperor Jircniv to the throne, who stripped away her family's nobility. Even so, she and her husband continued their lavish lifestyle as nobles and fell into debt. Their only source of income was through their eldest daughter Arche, who was forced to become a worker, desperately taking up jobs after jobs to repay her family's debt. It was then she joined Foresight led by Hekkeran Termite to take on more co-op missions.
Chronology

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
When Arche later returned home she found that her father had once again spent her hard earned money to buy an art piece. She scolded her father for wasting money as if they were still nobles. He became furious at her tone and reminding him of the hard truth. He wrongly believed that his purchases were 'necessary' expenses. Madame Furt intervenes slightly defusing the situation by giving Arche a gift of perfume. While the practicality of the gift softens Arche it did not erase the fact they were wasting money.

Arche seeing no use to reason with him stated that she would no longer be sending money to them and will be taking her sisters with her. Angered at her defiance and disrespect, Sir Furt was cowed into speechlessness by Arche's intense stare.[2]

Maruyama stated on his website that, after the family's money lender liquidized their assets, Madame Furt resorted to selling both of her younger daughters, Kuuderika and Ureirika, into slavery to pay off their debts.

Given of how their debt collector had already liquidized and taken their remaining assets and the loss of all three of their children who primarily supported them, it's likely that Madam Furt and her Husband are now completely ruined.

Abilities and Powers

Once a noble, Madame Furt and her family lost all influence though continues to keep the image of a noble even at the risk of falling into immense financial debt.
Relationships

Sir Furt

Like her husband, Madame Furt appears to support his views that they will rise to glory again so long as they maintain their lifestyle as nobles.

Arche Eeb Rile Furt

Arche appears to have a softer spot for her mother, despite her frivolous spending and is shown to have a less tumultuous and aggressive interactions with her mother in comparison to her father.

Madam Furt in turn is shown to still retain something akin to a loving-dotting mother-daughter relationship with her eldest daughter Arche, as seen where she still had the courtesy to buy her daughter a present.

However despite their less aggressive relationship, its still shown that like with her father, Arche has grown tired and exhausted at having to financially support her mother's excessive luxurious spending habits. No longer able to deal with the stress of her mother's delusional rejection of their new reality as commoners, Arche decided to abandon her together with her father to live separate with her younger sisters for the better.

Kuuderika & Ureirika

Kuuderika and Ureirika are Madame Furt's youngest daughters. Despite being family, however, she was willing to sell both of them into slavery to pay of her family's debt after their assets were liquidized.

James

Given his position as their family butler, it's likely that James was also quite loyal to her as the wife of his master. Like with her husband, James attempted to limit her of her excessive spending spree's and remind her of their actual financial situation and tried to remind her of Arche's instructions to only buy the needed necessities to survive. However, given the fact that she continued with her spending habits, it's likely that Madam Furt simply dismissed and ignored James's pleas.
