Malmvist (マルムヴィスト) was a member of Six Arms, the security department of the criminal organization Eight Fingers.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Malmvist was described as flashy, having the appearance of a matador.
Personality

Described as a lone wolf, Malmvist is an assassin that possessed the logic of killing an opponent quickly and efficiently no matter the method.
Background

A feared warrior in Eight Fingers who earned the title as "Thousand Kills."
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Malmvist was present with the other members of the Six Arms, excluding Succulent when Zero declares that all those who stained their name will be destroyed.[1]

After kidnapping Tuare, the Six Arms forms a welcoming party for Sebas Tian to make him pay for disgracing the group's name. Unfortunately, the opponent in front of them is a monstrosity whose strength is way beyond their realm of management. Seeing Sebas kill Davernoch, Edström, and Peshurian single-handedly, Malmvist goes half insane with disbelief, unable to comprehend the slaughter in front of him. Just before being killed, he catches Sebas' bloodied glove, thinking that it was an extremely powerful magic item.[2]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
After Eight Fingers collapse, Malmvist found himself without a job and switched his talents as a worker. At a bar with Six Arms, they were approached by Hilma who invited Six Arms to work at E-Rantel her using her new position at the Pharmacist's Guild. Zero not wanting to be indebt to her refused. Zero intended to build a new organization with his comrades in Six Arms. Malmvist became the head of the gambling, banking, and assassination trade in Zero's nascent criminal empire. The criminal empire started slow but was gaining momentum however he and his comrades lost and their noble backers as the Kingdom was cracking down on all illegal activities as part of their concessions to the new Tripartite Alliance. Though this set Six Arms back, Succulent brought news of the large amount of goods being transferred to the city of E-Rantel. The information opened a new opportunity to head to E-Rantel as it was apparent that the border city was becoming the new center of the world.[3] Later in order to destabilize the Tripartite Alliance, Zero made a deal with Zurrernorn to complete their Death Spiral ritual. The criminal kept his comrades in Six Arms out of the loop of the plan, but they followed his direction and worked with him to guard the site of the ritual thinking it was just a normal job. In the ensuing chaos, Davernoch was killed and Zero escaped, leaving Malmvist and the others to be arrested for the incident by Blue Roses and their allies.[4]

Once Zero defected to the Baharuth Empire, he gained amnesty for himself and by extension his comrades, allowing the surviving members of Six Arms to be acquitted of their crimes. They acted as a unit to train and lead a group of workers to fight against a horde of Chaos Beasts that were heading towards E-Rantel. Zero was ordered by the emperor to lead the monsters into the Quarry where the imperial knights would box the Chaos Beasts and eliminate them. Zero followed his orders to the letter but when the reinforcements came, he expected them to join in the fray. They did not and Zero suspected something was off. He then called his comrades to get off the quarry floor. That action saved their lives as the quarry floor was broken apart by a mechanism activated by the knights, causing the workers and Chaos Beasts to fall into the Melting Pot. The trap dissolved everyone that fell into the pit killing them. Zero friends who survived the trap watched in horror at the lengths of which the Bloody Emperor would use to achieve victory. On the contrary Zero praised the action as the best method worthy of a leader.[5]

In the aftermath, Malmvist and Peshurian were the only ones who stayed beside Zero. On a massive undead subjugation mission into the Katze Plains, Malmvist joined his leader in a quest to capture the Captain of the Ghost Ship. Among the workers that were hired as escorts only two survived the ordeal, being Regi and Shizuni. The Ghost Ship was located and its captain Iguva was challenged by Zero to become his subordinate. Malmvist witnessed his leader defeat and summarily offer the undead a place among Six Arms. After the lich accepted the offer, the workers returned to their hideout in Arwintar. There the members of Six Arms hosted a toast to their new comrade and to restoring their team.

Later he was sent to tail Regi and Shizuni at the orders of Zero as it was believed the two would make suitable candidates as members of Six Arms. The female workers sensed him watching them as they were in the Central Market and confronted him in an isolated alley. Their skill in detecting him convince the former criminal that the two were not rookies and stated that Zero wished for them to join Six Arms. The invitation was well received by the two workers as they were honored to be working alongside such big-names. There was a bit of unease when Shizuni offered to give Zero a jewel she swiped from a stall, surprising Malmvist as he failed to notice when she did that. The trinket though valuable was a bit careless and Malmvist cautioned the girl to avoid making a scene. This translated to Shizuni to return the item back to the stall before anyone notice and it was too late to prevent her. Since she was able to do so easily without attracting the attention of the knights patrolling the areas, it raised the two's skills in Malmvist's eyes. However before they could be inducted into his team, Malmvist informed them that a physical test of strength was in order and challenged them to fight him.

After the fight Malmvist was sure on their strength and guided them to the Singing Apple Pavilion where his comrade Peshurian was staying. While they waited for Zero and Iguva to return from speaking to their next client, he then offered a meal of pork stew with his new teammates so they could bond. The next day the mission was revealed to ensure the safety of a smuggling route in the Katze Plains to the Theocracy that wished to be used by the anti-Jircniv faction. The workers used Iguva's ship to travel along the route and check for any danger before the route was opened. While on the ship, Iguva warned his comrades that though he was able to keep lesser undead at bay, other stronger undead creatures like Death Knights and Skeletal Dragons were beyond his control. Since those were rare existences it was believed by Malmvist that an encounter with either types of undead was unlikely, however he proved to be wrong when a Skeletal Dragon appeared. The workers had to fight the dragon and not only successfully defeated but saw Regi and Shizuni in action.

A day passed since the route was cleared of any danger, and the workers were ordered by the nobles of the anti-Jircniv faction to guide their carriages through the Katze Plains to reach their business partners in the Theocracy who would trade them slaves and weapons. Among the cargo that was being transported to the Theocracy was an rune weapon armor set meant as a gift to the Theocracy which he informed Regi and Shizuni on its purpose. Six Arms led the convoy of nobles and workers through the fog, and were intercepted by the remaining members of the Four Imperial Knights.

To the horror of the anti-Jircniv faction Zero had sold them out, to gain a seat as a member of the Four Imperial Knights. The only ones who were in on the scheme were Malmvist and Peshurian. Though all the workers hired by the nobles remained loyal to their employers, Iguva, Regi and Shizuni chose to side with Zero. Once all the rebels were captured, the three worried about their fate and if they would be disposed of, though Malmvist put their worries at ease. As for Zero his promotion to a knight was delayed until a proper duel between him and one of the Four Knights could be scheduled to determine if he was worthy enough to be in their ranks. Though his boss was not promoted, Malmvist praised Zero on his success and was glad to hear that Six Arms would continue to exist for a little longer.[6]

One day Malmvist would spot Regi, Iguva and Shizuni going into the Katze Plains. Interested in what they were doing so covertly, he brought Peshurian to help him follow them. The two hid in the fog and watched as they three searched Iguva's Ghost Ship. Believing that this was odd, the two reported the behavior to Zero. Afterwards Regi and Shizuni were brought before the three human workers to explain themselves. Under pressure the women admitted that they were trying to make some extra money by seeing if Iguva had a mithril plate that they hoped to sell as the Adventurer's Guild was looking for it. Upon learning that the protagonist was involved in the recovery of the item and in the Katze Plains, Malmvist joined his team in the search for the plate. His team ran afoul with a horde of undead causing them to run and encounter Darkness in the fog. After agreeing to a temporary truce, the two groups fought to defeat the undead. Later Darkness shared some information that the mithril plate was in the possession of a Skeletal Dragon. Neither he nor Peshurian wanted to deal with that undead and believed it was better to withdraw, though Zero changed his mind after his boss told him that the undead dragon should have an enormous treasure hoard. More undead arrived, being led by the Skeletal Dragon, Malmvist knowing his piercing weapon was useless switched to using a melee weapon. After the battle, Malmvist was left exhausted by the battle but was glad that his team earned a sizeable reward.[7]

The fencer while in the Central Market of Arwintar spotted Regi and Shizuni frantically browsing through the wares of the merchants on magic item. Interested he came over and learned that the duo had an item to resell the items from the imperial capital to E-Rantel. Though demand for the items possibly grew due to the population boom, Malmvist wasn't sure if it was profitable due to the transportation costs, but changed his mind when they told him that Iguva could cover the costs using his Ghost Ship. He decided to help them as it was a quick way to make money, and directed them to the shops that had the better quality items.

Malmvist was at the base having drinks with the male members of the worker team, contemplating whether Regi's and Shizuni's resale venture would be successful. At the same time he cheered Zero up who was concerned that the team could fracture again, stating he and Peshurian had stuck by him too long to abandon him. Later he made a bet with Peshurian on the outcome of the female team members, with him betting that it would succeed. Peshurian won the bet, but the women brought valuable news and a new magic item that herald the Sorcerer Kingdom future plans of launching a new line of magic items.[8]

In the aftermath of the Calamity, Shizuni had gone missing. Malmvist and his teammates continued to operate as a group. Later when news reached them that E-Rantel was hosting something called a Halloween Festival, Regi decided to check it out. She was joined by Zero who was interested in the exhibition fight as he wanted to show off his strength there in front of the emperor who was said to be attending. While they were gone, Malmvist and Peshurian were left in charge. After they left Malmvist wondered if their boss went with Regi out of concern for her.[9]

Some days later, at their hideout, Zero brought news that New Six Arms had received a request from the emperor to be on security detail for the upcoming "Greetings and Victory" festival being hosted in the imperial capital. Malmvist at first didn't see the importance of the event, and later after the team captured a bunch of anti-imperials attempting to rob a convoy from E-Rantel, he still didn't get why the dissidents would disrupt a festival. Though Zero explained to him that Jircniv hired them to take care of the anti-imperials as he planned to eliminate an entire sub-faction in one fell swoop. Still the task of finding the dissidents was tedious. Though the job became easier when Regi brought a map of their locations. After the job, Malmvist and the workers celebrated for two days straight. On the second day Regi informed her comrades she managed to locate Shizuni in the Tob Forests and would retrieve her. Malmvist was excited by the news and used the chance to tease that Zero had been worried about Regi's depressed state since Shizuni went missing.[10]

On a slow day of working jobs, Malmvist hanged out with his team, minus Iguva=41, at the Singing Apple Pavilion. On the lack of prospective clients, Malmvist planned to go to the Katze Plains to hunt down Contaminated Beasts whose numbers had increased since the Disaster of Fire in E-Rantel. This brings up the topic of the latest rumors Regi heard about what happened in the city, where invisible monsters attacked it causing their victims to vanish, corpse and all. The talk about corpses though sickened Malmvist as he was trying to eat his meal. When Regi and Shizuni became interested in a bard singing a ballad about the emperor's brilliant plan in slaying a horde of Chaos Beasts, the fencer explained the role of bards. As the two showed interest, he told them that in order to do so, they would have to join a guild. Though Zero entertained the idea of bards singing prasies of New Six Arms, he and Peshurian expressed their doubts on such an idea. Much later at their hideout, he and all the male members of New Six Arms were examining a new item brought back by Regi and Shizuni, the electric guitar.[11]

After Zero allowed several former nobles escape from the Empire, via the Katze Plains, Malmvist expressed disbelief on Zero's action. Though was told that it was all part of a greater plan. Malmvist and his team would take a job from the Bloody Emperor to steal the Blood Oath from the Anti-Imperial Faction. While waiting for Regi and Shizuni to breakout of the venue, Zero commented how Regi successfully infiltrated the venue, Malmvist commented that it should be given how much money was prepared to create Regi's background and how foolish the anti-imperials were and that they had no place in the meritocratic society of the Empire.

As time went on, Malmvist commented on how quiet the venue was without any outburst, making him worried, but it was short-lived after some chaos erupted. He later assisted the female members of their team in dispatching the guards who pursued them, noting that they were not a spineless bunch. After confirming Regi had the Blood Oath, Malmvist teased his female companion of how it would be better for her to remain a lady, clearly enjoying her new appearance. When the workers headed to a bar to celebrate, Regi offered to teach Zero some tips on how to act like a knight, though Malmvist doubted she could teach as he still saw her as a uncouth woman.[12]

A year later, Malmvist is the last to arrive to the hideout of New Six Arms, reporting to Zero that the team received a request to clear out the undead in the Katze Plains to ensure its safety. Given that there were rumors that an inspection team from the Quadripartite Alliance had secretly arrived in Arwintar, the workers conclude that the request was for the safety of the representatives.

Malmvist believed that they could capitalized on the presence of the representatives from the Alliance. By staging an undead attack using Iguva's undead to attack the carriage carrying the representatives, and then having Zero lead New Six Arms to rescue them. The idea was rejected by Zero as he did not want to make a fool of himself or implicit Jircniv in such an incident, doubting such a scheme could be pulled off not with such intelligent dignitaries nearby.

Later before heading out to do the job, Malmvist was asked to make a bet. Though the worker was at a loss on the context unaware his team were taking bets on a match at the Grand Arena for two new fighters.

Malmvist though was able to use his connections to get into the venue at the arena and brought Regi and Shizuni with his as a treat. But the results of the match with the strangers winning caused Malmvist to lose, as he betted on them in losing. He didn't feel too bad as that meant Regi and Peshurian were buying dinner as they betted on the duo would win.[13]

In another competition at the Grand Arena, Malmvist and his team participated in the Chocolate Cup, fighting against the adventurers Soi and Shall. When the teams were getting ready to fight, Soi suggested they wager, in that if she and Shall won the workers would register as adventurers at the E-Rantel Adventurer's Guild. Malmvist rejected the suggestion, not wanting to be bound by rules. He with Peshurian, Regi and Shizuni fought against Shall in the match. Eventually his team were declared the victors of the promotion match, winning them five-hundred chocolate snacks and sale rights. Later back at the hideout Malmvist was shocked to hear from Zero lecture Regi and Shizuni about trying to have more class and tone done their unruly fighting styles so that they would not offput potential clients.[14]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Malmvist is a fencer who fights more like an assassin than a warrior, relying on a rapier which can kill any normal fighter with a single scratch. Despite lacking skills in the sword, his lunging technique is top-notch, even surpassing Gazef Stronoff's strikes. He also possesses numerous Martial Arts that could allow his lunging strike to even match the former Black Scripture member Clementine.
Main Equipment

Whetstone of Keane
Move Plus (Boots)
Mix Potion
Rose Thorn: This weapon's tip is covered in a mixture of several deadly poisons, and the rapier itself is imbued with two complementary spells.
Relationships

Zero

He respects and fears Zero as the leader of the Six Arms.

To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. Marchioness Raeven is the unnamed wife of Elias Brandt Dale Raeven and the mother of Rii-tan.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

A woman with a pretty face that was shadowed by gloominess. Her clothes were of exquisite make, but their colors were muted.
Personality

The Marchioness was described to have originally not be a "happy woman" and was stated to have only agreed to marry her husband in order to mutually consolidate both his and her families power base as Nobles. Due to this transactional relationship, the Marchioness was stated to have had a colder, more business like relationship with her husband.

However, since the birth of Rii-tan, she has begun to smile more often as she began to genuinely bond and fall in love with her husband over their shared love for their son.
Background

Marquis Raeven initially married her as a part of his plan to build his political power base. Though they had a loveless relationship, a small miracle would bring them closer together after she bore him a son.[1]

During Marquis Raeven's flight from the Massacre at Katze Plains his thoughts turned to his wife and son as he was being chased by a Dark Young, showing that despite how their relationship was originally nothing more than a transaction between her and her husband to increase his power, she came to genuinely love him over the course of their marriage and the birth of their son.[2]
Chronology

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
The Marchioness and Rii-tan paid Marquis Raeven in his office. She watched her son interact with his father. The Marchioness later excused themselves to allow Raeven to continue working.

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Later it was revealed by the surviving nobles from the Fall of the Re-Estize Kingdom, that she and her husband had a second son.[3]

Abilities and Powers

Given that she married Marquis Raeven, she holds the title of Marchioness.
Relationships

Elias Brandt Dale Raeven

Originally, Elias only cared for her as a tool and thus there was no love between them in the beginning. With this cold business like relationship being mutually shared with the Marchioness, who agreed to marry him to assist her own noble family’s power base. However, after the birth of their son, it caused the cold-hearted man she married to warm up and start appreciating his family. Initially, his change in personality made her wonder if there was something wrong with him. However, over time and after comparing his current personality with his personality from before the birth of Rii-tan, she came to like this new version of her husband.[4]

Eventually, during the course of raising their first son, the Marchioness and Marquis Raeven came to genuinely love each other as husband and wife and one of the Marquis's main reasons of desperately staying alive during the Massacre at Katze Plains was to go home to his wife and firstborn son, and even thought about going home to her to have their second child.

And later despite the immensely depressive aura of having betrayed his nation to the Sorcerer Kingdom during its fall to save his family, Elias was still noticeably happy due to his wife having now given him a second child.

Rii-tan

The Marchioness loved her child, however, unlike her husband she tried not to spoil him too much as it would hinder his development. The Marchioness in particular considers him to be a blessing that genuinely made her love her husband due to him changing his personality.

Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.




"Same...same sixth Floor Guardian Mare Bello Fiore, at your command."
— Mare's Introduction
Mare Bello Fiore (マーレ・ベロ・フィオーレ) is a dark elf and one of the twin Floor Guardians on the 6th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Mare is the younger twin brother of Aura Bella Fiora. Alongside his sister, he was created by Bukubukuchagama.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Mare is a child with dark skin and pointed ears, a signature trait of the dark elves. He has golden hair and heterochromia, his right eye is blue, and his left eye is green.

He wears a blue dragon scale leather full-body suit, covered by a white and gold vest embroidered with the sigil of Ainz Ooal Gown and a forest green-leaf cloak. Below, he has a matching short white skirt exposing his thighs, and on his neck is an acorn necklace emitting silver light. His slender hands are donned with shiny white silk gloves and he wields a twisted black wooden staff.

People outside of Nazarick besides Hilma always mistake him for a girl, due to how he looks appearance-wise and the clothing he mainly wears.
Personality

Mare has a shy and cowardly personality, the kind, which is a polar opposite to his sister, Aura. He often stutters when speaking and maintaining a subservient demeanor during conversations. This, however, is only an outward guise and does not affect his loyalty to Ainz or his ability to carry out his duties, no matter how cold-blooded they may be. Beneath his shy and retiring facade, Mare is capable of showing hostility and determination to those who threaten the territory of the 41 Supreme Beings. A frequent oddity of Mare, seemingly only noted by entities from outside Nazarick (especially those he's about to kill), is how he seems to be pretending when he acts meek, as if he's putting on an act unlike the other former NPC's.

Mare likes to sleep all day and is fond of reading books from Nazarick's library, Ashurbanipal, instead of talking with others. He is comprehensive of how his sister feels without her needing to say a word, knowing whether she is having a bad mood or not. He is also appreciative of the time and effort put forth by Ainz's New World followers, showering those like the lizardmen in compliments for showing their loyalty to his master with offerings. He also dislikes dragging out conversations with other Nazarick denizens like Pulcinella for too long, seeing that everything the latter tells him is uninteresting. If an opportunity presents itself in the conversation, he would have tried his best to hurriedly change the topic of their discussion before it goes on for any longer than it already did.

Unlike his sister, who has an interest in collecting beast species, Mare takes a keen interest in collecting plant species. Mare is also observant of his master's movements to the point that he can't help but openly lavish praises for Ainz during their times spent together between them. When Ainz provided his reason for staying with the NPCs, he was shown to appear very emotional and tearful around his master. It was to the point he indirectly got servants of Nazaricks like one of the Homunculus Maids to speak on his behalf while he is crying uncontrollably until Ainz calmed him down. This goes to show that Mare's feelings are relatable and understandable by servants who wish to convey them in his stead. He was reluctant about the idea of executing actions independently on his own without first seeking permission from Ainz ahead of time. He loathes the possibility of being scolded by Ainz by acting against his master's orders unless it is his creator making the decision for him. He was adamant and determined to not let anybody undermine the uniqueness his creator granted to him, going as far as to voice that vow loudly. On the other hand, he would kindly admonish his sister's words if it is out of line especially towards Shalltear.

When Mare becomes troubled of what to do on duty while alone, he can't help but express sorrow over it. Wherever there are NPCs like Aura around with him, he would rather consult them to help with completing the task. If he failed to achieve good results from the orders Ainz issued him to do, he would easily get depressed to the point where not even his fellow NPCs could be able to cheer him up except for his master or creator. Bad results of fulfilling his master's orders would make him question his own worth and existence as a servant to Ainz. He dislikes the mere thought of disappointing Ainz who counted on him to do his job correctly without failure. Mare thought about it so much that he tearfully imagined what would happen to him if everything went wrong. Nevertheless, he was very much appreciative of Ainz's willingness to encouragingly guide him on his task every step of the way during their mission together. He felt extremely grateful for the positive words Ainz had given him as wisdom, spurring, and aspiring him to work even harder than before with a newfound resolve and spirit. Simply hearing the gentle words come out of Ainz's mouth was enough to move Mare to tears, crying happily about it because his master did not give up on him.
Background

Mare was created to be the brother of Aura by his creator Bukubukuchagama. The reason why Mare is so submissive to Aura stems from how his creator wants that sibling-type relationship to be. Since she apparently believed that the younger brother should obey the elder sister, it was Mare's duty to listen and heed the words of Aura even when they are partnered and paired together during missions assigned by Ainz. (Gag between Peroroncino and Bukubukuchagama).

Whenever they had to visit the other Floor Guardians for fun or do other things, Mare and his sister would always inform one another where they were headed. That was because the two are assigned to guard their Floor together by order of the Supreme Beings.

As Mare tended to stay in the Amphitheater for the time being, it was the duty of his sister to go patrol the forest in the meantime. If he intended to leave the location, it was Mare's job to report to Aura ahead of time before proceeding further.
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
When Momonga teleports to the 6th Floor and enters the Amphitheater while being greeted by his sister, Mare has his presence noticed by his master. Mare is told by his master to show himself. Realizing Mare is not heeding to his command, the elf is called out by Aura to also pay his respects to their master. When Mare takes too long to respond to the protocol, his sister gets angry and begins scolding him for his inability to act quick on his feet. Feeling threatened by sister's threats physically, he gathers up his courage and greets Momonga, shortly later apologizing to his master for the long wait he has caused. According to Aura, Mare feels scared and afraid in the presence of his master. While Aura converses with Momonga about wishing intruders can invade their floor, Mare voices his fear by not wanting them to come. This, in turn, forces Mare to be taken away by his sister to have a brief, private discussion and scolding him for what he says. Mare is on his knees in front of Aura, who hurls a torrent of abuse at him, only to be stopped by Ainz, who wants Aura to forgive him.

Wondering why Momonga has come to his floor, Mare is shocked to hear that he is planning to do some training along with performing experiments while using both his magic and his guild weapon. When Momonga asks Aura if she wants to fight his summoned Primal Fire Elemental, his sister accepts happily. Although Mare is delighted to hear from his master that they will get to see the power of the guild weapon, he isn't very fond of the idea on fighting and testing the entity out himself. During the summoning of such a monster, he is protected and shielded by her sister's own servants, the Dragonkins from the elemental's fire effect that is unleashed along the way. After it is summoned, he refuses to go along with her sister's acceptance to fight by attempting to excuse himself and flee the scene about to unfold. In the end, before he can even get the chance to make his escape, Mare is enthusiastically dragged off by his sister to join and assist her in the battle. After he and Aura defeat the elemental, Mare returns back to Momonga's side while feeling somewhat exhausted and tired.

As a result, Mare is given a drink of water from Momonga, who appreciates the hard work he put forth while fighting the elemental with his sister. Mare thanks Momonga for his act of benevolence towards him and his sister, coming to the realization that their master is not as terrifying as he initially thought he was.

Once the other Floor Guardians arrive at the Amphitheater, he joins them in a formal salutation towards Momonga. Together, they collectively pay their respects and admire the powerful presence their master has. Additionally, when he is asked by Momonga about what to do to conceal the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Mare suggests covering the walls in mud and plants together as a way to camouflage it. When Momonga asks for confirmation from Mare if utilizing heaps of dirt to conceal the walls is workable, he believes that it should be possible as long as he is given permission by the latter to do so. Hence, it is decided by Ainz that Mare and Aura will be given the task of piling up the dirt from the nearby land close to Nazarick to make dummy hills as camouflage. Alongside his sister, Mare is given permission to use any resources from the other floors in Nazarick besides their own to help them with the task at hand.[2]

Since the meeting is over and Momonga has left their vicinity, Mare is the first to voice his thoughts on how scary their master's Despair Aura was. When Mare is questioned by Demiurge about breeding children for the sake of Nazarick, he is dumbfounded and flabbergasted on how to respond. Nonetheless, he regains his composure quickly enough to say that he will do whatever he can to help his master to make that happen at some point. Mare is promised by Demiurge that he will one day teach the elf on how to make children. Mare is also advised by Demiurge not to conduct breeding experiments on his own without their master's permission, considering the operations in Nazarick are currently running smoothly at the moment. Mare agrees with what Demiurge, believing that increasing their numbers in Nazarick right now won't do any good for them. While so, Mare informs Demiurge that the reason why he is dressed this way is due to his creator's decision of turning him into a trap.[3]

Later, Mare recruits several undead and golems to help him on his current task. According to Momonga, who is watching from afar, it appears Mare is camouflaging the walls of Nazarick with his magic. Demiurge notes that Mare's workload is only going to continue increasing further now that some gaps will be left after moving the earth, which will need to be filled with plants. Shortly thereafter, Mare ends up spotting his master and meets up with him to talk about the work being done to ensure the security of Nazarick. After some complicated exchange of words back and forth concerning the reward decided by Momonga, Mare finally accepts the Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown that is handed to him by his master. Moving forward, Mare promised Momonga that he will work harder than before so that his master will not be disappointed by him. On the other hand, Mare is informed by Albedo, who arrives later at the scene, to tell him that their master is dressed in armor to make sure that the former won't have his duty disturbed and interrupted while he works. Not only that, but Mare is also advised by Momonga to take a break before he continues the camouflage work, which the former complies to do.[4]

The Emissary of the King Arc

Main article: The Emissary of the King Arc
Mare is shown sleeping when a messenger from Ainz comes to the 6th Floor. Having been awoken by Aura, he quickly gets out of bed to greet the Death Knight, who has already been shown in by his sister. Upon hearing the undead's questions from their master, Mare, like his sister, is confused, but nonetheless believes Ainz has a reason. On their interpersonal relationships, Aura answers for Mare, stating he is a bookworm and hardly goes out. She berates him to make friends, to which Mare meekly agrees. He is recommended by Aura to start with the librarian, Titus Annaeus Secundus since they have similar interests. On the topic of their desires, Mare wants some plant monsters to raise to protect the floor, as opposed to Aura wanting a new magical beast.[5]

The Guardians' Vacation Arc

Main article: The Guardians' Vacation Arc
When Ainz suggests that the Guardians take a vacation, Mare is deeply troubled and confused by his master's suggestion. Having not the slightest clue how to handle his break time, Mare pleads with Ainz to tell him how to spend their rest days off. Mare thinks that perhaps the reason behind why Ainz is giving him some to take a break and rest is because he failed his master.

While spending his time with the Guardians in private, Mare brings up the health exam the Supreme Being Herohero once spoke of doing. Since Herohero was an Elder Black Ooze, he is unsure what the Supreme Being's internal liver organ would look like, assuming the slime had one in the first place. Near the end of the conversation with them, Mare promises the other Guardians that he will continue working his hardest and be of use to everyone in Nazarick.[6]

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Before heading to E-Rantel, Ainz orders Mare and his sister to scout the Great Forest of Tob so that they can ensure the safety of the Great Tomb of Nazarick and collect information. Because of this string of tasks, Mare, Aura, the vassals designated for construction, and other powerful entities invade the forest and disrupt the balance of power within it.[7]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
Ainz orders Mare and Albedo to eliminate Kralgra to keep the affair a secret. Mare uses his magic on the forest so that no one can escape. After having already killed the first person, Mare drags the corpse behind a tree before proceeding to his next target. He immobilizes his second target, Igvarge, and kills him by crushing the man's skull with his staff. Although he doubts his performance with how the adventurer was killed brutally, Mare is happy to know from Albedo that Ainz will surely be happy for what he did to the man.

Shortly thereafter, he helps Albedo bring the corpses of Kralgra back to Nazarick.[8] He and his sister accompany Ainz to a location that happens to be nearby to where Shalltear is positioned at before they part ways with their master to carry out their tasks.

As Ainz proceeds to engage Shalltear in a death battle from then onward, one of the tasks Mare and his sister have been ordered to do is to carefully monitor the area from afar. Having been given legendary items, he and Aura are given the additional order of withdrawing if the enemies who are responsible for brainwashing Shalltear appear.[9]

Once the fight comes to an end, Mare is informed by Aura that the victor of the battle is their master. Hearing this, he suggests they collect Shalltear's equipment drop after the battle, to which his sister says their master has that already taken care of. Mare and Aura later head back to Nazarick as instructed since their task was now over.

After Ainz returns to Nazarick, Mare and the other Floor Guardians beg him to never get in harm's way again and to allow them to handle any future incidents that may come from now on. Although the other Guardians advise Ainz to give Shalltear a harsh punishment, Mare instead suggests to Ainz that they are better off not being too strict on her. He considers removing all traces that remains in the battle, but Ainz suggests there is no need for him to do so because it will be used to fabricate an incident caused by the Sealing Crystal while fighting the vampire.[10]

The Show Must Go On!

Main article: The Show Must Go On! Arc
Mare and Aura are seen together working in the Great Forest of Tob. Mare is confused as to what they are doing, to which his sister explains that she is building a second Great Tomb of Nazarick. Upon hearing her response, he becomes uncomfortable and is afraid that his sister is planning to secede from Nazarick. Aura denies his claim, but before she can explain further, Ainz arrives through a Gate. To his relief, Mare learns that the structure Aura is building is simply a decoy base for Nazarick. At a meeting with Ainz and the Floor Guardians, he listens to his master's plan of implementing a fringe benefit system. Mare requests to create a sea on the 6th Floor of Nazarick.[11]

The Sealed Evil Tree Arc

Main article: The Sealed Evil Tree Arc
Mare, alongside with the other Floor Guardians, are ordered to fight together against Zy'tl Q'ae and to secure the herb and to complete Ainz's adventurer quest from Pluton Ainzach.[12]

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
After Cocytus loses the war against the lizardmen, Mare takes part in a meeting alongside the rest of his fellow Floor Guardians concerning the former's defeat. During the meeting, he and his sister Aura both shed tears emotionally after seeing the way on how Ainz chooses to forgive Shalltear for her betrayal. After the meeting is over and Ainz leaves, Mare shares his thoughts with the Floor Guardians. He speculates that maybe Ainz intentionally set Cocytus' expedition up to fail from the very beginning, considering why their master allowed Cocytus to use only weak undead.[13]

Mare and the other Floor Guardians appear next to Ainz when he addresses the lizardmen. When Aura voices her disapproval of having their guests be brought into her construction, Mare is an exception among the Floor Guardians to not be entirely against her idea. While everyone nods their head with Aura's reasoning in order to convince their master, Mare, on the other hand, chooses not to act accordingly like them and instead waits for his master to make the final decision.[14]

The Search for Hamsuke Arc

Main article: The Search for Hamsuke Arc
Mare is conscripted by his sister Aura to find Hamsuke, who has gotten lost somewhere on the 1st Floor of Nazarick. He figures that they could be at a disadvantage, considering Hamsuke cannot be found on the floor they preside over. When Aura suggested taking Hamsuke's pelt for herself if it turns out dead, Mare refuses her idea as that corpse could be put to use for a lot of Nazarick's experiments. Although there are no signs of teleport gates being used, Mare believes that in the event that Hamsuke did get teleported by a trap, it should not have been sent so far down. Hence, he advised that they keep on searching for the creature's whereabouts until they reach the 4th and 5th Floors as Hamsuke cannot be found on the 3rd Floor.

On the other hand, he considers using [Detect Life], but chooses not to because Kyouhukou's Black Capsule contains too many lifeforms to count. Mare and his sister attempt to continue tracking down the hamster to the 2nd Floor and are soon joined by Albedo and Shalltear. In the end, the four find Hamsuke alive. However, none of the female Floor Guardians want to approach the beast, as much to their horror, Hamsuke has a cockroach on her head. The other three push Mare to use his staff to crush the bug in response, but Mare is unsure and is afraid of killing Hamsuke since it is Ainz's pet. He isn't able to do anything to the hamster as the antics of the female Floor Guardians cause Hamsuke to flee in terror after being threatened with death.[15]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Back in Nazarick, Mare sits quietly in the Amphitheater and reads a book called "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer." Sensing the teleport gate being used to come here, he pauses his reading and goes to confront Pulcinella.

Mare is given a secret message from Demiurge's servant, Pulcinella. He reads the message and sees that it is an invitation from Ainz to all the male Floor Guardians to join him for a bath. Meanwhile, he learns from Pulcinella that Demiurge is busy conducting several Breeding Experiments with the best of intentions in mind. Hence, he doesn't understand why the participants in his experiments seem to have some hatred towards Demiurge for what he is doing to them.

After knowing why, he can't pass this folder to his sister Aura, Mare circles "Going" to show acceptance of his master's invitation. He understands that it is his duty to pass on this secret message to Cocytus in Guren's stead as the Area Guardian is busy guarding Demiurge's domain while its master is away. In order to keep the content a secret from the female Floor Guardians, Mare decides to contact Aura and lies to her sister about the reason why he needs to go to the 5th Floor. Before long, Mare heads out to search for Cocytus using the Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown, only to find that he isn't in Nazarick, but at the lizardmen's village according to the Frost Virgins.

Realizing he can't step outside Nazarick without high-level vassals to accompany him on the mission, he requests the Frost Virgins' assistance to bring the Floor Guardian to him. His request is turned down as they cannot disobey Cocytus's order to defend his domain other than their master Ainz. This leaves Mare with no other choice but to pay a visit to Nazarick's library, Ashurbanipal. There, he greets Librarian J and has the undead guide him to where Titus Annaeus Secundus is at in the search for the head librarian's assistance. Not only that, but Mare also goes out of his way to return "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" to Librarian J and is recommended by the latter to read some unknown book concerning a murder. Upon reaching the Head Librarian's location, Mare asks Titus a favor in exchange for his help.

As a result, Mare assists Titus on one of his experiments involving the creation of Magic Scrolls while under the condition of not using any of his dragons for it. After assisting Titus, Mare is allowed to borrow high-level vassals like Cocceius, Ulpius, Aelius, Fulvius, and Aurelius as promised. Before leaving Nazarick to visit the lizardmen's village in search for Cocytus once more, he hands his Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown to someone else along the way.

After reaching the lizardmen's village, Mare and his undead bodyguards pay their deepest respects to the statue of their master and praise the lizardmen for their dedication and hard work. When that is done, he then orders Aurelius to find someone among the lizardmen who knows where Cocytus is. Shortly after, he was greeted by Shasuryu Shasha, who tells him that Cocytus isn't in the village unfortunately after receiving information by Aurelius on that specific lizardman in question. Mare is informed that Cocytus has gone out on a quest to subjugate the toadmen in the northern part of the lake. While waiting for Cocytus's return to the lizardmen's village, he discusses with Shasuryu about the toadmen and the fish farm his people are constructing. Mare also informs Shasuryu that the food being provided to the lizardmen are created by the power of their master and other 40 Supreme Beings. He reaffirms to Shasuryu that Ainz is their god and will convey the lizardman's kindness to Ainz.

Finishing up his task, Mare returns to Nazarick and hands the invitation folder back to Ainz. The two exchange words as Ainz ends up by expressing his love for the NPCs, including Mare himself. He is awestruck by the way Ainz acts and behaves as a leader, hugging him and burying his face in his master's shoulder. While shedding tears about his master's kind words, Mare emotionally and tearfully appreciates Ainz's decision to stay with them unlike the other Supreme Beings, including his creator, who left. Suddenly, Albedo becomes unable to control her emotions and attempts to rape Ainz. Mare assists several Eight-Edge Assassins in restraining Albedo while his master punishes her to three days of solitary confinement in the Frozen Prison for assaulting him.

Margrave Urovana is the oldest person among the six great nobles. He is an elderly man with white hair and his body looks like a gnarled wood, he still retained the gravitas expected of an elder.

Margrave Urovana is the most persuasive of the Six Great Nobles.
Background

Margrave Urovana is the oldest of the Six Great Nobles of the Re-Estize Kingdom. Throughout his career, he has remained loyal to King Ramposa III and a patriot to the Kingdom.

Marquis Blumrush (ブルムラシュー候爵) was one of the Six Great Nobles of Re-Estize Kingdom. While putting on the guise of a loyalist, he was secretly working for the Baharuth Empire for monetary gain.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Approaching in his forties, he has fair skin and curtained blonde hair with matching pencil mustache.

Due to his immense wealth, he is dressed in the most luxurious and extravagant attire.
Personality

In public, Marquis Blumrush maintains a persona of a patriot to the Kingdom and a vassal loyal to the King

In reality, he is a greedy and treacherous man, to the point where he would betray the Kingdom by leaking information to the Baharuth Empire to further increase his already immense wealth. It was stated that he would even betray his own family for a gold coin.
Background

Marquis Blumrush is one of the six great nobles and a member of the Royalty Faction. His domain encompassed gold and mithril mines, which made him the wealthiest man in the Kingdom. In spite of this, he is secretly passing on information to the Baharuth Empire. Marquis Raeven perceive of his treachery, but as Blumrush's authority is necessary to maintain the Kingdom's stability, Raeven overlooks the problem for the time being and desperately conceal it from their rival, the Nobility Faction.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom Arc
To show the full extent of her intellect during a private discussion with Marquis Reaven and Prince Zanac, Princess Renner reveals that she’s fully aware of Marquis Blumrush’s secret dealings with the Empire, much to their shock and disbelief.[1]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Marquis Blumrush attended a meeting between the Royal and Noble Factions. Like the other attending nobles, he react with incredulity at the Empire's declaration to help Ainz Ooal Gown reclaim E-Rantel and the surrounding areas. He, along with the other nobles, discuss and dismisses Ainz as a simple magic caster and that the declaration is merely another casus belli to attack the Kingdom. After much deliberation, all nobles from both factions pledge their support on the war effort

"Hmph! Who's this Ainz Ooal Gown? Like Lindon said, what can one man do? If he flies, we'll shoot him down with bows. The same if he attacks from far away. What can one magic caster do? Those stories of magic casters who change the battlefield by themselves are just that, stories!"

Marquis Boullope (ボウロロープ侯爵) was one of the Six Great Nobles of Re-Estize Kingdom. He was also the leader of the Noble Faction opposing King Ramposa III.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Marquis Boullope's age was around in the fifties and his face was heavily scarred, like that of a warlord. His once stout body which had been honed through unrelenting training was little more than a memory of the past. Yet, his voice and gaze would make people think that there must have been more than a little bit of his warrior side still left in him.
Personality

Marquis Boullope was a rather warrior-type and virile man. He liked to strengthen the armaments. He trained his own elite troop very well, as he felt a competitive spirit against Gazef's Warrior Troop.
Background

Marquis Boullope controlled the most territory among the Great Nobles. He had been inspired by Gazef’s warrior troops and created a unit of his own professional warriors.
Chronology

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Overlord III EP12 035
The Death of Marquis Boullope
When the Baharuth Empire declared that it would conquer the fortress city of E-Rantel for its rightful ruler, Boullope was confident that the Royal Army would overwhelm the Empire and its new ally, Ainz Ooal Gown (Though was cautious enough to take Gazef's warning of his power to make him judge Ainz to be 5,000 men strong) . He also convinced King Ramposa III to allow Barbo to take a unit of five thousand men to investigate Carne Village and its relationship with the magic caster.[1]  

Marquis Boullope commanded the left-wing of the Royal Army before the battle in the Katze Plains. He was among those that were killed by the spell Ainz used to summon the Dark Young.[2]  

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Marquis Boullope and Marquis Raeven was mentioned in passing by the mercenary leader escorting Christopher Olson and his cargo to Re-Robel. He labeled them as nobles that were the riskiest to pick a fight with. Both of them have strong armies stationed within their own territories and it’d be dangerous to bump into them. The mercenary warned that even though the two nobles both suffered great losses in the war their caravan shouldn’t be careless

Despite his young age, he is portrayed as a stern and serious man. As a member of the Royalty Faction, he is loyal to the King.

His father was known to be a competent man with an excellent disposition. Many had hope his son would inherit his qualities. Marquis Pespea married the King's eldest daughter and at a young age became the head of his household.

Munuinia Ilyslym (ムンウィニア＝イリススリム) is one of the three wives of Olasird'arc Haylilyal, the White Dragon Lord of the Azerlisia Mountains.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Personality

Just like Olasird'arc, she believes that Dragons need strength above all else. She doesn't like to be ordered around even by Olasird'arc as shown when she threatened to cause irreparable damage to the Dwarven Royal Palace. Despite her prideful attitude, Munuinia values her own life as she quickly obeyed Ainz Ooal Gown who proved his own power by easily killing Munuinia's husband.
Background

Years ago, Munuinia battled Olasid'arc over territory. Their battles were so fierce that they destroyed Feo Teiwaz. She lost that battle and became his latest concubine.
Chronology

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
Munuinia was present in the throne chamber of Olasid'arc when Pe Riyuro brought a request for aid in repelling the invaders from the Dwarf Kingdom. After the Dragon Lord dismissed the Quagoa, he asked his concubines their opinion on the matter. Munuinia believed that the nuance of providing aid to the Quagoa to take care of a few dwarven invaders was inconsequential.

Olasid'arc agreed to the request and after dismissing the demi-humans, consulted with his mates to decide which of his children he should send. When Kilistran proposed sending Hejinmal as he would be wiser and have better judgment. Munuinia doubted his capabilities in handling the task, causing Kilistran Denshusha to state it would be better than sending her son Torangealit, to which the former took offense, but was stopped by Olasid'arc who agreed with Kilistran.

When Hejinmal arrived with Ainz and Gondo upon his back, acting subservient, both she and Mianatalon were shocked by this development. After they caught the scent of the value of Ainz's clothes, they fail to detect the danger they were in after their lord demanded Ainz to hand his vestments over. She witnessed her mate killed with a mere gesture.

Ainz Ooal Gown asked which among the dragons was Hejinmal's mother, Munuinia along with her two companions answered in fear for their lives. Ainz believing that each dragon had played a part in Hejinmal's upbringing asked the young dragon to clarify this. Hejinmal confirmed this to be 'true', thus sparing the trio.

Munuinia and the rest of the concubines were dismissed to gather their children to be presented to Ainz. When one of their fellows refused to accept his father had been killed by the undead, she witnessed Ainz kill him with a simple gesture, strengthening their fear of him.[1]

Abilities and Powers

Munuinia fought on par with the White Dragon Lord for territory many times before being defeated and ending up becoming his mate thereafter.
Active

Freezing Breath
Relationships

Ainz Ooal Gown

Munuinia is deathly afraid of the undead magic caster which had shown that he is more than capable of killing any and all of the Frost Dragon, starting with her own husband.

Olasird'arc Haylilyal

After being bested in combat by Olasird'arc, Munuinia agreed to be his concubine and bore his children. Though she usually gets her way with him by threatening to do irreparable damage to the Dwarven Royal Palace, should he order her around.

Kilistran Denshusha

It seems apparent from their conversation together with their husband that they do not get along. It shows that the two female Frost Dragons do not get along with each other as they both shared different values in tackling a problem.

Mianatalon Fuviness

While advising their husband on how to tackle the problem at hand, they both are agreeable with the same idea of willing to assist the Quagoa against the dwarves.

Hejinmal

It was shown that Munuinia has a low opinion about Hejinmal when Kilistran suggested sending him to deal with the intruders. However, when Ainz easily killed Olasird'arc and asked Hejinmal who was his mother, Munuinia said she was in order to save herself. Hejinmal himself noted that her eyes signified her trying desperately to ingratiate herself with him.

"I am Narberal Gamma, one of the battle maids, who swore loyalty to the overlord of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, the supreme being Ainz Ooal Gown. You lower life forms should be honored to battle with me."
— Narberal's introduction to Khajiit
Narberal Gamma (ナーベラル・ガンマ, Narberal・Γ) is a doppelgänger battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Nishikienrai, one of the original nine founders of Ainz Ooal Gown.

She is also known as Nabe, a magic caster and Momon's adventurer partner of Darkness. As an adamantite ranked adventurer, she is one of the most powerful adventurers in the Sorcerer Kingdom.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Narberal Gamma is described as an elegant, snow-white skinned, black-pony tailed beauty. People believe her beauty is comparable to that of the Golden Princess.

She wears a white bonnet in place of a helmet, and black armor decorated in gold and silver in the likeness of a maid uniform. As a battle mage, her weapon of choice is a golden staff plated in silver. In her adventurer persona, she wears a plain brown cloak.

Narberal's human form is gained through her Doppelgänger's transformation skill. However, due to her low-racial level, she can only transform into one form. Her original appearance as a Doppelgänger is similar to Pandora's Actor, and she has three long fingers on each hand that she hides with her gloves.
Personality

Like many others in Nazarick, Narberal views humans as nothing more than low-class creatures. The only human exempt from Narberal's contempt is Aureole Omega. Though she dislikes the thought of killing humans, she will not hesitate to do so if there is no reason to let them live, or unless given an order by Ainz. This makes Narberal one of the two, along with Solution Epsilon, "extremely dangerous" members of the Pleiades.

As a created NPC of Nazarick, she is extremely loyal to Ainz and proud of her quest to support him close by. Nevertheless, she seems unable to understand Ainz's purpose to become a hero and does not hide her aggressive attitude towards humans. At times, she will often refer to Ainz with a "-sama" honorific, even when the two masquerade as adventurers and he orders her not to.

According to Lupusregina Beta, when Narberal is outside Nazarick working on the job as the adventurer Nabe, she can't bear the thought of letting Ainz be looked upon by those around him in a rude manner. When seeing something like that unfold before her eyes, Narberal ponders whether or not she should immediately kill anyone who acts rude to Ainz before asking for his permission. Lupusregina notes that Narberal has to always keep herself focus at all times whenever she is with Ainz in order to stay on alert for if the enemy were to make a move on him.

Whenever she is on a break and resting in Nazarick, Narberal is apparently known to space out, looking at a certain direction where nothing is said to be present in her peripheral vision.

A hobby that she enjoys is chatting, which she does with the Pleiades, the general maids, and Cocytus.
Background

Narberal Gamma was created by Nishikienrai to be one of the battle maids, the Pleiades. They served as a last line of defense against intruders. However, because she is unlikely to be able to stand against enemy players who managed to come this far, her only real purpose was to distract the invaders until the guild members of Ainz Ooal Gown were able to fully prepare for their final stand in the throne room.
Chronology 

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
Narberal, along with her sisters, are ordered to guard the 9th Floor by Momonga. In the dressing room inside Momonga's chamber, she is in charge of keeping watch over him. When Momonga is about to leave, she tells him that his guards are on standby and will not let anything bad happen to him.[1]

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Narberal is chosen by Ainz to be his partner for the journey because she's the most human-looking of the Pleiades. She, alongside her master, explore the new world disguised as adventurers. Going by the name of Nabe, she is registered as a copper ranked adventurer along with Momon at E-Rantel. Their objective is to become famous adventurers and to gather information. She with Momon participated in a mission together with the Swords of Darkness to guard Nfirea Bareare while their client is in search for herb.[2][3][4]

During the course of their journey and after completing that mission, Nabe and Momon are assigned a new mission by Lizzie Bareare to rescue Nfirea who is shortly kidnapped thereafter upon parting ways with their client. During her mission, Nabe encounters several members of Zurrernorn in the city's graveyard. She is ordered by Momon to take care of Khajiit and his accomplices while he deals with Clementine. She begins the battle by making the first attack, eliminating almost everyone but Khajiit, who is left standing. Despite this, she was seemingly under a disadvantageous stalemate when Khajiit summoned two Skeletal Dragons for him to use as shields, whose (supposed) immunity to all magic left her without many offensive options.

In actuality, the "adventurers" were only purposefully dragging the battles to toy with their opponents. Once they finished toying around with their opponents, Momon gives Nabe the permission to show her true colors. She then exposes herself as Narberal Gamma and easily kills Khajiit and the two Skeletal Dragons with a powerful seventh tier magic spell. At the meantime, Momon also exposes himself as Ainz Ooal Gown and effortlessly crushes Clementine to death. Once she finishes her job of defeating the group, Nabe returns to Momon's side and is ordered to take magic items from the people they have killed. Before making their leave, she also shows Hamsuke her Doppelgänger hands to show that she is also not human. [5]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
Narberal stays behind in E-Rantel as Ainz returns to Nazarick to assess the threat of Shalltear Bloodfallen's rebellion. She later relays a message to him that his presence is needed at the Adventurer's Guild, and journeys to the area where Shalltear is maintaining her position. After the adventurers accompanying Darkness have been eliminated, she guides Hamsuke to Nazarick and introduces her to the Floor Guardians.[6]

The Sealed Evil Tree Arc

Main article: The Sealed Evil Tree Arc
Narberal is sent by Ainz to complete a quest from the Adventurer's Guild while he is tasked with a quest to collect special herbs. Ainz sends Yuri Alpha, CZ2128 Delta, and Entoma Vasilissa Zeta to help her along the way as additional support.[7]

The Search for Hamsuke Arc

Main article: The Search for Hamsuke Arc
Narberal reports to Ainz that Hamsuke has gone missing inside Nazarick after she had given her some experimental materials to transfer to the 6th Floor. Albedo suggests that she should try to search for Hamsuke with Shalltear, but Ainz interrupts her and Narberal ends up together with him. Narberal advises asking her little sister, who's in charge of the teleport gates, to find out Hamsuke's approximate location. However, Ainz says that while this is a possible action, he wants to have Shalltear and Albedo work side by side as a way to improve their relationship. She then apologizes for making a foolish suggestion and for not understanding Ainz's wise and insightful plans. Ainz temporarily lets her borrow the Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown, so she can move faster and go to the 6th Floor.

Later, Narberal and Ainz are able to find Hamsuke with one of Kyouhukou's minions. Ainz then orders Narberal to feed Kyouhukou's minion and command him to leave. When Narberal returns, she apologizes to Ainz for this incident, saying it was because of her lack of planning. Narberal says she almost killed his pet and apologizes for causing trouble for the Floor Guardians. Narberal says that she can’t atone for this crime with her life and asks for punishment. Ainz tells her that everything is okay and he's glad that everyone is safe. She accepts her master's kindness and thanks him.[8]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Nabe accompanies Momon and Hamsuke to E-Rantel. After releasing Enri Emmot from the authorities, Momon orders Nabe to question Enri on what she is doing in E-Rantel.

Once she is able to obtain enough information from Enri, Nabe returns to Momon and says that Enri was there to sell the herbs and was visiting the temple and Adventurer's Guild.

After finding out about Enri's request in the Adventurer's Guild, they return to Nazarick. There, he organizes a meeting with Lupusregina since she did not inform him about Enri and Nfirea. Once Lupusregina receives a scolding from Ainz, she escorts Lupusregina outside of her master's office.[9]

The Dark Hero's Story Arc

Main article: The Dark Hero's Story Arc
In E-Rantel, both Nabe and Momon stay at the Golden Pavilion; she informs him that the iron ore he has requested from the merchants is ready. Curious, she asks why he purchased various samples of iron, to which Ainz explains that he wants to see if the quality of ore would make a difference when they are thrown into the Exchange Box to produce YGGDRASIL gold. After he gives her the money to complete the transaction with the merchants, Nabe leaves the hotel. On the way out, she has a brief encounter with Torkel Karan Dale Völkchenheim and his servant, Andre. She is proposed to by Torkel, but she rejects him and immediately leaves.

Later, Nabe and Momon are hired to protect Torkel. During this time, Torkel tries to propose again, but ends up failing a second time. When a Gigant Basilisk appears, Nabe is asked by Torkel to help Momon. However, she tells him that her assistance is not needed and that he should pay attention and witness with his own eyes as a new page is written about the legend of Momon.

When Narberal and Ainz return to Nazarick, her master analyzes the Floor Guardians' requested items from the auction. She asks Ainz for permission to give her opinion about the Floor Guardians' requests. She says that the proposals thought up by everyone are great and that there is no greater joy than to complete a task with Ainz.[10]

Ainz Raises Money Arc

Main article: Ainz Raises Money Arc
When lending money to the Floor Guardians, Ainz indirectly orders Narberal Gamma, alongside Sebas Tian, to buy things for them.

Later, Narberal and Sebas are called upon by the Floor Guardians to take part in an emergency meeting over the money they have received from their master. When the Floor Guardians begin consulting Naberal and Sebas for market items that are worth exactly three gold coins, the two are unable to think of anything.[11]

The Maid Tea Party Arc

Main article: The Maid Tea Party Arc
Narberal participates in the monthly Pleiades report and tea party alongside her sisters. She reports her work to Ainz, as they traveled with two humans after receiving a request from the Adventurer’s Guild. When she informs them that they vanquished a Gigantic Basilisk, her sisters start getting jealous of her closeness with Ainz. After Solution asks how many calories are in CZ2I28's drink, Narberal informs her that there is enough for an active adult to have nothing for the entire day.[12]

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom Arc
Momon and Nabe accept a quest from Marquis Raeven by the E-Rantel Adventurer's Guild for an unprecedented amount of money. The quest is to suppress the group known as Eight Fingers. She and Momon are taken to the Royal Capital by magic casters under Marquis Raeven.

On their way to the capital, Momon notices a light in the distance. He decides to head to that location and asks Nabe to use the flight spell to take him closer and drop him off. The two interrupt the fight between Jaldabaoth and Evileye, and when Momon intervenes to fight Jaldabaoth, the demon retreats. Ainz asks Narberal to use the message spell and ask Demiurge about the details of his plan. When they learn that Evileye almost killed Entoma, both Momon and herself are filled with killing intent.[13]

Along the way, Narberal participates in Demiurge's plan to make Momon a lasting hero in the Re-Estize Kingdom. She fights Lupusregina Beta, Solution Epsilon and Entoma Vasilissa Zeta, who are disguised as Jaldabaoth's underlings.[14]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Nabe accompanies Momon to the city of Arwintar, or otherwise called, the Imperial Capital of the Baharuth Empire. During their visit, she and Ainz organize a meeting with Fluder Paradyne, where they reveal their true power and identities to the magic caster. Upon witnessing their tremendous power, which surpasses his own, Fluder swears his allegiance to Ainz and is willing to cooperate with him regarding the workers.[15]

Later on, Nabe and Momon head to Count Femel's residence for the next phase and escort the workers to the Tomb.[16] While Ainz returns to the Tomb, she and Pandora's Actor stay behind in the adventurer's encampment while the workers are busy investigating the ruins.[17]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
The Re-Estize Kingdom nobles decide to recruit Darkness for the upcoming battle at Katze Plains. Under her alias as "Nabe," she regretfully tells the messenger, Baron Cheneko, that Momon is not available at the moment.

During a discussion between Baron Cheneko and Barbro, he is upset at the disrespectful action caused by Nabe and for the fact that she assaulted him on his way out. He reveals to Barbro that his hand has been left with bruises because of her act of aggression upon him. He explains, using as little details as possible, that Nabe suddenly grabbed his hand and drove him out by force while he was attempting to visit Momon.

In a way, Barbro hopes to use this incident as a means to blackmail Nabe into submission, make her his, and do whatever he wants with the female adventurer. However, at the same time, he realizes that it will be impossible to do so because of how small the available information is.[18]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Narberal is resting alongside Lupusregina in the same room they share with Yuri. During her break, Yuri notes the way Narberal is spacing out and staring at nothing is disturbing to her and how the facial expression somewhat resembles Pandora's Actor. Though Lupusregina explains to Yuri that it is normal for Narberal as it allows her to relax in her doppelgänger form.

Later, to keep Yuri busy with work, she and Lupusregina approach Ainz with a request to give Yuri a new task.[19]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains I
and The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains II Arc

Narberal in the mansion she shared with Ainz while working as adamantite adventures, informed her liege that Albedo had requested their adventurer identities to see her. Since her master had arranged the meeting, the undercover Nazarick agent asked what the meeting pertained to. But she was also curious as to why a request was made since it had been arranged so that Ainz's undercover identity of Momon had become a subordinate of the Sorcerer Kingdom.

Ainz responded that it was to prevent Momon's reputation from being lowered as dog to the Sorcerer Kingdom. That being said the Pleiades was told to keep in mind of when Pandora's Actor played as Momon. Now understanding that this was just a charade to maintain the peace in E-Rantel, Narberal asked once this meeting was over would Pandora's Actor resume the role of Momon. However she is told that Ainz will be assuming the identity of Momon, at least until the end of the investigation into the Katze Plains.

Narberal expressed concern of Ainz in proceeding towards an unknown and dangerous place while acting as Momon, wanting to have additional bodyguards for her master. This was rejected by Ainz as he wanted to use himself as a lure, which Narberal realized was for the Slane Theocracy.

Narberal listened to her master talk about the upcoming mission, which was to locate the Ghost Ship in the Katze Plains and his suspicions that it was actually a golem. And given that they may have to negotiate with whoever was in control of the alleged golem, Ainz expressed that the would have to avoid damaging them, which the maid expressed displeasure to.

A receptionist from the Adventurer's Guild, arrived at their domicile. Narberal then switched to her adventurer persona. They greeted the panic stricken receptionist, who had difficulty speaking, so Momon directed Nabe to fetch some water for the human. After that they were told of their summons by Prime Minister Albedo. The adventurers then arrived at the Adventurer's Guild and directed to a room where Albedo and Ainzach were waiting. For the duration, Nabe kept quiet as Albedo and Momon engaged each other in a scripted conversation, acting out their roles of a domineering overseer and a defiant adventurer.[20]

Nabe and Momon journeyed to the Katze Plains on Hamsuke's back. They rode to the closet Broken Tower where they found Fist engaging in a losing battle against three Skeletal Dragons. Nabe attacked one of the two Skeletal Dragons Momon, battled, falling from the sky and hitting it on the head, forcing it down on the ground. The blow did not destroy it, but served as a distraction long enough for Momon to eliminate it himself.[21]

After the adventurers interacted with for awhile Fist and had departed, the team then retired into the Broken Tower.[22] Once the tower was determined to be secure for their purposes, Hamsuke was sent out to stand guard. Narberal had a short conversation with Ainz, talking about her sister's hobbies and hers, and also ordered not to attack the other party who was in control of the alleged Ghost Ship, before excusing herself to join Hamsuke and watch the sky.

Later the next phase of the plan proceeded with elder liches that Ainz summoned from Nazraick being sent out to conduct a thorough search of the undead land. The Ghost Ship was discovered by a lich and Narberal and Ainz headed to the vessel which was revealed to actually by a type of unknown undead. Due to Narberal's life signature, the pair were targeted by the undead crew when they approached the Ghost Ship from the air.

The undead crew were easily defeated by Ainz, but the commotion attracted the attention of the captain of the Ghost Ship, a lich named Greluné, who regarded the ship, Steel Valkyrie as his wife. At first the lich's attention was on Narberal due to her being of the living, but as soon as he noticed Ainz, he attacked him out of jealousy for his appearance. The attacks were useless against Ainz, and Narberal restrained herself from retaliating against the arrogant lich.

Thus once Ainz used his magic to dominate the Ghost Ship, she felt no pity for Greluné of his wife being taken from him. She even exacerbated his anguish telling him all undead belong to Ainz, though caused some misunderstandings that Ainz wanted to take Steel Valkyrie as a seducer. Though she was told off by Ainz, as there were exceptions like Shalltear, Nigredo and Yuri. On that note Narberal tried to amend herself, but was stopped by Ainz so he could proceed with negotiations with Greluné.

Later under Ainz's direction, the Ghost Ship was sent out to combat an undead crab, the Undead Axe Land Club, to see its offensive capabilities. Once the undead ship showed all of its capabilities before Ainz, he then proceeded to engage the undead crab himself. During that battle, Narberal had a small conversation with Greluné, telling the undead some of her master's capabilities, making him realize the scope of his new mater's powers.[23]

Later Narberal as Nabe was seen spotted on the deck of Steel Valkyrie, by Fist atop the Free City of Vadis, as the Ghost Ship emerged from the plains and headed to E-Rantel.[24]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
While in the main streets of E-Rantel, Narberal is shown to have been tailing after Ainz and Momon from behind. This act serves multiple purposes, the most important of all was to validate the fact that Ainz is still working together with Momon and Nabe. After Entoma contacts Ainz to return to Nazarick, she is ordered to bring the rest of the maids back to Nazarick too
