Nasrene Belt Cure (ナスレネ・ベルト・キュール) was the ruler of the Magelos Tribes of the Abelion Hills and one of the demi-human tribal leaders that participated in the invasion of the Roble Holy Kingdom commanded by Jaldabaoth.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Nasrene was described to have four arms. She adorns her face with cosmetics making it difficult to tell her exact age.[1][2]
Personality

Nasrene's personality can be described as one that has wisdom and her emotions are more controlled than a typical demi-human leader but does not tolerate anyone who jokes about her age and looks. Which she takes great pride in.

However, while more thoughtful and controlled than other demi-humans, she still possessed a measure of arrogance as she didn't think much of Ainz when she first saw him. Further evidence of her arrogance was that she had no spells or techniques for escaping a dangerous situation which indicated that the idea that she would ever be in a situation were she was forced to run never occurred to her. However, when made clear she was outmatched, she was filled with terror and could only think of escape. Her interactions with Ainz showed that underneath her pride and vanity, she was at heart a coward who could only act haughty when she was in a position of superiority.
Background

Nasrene was considered as the queen of the magelos. Because the magelos were quite long-lived, Vijar stated that she ought to be more than halfway through her lifespan. Additionally, Vijar had known about her presence throughout the hills for quite a while back when he was still a child.
Chronology

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
Nasrene met with the other demi-human leaders in the main tent of the demi-human encampment. In there, they discussed the next course of action as to how to retake the city that was once in the control of Buser. Nasrene got into a verbal spar with a colleague of her, Vijar Rajandala, and nearly went into a full confrontation, had it not been for Rokesh's warning of Jaldabaoth's wrath.

After the Demi-Human Alliance breached the west gate of Loyts, the demi-humans attempted to swarm through, though they were hindered by the paladins. Nasrene joined Vijar and Halisha Ankara in subduing the human defenders. Nasrene fought against the paladin Esteban and easily defeated him. She watched from the side lines of the battle between Remedios Custodio and Vijar. When the human used her ultimate attack on Vijar she was surprised and slightly disappointed of it ineffectiveness on her associate.

Just as the zoastia was about to finish Remedios off, Ainz Ooal Gown arrived and used his instant death magic on the tribal leaders. The only one to survive the spell was Nasrene, however despite her resistance she was terrified by the undead and his power. She attempted to use her own magic to put up a defense, but she was slain.[3]

Abilities and Powers

Nasrene was adept at using magic to the point that it could give a warrior like Vijar a consideration of fighting her. Whenever she was annoyed, Nasrene could induce an icy chill that filled the air and affect her surrounding. Her trump card was altering the powerful spell, [Silver Lance] to produce new, unique spells.

She is a formidable Magic Caster, capable of casting at least three spells simultaneously from each of her limbs. Among the three magic spells she possess, each one of them deals ice, fire, and electricity damage. She can even invent her own spells.
Active

Fireball: A 3rd-tier spell that allows the caster to summon a large fireball that is used for attacks.
Silver Lance: A physical spell of the 4th tier, that carried the silver element for great damage to any enemy vulnerable to silver. It also had a piercing special effect that dealt even more damage to targets not wearing any armor. A drawback was that armor could decrease its damage.
Burn Lance: A 4th-tier physical spell that dealt fire damage.
Freeze Lance: A 4th-tier physical spell that dealt ice damage.
Shock Lance: A 4th-tier physical spell that dealt lightning damage.
Main Equipment

Arm Band of Death Guard: This item gave Naserene complete immunity to death magic even against Ainz's 8th Tier [Death] spell. However, it could only be used once a day.
Relationships

Vijar Rajandala

It seems apparent that the two do not easily get along with each other despite the Demi-Human Alliance they are taking part of.

Jaldabaoth

Apparently, Nasrene's goal is made obvious by Halinsha who stated that she is planning to conceive Jaldabaoth's child. To do so though, she wanted to obtain the holy sword, Safarlisia by defeating Remedios Custodio after learning of the paladin's identity. She figured that handing such weapon over to Jaldabaoth will served as proof of her loyalty and worthiness to the demon. This come from the belief that even Jaldabaoth would lavish care on the species of his offspring.

Remedios Custodio

Nasrene wanted to fight and defeat her in order to obtain the holy sword, Safarlisia, to prove herself to Jaldabaoth. She considered Remedios to be a moronic woman who does not know the value of giving birth to children of a supreme ruler. Regardless, Remedios is utterly disgusted and sickened by Nasrene's desire to birth the child of a demon.

Ainz Ooal Gown

When Ainz first appeared and stopped her fire ball attack, she and her fellow demi-human leaders didn't think much of him other than that he had impressive accessories and robes which probably made him strong enough to be a challenge. However, when Ainz immediately kills her fellow leaders with silent death magic, she is confused and shocked. That shock quickly turns into extreme horror when she realizes that the power he possesses is on the same level as Jaldabaoth. In a panic she tries to attack Ainz in order to escape him but her spells do nothing against him to her further astonishment. Ainz, seeing no value in keeping her alive, promptly kills her using Reality Slash.

Nazami Enec (ナザミ・エネック) was a member of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Nazami is a tall and muscular man with dark tanned skin, dark brown eyes, short grey hair, a tear-troughs under his eyes, and an x-shaped scar on his chin.
Personality

Nazami is noted to be rather stoic and composed, rarely speak and only when spoken to. He’s also devoted to his duty and courageous enough to confront a dragon-mounted Aura and Mare when they invaded the Imperial Palace. In the Mass for the Dead continuity, he is portrayed as a compassionate and caring man, even towards the knights under his command, seeing a single knight to be vital to the Empire.
Background

Like the other Four Imperial Knights, he was selected by Jircniv to be a member due to his skills rather than his background.
Chronology

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
When Mare and Aura visited the Imperial Palace to warn Jircniv, Nazami came out to confront the trespassers. Jircniv ordered Fluder to tell Nazami to withdraw but Mare cracked the earth before he can be told to do so. Nazami was swallowed by the resulting earthquake along with several Royal Guards and subsequently killed by Mare's spell.[1]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Nazami participated in the defense of E-Rantel against a horde of Chaos Beasts. The first wave of ten thousand were eliminated by the combined armies of the Tripartite Alliance but word reached them that another wave of twenty to thirty thousand was approaching. Already exhausted the united armies had no hope to defeat the Chaos Beasts.[2] When the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth appeared to offer to save the Alliance, Nazami witnessed his liege Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix accept the deal. The demon and his cohorts defeated Chaos Beasts, but the Alliance were unprepared for the cost as the demons demanded not just all the valuables in E-Rantel but also Emperor Jircniv's life. The Four Imperial Knights unwilling to allow the last concession to come to pass fight against the Demon Emperor to protect the emperor. Nazami sacrificed his life in a vain attempt to allow his fellow Imperial Knights to strike Jaldabaoth which failed.[3]

After the Demon Emperor was defeated by the "Dark Warrior," efforts were made by the emperor to revive his loyal knight. Jircniv went as far to negotiate with Princess Renner to acquire the resurrection magic of Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra. Though the magic of the 5th tier was not enough to revive Nazami as his corpse was crushed by the Demon Emperor. The corpse was so damaged that the magic failed, leaving the Four Imperial Knights one member down and his comrades saddened by his absence.[4]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Nazami is one of the empire's most powerful warriors that specializes in defense that none of the other Imperial Knights could match. He’s mostly seen utilizing two oversized scutum shields in combat.
Relationships

Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix

Nazami was loyal to Emperor Jircniv and the Baharuth Empire, performing his duty as one of his bodyguards

"The Sorcerer King is justice and weakness is a sin."
- Neia's ideology of the Sorcerer King representing her group of followers.
Neia Baraja (ネイア・バラハ) is a citizen of the Roble Holy Kingdom. While starting out as a mere squire in the Holy Kingdom Liberation Army, after meeting Ainz Ooal Gown, she became vital in liberating her country. Afterward, she became the leader of a cult that follows the Sorcerer King's ideals that "strength is justice."

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Neia Baraja
Neia as a squire
Neia is a young teenage girl with short blonde hair and beady black eyes slanted upwards, giving the impression that she is constantly glaring at others. On the other hand, the dark circles around these eyes make the people around her think that she is the kind of person who hangs around with criminals in seedy back alleys. She is also shown to be carrying a sword at her waist, emblazoned with the crest of the Holy Kingdom's knight order. Additionally, she is adorned in a blackish-looking cape, which is used to cover around the upper parts of her getup.

At some point in the war, she would discard the dark cape in favor of wearing the Buser's green armor bestowed upon her by Ainz. Since then, she dons a reddish colored cape over her old one. In addition to that, she wears a unique visor that completely obscures her intimidating eyes from scaring those who observe or approach her. Besides the new attire, her equipment consists of gauntlets, a necklace, and a circlet that the Sorcerer King lent her. She possesses a quiver for holding the arrows on her upper back body and carrys a bow to fire at foes from it.
Personality

Since interpersonal relationships aren't her strong suit, it has caused Neia to develop a personality that favors doing everything by herself.[1] According to her father, he saw her as a gentle, fragile girl who is not the type of person that thinks of fighting power as everything. She is even reflective and self-aware of how others around her view her intimidating face, feeling thankful and appreciative for the Sorcerer King going out of his way to give the former a mask to cover it up for everyone's sake.

During and after the Holy Kingdom's war with the Demi-Human Alliance, her own belief and philosophy surrounding her home nation and countrymen began to change ever since she met and allied with the Sorcerer King. Having now understand what kind of person the Sorcerer King is positively, it encouragingly spurred and motivated her to take actions for him and the Holy Kingdom confidently and fearlessly. When put into several positions of power militarily and politically, she became even more vocal, patriotic, and charismatic about her new ideology that centers around justice and sin. Due to her interactions with the Sorcerer King and getting to better know him as a person, she has become more pragmatic with her view of the world. She accepts the grim reality of making necessary sacrifices for the greater good and wants to reinforce the Sorcerer King's views based on it. She is honest and careful with her words, not the least bit afraid of withholding information from Ainz.

As far as diplomacy goes, she acts under the role of being two factions' messenger and spokesperson to one another. In other words, she would convey her thoughts along with the Holy Kingdom Liberation Army's intentions and Sorcerer Kingdom's opinions for either sides to be informed of. At the same time, she becomes positively charismatic and engaging by the time she rises up in the rank of a leadership role among her followers. When leading both the Archery Unit and the Sorcerer King's Rescue Team, she has an eloquent way with words towards the people who supported her ideology. She was relentless in trying to save Ainz and acquired his aid, urging her supporters to do the same as well beside her. She deeply values and treasures the precious items Ainz had given her on her missions to save him and bring law and order back to the Holy Kingdom.

Additionally, she has shown at times to be sternly scornful around people like Remedios and the priests who speaks ill of the Sorcerer King. When listening to their conversations about the Sorcerer King silently, she frustratingly hated the thought of them badmouthing him behind his back. Moreover, she is considerately thoughtful, courteous, and attentive around Ainz, realizing the ways in how the Sorcerer King is trying to look out for both his nation and the Holy Kingdom's interests in mind fairly. She is also shown to act envious and longing towards Shizu's relationship with Ainz, wishing to be as close to the Sorcerer King like the latter. Nonetheless, Neia is a dutiful person who follows her superior's orders as they are given.

According to the author Maruyama, Neia Baraja was the kind of girl whose mental state is quite unstable. Throughout the course of the Sorcerer Kingdom's assault agains the Holy Kingdom, it made her an easy target for manipulation, as Ainz is capable of turning her into an obedient pawn almost unintentionally. Even in her normal state of mind, she still looks off-putting to some people due to the way she glares at them all the time. This crazed aspect of Neia was the reason behind why her superiors don’t think very highly of her.[2]
Background

Due to the fierce-looking eyes she inherited from her father, Neia Baraja tends to leave a bad first impression on anyone she meets. This is the reason why Neia's childhood friends kept a distance from her. For that reason, she happened to be bad at building good interpersonal relationships with people and always complained to her father over the matter. When her mother overheard her saying that, Neia took quite a beating from her.

At some point during her childhood, her father stated that she was always scared of caterpillars. At the age of six, she carved a wooden doll as a special gift to her father.[3]

While growing up, Neia decided that her goal in life was to become a paladin within the Holy Kingdom. She was rarely ever at home and instead took to training instead. She admired her mother as a Paladin and was dead set on becoming one herself to follow in the footsteps of her mother. However, no matter how much effort and time she spent practicing, Neia saw herself not improving. Before her first encounter with the Sorcerer King, Neia felt that she possessed no innate talent whatsoever with anything, even less so with a sword, and found her ranged abilities to be an utter waste of time to work on improving until now.

After taking on the position of a squire, Neia realized that she had become much more useful to her companions when conducting her missions and the orders that she followed by accordingly. Eventually, with courtesy of the people she talks to and listens to during meetings, it led Neia to accept her previously hated eyes as a way to direct how she feels towards the Paladin Order whenever they speak badly about the Sorcerer King.
Chronology

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom I
and The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom II Arc

Neia Baraja journeyed together with the Holy Kingdom's ambassadorial delegation to the Royal Capital of the Re-Estize Kingdom. Though her presence was seen as a nuisance by the veteran paladins, Neia's sole purpose in this journey was to ensure that they made it to the kingdom safely. As Neia walked through the streets, she happened to notice the citizens of the capital were visibly depressed, thinking this was due to the fact that they suffered an invasion not too long ago. However, she dismissed the idea after remembering that the Northern Kingdom's citizens are currently suffering worse. After being sent on a mission to contact the nobles of the Re-Estize Kingdom, she reported back to Remedios Custodio, stating that the nobles would not be able to receive them due to lack of time. However, Remedios didn't believe her at all and saw it as a failure done on her part.

Later on, she was present alongside the rest of the delegates during the meeting with members of Blue Roses. Upon encountering the adamantite adventurer group at first glance, she admired their composure, especially Lakyus, who seemed more refined than her own leader. After the meeting was over and no help could be established from any party in the Re-Estize Kingdom, she and the rest of her group departed for the Sorcerer Kingdom to seek out aid from Momon instead.

She leads the party and uses her sharp senses while stationed at the front to watch out for any danger. Right around when the envoys reach the Sorcerer Kingdom's border, they encounter a strange mist that approaches fast. As they are preparing for danger, she quickly jolts towards the sky after her senses were on fire. It turns out to be a flying ghost ship that was right in front of them all this time, leaving her dumbfounded. She is left speechless after realizing the flying ghost ship is carrying the Sorcerer Kingdom's banner. As a result, she ends up wondering what sort of nation the Sorcerer Kingdom is supposed to be if it has such strange forces like the flying ghost ship under its command.

When they reach the Sorcerer Kingdom's capital, E-Rantel, Neia is ordered to the back of the group as she was only serving as a guide beforehand. Upon their arrival at the city's main gate, she is left marveling at the two stately-looking gigantic statues flanking the gate and is left in awe at the appearance of frost giants tending to them.

Upon entering, Neia is astonished by the various races that inhabit the city. During their walk towards the Shining Golden Pavilion, her party comes across a trio of dwarves. After questioning them, she is surprised to find that the dwarves are technical advisers who came from the Dwarf Kingdom itself and that they are using the undead to pave roads.

Neia is later present when her party gains an audience with the Sorcerer King and Albedo. She watches the exchange between the two parties and is disheartened that the Sorcerer King can only provide help within three years time. Due to her unwavering insistence, Ainz is delighted and cuts the time to two years.

After the negotiations conclude, Remedios scolds the young squire for interfering. However, Neia fights back in her own defense as her effort had shortened the time even further than they were capable of. Once the two finally stop arguing, Neia goes outside to cool off her head. At that moment, she hears an invisible voice coming from behind her, directing her towards a back alley. The voice is revealed as none other than the Sorcerer King himself. Ainz wants to talk to her as he has another proposal for visiting the delegation. Ainz wants to carry out his plan in secret, requesting the young squire to help him get into the building, which she accepts without hesitation. Neia and the rest of the Paladin Order listen to his proposals and, after deliberations, they decide to accept it. Along the way, she is chosen by her superiors to act as his personal guard and to keep an eye on him.[4]

During the journey back to their hidden base, Neia and the Sorcerer King spend some time having informal conservation. She comes to better understand what kind of person he is, beginning to have a degree of respect and admiration for the Sorcerer King. Ainz, in turn, gives her his Ultimate Shooting Star Super bow in order to convince Neia to use it for his and her own protection.

Neia witnesses the difference in intelligence and charisma between the Sorcerer King and Remedios, which causes Neia to be more respectful of the undead than her own superior. She later draws a similar conclusion when comparing him to Calca or Caspond. When Ainz comments as to how the Liberation Army had remained undetected due to falling within the demi-humans plans to monitor the location of the human resistance, she relays his wisdom to Remedios. After the Sorcerer King retires, the priests in the camp notice Neia wielding the bow given to her by Ainz. She is asked to turn it over to the priest, as they believe it contains sinister magic, but she refuses, saying she will report its confiscation to the Sorcerer King. Remedios relents and Neia watches her 'lead' the meeting on the Liberation Army's next move to relocate and attack the enemy camps to replenish their supplies.

Later, she and Gustav meet with the Sorcerer King and inform him of the Army's plans. The squire is disappointed at the lack of proper respect given to the sovereign due to his undead state. She resolves herself to change that impression, believing he is a good person. Listening to their plans, Ainz comments that it is a sound strategy. However, he doesn't believe that there will be much food at the camps, as the demi-humans will probably have given their captives less in order to keep them weak and reduce their resistance. Despite the gamble, Gustav is insistent on saving the prisoners.

After Gustav leaves, Neia apologizes for his suggestions not being taken seriously. He then decides to ask her about the general area.

During the journey to liberate the nearby camp, Neia becomes fascinated by the Sorcerer King's wisdom. She wants to relay Ainz's wisdom to the leaders in order to achieve success. However, Ainz urges her not to, as the Liberation Army needs to realize the truth for themselves before seeing his alternatives. The Liberation Army attacks a nearby village controlled by the Bafolk. Neia and Ainz stay at the back of the army surveying the battle. When a Bafolk uses a child as a hostage to force the Army to withdraw, Remedios orders her paladins to back away. Neia is stunned at Remedios's single-mindedness in her belief of saving a single life at the expense of countless others. Ainz, seeing it futile to give into threats, intervenes and kills the child as an act of mercy and allows the Army to resume its liberation of the camp. Neia watches the child die, though she is not angry at the Sorcerer King, but grateful as she knows that he cannot show weakness, since the demi-humans will exploit it in the future and he did what needed to be done.

Nemu Emmot (ネム・エモット) is a villager from Carne Village and the younger sister of Enri Emmot.

Appearance

Nemu is described as a young little girl with reddish-brown hair and brown eyes. She wears woolen clothes and pigtails.
Personality

Nemu has a childish and naive personality, but it seems that she may actually know more than her older sister. She used to be more bold and rebellious, but after the attack on her village and the death of her parents, she tries to be more useful and obedient to help Enri.

However, it seems that her boldness comes back when she gets emotional, like the time that she visited Nazarick.
Background

Nemu is the youngest in her family of two unnamed parents.
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
When Carne Village is attacked by Imperial Knights, she tries to escape with her older sister. They run into the surrounding forest, but are caught by the attackers. However, before she is killed, they are saved by Ainz Ooal Gown. He offers her older sister a healing potion, though Nemu holds her back as she doesn't trust him. Albedo, who joins shortly afterwards, becomes enraged that the two are rejecting Ainz’s generosity and raises her bardiche to kill them, though she is stopped by Ainz. After drinking the potion, Enri’s wounds heal immediately, causing the two of them to look on in surprise. Before heading towards the village, Ainz casts two protective spells around them, and gives them two goblin horns to protect themselves.[1]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
After the battle at the gates with the monsters from the Great Forest of Tob was over, she, along with her older sister and Nfirea, join Ainz for dinner to celebrate Nfirea's new purple potion. She is so amazed at the wealth of Nazarick that she simply cannot contain her awe and excitement. When Ainz hears her compliments, he is so taken by the girl's fascination that he even offers her a personal tour of the tomb before dinner is ready.[2]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Nemu is in the village when an army led by the Crown Prince arrives, asking to be let in. She and the rest of the children are led out of the village through the rear gate while the men, goblins and ogres fight the enemy.[3]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
In this continuity, Nemu's parents were killed by Chaos Beasts and Enri was made de-facto chieftain during the crisis. Nemu was fleeing Carne Village after it was being assailed by Chaos Beasts and Contaminated Beast. At her older sister's orders she was to find and bring back help. Nemu was then found by the Swords of Darkness who agreed to come to the aid of the village. They met the protagonist, Surako and Narberal Gamma while the three were exploring outside of Nazarick. The two group united to help save the remaining villagers. Once the monsters were repelled with the help of the Sunlight Scripture that arrived in the area for a confidential mission, the adventurers and undercover Nazarick agents then headed into the forest to look for Nemu's sister Enri but it was too late as she was killed by a Quadruped Chaos Beast. The rescue party took what was left of Enri's remains and buried her in the village where Nemu grieved the loss of her entire family. Nemu then would be evacuated from the village by the Swords of Darkness to a nearby city..[4]

Nemu was later found in E-Rantel, having been taken in by Lizzie and Nfirea. The protagonist and his adventurer team found her alone in the streets when she was being accosted by some thugs. Before the protagonist and his allies could intervene Nfirea came to the scene and killed the ruffians. When Nfirea saw the adventurers approach he initially mistook them for more enemies, but Nemu managed to tell him that they were associates of her and the ones that save her at Carne Village. After Nfirea shared some words with the adventurers he then took Nemu away to return home.[5]

Nemu would not see Nfirea much as unknown to her he had become the director of the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute and sequestered himself in his research. Lizzie was there to take care of her and the young girl acted as the aged pharmacist's assistant. Nemu would also make friends with the other children in E-Rantel. When a straneg illness began to circulate among the orphans, she told Lizzie who suggested that Nemu speak to Nfirea on this matter when she had the chance. One night Nemu had awoke to Nfirea finally home. Though Lizzie urged to to tell Nfirea of the illness, Nemu not wishing to trouble Nfirea did not, but instead begged Nfirea not to overwork himself as he was obvisouly tired and yet refused to rest. But Nemu did not wish her older brother figure to waste away. Nfirea assured Nemu that he would rest before returning to his room.

The next morning, Nemu played with her friends under the supervision of Saint Clementine. The children and saint were paid a visit by Evileye who previously tried to approach the children a night brought gifts to allay their fears. Unlike the other children that were concentrated on the toys and sweets from the adventurer, Nemu listened to Evileye and Clementine's conversation which was about the illness spreading among the children. Nemu told the two older women that indeed some of her friends had contracted the sickness. Not wanting to see her friends die from the sickness, she was torned between bringing the issue to Nfirea as she did not want to trouble him given his own poor health. In her opinion she believed that the Fruit of Longevity could cure the sickness but was hesitant to ask Nfirea as the fruit was located in the dangerous wilderness of the Great Forest of Tob and did not want to endanger him. Eventually Nfirea learned of the situation and not wanting to see Enri's sister suffer made a request to be escorted by adventurers to retrieve the fruit for the cure. Nemu stayed up with Lizzie hoping for Nfirea's safe return and to help him make the medicine.[6]

During E-Rantel's Harvest Festival, Nemu and the orphans of the old district came out to join in the festivities. While wandering the streets, Nemu and her friends encountered the protagonist, Surako, Narberal and Evileye in an alley. After gaping at Narberal and Evileye's costumes, the children were candy by Surako as per the rules of the festival for properly greeting them.[7]

When several Cracks opened in the heart of E-Rantel, releasing hordes of Chaos Beasts, Nemu was caught in the horde of fleeing civilian though was kept close by her Lizzie. Just as the old woman was telling her everything would be fine, she was vanished right before the little girl’s eyes. Fearful of what just happened Nemu tried to get help from a nearby adventurer only to be locked away from the thug. When the thug was attacked by an invisible foe, Nemu found herself surrounded by Chaos Beasts. Lukrut though appeared to arrive and save her bringing her under the protection of the Swords of Darkness. As the adventurer tried to keep Nemu safe and fight off the attacking monsters, one by one they fell prey to an invisible foe that caused each of them to vanish. Nemu once again found herself alone braving an unknown danger that took her friends. [8]

Nemu survived the disaster, but now was left without guardians. Ninya who also lost her entire team, took Nemu in under wing. The two then joined living with Tuareninya Veyron who was Ninya's long lost sister.[9]

During the world-wide miasma spread, that hit E-Rantel, Nemu found herself among a group of surviving children. They were being protected and led by Saint Clementine and Tuare to one of the city shelters. Nemu on the way got separated from the group, having been so distracted by her grief of being alive whilst so many of her loved ones were gone. The girl feeling death was more appropriate wanted to die and stood still as two contaminated trolls approached her. Clementine swiftly came to her rescue but was not match for the enhanced feral trolls and nearly lost her life. Luckily, several adventurers guarding the shelter came to her aid, putting down the trolls and taking them to safety.

Nemu, seeing how hard Clementine fought to save her, found the will to live again, as the act reminded so much of her elder sister who sacrificed her life. At the shelter, Nemu would have a tearful conversation with Nfirea after he finally came with his fellow researchers from the Sorcerer Kingdom to launch a plan to decontaminate those affected by the miasma.[10]

A month later, it was reported that Nemu was looking happier due to having been reunited with Nfirea.[11]

Nemu was seen in the fourth wall section with Clementine. They encountered the protagonist, Shall, Soi and Surako giving a tour to two strangers. Nemu took the opportunity to greet the strangers, Aggresiel and Billiophia, who kindled asked her how she was doing.[12]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Although Nemu Emmot does not have any abilities of her own, she gains a passive stat boost from her older sister. It is heavily implied in the web novel that she has a higher level of luck than most people. She has also been shown to influence many other characters through her childish nature.
Relationships

Enri Emmot

Enri is Nemu's older sister, and she deeply cares about her. She's currently being cared for by Enri after their parents' death. She used to sleep with Enri until her elder sister married Nfirea.

Ainz Ooal Gown

Nemu sees Ainz as the savior of Carne Village, and holds him in high regard for saving her and her older sister. Due to Nemu's heartfelt praise of Ainz and his friends' residence, Ainz even tells Lupusregina to add Nemu to the protection list, just like Nfirea, Enri and Lizzie.

Nfirea Bareare

Nemu supports Nfirea getting along with Enri. After they become lovers, Nemu sometimes asks them awkward questions, and finds amusement in their response alongside the goblins.

Lupusregina Beta

Nemu is one of the four most important people in Carne Village, whose survival Lupusregina must ensure at all costs. Besides this, the two are rarely seen interacting. At most, Nemu is surprised by Lupusregina’s habit of appearing out of nowhere.

Goblin Troop

Nemu is very friendly with the goblins. She is not above playing pranks on her sister with their help.

Neuronist Painkill (ニューロニスト・ペインキル) is an NPC of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She is a special intelligence investigator in charge of torturing prisoners.

Appearance

Neuronist's appearance is that of a huge grey bloating corpse with tentacles, heavy makeup, and very long fingers with sharp inch-long nails with nail polish. Though its race is androgynous, Neuronist declared itself to be a Big sister. She wears a black leather outfit akin to a Dominatrix
Personality

Neuronist is in charge of torturing the prisoners and extracting information from them. She takes delight in her job and inflicting pain on others, especially since her favorite food is brains. She is very talkative, casually conversing with her victims whilst she prepares her tools. She is also quite vain; she considers herself more attractive than both Shalltear and Albedo.
Background

Neuronist is the Area Guardian of the underground portion of the Frozen Prison on the 5th Floor of Nazarick.[1]
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc
The remaining surviving members of the Sunlight Scripture including their captain Nigun Grid Luin were sent to be tortured by Neuronist Painkill after their confrontation with Ainz.[2]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
Shalltear Bloodfallen inquires Solution Epsilon whether or not she got along well with Neuronist Painkill. The battle maid regretfully said that she cannot understand that interrogator’s aesthetic sense.[3] Meanwhile, Albedo informs Ainz Ooal Gown that Neuronist is keeping close watch over the captured Sunlight Scripture members. The Overseer offers a suggestion to Ainz that they should summon Neuronist for guidance in the Frozen Prison, but the latter refuses considering that the interrogator talks too much. After all, this is over, Albedo initially plans to lecture Neuronist and caution her not to babble too much as he said until her master said otherwise not to do so.[4]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
According to Demiurge, Neuronist Painkill was able to successfully reduce the authority of those in power from the Eight Fingers with the help of Mare and Kyouhukou. With the assistance of these three in their operation, they can now begin to slowly infiltrate their organization's ranks until the Re-Estize Kingdom comes under our full control.[5]

While so, Neuronist was said to have assisted in Entoma Vasilissa Zeta's recovery from her fight with Evileye.[6] When several worker groups invaded the tomb, all of Nazarick was put on high alert to test out its defenses against the invaders. Heavy Masher's group had set off a trap, at least one of its members was sent directly to Neuronist Painkill's torture chamber, where he was repeatedly tortured by her.[7]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Neuronist Painkill met CZ2128 Delta, Yuri Alpha, and Aura Bella Fiora in the 6th Floor. She explained that she was going to visit Gashokukochuuou, with the rest of the Five Worst for a house-warming. When she explained the purpose of her gift, a bottle of perfume for men, she offered to educate the young dark elf in being a 'lady'. Though due to her close proximity to Neuronist, she caused Aura to run back to her floor.[8]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
During the Fall of the Re-Estize Kingdom, King Zanac Valleon Igana Ryle Vaiself's head was brought a sign of peace to Ainz by traitorous nobles of the Kingdom. Ainz in his silent fury ordered the nobles and soldiers along with their families to be tortured by Neuronist. It was his intention to ensure that they would be given a fate where they would live in agony and no mercy.[9]

The Half Elf God-kin Arc

Main article: The Half Elf God-kin Arc
Her master Ainz Ooal Gown returning from his sojourn in the Elf Country brought back a prisoner who was captured by Mare to the Frozen Prison so Neuronist can interrogate. The purpose of the interrogation was to learn how she was able to use Ainz’s [The Goal of All Life is Death] and Shalltear’s Einherjar. It was believed that maybe she was related to Shalltear’s mind control and so her interrogation was made a priority. Due to the prisoner was reported by Mare a powerful foe, Ainz had the dark elf guard the prisoner for Neuronist’s safety. After Neuronist stripped the prisoner of her equipment and interrogated her, she learned that it was indeed the Slane Theocracy who was responsible for brainwashing Shalltear. The information was reported to Ainz, who furious then declared war on the Theocracy in retaliation.[10]

Nfirea Bareare (ンフィーレア・バレアレ) is a famous pharmacist in E-Rantel. He is the grandson of Lizzie Bareare and the husband of Enri Emmot.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Nfirea is a young boy with short, bowl-cut blonde hair that covers half his face. He is dressed in ragged work clothes from the potion making workshop.
Personality

Nfirea is described as a nice, calm, and timid person. He works hard at making potions with his grandmother every day.

He also has a minor inferiority complex, due to comparing himself to Ainz. When finally winning Enri's heart, this complex finally went away, revealing a more shrewd side of his personality, becoming more analytical and a sharp wit to match, the first glance of this new side to his personality is him becoming suspicious of Lord Ainz, after the goblins fought the Zombie Troll, though despite his suspicions, his loyalty to Ainz remains strong.
Background

At a young age, Nfirea Bareare was raised by his grandmother Lizzie Bareare after his parents died; he only has murky impressions of them. His grandmother made him her apprentice and taught him everything she knew about herbs, alchemy, and potion-making. He met Enri Emmot while delivering potions to Carne Village and developed feelings for her. Nfirea is also a famous talent holder, born with the ability to use any magic Item without limit or restriction.
Chronology

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Nfirea requested Momon and the Swords of Darkness to help gather some herbs from the Great Forest of Tob near Carne Village, however, his true intention was to get closer to Momon so he could learn how to make the unknown red potion.[1] After returning from the quest, he was kidnapped by Khajiit Dale Badantel and Clementine, who intended to use his talent as part of the ritual to turn Khajiit into an Elder Lich. He was forced to wear the Crown of Wisdom, which left him in a blank state. He was later saved by Ainz, who healed his injuries.[2]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Nfirea and his grandmother were hard at work in Carne Village making new potions, using equipment given to them by Lupusregina Beta from Ainz Ooal Gown. It was stated that they served as the town's new apothecary.

At his house, Nfirea told Enri about a new potion that he and his grandmother made. Later, Nfirea joined Enri and a few goblins in picking herbs in the Great Forest of Tob. While there, they encountered a young hobgoblin being chased by a Barghest. Because Enri wished to help him, the goblins and Nfirea fought and killed the beast. They decided to bring Agu with them to get information on what was happening inside the forest. Agu tells them that due to the appearance of the Monument of Ruin, and the disappearance of the Beast of the South, the balance of power in the forest has shifted. Nfirea and the others grew worried about being attacked by the Giant of the East or Demon Snake of the West that Agu previously mentioned. Nfirea suggested that Enri go to E-Rantel and ask the Adventurer's Guild for help against the monsters. Later that night, Nfirea accompanies Enri, where she puts on an act to take command of the members of Agu's tribe that arrived so that they wouldn't betray the village.

A few days later, Nfirea greets Enri after she returned from E-Rantel. He tells her why she should become the new chief of Carne Village. After Enri became chief, Nfirea becomes her tutor to help her learn the basics needed for the position.

When the village is attacked by the monsters, Nfirea gave Agu his alchemical items to use in battle. He and Enri went off to patrol the houses to see if anyone hadn't noticed the emergency. While patrolling, they came across a troll who climbed over the wall. He and Enri use tricks to distract it, and buy time for the others to fight the monsters as they were to help out afterward; however, this plan fails. Nfirea decided to stay behind and fight by himself so that Enri could get help from the others, and as she was leaving, he tells Enri that he loves her. Nfirea is able to fend off the monsters for a little while thanks to his magic but is eventually incapacitated. He thought that he was about to die until Lupusregina suddenly appeared with the intent of defending him. She heals him and he limps away and returns to Enri who had just arrived with several goblins. They looked on in amazement when the troll was completely incinerated by Lupusregina's magic. Before she leaves, she tells them that they are invited to Ainz's house to celebrate the new potion Nfirea created.[3]

Sometime later, Nfirea, alongside Enri and Nemu, were preparing to go to Ainz's house. Lupusregina arrived with Yuri Alpha, who used a magic item to teleport them to Ainz's location, much to Nfirea's amazement. There, they were greeted by numerous beautiful maids, impressive artwork and architecture, and delicious food and drink. Nfirea felt intimidated by all of this and inferior compared to Ainz. He was comforted by Enri who told him that she likes him just the way he is.[4]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Nfirea, along with Enri were checking if they had enough feed for the livestock when Jugem alerted them to an army approaching the village. They discovered that the army is from the Kingdom and led by none other than the Crown Prince Barbro. Nfirea suggests stalling them for a time until the demi-humans could hide. They heard from the army's messenger that Ainz Ooal Gown was an enemy of the Kingdom and they came to question them about what they knew about the magic caster.

When Barbro orders the army to attack the village, the villagers decided to fight back. Enri, Nfirea, and a few others were in charge of taking the children to the forest to avoid battle while the rest stayed behind. When they took the back exit, they were ambushed by the enemy's cavalry. Nfirea decided to try and stay behind to stall them, however, Enri used her second Horn of the Goblin General to summon an army of goblins instead.[5]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
It's revealed that Enri and Nfirea have been married for around half a year. Enri mentioned that recently, Nfirea stopped his work in fabricating new potions and instead, had been helping her with her chief tasks and with the preservation of herbs for the village.[6]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc
Spoiler Warning: Plot from the light novel details follow


The Half Elf God-kin Arc

Main article: The Half Elf God-kin Arc
By the time of Ainz’s vacation to the Elf Country, Nfirea and his grandmother had already successfully replicated the red potion, and were now working on trying to develop a version using cheaper herbs and alchemical solutions.

During his visit to the Dark Elf Village, as Ain Bell Fior, Ainz used what little he learned from Nfirea to convince Chief Pharmacist Mango Gilena to take him on as an apprentice to learn his medicinal secrets. During his studies with the dark elf pharmacist, Ain maintained a [Gate] to Nfirea to query him on herbs that he learned from his master.

It’s revealed that Nfirea is working on a herb cultivation experiment, setting test beds through the Tob Forest

Abilities and Powers

Nfirea is seen as one of the best alchemists in E-Rantel. He is a 2nd Tier Magic Caster. His innate Talent allows him to equip and use any magical item regardless of restrictions. To better understand what that means, he can potentially use the Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown as if he was Momonga himself. For this reason, he is considered one of the most potentially dangerous people in the New World. However, his skill in alchemy and the great potential of his talent makes him one of Momonga's most valuable subjects.
Job Classes

Wizard: Level 3
Alchemist (Genius): Level 4
Pharmacist (Genius): Level 4
Doctor: Level 1
Active

Acid Arrow: A 2nd Tier spell that fires a bolt of caustic acid at the enemy.
Continual Light: A spell that is capable of summoning a magic light. The brightness of the magic light could be roughly adjusted to the caster's whim.
Hypnotism: A spell that hypnotizes a target.
Reinforce Armor: A spell that raises the target's defense.
Relationships

Enri Emmot

Before becoming her husband, Nfirea had romantic feelings for Enri, but couldn't admit them and was easily flustered when he was near her. In the past, he tried to comfort her upon finding out that her parents were killed. He was afraid of Enri falling in love with someone and became very jealous when she was with others because of it. He finally confessed to her during the 2nd Battle of Carne Village, and they became a couple after the fight and married not long after that. Unfortunately, Enri has a ridiculously strong sex drive and large amount of stamina; forcing poor Nfirea to down tons of stamina potions to stayisfy her.

Nemu Emmot

Nemu supported Nfirea when he tried to get along with Enri. After Nfirea and Enri became lovers, Nemu sometimes asks some awkward questions and enjoys their response with the goblins.

Lizzie Bareare

Both Nfirea and his grandmother are quite famous in E-Rantel for being well-known potion makers. He assists his grandmother in their workshop. She taught him everything she knows about alchemy and magic.

Ainz Ooal Gown

When he first met Ainz under the name Momon, his only interest was his red potion and wanted to know how to make it. After he found out that Momon is actually Ainz, Nfirea is thankful to him for saving Enri and Carne Village and apologizes to Ainz for deceiving him. He admires Ainz's strength and even asked to be a part of his adventurer group so that he can become strong just like him. For some reason, Nifirea is willing to speak openly about his intimate times with his wife to Ainz. In return Ainz respects Nifirea and ensures the safety of his family as Nifirea's potion research is a much needed aspect of understanding the New World.

Lupusregina Beta

Lupusregina Beta is the battle maid sent by Ainz to protect the village. She has a friendly relationship with Nfirea, however, this is all a farce and part of her sadistic and evil personality. She is the one responsible for delivering the alchemical items and apparatuses to the Bareares as well as commanding the stone golems. Nfirea is one of the four most important people in Carne Village that Lupusregina must protect and must ensure they remain alive at all costs.

Goblin Troop

The Goblin Troop trusts Nfirea and knows that he harbors feelings with Enri. They are supportive and believe that he can offer her happiness and assist in making Enri reciprocate those feelings

Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.




"It's wrong, it's wrong, it's wrong, it's wrong...my baby, my baby, my baby--! You, you, you, you, took, took, took, took, my baby, my baby, my baby, my baby--!"
- Nigredo's Introduction
Nigredo (ニグレド) is an NPC of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, she is the older sister of Albedo and Rubedo. Nigredo was imprisoned in the "Frozen Prison," situated on the 5th Floor of Nazarick and acted as an Area Guardian. She was released at the request of Yuri Alpha to help manage the new orphanage in E-Rantel.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Nigredo has an appearance similar to Albedo's, in the sense of hair, but the similarity ends there as her face has no skin, but rather, a mass of exposed muscle.

She has beautiful eyes and teeth, but there were no lips whatsoever, only beautiful pearly teeth. There are no eyelids, only brightly shining eyes. As such, her grotesque appearance horrified all the guild members of Ainz Ooal Gown, who all immediately attacked simultaneously upon seeing her.
Personality

Though she acts insane and attacks her visitors without mercy if a baby-doll isn't given to her, Nigredo is assumed to be tender-hearted under normal conditions. She and Pestonya opposed killing innocent people kidnapped from the Re-Estize Kingdom. In addition, Nigredo had a soft spot for babies, perhaps even surpassing that of Pestonya’s. However, her compassion is often limited to that of infants. Once they live past the age of two, she becomes mostly indifferent towards their well-being though she seem to have some care to children after being appointed in the Sorcerer Kingdom Orphanage. Despite this, Nigredo does not actively seek harm towards humans unlike most of the denizens of Nazarick, and is a generally compassionate individual.
Background

Nigredo was only the Area Guardian of the above-ground portion of the Frozen Prison.
Chronology

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
Ainz Ooal Gown visits her together with Albedo, requesting her to use her surveillance abilities on locating Shalltear Bloodfallen. After Ainz takes his leave, Nigredo, and Albedo bond, though it mostly involves Nigredo warning the Overseer about their younger sister, Rubedo.[2]

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom Arc
Nigredo was tasked with providing protection to the alley where the Pleiades members are situated in during their short meeting together. For the sake of ensuring the security of Demiurge's operation, Lupusregina Beta stated that the alley has been warded against spying by Nigredo.[3]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Due to his minions' hard-work, Ainz decides to let them request him any kind of reward they want. When Solution asks for a few humans, Ainz reminisces about the humans held captive from the Eight Fingers and the remaining humans being protected by Pestonya and Nigredo who are under confinement. He decides to give Solution the remaining Eight Fingers members and not use the latter ones because Pestonya and Nigredo risked going against his orders to save them.[4]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Due to her actions, Nigredo was confined in the Frozen Prison with Pestonya as her cellmate. Later, with permission from Ainz, Yuri Alpha secured their release to assist her in building a Sorcerer Kingdom sponsored orphanage.[5]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
Both Nigredo and Pestonya are released from confinement and are later put in charge of managing a new war orphanage in E-Rantel in order to help with integrating future generations to stay loyal to Nazarick.[6]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc
When Ainz and Narberal engaged in a conversation with Greluné the Undead Captain of Steel Valkyrie, the Pleiades declared to the elder lich that all undead belonged to her master. At that Ainz clarified that there were exceptions, like Nigredo, Shalltear and Yuri.[7]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
When Buser begged Ainz to spare his life, he refused as he stated Nigredo and Pestonya would been disgusted with Buser killing human children and wearing their skulls as trophies if he were allowed into his servitude before killing him.

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
When looking for candidates to run the intelligence agency that is being spearheaded by Demiurge, Albedo noted how her older sister Nigredo might be a decent choice. However, seeing that Nigredo was not an ally that Albedo could trust unconditionally, she starts to think otherwise about giving her the authority to manage it. According to Albedo, if Nigredo figures out her true intentions, she felt it was entirely possible for them to become enemies in the future.[8]

At some point before Ainz make his return back to Nazarick, Nigredo had requested her colleague Sebas to speak on her behest with their master which the butler obliged to do, considering she doesn't have permission to leave the area she was at. She and Pestonya wanted Sebas to have Ainz pay her a visit to the Frozen Prison alone where she was located in which their master agreed on doing after briefly discussing with the butler.

Once they are present, she began discussing with Ainz by offering a suggestion to her master that he should rent out more of his undead minions for agricultural purposes. She reasoned that by doing this, Nazarick would certainly have developments in the improvements of breeds of food. To back up her statement, she claims the food culture would surely blossom to the point that they can even produce food of an equal quality compared to Nazarick’s offering which Ainz approved of doing.

After the conversation shifted towards the main topic of discussion, she was the first before Pestonya to argue their cases to Ainz on why a large-scale massacre of the Re-Estize Kingdom needs to be avoided. Ainz however is adamant that the cull was deem necessary for the sake of strengthening the Sorcerer Kingdom and to make sure that human civilization could never grow too strong.

More so, he voices his concern of why Nigredo had not bother to contact her other superiors, the Floor Guardians instead of him. Seeing this, Nigredo who is an Area Guardian was viewed by Ainz to act detrimental towards Cocytus's authority as the Floor Guardian. According to Ainz, she was supposed to ask the Floor Guardian, Cocytus about this matter since she is part of his floor he manages under his rule. Although Nigredo offers her suggestions despite her position, none were convincing enough to make Ainz consider changing his decision about the massacre.

However, when Pestonya brought up the idea of letting humans escape alive as fearmongers through spreading the news of opposing the Sorcerer Kingdom to be hopeless, Ainz began considering it carefully. She along with Pestonya and Sebas were informed by their master that he will allow only 90% of the Re-Estize Kingdom's people to be wipe out while the rest will be allowed to live on. Once Ainz decides to take Pestonya's idea into consideration, she alongside the maid voice how eternally grateful they are to their master hearing them out.[9]

The Dinner Is All Nazarick Members Arc

Main article: The Dinner Is All Nazarick Members Arc
Nigredo attended a lavish meal prepared by the Head Chef. Those also in attendance were Clavu, Pestonya and Éclair. However when Éclair toasted for himself, she gave him a cold stare.
