Non-Canon: REMINDER! This page is considered as among one of the many pure game contents found exclusive in Mass for the Dead only. It includes the new standalone characters that had a first-time appearance in the game. Meanwhile, the old characters had a different role and fate than from the main storyline in the official books. For that reason, it has no connections to the canon story materials of Overlord Light Novel series. The content that you had read here are based on the Overlord mobile game.




"To say what its all for--- It is a dream to improve the quality of life level of human society using monsters!"
— Sophie's dream.
Sophie Noia (ゾフィ・ノイア女史) is a game original character that appeared in Mass for the Dead.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

A woman with heterochromia eyes, her left eye is blood red, while her right eye is pink. Sophie is a fair woman with dark purple hair and a scar over her left eye which she covers with a gold-rimmed monocle. She wears a white jacket with a hood, and an open chest top revealing her bosom. At her waist, she is equipped with a belt carrying various items, like test tubes and other instruments.
Personality

A confident young woman she appears to be somewhat crazed and perverted. She holds the belief that humanity can advance through the fruits of her research on monsters.
Background

In the empire, there was research on how to make skeletons do manual labor, but Sophie wishes to make an attempt in using other types of monsters. One specific type of monster that is of interest are slimes. According to her humanity has long coexisted with slime-types.

She recently became the newly selected High Disciple of Fluder. Though she became a researcher after the subject of her revenge died during the Catastrophe.
Chronology

Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
In the game, Sofie relocates to E-Rantel for her research on monsters. There she meets the protagonist and contracts his team to collect samples of the slimes in the city's sewers to discern why the monsters have gone aggressive.[1]

From her analysis she learns that the slimes have traces of alchemical solution, causing them to mutate. The magic caster brought her findings to Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra, who then called a meeting of the city's representatives and the members of the Tripartite Alliance. Suspicion fell on Hilma Cygnaeus, the executive of the Pharmacist's Guild, for illegally stealing the substance to mutate the slimes. It was later learned that the mutation was an accident caused by the rundown from the artificial herb project, in which the solution was permeated in the soil and washed into the sewers.

After the protagonist cleared out all the mutant slimes, Sophie was in doubt that they achieved this until she saw the slime core from the Super Giant Sanitary Slime.[2]

Sophie visited the secret laboratory where Nfirea Bareare was trying to cure the contaminated Gazef Stronoff. The magic caster suggested that perhaps they should move their subject to a more open area, however, she was ignored, thus they turned to reviewing their notes on their progress in finding a cure for the Miasma which did not seem to be a poison but rather a "curse" as those afflicted remained Contaminated Beasts even after they are revived from death. Sophie had very little interest in making a cure as her focus was on slimes, but praised her peer for the work he was doing, advising him to take better care of himself before leaving.

Sophie later bumps into Fluder Paradyne outside in the streets of E-Rantel. After they share a few words, she inquires about her senior's secret project and what prompted him to conceive of such an idea given his sole interest in magic. When the wizard states that it a result of the times. After he departs she wonders if that is the case. While she finds her master's work to be amusing she however decides to focus on her own slime project.[3]

Shortly before the protagonist was granted the title as Guardian of E-Rantel and transferred the administration rights of the city to the Sorcerer Kingdom, he recruited Sophie to become part of a new research team called the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute to study a broad field of subjects for the Alliance. The magic caster happily accepted the invitation, to further her research in slimes and their potential uses. Later she was out in the field, investigating the cause of why the slimes in the Melting Pot at the Quarry failed to melt all the Chaos Beasts that fell within. Upon studying the slimes' mucus samples, she made a startling discovery.[4]

Sophie was busy at the time of the protagonist's second visit to the institute as she was engrossed on her own discoveries in the laboratory and refrained from greeting her benefactor.[5]

Sophie having the need of a strong slime for her experiments complained to Nfirea to no end. Nfirea who heard of the protagonist’s interest in suitable fiber plants that could be harvested in the Tob Forests, agreed to provide the adventurer a list though afterwards Nfirea asked that suitable slime be captured and brought to the institute.[6]

The institute would be visited again at the dead of night by Darkness, after Clementine alerted the city officials of suspicious activity from the remnants of Zurrernorn. It was thought that the old base of the cult would be targeted, but Nfirea and Sophie confirmed that they received no visitors or intruders. Sophie was confident of her slime traps she laid around the facility and reported none had caught any prey.

Since the group came out of their way to check on the institute, the adventurers asked the researcher what project she was working on. Sophie revealed that her latest pet project was a drug that suppressed the predatory instincts of slimes that she developed so that her slime trap would yield living captives. It turns out the project was actually an older one from the Kingdom to address the eating habits of the sanitary slimes in E-Rantel.

The research of the "anti-slime" agent piqued the protagonist's interest as he managed to inductively come to the conclusion that Zurrernorn's latest scheme involved the slimes of the city sewers. Armed with this knowledge, the protagonist procured a sample of the agent and gave it to Soi who was sent to aid the members of Blue Roses in driving a Super Giant Sanitary Slime created by the death cult back into the sewers. More of the agent was produced through the efforts of Sophie and Nfirea after a plan was devised by the adventurers, Sunlight Scripture to cleanse the sewer of the abomination.[7]

Sophie was still tirelessly working to develop a cure for Gazef Stronoff, conducting various experiments with slimes and Chaos Beasts to produce the necessary decontamination effect that occurred in the Melting Pot. All experiments were met with failure, creating substances called Slime Special Chaos Beast Potage Soup. Though she was glad to be working with her former teacher Fluder Paradyne, even calling him master again despite being equals now.

There were concerns from the Sorcerer Kingdom on staff overworking themselves, leading to the protagonist to be sent to convince the researchers to take better care of themselves. Nfirea though warned that some researchers, like Sophie would rather not waste time taking breaks when they could be working to further their research.

An emergency investigation of the Great Lake needed to be conducted after reports of a strange alleged slime was spotted in the water. Sophie was deemed to be best suited for the field mission, given her specialty. Plus she was seen as the most unlikely person who would reveal too much about the kingdom's operation in the wetlands due to her political disinterest.

At first unwilling to participate, Sophie quickly accepted the task after hearing of the allege slime in the area, before passing out from exhaustion. The researcher was then carried to a carriage which she rode with the adventurers of Darkness to the site. There she donned one of Tsuibayaya's swimsuits to assist her in the waterside environment. Sophie was introduced to Mare who was waiting, and to do a thorough survey, brought out her two pet slimes Sunny and Tully. Shortly later she met with the lizardmen and after hearing how the local fish and lizardmen were feeling more energetic, she assessed that whatever was in the water was not harmful. She affirmed that the alleged slime was to blame and diluting the lake with whatever substance it was imbued with.

Using some slime food as bait and with the help of Mare in locating the slime, which turned out to be a Super Giant Sanitary Slime, it was brought out of hiding and killed. While Sophie wished to capture it for live study, she instead was more interested to learn from her peers that the giant slime may have been mutated after eating the Longevity Nut. She was miffed that Nfirea was aware of the item's existence but failed to inform her, as she wanted to conduct head to the Tob Forest to collect some. However she could not as the tree which bore them had not grown any new nuts and also she once again collapsed out of exhaustion.

When she was back at the institute, Sophie, not bothering to change her attire, pestered Nfirea to hand all his data and samples of the Longevity Nut, believing its secrets could bring answers to the Melting Pot conundrum. She was refused as the director believed the nut was better suited as a medicinal remedy which was needed currently as the children of E-Rantel were undergoing another flu. Sophie relented to the reason, after Nfirea agreed to include on the project as well as promised her she would get his material on the nut if no progress was made on the decontamination. Though she was sternly warned that the nut would not be used for creating any giant slimes. Sophie then resume her work, being allowed to keep her swimsuit as compensation for her services to the Sorcerer Kingdom in the investigation at the Great Lake.[8]

Some days before the protagonist and Slimeko would be heading out to lead a delegation to the Dwarf Kingdom, Sophie shared the results of her discovery to her colleagues at the Institute. The researcher discovered that the conditions in the Melting Pot, may have inadvertently developed a method by which the contaminated essence of creatures affected by the Miasma could be removed. When she informed the news to the protagonist, Sophie planned to experiment and try to replicate the Melting Pot to see if a cure for the Miasma could be synthesized.

While Soi stood guard at the Institute in the absence of the protagonist, Sophie worked with Fluder and Nfirea to figure out how to use the contaminated slimes and Chaos Beasts to create a cure. Their experiment to involved using contaminated slimes to melt a Chaos Beast, however the decontamination effect did not occur. Sophia hitting a wall on how to apply her knowledge, turned to Nfirea as he was an expert on Chaos Beasts. From what she could tell the slimes both normal and contaminated caused a reaction that decontaminated the traces of miasma when they melted the Chaos Beasts. But there were several inconsistencies that did not make sense, and Sophie she felt that they were missing something to make their theory work. Nfirea was the first to realize something, which Sophie noticed and begged the young director of the Institute to share his epiphany.[9]

When the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute came under attack from Chaos Beasts that were invading from several Cracks that appeared in the city, Sophie was bunkered down in the lowest level of the facilities resuming the experiment. She was joined by Nfirea who wanted to see the experiment through. Sophie was amused that the young man's determination was fueled by revenge, something which she ironically lost when the Incident happened though was able to find solace in her slime research. The imperial knights, Nimble Arc Dale Anoch and Leinas Rockbruise had arrived for their protection, their appearance caused Sophie be relieved that their work would be preserved, but it was fleeting as a Spear Chaos Beast teleported into the area, killing her, the researchers and the knights. Despite her death, Sophie's work on the cure for the contamination of the miasma proved to be successfully as it returned Gazef Stronoff to sanity.[10]

Some months after the attack on E-Rantel, Sophie was among the personnel of the Empire whose corpses were recovered and resurrected as courtesy of the Sorcerer Kingdom. During her brief encounter with death, Sophie finally made a breakthrough in the usage of Chaos Stones, using the items to enhance equipment, analogous to players use of Data Crystals. The research was later shared with the Sorcerer Kingdom which Demiurge, Pandora's Actor and the Chief Blacksmith and used to develop equipment that could be worn to allow users to safely enter the "other side" of the Crack for brief periods of time.[11] Said equipment that was the result of Sophie's research was first utilized to allow the Sorcerer Kingdom to launch a rescue mission to retrieve the missing members of the Pleiades.[12]

During the miasma crisis affecting E-Rantel, Sophie and her fellow researchers returned to the city to assist the beleaguered rescue team in decontaminating the surviving populace. Sophie revealed how she accidentally discovered the cure through examining the remnants of the Melting Pot and a plan was concocted by the group to save the infected.

Sophie, Fluder and Nfirea were noted to be insensitive on the issue of using human corpses to make a cure for the contamination. To Sophie the crisis was a perfect way to test her hypothesis and also believed that using the dead was perfectly fine as it reduced waste. This caused Slimeko to question if the trio were really humans to begin with. Sophie hinted about knowing the Sorcerer Kingdom's ulterior motives in the crisis but added that she dare not question the kingdom due to their backing.

Later when Enhela appeared and defeated Sebas, she expressed shock along with the other researchers. She and the others observed the dialogue between the priest and the Nazarick agents, and despite the ambiguity of the situation the alchemist was able to follow the story of hostility between the two parties.[13]

A month later the situation in E-Rantel had greatly improved. At the reconstructed Institute, Sophie greeted the protagonist with his team and informed him of their steady progress in decontaminating all the victims of the miasma. Sophie reported that while it'll take a while to decontaminate everyone who's been detained, she expressed her surprise on the progress so as as almost all the contaminated residents were cured.

Although she attributed their success to being the amount of fresh corpses. But the researcher clearly remembered that on that day of the upheaval, there more contaminated residents than ingredients for the cure. She wanted to ask where the protagonist was finding all the fresh corpses, but her question was in jest as she had no intention to pry into the protagonist's business. Additionally she promised not to say anything what she saw in regards to his interactions with Enhela on that, though warned if she suspicions then others would too eventually. Before the protagonist left, she was gifted a souvenir, an unique slime from the Sorcerer Kingdom, which the researcher accepted with glee.[14]

Around New Year's, the researcher was briefly mentioned by Hamsuke when she reflected to Narberal about the usefulness of the Longevity Nuts.[15]

During a discussion in Nazarick on the implementing the use of golems rather than undead for the security of E-Rantel. Mare recalled how thrilled Fluder had been upon seeing the undead march under orders in E-Rantel. The wizard was a bit madly engrossed by the sight that his apprentice Sophie had to drag him back to the research lab as it had been three hours.[16]

Abilities and Powers

The strongest of Fluder Paradyne's disciples, Sophie can use up to the 4th Tier Magic. While casting her magic, she also utilizes potions in her attacks. Additionally she has managed to tame two sanitary slimes to help her collect data on substances.
Active

Magic Boost (Medium): Increase the magic attack power of allies alone.
Viscous Species Special Effects: Damage increases for “viscous” seeds that deal magic damage to single enemies.
XXX Cage: Inflict magical damage from the "Darkness" element on a single enemy, making it paralyzed.
Darkness UP: Increases the attack power of the "Darkness" element.
Relationships

Slimeko

Due to her interest in the monster, she appears to have an unhealthy obsession with the Slime.

Saint Clementine

The two women are colleagues, as Clementine acts as a middle person for her transactions to acquire new samples for Sophia's research. Though Clementine finds her habits to be strange, and the researcher referring her as her senior, embarrassing the saint who sees Sophia as a good person.

Nfirea Bareare

Sophie seems to relish teasing Nfirea, especially noting his radically changed personality after Enri Emmot's death. When she comments him on his genius in his work, it is a mixture of praise and criticism. His now stoic and cold disposition interests her, and she openly states that its hard to believe that he is the "genius boy" she knew in the past.

Soi

Sophie appears to have an attraction towards the adventurer. At one point compliment on what beautiful skin she has. While such praise is nothing new to Soi due to her beauty, Sophie's interest in Soi appears to go deeper that just physical attraction. Oddly enough Soi does not appear to be disgusted, but rather intrigued by the attention.

Staffan Heivish (スタッファン ・ ヘーウィッシュ) was a patrol officer of Re-Estize and a former operative of the Eight Fingers syndicate.

Appearance

Staffan Heivish was a man with wide shoulders dressed in decent clothes. On his chest, he wears a heavy crest that shines with the glint of copper metal. The healthy complexion of his face is padded with blubber and he is remarkably very fat, perhaps due to his eating habits.
Personality

Staffan Heivish speaks with a high pitch tone and an air of superiority due to having the law on his side. He was also a closet sadist and a pervert who enjoys inflicting pain on others, especially beautiful women, feeling an intense ecstasy, but cowers in fear when he was on the receiving end. Morally speaking, he could be regarded as the lowest of scum, taking advantage of the helpless and regarding slavery as a good thing. He also has a warped sense of morality as after nearly murdering a slave for his fetish, he could not identify what he had done wrong.  
Background

Staffan was a man who enjoyed beating women before indulging his lust. The banning of slaves made sating his perversions difficult and he hates the Golden Princess for doing this.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom Arc
Staffan escorted Succulent to the residence of Sebas and Solution after interrogating the worker that betrayed them and allowed Sebas to take one of their slaves. They attempted to intimidate and force Sebas to pay a hefty fine for a false charge of slave trading.[1] After leaving, convinced that they succeeded in extorting the "frail old butler" Staffan returned to the brothel to indulge in his sexual desire, while Succulent, thinking that eliminating Sebas would allow them to manipulate his master, perhaps even turning her into a high-priced slave/hooker, assigned assassins to kill him. Unfortunately, the duo of criminals were poorly mistaken; they did not extort a "rich butler," but instead enraged a monstrosity they have no business picking a fight with. Angered, Sebas raids Succulent and Staffan's brothel alongside Climb and Brain Unglaus and promptly killed several of the Assassins targeting him in one blow on the way while Climb and Brain Unglaus took down the rest.

Once Sebas enters the brothel, he makes a beeline towards Staffan and single-handedly kills or mortally cripples all of the guards standing in his way. When the raid occurred, Staffan was indulging himself by torturing and inflicting brutal punches on a defenseless woman, completely unaware that the "butler" he tried to extort is walking towards him. Staffan was just about to rape her near lifeless body when he was interrupted by Sebas entering the room. After witnessing the grotesque horror inflicted by Staffan, he began to gruesomely kill the pathetic man by slowly slapping him to death.

Despite his shouts for help, Staffan was told by Sebas that none will come since they were all either dead or unconscious with their legs and arms broken. After being told that he was a prime example of "someone who doesn't deserve to live", Sebas gave him a final blow to the stomach which ruptured his organs. Staffan was left alone to die in his final moments in agony from internal-bleeding.[2]

Abilities and Powers

As a patrol officer, Staffan is a civil servant tasked with keeping public order in the city. While so, he commands numerous guardsmen in order to accomplish his duties. Thanks to his position as a civil servant, Staffan is able to use his connections to cover for Eight Fingers and their nefarious schemes. He is otherwise an ordinary man with no combat value on his own and falls completely flat in front of individuals who do not care about his political authority.
Relationships

Succulent

He worked together with Succulent in an attempt to intimidate and force Sebas to pay a hefty fine for a false charge of slave trading.

Sebas Tian

He underestimated Sebas Tian and tried to his power to get Tuare back. However this became fear when he was at his mercy to be killed. Sebas saw him first human disgusting in new world.

Solution Epsilon

He saw Solution as a future slave and plaything when he eliminates Sebas, he even sadistically joked about her taking Tuare's place if she too weak to do the job until Tuare recovers

Succulent (サキュロント) was a member of Six Arms, the security department of the criminal organization Eight Fingers.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Succulent wears black clothing, and has skin so pale, it looks like it has never been exposed to sunlight. He has sharp eyes and gaunt cheeks, making him look like a bird of prey that scavenges ravaged and rotting carcasses.

Succulent appears to have a long scar that runs from his right cheek to his chin.
Personality

Succulent was serious about his job and didn't like anything getting in his way. He was also prideful about the fact that he was a member of Six Arms.
Background

A member of Six Arms, Succulent poses as a representative at a brothel owned by Cocco Doll.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Overlord II EP07 126
Succulent and Staffan blackmailing Sebas Tian
Succulent and Staffan Heivish head to the residence of Sebas and Solution, where they attempt to intimidate and force Sebas to pay a hefty fine for a false charge of slave trading. In actuality, the two criminals unknowingly enraged a monstrosity they have no business picking a fight with and indirectly kickstarted a series of events leading to the demise of the Eight Fingers that they worked for in the hands of Nazarick. After leaving, he thinks of a plan to eliminate the "butler" and hired assassins to try killing him, only for the "butler" to effortlessly defeat one group of the assassins while Climb and Brain Unglaus took care of the rest. [1]

Overlord II EP09 102
Succulent Arrested
While guarding Cocco Doll, he encounters Climb at the secret exit of the brothel and fights him. He defeats Climb and prepares to finish him off and take his head back to Cocco Doll. At this moment, Brain Unglaus shows up and saves Climb, and introduces himself. Succulent attempts to persuade Brain to join the Six Arms, but is turned down. He faces Brain but is easily defeated. Afterwards, he and Cocco Doll are captured and sent to the authorities.[2]

Unfortunately, Succulent's cohorts bribed the officials to release him. He posed as Tuare when Climb, Brain and Lockmeier raided Six Arms' base. Climb would, this time with Lockmeier's aid, fight Succulent again during the raid. Due to Succulent being denied his usual equipment and being forced to wear a maid's outfit while Climb was fully equipped in addition to having Lockmeier's support, Succelent was slain with a sword strike by Climb to his head, and the battle ended in Climb's victory.[3]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
After Eight Fingers collapse, Succulent found himself without a job and switched his talents as a worker. At a bar with Six Arms, they were approached by Hilma who invited Six Arms to work at E-Rantel her using her new position at the Pharmacist's Guild. Zero not wanting to be in debt to her refused. Zero intended to build a new organization with his comrades in Six Arms. Succulent became the head of the drug trade in Zero's nascent criminal empire. Unlike the others Succulent was mostly absent during the executive meetings to establish new routes to peddle drugs.

The criminal empire started slow but was gaining momentum however he and his comrades lost and their noble backers as the Kingdom was cracking down on all illegal activities as part of their concessions to the new Tripartite Alliance. Though this set Six Arms back, Succulent having returned from his journey, brought news of the large amount of goods being transferred to the city of E-Rantel. The information opened a new opportunity to head to E-Rantel as it was apparent that the border city was becoming the new center of the world.[4] Later in order to destabilize the Tripartite Alliance, Zero made a deal with Zurrernorn to complete their Death Spiral ritual. The criminal kept his comrades in Six Arms out of the loop of the plan, but they followed his direction and worked with him to guard the site of the ritual thinking it was just a normal job. In the ensuing chaos, Davernoch was killed and Zero escaped, leaving Succulent and the others to be arrested for the incident by Blue Roses and their allies.[5]

Once Zero defected to the Baharuth Empire, he gained amnesty for himself and by extension his comrades, allowing the surviving members of Six Arms to be acquitted of their crimes. They acted as a unit to train and lead a group of workers to fight against a horde of Chaos Beasts that were heading towards E-Rantel. Zero was ordered by the emperor to lead the monsters into the Quarry where the imperial knights would box the Chaos Beasts and eliminate them. Zero followed his orders to the letter but when the reinforcements came, he expected them to join in the fray. They did not and Zero suspected something was off. He then called his comrades to get off the quarry floor. That action saved their lives as the quarry floor was broken apart by a mechanism activated by the knights, causing the workers and Chaos Beasts to fall into the Melting Pot. The trap dissolved everyone that fell into the pit killing them. Zero friends who survived the trap watched in horror at the lengths of which the Bloody Emperor would use to achieve victory. On the contrary Zero praised the action as the best method worthy of a leader.[6]

Shortly after the massacre of the workers, Succulent had apparently left Six Arms to go off on his own, forcing Zero to seek a replacement.[7] Shizuni heard from Zero that Succulent went to work for the nobles of the Re-Estize Kingdom, but that was all. Later it was discovered that the former Six Arms member was operating a illegal gambling den at the outskirts of the Kingdom.

His establishment was funded by a noble that allowed him to use a mansion as a venue and due to all the illegal gambling dens being crushed in E-Rantel, his gambling den flourished and operated uncontested to the point that it was an open secret in the town it was based it. His establishment not only carter to betting and games, but also several blood sports such as rat killing and utilized slot machines. It also served as a cover for his smuggling and drug trading venture where he operated a black dust market.

Succulent wanting to gain more influence and respect in the underworld, used his illusion skills to make himself appear as Zero, since his old boss evoked a fiercer reputation than his. Under the guise of Zero he took credit for many feats of the protagonist, including attributing the retreat of Jaldabaoth to himself.

While it did give him the notoriety he wanted, Succulent's gambling den was often visited by dojo stormers seeking to prove themselves. Unwilling to show himself lest the story came out that he was fraud, Succulent relied on his escorts at the den to keep such people out. To maintain his boss image, he sequestered himself in an underground basement on the property of the den and only allowed his executives to visit him once a month to deliver reports on the operation, which he called "harvest".

Due to rumors about the den reaching Clementine, it was reported to Soi who reported it to Momonga who then authorized an investigation of the den as there was an interest in the suspect slot machines being evidence of a player. Soi coordinated with Shizuni and Ku to infiltrate the establishment and locate the boss. Once his hideout was located and his illusion was dropped, Succulent was defeated by the three women. As for his fate, due to him being an inconvenience to Lupusregina Beta and CZ2128 Delta's worker identities in New Six Arms, Momonga decided to have him imprisoned in the Frozen Prison. It was believed that the human could provide the Sorcerer Kingdom with valuable information on the underworld.[8]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

He fights by combining swordplay with illusion spells. Due to this twin specialization, he is actually below Climb in terms of fighting power and was the weakest of the Six Arms. In fact, other members of Six Arms actually tend to mock him for his lower strength and combat capability.
Job Classes

Fencer
Illusionist
Main Equipment

Cat's Elegance (Chainmail shirt)
Spear-blocking Hood
Ring of Energy Boost
Illusion Spells/Skills

Fox Sleep: An illusion spell that activates after being injured, tricking the target into thinking the user is out of commission.
Ghost Sound: Produces sounds that can confuse or mislead people.
Multiple Vision: Succulent can make illusionary copies of himself.
Scintillating Scotoma: Creates a blind spot which flickers and wavers between light and dark in an opponent's vision.
Relationships

Zero

As Succulent's boss, Zero was the one that ordered him to act as a bodyguard for Cocco Doll. Zero also seems to look down on Succulent's fighting power, considering his illusions to be nothing but petty tricks that may work against lower-level opponents but not against stronger ones.

Climb

Climb and Succulent fought each other when he along with Sebas and Brain raided the Brothel. He managed to defeat Climb using his illusion skills but not before suffering serious wounds. Later they fought again, and Climb was finally able to beat him.

Sukyu Juju (スーキュ・ジュジュ) is one the five chieftains of the five lizardmen tribes, whom fought against the first undead army, and was amongst the few surviving lizardmen whom fought against Cocytus.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Sukyu Juju is a petite lizardmen comparable to other lizardmen, but his limbs were as strong as steel. In the Manga and Anime, he constantly has his tongue sticking out. Unlike the other lizardmen he has a crest that runs down the back of his neck.
Personality

Sukyu is very blunt in his responses. It also appears he is less knowledgeable on land-swelling creatures, and very unfamiliar with humans given his ignorance on identifying skeletons of them. However he favors immediate action in battle
Background

During the fight to decide the position of chieftain, Sukyu Juju settled each of his matches with just one precise rock throw.
Chronology

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Sukyu Juju was part of the meeting that decided how the Lizardmen Alliance would fight their enemy.[1][2] It was decided that he would form a garrison alongside Kyuku Zuzu and Shasuryu Shasha. During the battle, they stayed in the village in order to defend it against any attackers that got through their forces.[3]

Overlord II EP05 072
Impaled by Cocytus's Attack.
A few days later, after the Alliance defeated the army of the Supreme One, another stronger army appeared outside the vicinity of the village. He declared it was impossible as their scouts reported no movements of any kind in the Great Lake.[4][5]

When Shasuryu and Zaryusu returned with Ainz Ooal Gown's ultimatum. Their options exhausted and knowing that they had almost no chance of winning, the chiefs agreed that they still must at least challenge Cocytus. The lizardman pick out the fifty most elite warriors among the lizardmen and then go to fight against him. Sukyu was one of the few not affected by Cocytus' passive skill. He attacked Cocytus, using his sling but was they were ineffective. When he tried again he was deemed annoying by the Floor Guardian and was killed by his [Piercing Icicle].[6][7]

Abilities and Powers

Originally from the hunter group, Sukyu Juju's ranged attack skill is the best among all lizardmen in the vicinity of the Great Lake. Sukyu Juju is the lizardman with the best guerrilla tactics.
Main Equipment

Sling: In the Anime it is depicted that the chieftain carries a sling.
Relationships

Shasuryu Shasha

Sukyu appears to trust the chieftain of Green Claw, enough to lead the Lizardman Alliance, and also is familiar with the latter's nonverbal cues as when he asked Shasuryu if it was possible to parley with the Supreme Being, all it took was a look on Shasuryu's face to comprehend the dire situation.

Tabula Smaragdina (タブラ・スマラグディナ) is a guild member of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as one of the Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creator of Albedo, Nigredo, and Rubedo.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Tabula's appearance is that of a humanoid with a head resembling that of a distorted squid. He wears a shiny, form-fitting black leather outfit studded with silver jewelry and several belts wrapped around it. His black cape was also closed in front of it as if to conceal its body.

While so, the right side of his head was shown to be half-covered in twisted, tattooed letters. He has two cloudy pupil-less, blue-white eyes as well as six twitching tentacles that are sprouted from his mouth dangled down to his thighs.

His skin was like that of a corpse, with purple blotches amidst a ghastly white color. He was covered in some sort of sticky slime that gave off a bizarre sheen. Additionally, webs of skin grew between the long digits of his four-fingered hands.
Personality

Tabula Smaragdina has a strong personality, in various ways. During normal discussions, he would speak coherently as a rational man. However, as the talk became more in-depth, various parts of his true nature that are hard to associate with would begin to surface. Tabula was the kind of setting maniac who produced extremely long design documents for his creations upon writing them.

Tabula has two passions in life: "gap moe," which is the cute contradiction between the actions of someone and his or her usual character, and horror films, of which he has extensive knowledge, from the classics to the latest, that surprised even his fellow guild members. He was described to always talk about things none of his friends are able to understand clearly. He was highly perceptive to recognize the name such as Nazarick to not have any correlation to mythology, Latin, or Greek. Tabula seems to also know how not all names in the DMMORPG, YGGDRASIL are from mythology or based on it.

In addition to that, he was said to have somewhat of a bizarre fascination for the occult. It even went as far as to drive him into naming his three NPC creations after alchemic ingredients. He is analytical to the point where Ainz seems to acknowledge that Tabula is the one person in the guild with the most knowledge about the occult books and that it influences his naming sense during the making of a guild NPC. For instance, Ainz had once acquired some brief information about runes from Tabula during past conversations they shared together.
Background

Tabula Smaragdina Embelm
Tabula Smaragdina's Emblem
Tabula Smaragdina attended the weekly clan meeting for Nine's Own Goal. He was intrigued by Nishikienrai's news of an unexplored dungeon and was surprised that it was located in the Grenbera Swamp as many did an aerial reconnaissance of the place and found nothing. He hypothesized that the Great Tomb of Nazarick could only be found on foot. After the Clan was to be reorganized as a Guild, Momonga was also designated as Guildmaster. Tabula conferred with Punitto Moe and Bellriver, each sending emails to Momonga stating that no one else was suitable, else the Guild would tear itself apart. Once Momonga accepted, the clan members attempted to create a new name. Tabula suggested the idea of naming their new guild to be Knights Templar, however, it was rejected like many others until the name Ainz Ooal Gown was chosen.[2]

Later on, Tabula joined his guildmates in an expedition to the Great Tomb of Nazarick. While in the marching as a rearguard in the swamp, he attempted to discern where the name Nazarick originated in human mythology but was unable to come to an answer. At the doorstep of the tomb, he was hesitant to divide their group into parties, wanting to wait until they got deeper into the tomb. The guild then by majority vote agreed to Tabula's suggestion and continued on. Tabula turned out to be correct as it was discovered that the tomb is a simultaneous attack dungeon. At that point, he was assigned to a team and entered the depths of the tomb.

Tabula and his group managed to make it to the last level where they waited for Momonga's groups after they successfully killed the Asura. Tabula celebrated with his Guild at the conquest and the acquisition of the Great Tomb of Nazarick as they took a photo of their victory.[3]

As a member of Ainz Ooal Gown, he was one of the intellectual elites in the guild. According to Momonga, Tabula Smaragdina was quite versed in the knowledge of occult lore. Additionally, he has a love for gap moe and watching horror movies. Based on his knowledge and taste, he would use it to help him with the creation of his own NPCs. His creations Albedo and Nigredo embodied respectively these two hobbies. Tabula Smaragdina have also apparently collected the manuscript of copyright-expired works from the real world and convert them over into YGGDRASIL book format. Tabula often tends to store these materials in the library of Ashurbanipal in the Great Tomb of Nazarick on the 10th Floor.

On the other hand, Tabula had a hand in designing about 20% of the smaller mechanisms throughout the Great Tomb of Nazarick. His abnormally intricate designs consumed much of Nazarick's free data capacity, which caused the other members to complain about being unable to indulge themselves. Thus, he took responsibility for his actions and paid for many cash items to expand said data capacity.

Among such creations was Photo Studio Tabula, which he made for Bukubukuchagama after he learned about her hobby of photography.[4] And also the Beauty Parlor at her request to recreate a scene from an old romance movie.[5] In addition the Frozen Prison on the 5th Floor was a result of his designs.[6]

At one point he assisted Touch Me, Luci★Fer, Momonga in opening a secret door after solving a puzzle of the Sefirot. Although he was frustrated that his friends had no idea what the Sefirot was and tried to lecture them on it.[7]
Chronology

The Undead King Arc

Main article: The Undead King Arc

Prior to YGGDRASIL's silent shutdown at the end of the game, Momonga recalls all the good times the members of the Ainz Ooal Gown including Tabula Smaragdina. In the lamentation of his fellow guildmates' departure a few minutes before him, the Great Tomb of Nazarick and all of its NPCs were transported to the New World.

At the same time, Ainz learned that his NPC, Albedo is equipped with a World Item without permission, suspecting that it was Tabula who gave it to her. In the end, Momonga felt that he should respect the wishes of his comrade who had given such an item to Albedo, and so he did not take further action.[8]

When Ainz says that he feels bad for altering Albedo’s setting and tarnishing Tabula’s creation, Albedo only replies that Tabula would definitely give his blessing with the feelings of seeing his daughter off to marriage.[9]

The Emissary of the King Arc

Main article: The Emissary of the King Arc
Upon realizing that Albedo did not have appropriate quarters which was her room, Ainz became apologetic about it. He also believed the blame lies with Tabula for not preparing one for Albedo in the first place since he is the one who created her. In the end, he did not blame Tabula due to their sudden transportation into the New World, expecting him to account for this possibility and design a room for her would have been too much even for his obsessive-compulsive disorder. Ainz even noted although Tabula Smaragdina was a setting maniac who produced extremely long design documents for his creations, he presumed that his friend's imagination was probably within normal parameters.

On the other hand, Albedo is willing to let Ainz see the items her creator Tabula imparted to her through an unknown bag. Since Tabula Smaragdina was a fan of horror movies, Ainz did not know what he would expect to find inside the bag he gave to Albedo. For that reason, Ainz had a mix of fear and curiosity which piqued his interest to keep searching the content inside, hoping it to be special rare items. However, one of those items Ainz discovered from Albedo's bag was nothing but her underwear that he mistakenly thought to be a handkerchief.[10]

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Recalling the fact of how he had tamper Albedo's character setting, Ainz can't help but ponder what would his friend Tabula Smaragdina think about what the former had done.[11]

The Bloody Valkyrie Arc

Main article: The Bloody Valkyrie Arc
When Ainz and Albedo visit Nigredo in the Frozen Prison, he is impressed by Tabula’s work, as his guild member manually placed many Carrion Babies there. Ainz wonders how much money Tabula must have spent in the end, as he configured many monsters.[12]

Ainz reminisces about Tabula one more time when he enters the Treasury, saying he was a perfectionist. He reminds us that Tabula was one of the people responsible for designing Ainz Ooal Gown’s mechanisms. He also remembers that he wasn’t a bad person and had a strong personality, in various ways.

Upon meeting Pandora's Actor unknowingly for the first time, Albedo mistakes the Doppelgänger for her creator Tabula Smaragdina. However, she shortly retracts her words and questions the unknown NPC who it was in disguise. Albedo declares to the impostor that even if it takes on the form of Tabula, she would not easily mistake her own creator for anyone else.[13]

The Show Must Go On! Arc

Main article: The Show Must Go On! Arc
For the sake of building a theatre play in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Albedo obtained a script about "Romeo and Juliet" in the library, Ashurbanipal to help her on the way. According to Albedo, the script seems to have been brought over from the World of 2138 which Ainz used to reside in originally. Upon learning of this piece of information from Albedo, Ainz realized that such a script found in Nazarick's library had to be one of Tabula's doing bringing it there without him noticing until now. In the end, Ainz noted that Tabula was always the kind of detail maniac to have done something like that.[14]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invader's of The Large Tomb Arc
When Albedo considers forming a secret unit in search for the remaining Supreme Beings, she suggests to Ainz the conditions for doing so mean keeping the subject a top-notch secret from the other Floor Guardians. Hence, Ainz inquires Albedo whether she can behave accordingly if Tabula was found to which the latter believes that it won't be a problem as someone holds the position of Overseer.[15]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
When Albedo told Ainz about a remedy that is effective against illness, the latter begins to wonder whether this knowledge she knows of came from Tabula Smaragdina who programmed her. In the end, the remedy was said to be a kiss suggested by Albedo. When Albedo implores Ainz to give her a kiss as a remedy, he felt it was wrong to ignore the wishes of Tabula Smaragdina’s daughter and as a result, kissed the Overseer on her cheek.

After Ainz gave the Book of the Dead to Fluder Paradyne, he showed him some page of its lore and then mentions his guild member, Tabula. In particular, Ainz thought that if Tabula was present with them right now, he would be able to explain the meaning behind this book's lore to Fluder.[16]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
When Ainz shared with Gondo Firebeard what he knew about runes, most of the things he mentioned were what he learned from his friend Tabula. However, Ainz had forgotten many things from what he learned from Tabula.[17]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
For the sake of repaying Tabula's kindness along with Ankoro Mocchi Mochi, Ainz has chosen to utilize that as a reason for considering Pestonya's suggestion of sparing some humans alive from the Re-Estize Kingdom.[18]

Abilities and Powers

In terms of pure destructive power, Tabula is a stronger magic caster than Momonga.
Main Equipment

Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown: It allows the user to freely teleport between every room inside Nazarick. Every member of Ainz Ooal Gown was required to wear this ring.
Relationships

Momonga

Tabula would constantly feed Momonga useless trivia on mythology. Tabula thought that if anyone but Momonga became the Guildmaster of Ainz Ooal Gown, the guild would surely tear itself apart. Therefore, he even considered the idea of joining a different guild with Momonga.

Punitto Moe

Tabula and Punitto Moe shared the same opinion that if someone other than Momonga became the Guildmaster of Ainz Ooal Gown, the guild would surely tear itself apart. Therefore, they wanted to join a different guild with Momonga.

Bellriver

Tabula seems to get along well with Bellriver as the two agreed that if someone other than Momonga became the Guildmaster of Ainz Ooal Gown, the guild would soon fall apart. Reasonably so, they are hoping to join a different guild in the event that Momonga were to ever leave Ainz Ooal Gown.

Touch Me

Tabula considered naming the guild, Knights Templar based on how he viewed Touch Me. He describes Touch Me to be the kind of person who was a lot like Hugues de Payens.

Albedo

Tabula is the creator of Albedo and her sisters. Thus, he commands the most respect and loyalty from Albedo than all the other guild members, except for Momonga who altered her settings to be in love with him as a joke. He put great detail in her setting, however, neglected to provide her own quarters. In addition, Tabula gave Albedo a limited amount of styles of clothing for her wardrobe, though he did provide her with numerous sets of lingerie to wear.

Nigredo

Tabula is Nigredo's creator thus he commands the most respect and loyalty from Nigredo than all the other guild members.

Rubedo

Tabula is Rubedo's creator thus he commands the most respect and loyalty from Rubedo than all the other guild members.

Luci★Fer

Luci★Fer admired Tabula's work, such as Nigredo, which inspired him to create a golem that would chase people similar in the way to the NPC

Tia (ティア) is an adamantite ranked adventurer and a member of Blue Roses. She is also the triplet sister of Tina and Tira.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Tia has a slender figure with fair skin, coral eyes, and blond hair that is tied in a ponytail with a blue string.

Her kunoichi outfit consists of a black half-breastplate over a sleeveless mesh bodysuit, a black and blue striped headband, light orange scarf with blue flower pattern, black arm gloves with metal bracers, a light orange hakama pants, and black boots with metal plate around the shin and instep.

When not on duty, she wears a simple dark-colored yukata tied with a blue obi and a long yellow scarf that falls to her sheen.
Personality

Raised as an assassin, she is cold, professional, and the loss of human life almost never affects her emotionally. However, after joining Lakyus, she gradually developed feelings for her fellow members of Blue Roses.
Background

Both she and her sister were raised in the art of assassination and never trusted anyone but themselves. Before joining Blue Roses, Tia and her sister are believed to have originally hailed from the Baharuth Empire when they were still assassins of Ijaniya. They were once tasked to assassinate Lakyus. However, they failed as she had proved herself more than an easy target. After tailing Lakyus in an attempt to discover and exploit any weakness of hers that they could utilize to execute their assassination, they eventually decided during this time that the life of an adventurer suited them better.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Together with Tina, the stealthy pair raid a drug production village belonging to Eight Fingers. After a thorough cleanup of the facility, the two set fire to the fields that were being used to grow the drug beforehand, razing the facility to the ground and removing any trace of the Blue Roses' involvement with its destruction. During their infiltration, the pair retrieve several documents which they had deem to be the only items of importance for their Mission. After this, they return to the other members of Blue Rose and leave the vicinity soon afterward.[1]

Later on, she partners with both Gagaran and Evileye in order to defeat Entoma. As a result of their strong team cooperation, they nearly succeed in killing her. However, this is stopped by the arrival of Jaldabaoth, who managed to save Entoma before the three of them could deal the finishing blow. After Evileye orders her and Gagaran to flee, she is killed along with Gagaran by Jaldabaoth's Hellfire Wall.[2]

Later, Tia and Gagaran are revived by Lakyus. Despite the drain in their strength, they still resolve to join the fight against the demon army attacking the Re-Estize Kingdom.[3] After the attack is over, Tia is present along with the other Blue Rose Members to bid farewell to Momon after the whole crisis had passed.[4]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
In a conversation between Renner and Blue Roses, it is revealed that Lakyus is helping Gagaran and Tia to recover the experience they lost when they got killed by Jaldabaoth by constantly placing themselves in danger.[5]

The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Paladin of the Holy Kingdom Arc
The twins are present at the meeting with delegates from the Roble Holy Kingdom along with the other members of Blue Roses, where they ask for Neia's name after noticing that she doesn't have the body of a warrior. Because of their mischievous nature, both she and Tina resort to making jokes regarding Gagaran's unique huge physique by comparing it to Neia Baraja. It's unclear who did it, but Evileye signals to one of the twins to examine the small pouch of money handed over to them by the envoy Gustav. It is their job to check and see if the small pouch actually contains the expected amount by throwing it up and catching it to feel the weight sensationally.

When Evileye draws the identity of Jaldabaoth on paper to Remedios, it is either one of the twins who snatches back the former's drawing and tears it in half. While Evileye is furious and distracted about what one of them did, the other twin takes the chance to snatch away the pen and draw swiftly on a new piece of paper. One of the twins then shows Evileye their finished drawing of Jaldabaoth, which is of far greater quality than the picture drawn by their companion. The twins and Evileye cease their feuding concerning the drawing of Jaldabaoth and turn back towards Remedios after the paladin confirms that was the demon they fought against in the Holy Kingdom.[6]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Before opening the doors to the inn where the secret meeting arranged between Blue Roses, Red Drop, and their unknown client is being held at, Tia and her sister tap their leader twice on her waist to signal for her to be on alert as they have noticed something. After entering the secret meeting room and seeing that Evileye has done the job of taking out the two women who were with Azuth Aindra, she decides to give the vampire a rough explanation of the methods for how women weaponize their femininity, which her colleague instead ignores and speaks to Lakyus instead. Upon noticing the presence of their clients, she calls out to her boss to indicate that their clients have finally arrived to their meeting.

When the 10th Seat of the Black Scripture reveals his hidden presence to them, Tia and Tina are the first to be left utterly shocked by how the assassin appeared out of nowhere unnoticed by them. As a result, she and her twin immediately draw their weapon out of caution due to the fact that a new guest has suddenly appeared before them, acknowledging the latter to be an assassin who is far stronger than them.[7]

Later, when the capital Re-Estize is already surrounded by the Sorcerer Kingdom's forces, Tia and the rest of the members from Blue Roses meet up with Renner, Climb, and Brain in the palace. Once Evileye suggests to Lakyus that they have enough time to drink some tea together, Tia follows along with her ploy. Tia decides to steep and pour a cup of tea for Lakyus while the latter talks with Renner. Tia tells Lakyus that the tea will be richer than she could dream of, causing the latter to believe that they are really looking forward to drinking Renner's tea out of kindness for the princess who offered it to them.

After pouring five servings of tea, Tia swings the Warm Bottle around as if to emphasize the fact that it is empty. Tia then signals to Tina to drag Brain Unglaus out of the room for the time being as Evileye and Gagaran will take care of the rest until she returns. Leaving Brain to Tina to take care of, Tia heads back to the room alone with the Warm Bottle. She reasons with Lakyus that Tina and Brain are looking for desserts to pair with the tea.

Upon seeing her leader drink the tea and the drug effect finally kick in, she and Gagaran immediately spring into action and start repeatedly throwing heavy jabs at the defenseless Lakyus without any equipment to protect herself. While Lakyus is weakened by whatever effect the drug has on her and before getting the chance to use magic, Tia and Gagaran continue hitting her simultaneously until the latter is weak and injured enough to be affected by Evileye's spell, [Charm Person]. To make this happen, Tia impales Lakyus with a few spiky needles after the air is knocked out of the latter, rendering Lakyus unable to breathe.

Tia admits that she had been making careful observations for quite a while now, looking for ways to neutralize Lakyus. She mutters to Lakyus that normal methods would be resisted by the latter, so a combination of magic and poison would have to be used altogether against her to ensure she is in a weakened state. Tia doubts that someone like Lakyus would even be capable of resisting the effect of multiple poisons simultaneously. When she finally does her job, Tia leaves it to Evileye to finish her off with the [Charm Person] spell so that they can carry out their escape plan without being opposed by their leader.

After Lakyus falls under Evileye's mind-control and starts healing herself, Tia is instructed by Evileye to not do anything rash that may ruin their plan. Hence, Tia decides not to pull out the needles she had impaled inside her leader's body due to the likelihood that the pain of taking it out would result in dispelling the mind-control spell and causing Lakyus to turn hostile. Once Lakyus is fully healed and removes the needles herself, Tia and the other members await Tina's return to the room. After Tina comes back, Tia and the rest of Blue Roses depart with their leader to go and retrieve her equipment in the inn before teleporting away from the Royal Capital.[8]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Tia was seen with Gagaran at a dining together at a local pub in the Royal Capital. When Gagaran spots Zero and Peshurian pass and inquires who the are to the assassin, Tia explains that they were former members of Eight Fingers. Tough their past was shady, Tia noted the good that the former criminals have done since the Catastrophe, commenting they may have reformed like herself.[9]

When there was a string of thefts among the refugees coming into the capital, Lakyus had Tia and her sister Tina investigate the issue from behind the scenes.[10] Tia was absent with her sister when Princess Renner had a meeting with Lakyus and Gagaran. Lakyus when asked on their whereabouts replied that they were doing research.[11] They later joined the meeting at the palace just when Gagaran left to get a drink from the city. Once the meeting was over, all of Blue Roses regrouped together so that Lakyus could inform the women of their new task from the Kingdom, which was to reclaim a mine infested with monsters.[12]

At the mine Tia's team were supported by other adventurers to do the monster extermination. Among them was the protagonist and Surako. Most of the adventurers they brought were killed by the monsters and also demons that were introduced into the mine, by a cult. Rather than retreat, Tia and her friends pressed forward and finally got to the deepest part of the mine and faced the Abyss Demon. After Lakyus dealt a grievous wound on the demon, the mine began filling with poisonous gas forcing the adventurers to retreat. In the end the recovery of the mine failed, but Blue Roses took comfort in having destroyed a demon nest.[13]

At E-Rantel, Tia's team assisted in an investigation of the missing refugees in E-Rantel. The assassin worked with her sister to collect information on those that vanished. Their investigation was joined by the protagonist and Surako, and a new adventurer named Soi who surprised Tia and her sister when the other woman was able to detect them. Tia particularly takes a liking to Soi and is paired up with her for the mission. The adventurers catch their first suspect, thanks to supposedly Soi who launched a needle projectile at him preventing the suspect from taking his life. The skill impresses Tia and she tries to flirt with her junior, only to be taken away by Lakyus so that they can interrogate the prisoner. The information leads the investigation to the E-Rantel's Cemetery, where they discover Six Arms to be working with Zurrernorn to complete their Death Spiral. Tia and her twin fought against Succulent and Peshurian. Once all the members of Six Arms were defeated, only Khajiit Dale Badantel was left and was about to initiate the ritual, until he is struck with a needle projectile and is killed. Tia buys Soi's claim that she threw the weapon at the cultist.[14]

Later when the summit of the Tripartite Alliance took place in E-Rantel, Tia worked with her team to locate Zero who had escaped arrest. The adventurers also witness a growing mob demanding entry into the inner city, which was closed for the Alliance's venue, and help to act as crowd until the people calmed down. However the crowd was broken up when news of a horde of Chaos Beasts approaching the city disseminated. Tia joined in the defense of the city to protect the residents whilst the protagonist and his team engaged the leader of the horde.[15]

On another mission for the royal family to pick up armors from a dwarf blacksmith at a seaside village, Tia and her team reunited with the protagonist's team and his companion Narberal Gamma. They were unable to locate the dwarf, Tsuibayaya, at the village, but followed his whereabouts to the cove, saving him from being eaten by some Giant Crustaceans. As he was on a mission of his own and thus unable to give the armors just yet, he allowed the adventurers to locate the Legendary Mermaid for him and retrieve its scales. To equip the members of Blue Roses, the dwarf loaned them several swimsuits to wear in their water environment. Blue Roses separated up from the protagonist to locate the Promise Stone required to meeting the mermaid, while the former searched for the entrance to the mermaid's lair. When the two group found both they used them to summon the Legendary Mermaid and after defeating the famed entity in a duel they were rewarded the scales. The scales were then given to Tsuibayaya who used them to create his masterpiece, which was given and wore by Gagaran much to Tia's disgust.[16]

Tia reappeared again with Blue Roses when they located a cave north of the city and where Gazef Stronoff vanished. She worked with her team and the protagonist to eliminate two Spear Chaos Beasts that were guarding the entrance.[17] After the Chaos Beasts were killed, Tia and the other remained at the entrance to guard it while the protagonist and his team searched and recovered the Warrior Captain.[18]

At the time of the attack on E-Rantel by Jaldabaoth's horde of demons, Tia joined Blue Roses in defending the city. She and Blue Roses also witnessed the protagonist save the Bloody Emperor from being executed by the demons, commenting on how strong their was.[19]

A few weeks after the attack, the city of E-Rantel was beginning to heal. To raise the spirits and also amount of defenders for the Kingdom. the protagonist organized an adventurer tournament. Tia came to participate at the invitation of the protagonist. A day before the start of the tournament she and her team met with the organizer and his assistant to touch base on the event.[20] Tia and Tina fought in the first exhibition match against her teammate Gagaran, which led to her defeat. Though she was defeated by the muscle warrior, she and her sister claimed that they were going easy on her out of respect to Lakyus. In the tournament Tia grew interested in the two newcomers Shall and Ku. She would later join her team in fighting the pair in the seventh match and later fought the "Dark Warrior" as part of the finale of the event.[21]

Tia would join her team and the protagonist in investigating Re-Blumrushur to see if Marquis Blumrush was responsible for a string of disappearances of brides seeking to answer his solicitation to be his wife. Tia and the others busied themselves in collecting testimonies from the victim's families. Tia and the others would be approached by a desperate soldier seeking aid to eliminate undead that infested the mine near the city. Though the adventurers had priorities, the protagonist convinced them to help since could. Tia and her sister Tina remained behind in the city to continue collecting information.

The undead appearing in the mine turned out to be related to their investigation as they found that the undead were amassing due to the remnants of Zurrernorn conducting their rituals using the captured brides as sacrifices The adventurers killed the cultists and later found Evil Lord Greed at the scene. Since he was present it led the members of Blue Roses to believe that Blumrush was associating himself with the Demon Emperor. The twins eventually caught up their their fellow comrades, after informing the local Adventurer's Guild of the noble's crimes allowing the local adventurers to arrest those involved at the estate. After the mine collapsed, Tia and her friends enjoyed their victory and also found began teasing Evileye on how cute she looked in her bridal gown.[22]

When the E-Rantel Magic Research Institute was formed by the protagonist, Tia and her team journeyed with several researchers to cordon the Northern Cave to prevent more Chaos Beasts from escaping to the surface. While working to establish a defensive perimeter the assassin hoped that the researchers could solve the mystery of the Crack so that her team could resume working as adventurers.[23]

While away from E-Rantel, Tia and her team were in a job to infiltrate an illegal gambling hall to retrieve a wayward son of a noble. Using Hide Shadow technique Tia and her sister infiltrated the area along with Lakyus and Evileye in disguise. After the women finished the job and were heading back, they received word from Renner that a group of strangers were impersonating them. Evileye was extremely flustered by this violation of her identity being used especially when her imposter took the form of her in a bunny girl costume. The assassin tried to convince Evileye that the outfit was not that bad to no avail.[24]

During the minor epidemic in E-Rantel, Tia and Tina were on an investigative mission, thus unable to assist Lakyus and Evileye in scouting the city for signs of the disease among the orphans.[25]

For E-Rantel's Harvest Festival, Tina and Tia contributed in the event by acting as lookouts for trouble in the crowd. However unlike the rest of the denizens celebrating the festival, they did not wear any costumes and instead used their abilities to hide among the crowd. This greatly annoyed their friend Evileye as she was stuck out in skimpy mummy outfit. After the event demonstration, the twins reappeared to congratulate Evileye, who swore to make the two wear costumes in next year's Harvest Festival.[26]

In a situation where remnants of Zurrernorn were plotting a nefarious scheme for E-Rantel, Tia and her team went to investigate the sewers of the city for any of the cult's activities. She and her comrades found the secret room in the sewer passages but it was in disuse. They finally found the cult conducting some sort of ritual in the main sewage hall. Since time was of the essence, Blue Roses directly approached the cultist, who declared that E-Rantel's days were numbers and committed suicide, sacrificing their lives to a Super Giant Sanitary Slime that the cult created and began turning the dead into undead. They were nearly overwhelmed by the slime, until Soi came to their aid with "anti-slime agent" to drive the monster back into the sewers.

Given that the water environment and that the "anti-slime agent" could be used to dissolve normal equipment, swimsuits were required. Tia wore hers during an operation to eliminate the slime, with Blue Roses, minus Gagaran, Soi and Clementine. After defeating the threat, she and the other women addressed the people in the city square to explain the hyped up military presence as a routine cleaning of the sewers. At the address, Tia and her sister were envious seeing Clementine receive all the attention from her swimsuit by Tsuibayaya.[27]

Blue Roses would participate in a joint operation between adventurers and E-Rantel's authorities against brokers dealing in child trafficking. They were assigned by Guildmaster Ainzach to infiltrate the base of the brokers and cause a ruckus. At the start of the operation, after all the sentries were taken care of, Tia with her team entered into the base to take care of the rest of the criminals.[28]

At the time when E-Rantel was being overrun by Chaos Beasts emerging from several Cracks that had formed in the area, Tia was reported to be trying to defend the city with her team.[29]

After the Calamity of Cracks, during the reconstruction of the city of E-Rantel, another Greetings and Victory Festival was hosted to raise the spirits of the people. For the festival Tia wore her swimsuit and also reunited with Shall and Ku who were the guests of honor for the event. For the final match of the dedication performance, Tia's team fought against Shall, Ku, Aura, Narberal and Soi which resulted in a draw.[30]

Some months after the Calamity of Cracks, Tia and her team undertook a new mission from Prince Zanac to search for his missing sister in Carne Village where she was hiding with several refugees. Blue Roses though were too late as the entire camp was destroyed by Contaminated Beasts and it was believed by the adventurers that the princess had taken her own life before being devoured by the monsters. Afterwards the death of the princess was covered up by Zanac, and Blue Roses was dismissed. The ninja and her team were seen participating the festival happening in E-Rantel, handing out rations to the needy.[31]

Some months later, the adaptive equipment promised by the Sorcerer Kingdom was ready. Tia and her teammates were at a bar discussing the implications of the upcoming rescue operation. Tia hoped that the residents taken from E-Rantel were safe on the "other side" of the Crack. At hearing that the leaders of the Alliance wanted to host a pep rally to boost morale for those participating in the operation, Tia did not find it unexpected given the number of people involved. The adventurer was seen at the venue of the rally with her team.[32]

Tia joined the Four Kingdoms Rescue Team led by Gazef Stronoff to rescue a hundred people from beyond the Crack. During the rallying speech by the Warrior Captain, Tia and her sister were annoyed by the bickering of Evileye and Gagaran arguing. After the operation was a success, Tia was seen joking with her teammates on their victory.[33]

Later the rescue team rushed back to E-Rantel after receiving word from the Sorcerer Kingdom that enormous amounts of miasma were spilling in from Cracks in every major city in the Tripartite Alliance. Since their unit was the only military force in the area, the joint international force hurried to the alliance's capital to save what they could.

At E-Rantel, Tia scouted the city with Tina, Soi and Gagaran and reported to the rescue team that not all the populace were turned into contaminated and that there were still people who could be saved.[34]

A year later a new threat surfaced, when the protagonist summoned all the military leaders in E-Rantel. Tia with her team of Blue Roses, learned of the discovery of a new type of Chaos Beast, the Mimic, which can take the form of other beings. Tina supported the idea of using passwords to confirm the identities of people.[35]

At the festival celebrating the Quadripartite Alliance in E-Rantel, Tia was present with her teammates looking at the food provided by the stalls.[36]

Tia and the rest of Blue Roses would hear from Lakyus about her accepting a request from a minor noblewoman named Helga, as she was obligated to aid her due to a letter of introduction she had from her uncle Azuth Aindra. When told about the attacks on the shipments of minerals and herbs to E-Rantel going out of Helga's family territory and that it was suspected to be the work of nearby noble of high status. It seemed that the noble in question was trying to pressure Helga in marriage to claim her family's territory through the arrangement. And though a report for an inquiry was sent to the capital to address this harassment, the hiring of Blue Roses was to prepare for the worst scenario. Tia suspected that the noble would escalate the threat towards Helga, and given that she is a woman would try to abduct her and make her vanish to get what he wants.

After meeting Helga and hearing of her suspicions that there was a spy in her staff, it was planned to have some of the adventurers guard Helga at her home. When the protagonist suggested having some of their members infiltrate the staff as maids to protect Helga and find the leak at the mansion, Tia and Tina agreed to the idea. Lakyus volunteered due to having training as a maid from her noble background. As for the second person, Tia and Tina singled out Evileye as the next best candidate. As for Tina, Tia, and Gagaran they were assigned to guard the cargo convoy heading to E-Rantel from Helga's territory. While on the job the adventurers talked about how Helga knew Azuth in the past and what their relationship was to afford a favor from his family. Tia said that Lakyus had refused to share what exactly was on the letter of introduction written by Azuth. From the mutterings of Lakyus, Tia assumed that Azuth incurred a serious debt to Helga's family for some reason. On the way the adventurers dispatched the bandits that attacked convoy. After restraining the criminals, Tia and her team resumed their course with the convoy to E-Rantel.[37]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

As a former assassin of Ijaniya and an adamantite-rank adventurer, Tia is skilled in espionage, stealth, tracking, and assassinations. She is also well versed in a number of poisons and other substances of the like. During her battle with Entoma, she displays incredible agility, manifests shields for defense, and hides in and create clone of herself from shadows.
Job Classes

Rogue
Assassin
Ninja
Active

Bursting Flame Column: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to seemingly create a self-imploding explosion with flames.
Dark Crossing: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to teleport from one shadow to another one nearby.
Hide Shadow: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to hide in a shadow to avoid detection.
Immobility Binding Paralysis: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to temporarily immobilize a single target.
Immovable Adamantine Shield: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to create a large shield radiating with multiple colors to appear in front of her.
Shadow Clone: A ninjutsu skill used by Tia to create a clone of herself. The clone has one-quarter of the original body’s battle power. However, only the shadow’s evading ability is determined by the amount of magic power granted to it by the main body.
Main Equipment

Vampire Blade: A dagger that can suck the blood of the victim, leaving no evidence of a murder.
Poisoned Needles: During their plan to forcibly evacuate their leader, Lakyus, out of the Re-Estize Kingdom during before its complete destruction, Tia is shown to possess at least several miniature poisoned needles laced with at least five different types of poison that she uses to forcibly weaken Lakyus enough to forcibly escape with her and their team.
Kunai: A set of ninja knives used a projectiles.
Relationships

Tina

Tia's twin sister, a fellow "ninja" and adamantite adventurer of Blue Rose.

Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra

Tia and her sister were originally supposed to assassinate Lakyus. However, they ended up failing. They decided to follow her in order to learn her weaknesses. After some time, they decided to quit being assassins and become adventurers instead, joining Lakyus' team. Tia now considers her a good friend and trusted teammate. She and her sister often refer to Lakyus as "boss."
