"Why, Climb. Are you on your way to show your face to that monster?"
— Prince Zanac's Introduction.
Zanac Valleon Igana Ryle Vaiself (ザナック・ヴァルレオン・イガナ・ライル・ヴァイセルフ) was the Second Prince of the Re-Estize Kingdom. Though mistaken by others as a power-hungry man, jealous of his brother and sister, he was actually the only royal child who genuinely cared for the Kingdom.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Prince Zanac was a short and portly individual with short blond hair. There were a few occasions where he clad himself in full body armor, the first occurrence was during the Demonic Disturbance and the second time was when his kingdom went to war with the Sorcerer Kingdom. The armors he wore are not the same, as they differed from each other in these two events, one of which was the Guardian Armor that formerly belonged to Gazef Stronoff.
Personality

At first glance, Zanac appeared to be an incompetent person who was jealous of his siblings and scheming to steal his brother's birthright. However, in truth, this was all an act he created to mislead his enemies. In reality, Zanac was a talented, pragmatic, and sensible person, capable of comprehending the true natures of Renner and Marquis Raeven. Also, though it was true that he aimed for the throne, he did so out of a genuine belief that he would make a better king than his sheltered brother. He even claimed that he would give up his claim if it were for the greater good of the Kingdom. In the end, Zanac was a true patriot to his country.

A utilitarianist, Zanac's style of leadership often involved taking risks and making sacrifices for the greater good. He was even willing to resort to underhanded and even treasonous actions if he was compelled to. Still, he wasn't outright apathetic towards his people's struggles. Rather, his somewhat extreme beliefs were a direct result of the violent world he lived in; thus, making him a realist. Despite his logical mindset, however, he did have a sense of pride, ultimately choosing to fight and die with honor rather than just accept his fate.

To the public, Zanac maintained a well-mannered and prideful demeanor expected of a prince. Beneath this, however, Zanac had somewhat of an inferiority complex, unable to see his own talents and constantly comparing himself to others. However, this did not make him jealous. In fact, he actually felt admiration towards those he saw as superior; his father for his charisma and even his brother and sister, who he hated and feared, for their swordsmanship and intelligence respectively. Also, due to his lonely youth, Zanac didn't have any friends, causing him to deeply cherish the closest thing he had to one, which was Marquis Raeven.
Background

Zanac was born as the second son of King Ramposa III of Re-Estize Kingdom. Growing up, due to him only being the Second Prince, Zanac was mostly ignored by those around him, causing him to be somewhat lonely.

Despite him being the second born, Zanac believed he would make a better king than his spoiled older brother, Crown Prince Barbro. He thus began plotting to steal his brother's birthright, resulting in a bitter rivalry between the two princes. At some point, Zanac allied himself with Marquis Raeven after he saw through his opportunist act, which caused the latter to see his worth and back his claim to the throne.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Zanac was first introduced along with Marquis Raeven while walking through the royal palace and saw Climb, who was on his way to Renner's room. Walking into each other, Zanac tried to warn Climb about his master and his younger sister, Renner. However, Climb disregarded his warning about her true nature.[1] 

Later, Zanac attended a meeting between Marquis Raeven and Renner. During their conversation, he was disturbed when Renner revealed her true nature and her twisted love for Climb. Zanac offered to allow her to marry Climb if she supported his claim to the throne, to which she immediately agreed.[2]

Additionally, he was present when Renner and Lakyus called together all of the adventurers in the Kingdom to battle Jaldabaoth and his demon army. During the battle between the adventurers and Jaldabaoth, Zanac, along with some of Marquis Raeven's personal troops, led the civilians to safety. Using this, he earned the praise of the citizens and nobles. Thus, it helped him increase his chances to gain the throne over his older brother, Barbro.[3]

The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc

Main article: The Magic Caster of Destroy Arc
Zanac was later present during the meeting between the royalists and the nobility, where his father announced that the Baharuth Empire had allied itself with the newly founded Sorcerer Kingdom and had declared war on them. When Barbro, volunteered to fight on the battlefield, Zanac tried to stop him and volunteered to go himself, arguing that it would be foolish for both the Crown Prince and the King to risk their lives on the battlefield. However, his father ultimately decided to take Barbro with him to the battlefield over him.[4]

The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc

Main article: The Ruler of Conspiracy Arc
After the massacre at Katze Plains, his father fell into a depression due to the loss of Gazef Stronoff. With Prince Barbro's whereabouts unknown, Zanac had practically taken control of the Royalty Faction and was now first in line for the throne. However, he was also faced with a great amount of pressure and heavy burdens caused by the extreme tensions between the nobility faction and the royalty faction as a result of the war. Zanac was also having difficulty gaining reliable security and allies since his closest confidant, Marquis Raeven, retreated back into his domain, refusing to provide any further support after the massacre he witnessed.

At the same time, he tried to contemplate how to proceed with relations in regards to the newly formed Sorcerer Kingdom, as well as dealing with the internal infighting for power that had been plaguing the Kingdom for some time now. When he received news that the Sorcerer Kingdom would be sending a diplomatic envoy to their nation, these complications were instantly solved. Several days later, his father sent him to personally welcome the envoy, Albedo.

It was his duty to escort Albedo to the Ro-Lente Castle. Before diplomatic negotiation between the two nations begin, he had a dinner scheduled with himself and the rest of the Royal Family for that night. The following day, he and Albedo visited the theaters during the day to watch the dances and held a dinner party at night, where all the nobles of the Kingdom were invited. The next day, Zanac and Albedo attended a concert by the Palace's orchestra, after which the diplomatic negotiations took place.[5]

The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom Arc
Zanac was seen working in his father's office along with his sister back in the capital, looking at all the reports that had been plaguing the Re-Estize Kingdom. Among the many problems that had been listed since the end of the war, food supplies and manpower were revealed to be getting dangerously low. In addition to that, other possible threats included the endangerment of the remaining crop rations as they could suffer from cold snaps and droughts. Zanac had been seeking solutions to deal with them. He asked for his sister's opinion and suggested a few ideas, including using high leveled druid adventurers and using the excess surplus of grains purchased by merchants who got them from the Sorcerer Kingdom.

He also had been monitoring the situation with the humanitarian aid the Sorcerer Kingdom had been providing to the Roble Holy Kingdom. Seeing how this was unfolding, he started to contemplate that all of this had been set up so that the Sorcerer Kingdom would move against them and eventually take over by manipulating events in the Holy Kingdom while also making the Re-Estize Kingdom look in an even worse light for not providing them aid as they had done.[6]

After learning of Philip's attack on the trade caravan, Zanac participated in a court meeting with his father about the grave news and the Sorcerer Kingdom's response to it. Particularly, he announced to those participating in the meeting that the topic would focus on the declaration of war their nation had received from the Sorcerer Kingdom. He suggested to his father that they should offer the head of Philip as an apology to the Sorcerer Kingdom. Although he was quickly scolded by his father for that idea, Zanac refused to yield and states that it was imperative for their nation to avoid a large loss of life with a small sacrifice. When the suggestion of an alliance with another country was brought up, Zanac immediately turned it down, since negotiations had been unsuccessful with the Argland Council State and there had been no reply from the Slane Theocracy. Despite his father's other suggestion of forcing the Sorcerer Kingdom's army to retreat, he felt that they were better off putting Philip on trial and giving him over to the enemy kingdom as a way to guarantee their nation's survival. Upon learning that Prime Minister Albedo from the Sorcerer Kingdom would be arriving soon, he was ordered by his father to get dressed in a more formal attire and meet him in the throne room.

Once the meeting between King Ramposa III and Albedo finally ended, Zana tried to suggest chasing the Sorcerer Kingdom's Prime Minister down, but his father quickly turned that idea down. When he and Renner had a private meeting with Ramposa, the latter suggested that he and Renner flee from the kingdom, realizing that was about to be destroyed. However, both he and Renner refused to abandon their home nation.[7]

With the new war on the horizon and the Kingdom's weakened armies and low chance of actually winning against the Sorcerer Kingdom, Zanac had already begun making several preparations in gearing up the nation for war and had made several allies with the Kingdom's high ministers in preparation.

However, despite the obviously hostile stance of the Sorcerer Kingdom, King Ramposa was still insistent on trying diplomacy to diffuse the war between the Re-Estize Kingdom and the Sorcerer Kingdom. This notion eventually led Zanac and several of his allies to deem Ramposa to be no longer worthy to be their nation's leader during this national crisis. This finally caused the Crown Prince to stage a coup d'etat and dethrone his own father for the good of their kingdom. After successfully taking power and becoming King Regent, Zanac proceeded to secretly place Ramposa under house arrest and suppress all knowledge of the coup in order to prevent mass panic and confusion to the already vulnerable nation.

With his father indisposed, Zanac began to handle the affairs of the Kingdom. He was interrupted by Renner as the latter reported that more than half of their cities and villages in the Kingdom had already fallen to the Sorcerer King’s conquest. Zanac asked his sister how they did not get this intel sooner, only for her to inform him that someone had put all the Kingdom's sources of intel on lockdown. He was shocked when she revealed it to be none other than Marquis Raeven himself. He was provided multiple reasons by his sister on why the Marquis would choose to side with the Sorcerer Kingdom rather than their nation. Hearing one of such reasons, which was that Sorcerer Kingdom threatened to kill the Marquis' family if he refused to aid them, he believed the Sorcerer Kingdom's actions were despicable at best. He then asked for his sister's opinion about what she thought of the Sorcerer King, to which the latter responded with admiration and respect for the undead. Listening to Renner's response to his question, he then asked her further if the Sorcerer King was also better than her, which the latter chose not to answer.

Zanac was then asked several questions by Renner about how he would handle their country's situation with the Sorcerer Kingdom during the war. For instance, Zanac had already taken into consideration the mobilization of soldiers in the capital city where the final battle would happen between his army versus the Sorcerer King's army. Particularly, he had taken a stance by choosing to let himself be the royal who would take charge of leading the army to their death. He hoped to leave it to his father to prepare his own funeral after he died. Since his elder brother was no longer around, Zanac felt utterly compelled to take responsibility for the Kingdom's survival and could not afford to run away while it was on the brink of destruction. Zanac acknowledged that if only his elder brother was still here with them, he would have agreed to his father's idea of leaving the Re-Estize Kingdom with Renner to go to the Karsanas City-State Alliance.

On the other hand, he even offered a suggestion to Renner to flee at any time, like their father always wanted them to do initially. Hearing Renner's response on why she was not leaving immediately, he felt that it would only help the Sorcerer King to exploit her death after she died, such as the concern for the undead using her corpse. However, upon hearing once more from Renner, he was reassured by her that she would leave the Kingdom when the time came for her to do so.

After the Sorcerer Kingdom's army was about a half a day's march from the capital, Zanac mobilized the entire army of the Kingdom to assemble a front to combat the opposing nation. Zanac led an army of 400,000 men against the Sorcerer King's forces of 10,000 undead. Despite his forces' numerical superiority, Zanac already knew that they were no match for the Sorcerer King's overwhelming monsters. Hence, he decided to approach the Sorcerer Kingdom's army alone without any bodyguards and meet face-to-face with the Sorcerer King to try and better understand his motivations for this war. At the same time, he hoped to find out what kind of a thought process would have led the Sorcerer King to do what he had done against them.

Going out alone, he was given an audience with Ainz Ooal Gown and was treated with courtesy. While speaking, Zanac asked why Ainz, who already had so much power, would commit to this senseless war. Ainz declared that it was meant to show the world his power, but Zanac believed his answer was petty and asked what Ainz's actual goal was. Ainz, while in thought, considered the path he took in finding his comrades and later caring for his NPCs, revealing that all he strived for was 'happiness'. Zanac asked if he would trample on the happiness of others to achieve his own, which Ainz affirmed, causing the former to nearly outburst in objection, but quickly calmed down. Ainz forgave him, stating he was merely this doing for his nation, which Zanac could relate to and understood him as a fellow ruler. Before parting ways, the two discussed many things, such as who was wielding the late Gazef Stronoff's sword and even the fate of Barbro. After learning from Ainz that he was probably killed by one of his subordinates, Zanac actually thanked the undead for telling him. In the end, he also made Ainz promise to give him and his own countrymen a gentle painless death. Though the two were still enemies, the conversation ended on pleasant terms and it also allowed Zanac to see that there was a human side to the Sorcerer King.

After returning back to his army's side, Zanac informed his subordinates that the Sorcerer King's plan to kill them all was non-negotiable and could not be swayed no matter what he said. As he was coordinating with the minister of military affairs on how to proceed from there, they were ambushed by a group of mercenaries and nobles, who planned to take Zanac's head to the Sorcerer King as a means to appease him. Zanac declared that he was not going down without a fight, pulled out his sword, and dared everyone to try and take it from him by force. His severed head was later given to Ainz Ooal Gown as a gift of their loyalty. Despite being done to earn his favor, Ainz was disgusted by their self serving actions. The Overlord took Zanac's head and ordered Albedo to prepare a proper burial for his fellow sovereign. After giving these orders, Ainz told Albedo to take the mercenaries and nobles, along with their families, to Neuronist Painkill for their "reward".[8]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
Zanac was present in E-Rantel and attended the second summit meeting of the Tripartite Alliance with his family. At the venue he was introduced to the protagonist who was working as an escort for the royal family. The prince expressed doubts on the adventurer but mostly kept them to himself. When the Slane Theocracy revealed some disturbing revelations about the world, Zanac was skeptical on how true it was. Later when the emperor of the Empire challenged the Kingdom's warriors against his own, Zanac was nervous on how his father's champions would fare. He watched with his family as the adventurers fought against the members of the Four Imperial Knights, Zero and even Fluder Paradyne until the mock battles were called off to address the monster attacking the city.[9]

After the attack on the city was stopped by the protagonist, Zanac personally retrieved the hero from his room in the city and brought him to his father. His father wanted to hire the protagonist to locate Gazef Stronoff who had disappeared while on a mission to locate the source of the Chaos Beasts that attacked the city during the summit meeting. The protagonist accepted the job, though he asked King Ramposa III to consider forming an alliance with his nation. While the conditions for the alliance were standard, Zanac was hesitant to ally with a foreign nation that the Kingdom knew very little.[10]

Once Gazef's location was pinpointed to the Northern Cave, Zanac and his family was informed of the situation. To prevent a panic, the prince made efforts to ensure the Warrior's Captain's disappearance was not leaked.[11] The prince also was there when his father greeted the protagonist after his return and rescue of the Warrior Captain. As his father promised the adventurer would have any reward, which turned out to be the administration rights of the city of E-Rantel. Zanac objected to such a demand as it was outrageous akin to submitting the Kingdom's territory and create an unstable political environment for Tripartite Alliance. The idea though was not out of the question to his sister or father as relinquishing the city would unburden the Kingdom.[12]

When another Chaos Beast horde attacked the city, the first being defeated by the combined armies of the Alliance and a second one coming, the humans were offered reprieve from doom by a being known as Jaldabaoth. When Jircniv accepted the terms of the demon to save the city on behalf of the Alliance, Zanac was shocked alongside many of his peers when the Theocracy responded by pulling out all its forces from the city.[13]

After some disappearances in the territory of Re-Blumrushur began circulating among the nobles Prince Zanac take charge of the investigation to keep it out of his brother Barbro Andrean Ield Ryle Vaiself's ear less he makes the situation worse. Given that the rumors of brides going missing involved Marquis Blumrush, Zanac had to handle it delicately as the incident could spark a civil war among the Six Great Nobles. He contracted the help of the protagonist and his team as the leader agreed that the issue needed to be resolved quickly before it affected the unity of Tripartite Alliance. To assist them, he also informed that his sister would send Blue Roses to collaborate with the protagonist.[14]

Later involving an incident of the disappearances of orphan and homeless children in E-Rantel and evidence of child trafficking, Prince Zanac and Marquis Raeven were approached by Saint Clementine on the situation. While a raid was being conducted at the broker's base and warehouse, the prince and marquis provided some details of their investigation to the protagonist and saint. They were able to determine that a noble from the Nobility Faction was the mastermind, though he was using a story of losing control of his subordinates who were the real ones conducting the illicit slave trade to feign innocence.

To Zanac it was obvious that the man was lying and intending to use his men as scapegoats to take the blame. Despite the lack of physical proof against the noble, the second prince intended to continue his inquiry. To his amazement, the protagonist asked the prince if he could take over the investigation, offering get the evidence they needed to take all the perpetrators in one fell swoop. The prince intrigued allowed the protagonist to do so. The incident ended in the arrest of the noble, thanks to a magic caster of the Sorcerer Kingdom, locating copies of documents recording sales to slave traders from other countries and identification of the locations where the dead children were disposed of, providing the needed evidence to end the noble's operation.[15]

At the time of his father and older brother's disappearance on a battlefield just outside of E-Rantel, Zanac found himself the de-facto leader of the Kingdom's forces in the city. Though he was distressed by the apparent loss of his father, the prince tried to put up a competent attitude lest he showed weakness. Upon discovering that his family members were not the only ones to have vanished, Zanac attempted to connect with the guards and imperials to launch an investigation and also a joint defense strategy. However all magical communication was cut off within and outside of the city as numerous Cracks began to emerge and countless Chaos Beasts invaded bypassing all barriers in E-Rantel. Zanac relocated his base to outside to coordinate a defense, but met little success as the city's forces and inhabitants were in disarray. The prince saw that the situation got worse when he saw a Crack form in the skies above the city square.[16]

After the attacks on E-Rantel dissipated, Prince Zanac found himself the only royal to be accounted for, as his father and brother were reported to have perished with their corpses missing, while his sister had seemingly vanished to parts unknown. He was left to deal with political aftermath, contending with the scheming nobles who sought to take advantage of the decline of the royals' power. Although he was next in line, Zanac did not crown himself king, as a funeral could not proceed without any bodies, and doing so would earn himself criticism by the nobles of the Kingdom.

During the reconstruction of E-Rantel, Zanac attended the Greetings and Victory Festival which was a holiday from the Sorcerer Kingdom. Upon learning that two celebrated adventurers were attending, he went out to greet them. Initially wanting to meet them discretely, he regardless came with his own guards to personally thank them for coming to the festival to boost the morale of the city. Later is observed the dedication demonstration of the adventurers.[17]

With Marquis Raeven, the prince witnessed in a few months times the reconstruction of E-Rantel along with the implementation of new measures to deal with the new Cracks that formed in the city. The new procedures were spearheaded by the Sorcerer Kingdom and involved the dispersal of the population of E-Rantel to the Kingdom and Empire and quarantine of the Cracks by contingents of undead. The speed and acceptance of the new measures were startling to the prince and Marquis, though they attributed it to the level of trust the people of E-Rantel had with the Sorcerer Kingdom's representative. While the new measure in place were to ensure humanity continued survival, Zanac was quick to note the dispersal of people from E-Rantel would spread the propaganda of the Sorcerer Kingdom and create even more followers to the foreign nation. Not only that, the prince realized that Sorcerer Kingdom's inclusion of demi-humans into the city was a long-term plan to slowly bring the people to accept the undead army which now the Kingdom had to militarily rely on due to manpower shortages.

He understood that it was only a matter of time before the Sorcerer Kingdom subsumed the Re-Estize Kingdom, and while the idea was frightening on the level of machinations by the Sorcerer King to lead to this outcome, Zanac was not adverse to relinquishing political control to the other nation. In his view it was necessary for the continued survival of his people, and if not mankind during the troubling times. Zanac even admitted he was a supporter of the Sorcerer Kingdom's representative and planned to assist in the eventual change in power.[18]

A letter sent by the missing Renner would reach Zanac, who learned that she was hiding near the Great Forest of Tob, setting up a refugee settlement with those who escaped from the E-Rantel during the Calamity of Cracks and was being protected partially by the Wise King of the Forest. The prince needing some help to stabilize the country even with the return of his father who was rescued by Gazef Stronoff was happy to bring her back in the fold. He believed that his sister's absence in the court was a result of being unable to bear Climb's death. The prince sent the elite warriors to the refugee camp. But he lost contact with the group. The prince with his aide Marquis Raeven contacted the Adventurer's Guild to send Blue Roses to investigate.

When the adventurers returned, Zanac learned with a heavy heart that Renner's camp was annihilated by Contaminated Beasts and that she was dead. All he had left was a letter that explained she took her own life before the monsters came for her. In light of this, Zanac ordered that Renner's death be covered up as Rampsa III was still recovering emotionally from the death of Barbo. If the death of Renner was made public, it would devastate not just his father, but the people of E-Rantel who were already celebrating the rebuilding of the city.[19]

At the time of the completion of the mass production of the Chaos Adaptive Equipment, produced by the Sorcerer Kingdom, Prince Zanac with Marquis Raeven and Mayor Panasolei, were preparing a prep rally for the Quadripartite Alliance in a prelude to the upcoming rescue mission to the "other side" of the Crack. For the rally, the prince planned to turn down any noble who attempted to ingratiate themselves on the guest list for the representative side of the Kingdom.

Zanac knew the importance of the rally as it wasn't just to motivate the volunteers of the mission, but give thanks to the man benefactor, the Sorcerer Kingdom and thus wanted to avoid any turmoil from his country's internal politics in overlapping with the Sorcerer Kingdom's inner workings. As to Marquis Raeven's concerns of the Theocracy attending the event, the prince believed they would not dare challenge the Sorcerer Kingdom moment of achieving of greatness at the event. Despite the mayor voicing that they had yet to receive an attendee list from the Theocracy for the auspicious event, Zanac was hopeful for the future as he didn't want to think that there were people in the Alliance who can't honestly celebrate the ceremony.

At the venue of the event, Zanac attended it flanked by Raeven and Gazef where he first started speaking to the assembled people of how close humanity's dream of unity and security against the Cracks was at hand. After letting the other leaders of the Alliance speak like Emperor Jircniv and Cardinal Raymond, the final speaker at the event were two representatives of the Sorcerer Kingdom, Aura and Mare. The prince was impressed by the provoking words by the elves, wondering if it was due to their age of their species or personality. Later he enjoyed mingling with the other delegates at the feast portion of the venue.[20]

After the chaos that occurred with the multiple Cracks appearing throughout the Alliance had subsided, Zanac had ascended to become King of the Re-Estize Kingdom, succeeding his father who died as his health had deteriorated after his rescue from the Northern Cave.

A month later Zanac met with the protagonist as the king needed the protagonist's advice since Marquis Raeven was absent due to the turmoil in his own territory. While Zanac was the king, he brushed aside such honorifics like His Majesty. The topic of their discussion was the proposal of having the Re-Estize Kingdom become a vassal state of the Sorcerer Kingdom. Given the current situation, Zanac believed it to be the best action.[21]

A year later King Zanac found himself in constant company with his fellow representatives in the Quadripartite Alliance, regularly traveling them to inspect various sites of the Alliance. This time he accompanied them on a joint inspection of the Baharuth Empire. The only party absent were representatives from the Theocracy, which the commented was just as like the last inspection, noting that the Sunlight Scripture were still stationed in E-Rantel.

Zanac seemed to understand their absence agreeing with Prime Minister Albedo that the Theocracy was busy, especially when dealing with the level of non-human co-existence in E-Rantel which the human supremacist nation must have many internal conflicts over. In regards to the Empire's recovery, Zanac remarked that progress was going well even though the damage by the miasma was severe. Additionally he found it was good fortune that those who had been cured by the contamination were significantly strengthened like Gazef Stronoff.

During the journey to Arwintar through the Katze Plains, Zanac noticed Jircniv's troubled look, who then revealed that the emperor received some interesting rumors from the workers of adventurers and out-of-place soldiers in the area. While the rumors were not reliable, Zanac though they could be people aiming to take advantage over the state of chaos in the world, like Zurrernorn or a new faction.

The group received a treat by Jircniv with a surprise visit to the Grand Arena, where Zanac admitted to feeling the vitality of the excited crowds. While at the VIP Box, the emperor shared an idea of his he worked with the promoter Osk, in utilizing the arena to display the decontaminated using their newfound strength to defeat monsters and dispel the public's fear towards these individuals.

A match composed of two newcomers against two members of Silver Thread Bird caught Zanac's eye. He asked Jircniv if the newcomers were individuals who were decontaminated, but was told otherwise. After seeing the newcomers achieve victory against the adamantite adventurers, the king thought perhaps he and his peers just witnessed the birth of new heroes.[22]

Shortly after the inspection of the Empire concluded, Zanac attended a conference of the Quadripartite Alliance in E-Rantel. While going over the inspection in the Empire Zanac stated that it was stimulating, a contrast to his Kingdom which was still in mourning for his father. He found it a good distraction, and looked forward to continuing to work with the Sorcerer Kingdom and the rest of the Alliance in recovering his Kingdom.

The next inspection was deemed to for the Re-Estize Kingdom, which Zanac accepted though found it unfortunate that his nation did not have any flow fields for scenic views for the inspection. Later when Albedo mentioned that she would be busy in the coming days leaving her post as representative of her nation at the Alliance vacant, Zanac found it troubling as the same problem affected the Theocracy. Although he believed that the Sorcerer Kingdom could remedy this if the King of the Sorcerer King came to the conferences personally.

This sparked interest among the representatives of meeting the leader of the Sorcerer Kingdom as he had yet to publicly appear. Zanac who had yet to be formally coronated as king, had no plans for a big event, even after the mourning period is over, expressed interest of wanting to offer his greetings to the Sorcerer King as a fellow monarch. If the Sorcerer King did make a public appearance, Zanac offered to hold a banquet in his honor.

Later on the protagonist passed word that the Sorcerer King would make his public appearance in the future, though not during the inspection of the Kingdom, at least until he settled his national policies. Even so Zanac looked forward to meeting the Sorcerer King.[23]

In regard to the request from the humans in E-Rantel for the Sorcerer Kingdom to temporarily substitute the undead guards during the period of a festival, the leadership in the Sorcerer Kingdom wondered if it was an attempt to limit the Sorcerer Kingdom's influence over E-Rantel. Based on Albedo's analysis of the situation, it was doubted that the Emperor of the Empire or the new King of the Re-Estize Kingdom would fathom this.[24]

After receiving word about a noble abusing his status to conduct criminal activity with the territory of a minor noble in the Kingdom and restart the drug trade, the king authorized the arrest of the noble after being present evidence of his crimes.[25]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Zanac was aware of his incompetence, but he was capable of seeing through the facades worn by his sister and Marquis Raeven. Maruyama himself considers Zanac to be a good ruler on par with Pe Riyuro. Unlike his father, he was more than willing to take a few risks if it meant getting results.
Job Classes

King (1)
Prince (4)
Charisma (2)
Fighter (1)
Main Equipment

Amulet of Immortality (former): Provides regeneration.
Gauntlets of Endurance (former): Grants endless stamina.
Guardian Armor (former): Made of extremely hard steel or adamantite. Enchanted with magic, it can protect the wearer from lethal blows.
Personal Armor:
Relationships

Ramposa III

King Ramposa III was Zanac's father. However, the Prince's opinion of him would drastically shift depending on the situation. He admired his charisma and his willingness to self-sacrifice for the sake of his people. He was also worried about his wellbeing when he fell into a depression following Gazef's death.

Spoiler Alert
Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.




Zaryusu Shasha (ザリュース・シャシャ) is a lizardman of the Green Claw Tribe and is the younger brother of Shasuryu Shasha. He is the wielder of Frost Pain, one of the Four Treasures among the lizardmen tribes, and is amongst the few surviving lizardmen who fought against Cocytus. He was the last to die but was later revived by Ainz.

Appearance

Zaryusu Shasha is a lizardman with dark green and charcoal black scales, similar to that of his elder brother Sharyusu Shasha. On his chest rests the crimson brand of a "traveler."
Personality

Zaryusu became a traveler not only because of his curiosity but his determination, resolve, and sense of duty to his tribe. When the tribe was threatened by Nazarick’s ‘invasion’, he showed his wisdom by convincing his tribe that the only way to survive was to form an alliance with the other tribes. He shows through his negotiation tactics with the chiefs of each tribe as well as his interactions with them that he is capable of doing whatever has to be done for the greater survival of not only his people, but his species and their culture as a whole, thereby showcasing his values.
Background

Zaryusu Shasha is a traveler, one who has decided to leave his village to see the outside world. While given a great deal of respect and status within the villages, travellers don't actually have any say regarding important decisions in lizardmen communities. He is the younger brother of the leader of the Green Claw Tribe.

In Zaryusu's case, he is given even greater respect because he is the wielder of the magical blade known as Frost Pain which is one of the lizardmen's four treasures. The weapon was a spoil of war from the Resource War. He was hailed a hero after he slayed the original owner, the chieftain of Sharp Edge. During his travels in the outside world, he studied the methods of aquaculture and upon returning to his homeland, began to create a fish farm in hopes that it will provide a sustainable food source for his people and prevent another Resource War.
Chronology

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Overlord II EP01 123
Zaryusu and Shasuryu
While tending the newly established fishery farms of the tribe situated at the edge of the Green Tribe encampment, Zaryusu receives a visit from his older brother, Shasuryu Shasha. His brother praises Zaryusu's success in replicating the aquatic farming techniques he discovered during his travels. He comments that the cultivated fish are healthier and more nutritious than the ones the tribe used to harvest in the wild. Zaryusu brushes aside the praises, admitting that the farm wouldn't exist had it not been for Shasuryu's support.

They are interrupted after tides of dark storm clouds rush towards the Green Claw Tribe village, and would later continue to loom over the village. Sensing danger, the traveler and his brother rush back to the village. At the center of the village, an undead messenger appears and declares the imminent destruction of the lizardmen at the hand of the Great One in eight days' time, claiming their village as the second offering of death to the Great One. After the undead vanishes in a cloud of smoke, Zaryusu attends a tribe assembly with his brother. The Elder Druid voices his opinion stating that it is hopeless to fight, as the magic displayed by the messenger is stronger by at least twofold compared with the magic cast by the elder. The option of fleeing the Wetlands is given thought until Zaryusu is given a chance to speak. He reminds them that victory is still possible if they call out to the other tribes, believing that the only way they can defeat this new foe is to throw their reckoning off by uniting their forces.

Many in the assembly object to this idea as it is unheard of for a traveler to be given such authority, but their complaints are put down at the word of the chief who proceeds to hand Zaryusu his seal. After exchanging a few words of support and regret with his brother Zaryusu, he and his pet hydra Rororo travel together to enlist the help of the Red Eye Tribe.[1]

Luluspeaking
Zaryusu meeting Crusch Lulu.
Upon reaching the Red Eye Village, Zaryusu quickly becomes aware that the tribe does not have a ‘chief’, but an ‘acting chief’ instead. Upon meeting with them, he becomes smitten with the acting Chieftain Crusch Lulu. He immediately proposes to marry her, causing her to become befuddled at his sudden display of emotions. Later, on a more serious note, both discuss their race's predicament in the upcoming invasion. After some degree of urgency and subtle use of blackmail, Red Eye joins in the tribal alliance. Zaryusu, Rororo, and Crusch then make their way to appeal to the Dragon Tusk Tribe.

Overlord II EP03 019
Zenberu vs Zaryusu.
Upon entering the Dragon Tusk Tribe’s territory, they are met with hostility, as the members of the tribe were formerly tribesmen of Yellow Speckle and Sharp Edge, tribes Green Claw had defeated in the resource war. The chieftain, Zenberu Gugu quickly demands a duel with the traveler, proclaiming that their tribe only heeds the words of the strong. The match ends with Zaryusu's victory and Dragon Tusk's acceptance of participating in the war.

To celebrate, Dragon Tusk held a banquet in honor of their tribe's new alliance. Zaryusu, Crusch, and Zenberu got more acquainted with each other and discussed the upcoming battle. They travel together to the Green Claw Village where the remaining tribes had gathered. Zaryusu and the chieftains drew out a battle plan stands alongside the chieftains as they announce the dissolution of the tribes and the formation of the Lizardman Alliance.[2]

Overlord II EP03 151
Zaryusu slaying Iguva=41.
When the battle between the undead and Lizardman Alliance erupts and fell into the favor of the latter, Iguva=41 entered the battlefield. To defeat the undead, Zaryusu, Crusch, Zenberu, and Rororo fight together to defeat the elder lich. Thanks to his friends, Zaryusu manages to get close to the undead commander and finish him with a final blow from Frost Pain, but not before falling unconscious.

Overlord II EP04 006
Zaryusu and Crusch.
Zaryusu awoke a day later, in the care of Crusch who reveals that after Zaryusu slew the lich, the undead army had retreated. The two had a very tender romantic movement until they were interrupted by Zenberu, asking them to join the feast that was held to celebrate the lizardmen's victory.[3]

The next morning, Zaryusu and Crusch awake abruptly sensing something was amiss. The rest of the tribe likewise come to the same conclusion and to their horror saw a vast, powerful undead army at the foot of their village.

[Some content is likely missing here.]

Overlord II EP05 028
Zaryusu mating with Crusch
As a result, he and his brother approached Ainz Ooal Gown and his fearsome cohort in hopes of peacefully surrendering. However, they were forced to accept a challenge against Cocytus. After Zaryusu reported back to his fellows, Crusch fearful that he may die, asked him to impregnate her with his child.[4] He complied and spent the night with her before departing with his fellow warriors to fight Ainz's champion.

Overlord II EP05 089
Zaryusu prepares for his death.
During the first wave of attack, the majority of the lizardmen warriors are wiped out, leaving Zaryusu and the remaining lizardmen chieftains to fight Cocytus. The other chieftains are eventually killed leaving Shasuryu and Zaryusu. His older brother sacrifices himself to allow an opening for Zaryusu to get close enough to Cocytus to strike a blow. Cocytus had caught his blade, but the traveler coated the blade with his own blood making Frost Pain slip through the Floor Guardian's fingers. However, the attack is soon deflected thanks to Cocytus's special ability. Zaryusu is the last to be slain while earning the respect of Cocytus, who later petitions the lizardman's resurrection to his master Ainz.[5]

Overlord II EP05 132
Zaryusu's Resurrected
Zaryusu soon awakens after being revived and his limp body is quickly embraced by Crusch. Though he is confused, he is soon made aware of his situation. Zaryusu comes to the conclusion that Ainz Ooal Gown is a god. Thus, he then bows down to him in reverence and swears his fealty to the Overlord.[6]

The Invaders of The Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Zaryusu along with several other Lizardmen are present in Nazarick at the time when the worker groups invade the tomb, doing some training in order to become stronger. Zaryusu serves as Hamsuke's martial arts master in order for her to learn martial art skills. He bears witness to the fight between Hamsuke and Erya Uzruth. The battle ends with Hamsuke's victory and learning a new martial art skill. Zaryusu states that Hamsuke has proven herself ready to train for the next stage with battle armor.[7]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
Zaryusu has now become the father of a healthy baby boy that has the same albino skin as its mother, Crusch Lulu. He is summoned by Ainz along with Zenberu Gugu and the other lizardmen when Ainz came to their village to seek Zenberu for his aid in finding the Dwarf Kingdom.

At the same time, Ainz congratulates the new father and asks if he would like to join him in E-Rantel as part of his plan to integrate multiple races to live in harmony under his new nation. While at first, he is nervous to respond for the right answer, Ainz assures him to speak his mind and Zaryusu requests that he would prefer not to go for the sake of his family and instead took the proposal of finding other lizardmen to go in his stead.[8]

The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc

Main article: The Phantom Ship of Katze Plains Arc
The lizardman was mentioned by Momon while watching Hamsuke fight a Skeletal Dragon at Broken Tower 1, contemplated how much experience points she would gain from the hamster based on the Skeletal Dragon's level and her assumed level in comparison to the game. Though he understood that his thinking was bound by game mechanics of YGGDRASIL, so he considered that it was possible creatures in the New World like Hamsuke and Zaryusu were not structured according to a level system. It made him recall the experiments he conducted Zaryusu and other lizardmen on combat training.[9]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
In the aftermath of the Catastrophe and the appearances of the Cracks Zaryusu sought the assistance of the adventurers in E-Rantel, to do a survey on the mysterious rising temperature of the Great lake. The lizardman was however turned away by the wary city guards. Unable to enter to city, the lizardman sat outside on the road looking to find any adventurer that would help him. His aid came in the form of the Slimeko and the protagonist who were interested in hearing his story. More help came Nazarick in the form of Cocytus, and Aura who believed that the existence of Caloric Stone was responsible for the incident at the lake and wished to claim the resource.

Initially surprised working with not just 'humans', elves and an insect Zaryusu became intrigued that the organization that his allies came from was a multi-racial group. The group traveled to the Great Lake, briefly stopping at the Great Forest of Tob where the lizardman was further surprised that the Wise King of the Beast was a pet to one of his newfound friends. They set off towards the wetlands where they came to the village of Green Claw. There Zaryusu introduced them to his brother Shasuryu. The traveler and the team were heading to the north side of the lake where the temperature was rising getting into a scuffle with some members of Dragon Tusk. Zaryusu and his friends defeated them but rather than kill them, Zaryusu told them to leave as in this time of crisis they should be not fighting amongst themselves. At the north side of the lake Zaryusu and the others soon found the cause of the lake to be due to several Giant Lizards that were migrating from the mountains. Once Cocytus used their ice abilities to slay most of them, it was discovered that the beasts had not Caloric Stone within them but a new type of mineral. The stones were taken as payment for helping Green Claw.[10]

Zaryusu would later meet with his benefactors again this time with visitors from another world. The traveler had informed Nazarick that gold was discovered near the banks of the lake. The exact location of the gold vein was somewhere within the Azerlisia Mountains. The lizardman acted as a guide to a safe path to the mountains.[11]

When strange ghosts began to haunt the forest, came to the lake again to see if any similar incidents occurred. They met with Zaryusu and his introduced his pet Rororo to them. Hearing about the situation in the forest the traveler brought them back to his village where Shasuryu was speaking with Kyuku Zuzu the leader of Razor Tail. Zaryusu having been inspired by Nazarick's unity of races had convinced his brother to re-establish the old alliances of the other tribes in order to survive in these strange times they face. The two were just discussing about a more permanent alliance when the traveler brought his friends. Kyuku proved to be a valuable asset as he pointed Aura in the direction of an entity that might be responsible for the ghost haunting, the Demon Snake of the West. Using the information from the chieftain Aura and Zaryusu headed to the lair of the Demon Snake. When they met the entity, they found out that he was not involved with anything in the Tob Forest.[12]

The lizardman would invite the protagonist, Slimeko and Cocytus for a feast prepared for them in their honor where four lizardmen tribes had already united due to the influence of their benefactors. At the feast the trio from Nazarick are introduced to Zenberu Gugu by Zaruyusu. The chieftain of Dragon Tusk immediately challenges the warrior Cocytus, much to Zaruyusu chagrin. However, Cocytus takes no insult and welcomes the challenge and soon Zaryusu joins the fight along with Kyuku Zuzu. Though they were defeated in the end the warriors gained respect from Cocytus.[13]

Zayusu would continue to work to unite all the lizardmen tribes in the Great Lake. His efforts led to not only Razor Tail joining but also Dragon Tusk. During one tribal meeting an unnatural cold wave hit the wetlands, coming from the mountains. Due to the weather, many monsters began to migrate to escape the cold and head towards the lake. Zaryusu and his fellow lizardmen not only had to fight the aggressive beasts but try to stay warm amid the freezing temperatures. Cocytus came to their aid lending his forces and sword to fight the encroaching monsters. To keep the lizardmen from freezing Cocytus ordered that the heatstones that were to be shipped to Nazarick be used to warm themselves. To solve what was causing this change in weather, members of the Pleiades agreed to find the source of the abnormality. Zaryusu and his fellows saw them off. When they successfully returned, the weather was returning to normal. Zaryusu thanked them from the bottom of his heart, affirmed that Nazarick's brotherhood was something to strive for.[14]

When the protagonist arrived with his party to pick up Zenberu to be a part of the Sorcerer Kingdom's delegation to the Dwarf Kingdom, Zaryusu and Shasuryu greeted them. Zaryusu was hopeful on the plans for co-mingling with other races that would be coming to the area. He became annoyed when Zenberu finally showed up and challenged Yuri Alpha for a match.[15]

Upon receiving a personal invite from Cocytus to attend the Sorcerer Kingdom's National Foundation Day Ceremony, the traveler graciously accepted the invitation from his peoples' benefactors.[16] The lizardmen were transported from the Great Lake region to Fake Nazarick via carriage. There the traveler and his comrades were greeted by Yuri Alpha and the Pleiades and brought to meet the other guests attending the event. At the ceremony, Momonga personally addressed Zaryusu and his people, acknowledging their alliance to the Sorcerer Kingdom. Furthermore, Momonga was aware of Zaryusu and Crusch's upcoming wedding and promised to give them a wedding gift afterwards. Zaryusu and his party would be guided to the banquet of the venue where they enjoyed the delicacies provided, made small talk with Cocytus and participated in the ballroom dance. Before returning to the Great Lake, Zaryusu was able to admire the newly unveiled Sorcerer King Momonga Statue.[17]

The lizardmen were graced by a visit from an entourage from the Sorcerer Kingdom when the village was celebrating Zaryusu's union with Crusch. The visitors included not just the usual faces, but none other than Prime Minister Albedo. Zaryusu and Zenberu were the first to greet them, though the latter had the misfortune for nearly insulting Albedo with his poor manners, causing Zaryusu to apologize for him on his behalf.

For a change the lizardmen were sought help from their patrons, concerning information on usable fiber plants from the Tob Forests that could be used for fabrics. Zaryusu was delighted to help as Albedo had taken some time to congratulate on his upcoming fatherhood.

When he introduced him to Crusch, Albedo took an interest at a tapestry of the symbol of Red Eye, Zenberu spoke that it was just merely cloth, causing Albedo to ask if him knew more, though thankfully Zaryusu interrupted and told his friend to be quiet and allow his wife to explain. [18]

Zaryusu would receive another visit from the Sorcerer Kingdom, when the protagonist and Slimeko brought Aura Bella Fiora and Mare Bello Fiore seeking the lizardmen's assistance in aquatic combat training. Eager to assist his benefactors, Zaryusu was willing to help as it would be good training for him and the others. His interest deepened when he learned that the training was a prelude to an expedition the Sorcerer Kingdom was planning to explore a isolated island via teleportation magic. The lizardman with some tribemates did mock combat with the elves in their swimsuits.

Later they were joined by his pet Rororo who he decided to allow to participate as it was one of the rare chances he could play with the hydra. Once training finished, Zaryusu invited them into his home, where Crusch was waiting. Before the Floor Guardians and their escorts left, Zaryusu asked to join the expedition to the surprise of his fellow lizardmen. The lizardmen argued that it would be best to have someone experience in aquatic combat, citing he could be an asset. Though a few were concerned that he should not be due to his wife's pregnancy, Crusch permitted it and asked Aura and Mare to consider her husband's request as it was his desire as a traveler. His request was brought to Momonga who agreed to it as it would deepen their ties with the lizardmen and lead future projects for the island.[19]

Zaryusu inclusion was wise as he provided so insights to the topography of the island that even the protagonist missed. After the lizardman observed the bountiful marine life in the reef side of the island, he believed that the location was ideal to create a fishery. It was his ambition to use the island to supply much needed food for his village. When he saw how the former pirates met their end by remaining in their vessel and drowned, it related to him as he wanted to avoid the lizardmen in being complacent.

After the survey was complete, Momonga upon hearing his request rewarded him the right to the fishing grounds as long as the lizardmen assisted in building a base on the island.

Zaryusu returned home and also hosted a Swimsuit Sports Festival at the Great Lake as it would allow the lizardmen warriors to train with the Pleiades. He informed the other chieftains of the deal, although was worried that he acted without their consent when he accepted the reward. His worries proved to be misplaced as the chieftains trusted him to make the best decision for his people. Later he decided to focus on his family and to allow the future to take care of itself.[20]

When an unconscious human girl was found in the Tob Forest by the village rangers. After their guest awoke, Zaryusu, Crusch and Shasuryu learned that the human transported to the Great Lake area via a Crack and was from a place called Britannia and used a different system of magic in contrast to tier magic. Having no way to return their guest home, it was decided that they should notify the Sorcerer Kingdom.

However the village was soon attacked by an unprecedented horde of Chaos Beasts that surged from Tob Forest. Crusch was asked by Zaryusu to evacuate with the non-combatants, due to her pregnancy, even though the female lizardman wanted to remain and fight, arguing they will need a druid to heal their wounds in the battle against the Chaos Beasts. She was finally convinced to evacuate after her human charge promised to take her role as a magic supporter and protect her husband Zaryusu. In the battle, Zaryusu tried to warn the human woman about a Double Sword Chaos Beast that was about to attack her. It looked as if she would be killed, by Cocytus arrived in time to slay the Chaos Beast.[21]

Zaryusu returning to the village from his fish farms, found his brother Shasuryu talking to Lupusregina and CZ looking to see if anything strange was happening at the Great Lake. The traveler answered that the young fish at the farm were acting more active, making him think the quality of the water had changed. This concerned him as well as his wife Crusch.

After a second investigation team was dispatched led by Darkness, Zaryusu and Shasuryu were introduced to Sophie Noia and her specialty. When Sophie wanted to bring out her pet slimes, Zaryusu was not sure, worried that they could harm the children, but when the protagonist vouched for her, he dropped the matter. Upon being questioned on the status of the lake, Zaryusu stated that the fish were growing better at the farm and even some people felt better and more energy.

Before the protagonist and his team headed to the lake, Zaryusu had one last piece of information. The number of adult fish decreased along with the growth of the young fish. As if they were being "eaten" by a mysterious creature. The traveler and Zenberu wanted to join in eliminating the creature, but were convinced by the protagonist to remain in the village to protect it.

After the situation was resolved, Zaryusu was checking the fish farms again when he was visited by Lupusregina and CZ. The lizardman told the women everything was fine now, apologizing to them and the Sorcerer Kingdom for bringing them so much trouble. But the Pleiades mentioned that the situation turned out beneficial to the lizardmen as the slime that resided in the lake released diluted extract of the Longevity Nut that stimulated the growth of the fish and health of his tribe. Seeing their point, Zaryusu vows to be not discouraged by this, as now his people are not alone thanks to the Sorcerer Kingdom. And vows to make his farm even better than before, humbled by the generosity of the Sorcerer King, and agreeing to the Pleiades that his people will worship him like a god.[22]

Later on, at the isolated island claimed by the Sorcerer Kingdom, at Renner Theiere Chardelon Ryle Vaiself's request, Zaryusu went around the lizardmen community to collect their opinions for a reward from the Sorcerer Kingdom for the hard work the demi-humans put into the island infrastructure. One of the things that the lizardmen requested was the creation of an ice room. It was explained that the lizardmen heard of such a feature from Cocytus as a way to preserve food. In addition, the ice room would be used by the lizardmen on the island as a way to cool down, given the environment was still a bit too hot for their kind.

The last request was a bit embarrassing for Zaryusu, and after much coaxing from Renner, he disclosed that his people wanted a statue of Momonga having been impressed when they saw the Sorcerer King Momonga Statue. And it was their intent to offer thanks for the fish they caught. Some days later, Zaryusu was back in the wetlands, where he was met with a visit from Renner and Slimeko, informing him and the tribal leaders that their requests were approved and that an ice statue would be installed within the ice room. This was more than Zaryusu could hope for than he hoped for, and was thrilled that the effigy would be made by Cocytus stunned that such a warrior had artistic talents.

He did not think that his people could repay all the kindness the Sorcerer Kingdom have given them. And when he learned that the emissaries of the Sorcerer Kingdom were going to the Azerlisia Mountains on an expedition, he offered to accompany them, but was declined, though was content to give the group a send-off to the mountains.[23]

Sometime later, the village was graced by a visit from the Sorcerer King leading a delegation. After some shock and confusion, the demi-humans were given New Year's gifts in the form of fish produced by the Cauldron of the Daghdha. Zaryusu marveled at the fish notice them to be of superior quality to the fish produced at his farm. When Zenberu casually commented he was grateful beyond jealousy at the gifts, Zaryusu scolded him for his rude behavior. He thanked the Sorcerer King, having never expected that the sovereign would come to his village in person. After being asked if there were any odd occurrences in the area, Zaryusu reported that none have happened so far. Before the delegation left to journey to the Azerlisia Mountains, Zaryusu and his tribe bid the farewell, expressing hope to repay the Sorcerer Kingdom for their generosity.[24]

A year later, Momonga while in the Guest Room where Pandora's Actor was resting after practicing being his body double, performing as Momonga, expressed interest of bringing the Area Guardian to see Zaryusu and the others at the Mysterious Island to see their reactions when interacting with "Momonga."[25]

Zaryusu was part of the lizardmen delegation who had been invited to a New Year's banquet at the Amphitheater of Nazarick. The lizardmen presented a homemade drink made by the lizardmen, and the former traveler explained its significance to Momonga. The lizardman looked froward to the festivities at the banquet, particularly a dance his wife would perform for the occasion. The lizardman was seen cautioning Crusch from partaking too much of otoso and also witnessed the mock battle between Kyuko, Narberal and Shiro.[26]

While initially heading to the isolated island, Zaryusu came across Cocytus deep in thought in Nazarick. Learning Cocytus was trying to select his candidate to temporarily replace the undead guards in E-Rantel, Zaryusu seeing this a chance to repay Cocytus and the Sorcerer Kingdom, offered himself and the lizardmen for the candidacy. At the Amphitheater where all potential candidates were being vetted by the Floor Guardians and Momonga, Zaryusu and his people's candidacy were thank but no really considered. Mostly due to the gap in power needed to guard the Cracks in E-Rantel and also Zaryusu coming short against another potential candidate, a Spear Needle cub. Still his initiative was commended by Momonga and the others.[27]

Zaryusu and his fellow lizardmen would receive a visit from Cocytus, warning them not to go into the Tob Forests as there was a defense inspection in progress. That was fine with Zaryusu and the others as they were enjoying the comforts at home thanks to the Sorcerer Kingdom. While Cocytus questioned them of how the lizardmen show the goodness of their tribe, Zaryusu stated that it important to show their current strength, but that's only possible because of what their ancestors gave them.

For example, he has been saved many times by one of the treasures passed down by his tribe, Frost Pain so he will pass it one to continue that tradition. When Cocytus mused about ancestral ties, Zaryusu wondered if the Floor Guardian was seeking someone to speak about the greatness of the Sorcerer Kingdom, thus offered to accompany Cocytus. It was declined, but it did inspire Cocytus with an idea. Before leaving he expressed the lizardman and his kind to be careful near the forest, which Zaryusu likewise told his superior to take care.[28]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Zaryusu Shasha is seen as one of the strongest lizardmen alive. He is the wielder of Frost Pain which is one of the Four Lizardmen Treasures. Even Cocytus is impressed by the strength and ‘spirit of a warrior’ he displayed.
Racial Classes

Lizardman (1)
Job Classes

Fighter (10)
Sword Master (6)
Ranger (1)
Sage (2)
Skills

Whirlwind (Web Novel Only): It was an area of effect attack.
Eyes in the Back (Web Novel Only): It allows the user to notice attacks outside of one’s field of vision.[29]
Main Equipment

Frost Pain: A magical sword that inflicts ice damage, as well as protects its wielder from ice-based attacks of a similar level.
Relationships

Crusch Lulu

Zaryusu fell in love with her at first sight and immediately proposed to her. Initially, Crusch was embarrassed by the proposal, but after confessing to her multiple times she eventually reciprocated his feelings. After the Lizardmen Alliance was conquered by Nazarick, she married Zaryusu and birthed his child.

Shasuryu Shasha

Zaryusu is the little brother of Shasuryu, the two of them share a deep brotherly bond. He considers his older brother as a trustworthy and competent chieftain. When he realised that he was killed, Zaryusu pleaded for Ainz to resurrect him.

Zenberu Gugu

Zaryusu and Zenberu initially saw each other as enemies, but after they dueled, Zaryusu now views Zenberu as a competent warrior and friend. Though he is a bit annoyed by his peer's perverted comments and overbearing nature, Zaryusu was unwilling to accept his friend's death and requested Ainz to resurrect him.

Hamsuke

Zaryusu is Hamsuke's martial arts master.

Ainz Ooal Gown

Zaryusu regarded him as an undead monster when he attacked the lizardmen. After his resurrection, he thinks of Ainz as a divine existence.

Rororo

Zaryusu's pet hydra which he picked up during his travels after its mother abandoned it because of its deformity. (Rororo has 4 heads while normal hydras have 6 heads.) Regards Zaryusu as its parent and is more than willing to die to protect him.

Cocytus

Zaryusu was killed in battle by Cocytus. After Zaryusu's resurrection, he became a direct subordinate of Cocytus and received warrior training from him in Nazarick.

Trivia

Zaryusu and his fellow lizardmen visited the Great Tomb of Nazarick to train and went back to the village to spread word of the amazing worlds that they saw inside Nazarick.
Zaryusu and his fellow lizardmen stay at the 6th Floor where there are ten log houses built for them.
Zaryusu and his fellow lizardmen were training in a large room where Shalltear governs and they were wearing a collar around their neck with a broken chain hanging off it, which might be equipment that Ainz promised to lend to the lizardmen to make them stronger.
At some point, after the events of Volume 10, Zaryusu was recruited by Ainz to become an instructor at the new training facility for adventurers.[30]
Quotes

(To Slimekoale): “Personally, I think one like sister-in-law's is also fine."
(To Crusch about her appearance): "...It's like the white snow that covers the top of the mountain range."
(To Crusch): "It was love at first sight. Besides, death may result from the war this time, and I do not wish to leave any regrets behind."
(To Hamsuke): "I think it's pretty short. Hamsuke-san, it usually takes about a year to learn martial arts. Considering that, you're learning pretty fast."
(To Zenberu): "That's right. Real battle experience, healing when you're injured, fighting stronger opponent with enhancement magic, etc. It might be hellish training, but it gets results."

Zenberu Gugu (ゼンベル・ググー) is the chieftain of one of the five lizardmen tribes, the Dragon Tusk Tribe. He was amongst the few surviving lizardmen whom fought against Cocytus.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Zenberu Gugu has the appearance of a humanoid crocodile. He is quite tall, exceeding 2.3 meters when standing, which makes him rival in height with the 5th Floor Guardian, Cocytus. His body, covered by several scars, gives the impression of a veteran of battle. His most bizarre feature is his asymmetrical arms. Similar in trait with a fiddler crab, his right arm is especially more thick and muscular when compared to his left. His left arm's ring finger and pinky are completely gone. On his chest is the crimson "traveler" insignia burned in the form of a two-headed snake.
Personality

Zenberu Gugu is quite blunt and to the point in verbal conversation. Having no need for formalities and niceties of diplomacy he seems to favor strength and duels to solve disputes. When he talks, his teeth clash together, making it difficult for others to discern whether he is being casual or threatening. In battle, however, he is calm and collective, preferring to wait out his opponent and then strike. While he is considered a battle maniac, he always honors his promises with friends and foes alike.
Background

Before the Resource War in the Wetlands, Zenberu once fought the Chief of Sharp Edge Tribe and was defeated. This defeat encouraged him to become a traveler so as to see new sights and get stronger.

According to Zenberu, he had climbed up and down slopes and peaks of the Azerlisia Mountains to find where the Dwarves were located at, spending a month in his fruitless search for them. It was only until when he was about to give up on his quest that he first encountered a Dwarf who came out to explore the surface. After that, various things happened, and he earned the Dwarves' trust and was brought to their city. In a way, he was rescued by a dwarf and formed an amiable relationship with him. Zenberu settled in Feo Raidho and had acquired a vast amount of knowledge of dwarven culture in the process. Along the way, he had learned martial arts in the Dwarven city. Zenberu left once he gained enough confidence in himself and returned to the Lizardman village.[1] Before departing, his dwarf friend bequeathed Zenberu a steel halberd.

Zenberu then return to the Wetlands, and managed to be accepted back into his tribe. Despite his past as a traveler, he managed to rise to the top of the tribal hierarchy, no doubt using his new-found strength and experience from his travels. Zenberu Gugu now leads the Dragon Tusk lizardmen tribe. Every few years the Patriarch is chosen through a test of strength within the tribe and Zenberu has proven himself to be the strongest within the Dragon Tusk tribe. He is a unique figure in lizardmen culture, as in the past he was originally a traveler like Zaryusu Shasha.
Chronology

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Overlord II EP03 021
Zenberu Duels Zaryusu
When Zaryusu and Crusch Lulu visit the Dragon Tusk tribe to form an alliance, Zenberu immediately challenges Zaryusu, the wielder of Frost Pain to a duel. Losing the ferocious duel, they have a celebration and Zenberu tries and fails to convince Zaryusu to become the new chief of Dragon Tusk.[2]

Overlord II EP03 115
Shielding Zenberu
Before the onset of the first undead invasion, Zenberu journeyed together with Zaryusu and Crush to the Green Claw Village. After the tribes unanimously decided to dissolve all tribal lines to form the Lizardmen Alliance, Zenberu became a member of the chieftain elite unit. He was instrumental in obtaining victory for the Alliance by acting as a living shield for Zaryusu to get close enough to deal the final blow on Iguva=41.[3][4][5][6][7]

After the battle, the surviving lizardmen hosted a feast in honor of their victory. Zenberu, curious to see where Zaryusu and Crusch were, decided to go check on them. He inadvertently interrupted a tender moment between the two, earning their ire.[8]

Overlord II EP05 075
Zenberu Slain by Cocytus
The next day after the undead army was defeated, another soon appeared right at the Alliance's doorstep. Zenberu made a note to the others that the new army was equipped with magical weapons and that the lizardmen didn't stand a chance.[9][10]

Zenberu joined the tribal chieftains and a band of other brave lizardmen in a fight against Cocytus. After Sukyu Juju was killed he attempted to attack Cocytus, but was summarily beheaded and killed. After Zaryusu was resurrected, the lizardman pleaded to Ainz also resurrect his brother and Zenberu stating they were capable warriors. Ainz said he would consider the proposal and told them to care for the corpses until he came to a decision.[11][12][13][14]

The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc

Main article: The Invaders of the Large Tomb Arc
Some time after the subjugation of the lizardmen, Zenberu was among the lizardmen that were resurrected. He was present in Nazarick along with a few other lizardmen including Zaryusu Shasha doing some training when the worker groups invaded the tomb. While Hamsuke and Erya Uzruth fought against each other, he and his fellow lizardmen mostly just observed the match from a distance.[15]

The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc

Main article: The Craftsman of Dwarf Arc
When Ainz Ooal Gown and his entourage came to the Lizardmen's village, Zenberu was recruited to act as a guide to the Dwarf Kingdom.[16] During the expedition, Zenberu had difficulty recalling his exact path due to the terrain and his memory. In order to hasten the journey, Ainz asked to probe his mind so he could accurately pinpoint the entrance to the dwarven city that Zenberu had stayed over years ago. They eventually arrived at the entrance to the dwarven city but they discovered that the city was abandoned.

Upon their investigation, it was revealed that the dwarves had voluntarily abandoned the city after they discovered a lone dwarf miner named Gondo Firebeard in the city's mines. Zenberu shared a conversation with Gondo to learn what happened to his dwarven friend.[17]

Zenberu later went to Feo Jera after it was discovered to be where all the dwarves have migrated to. He was present during Ainz's discussion with the Regency Council and was asked to help make the measurements for the suit of armor for Zaryusu. He was left in Feo Jera while Ainz and company left to recapture the ancestral dwarven capital.[18]

Shalltear's Travel Diary Arc

Main article: Shalltear's Travel Diary Arc
During the night when Ainz's entourage, while heading to the Dwarf Kingdom, camps out in a fortress he created, the lizardman is briefly mentioned by Ainz as he speaks with Aura and Shalltear on the what he learned from Zenberu's memories and how near they were to the dwarven nation
