Zero (ゼロ) was the leader of Six Arms, Eight Fingers' security department. He was killed by Sebas.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Zero was a giant, bald man with half of his face and body covered with tattoos of various beasts. There is a panther on his legs, a falcon on his back, a rhino on his arms, a buffalo on his chest, and a lion on his head. Everything about him is large. The outlines of his muscular figure can be seen through his clothes. The cold glint in his eyes belongs to that of a seasoned warrior.
Personality

Zero was a strategic thinker who's always composed, examining any situation calmly. Given his experience, he was observant enough to recognize that the hole made by Sebas on the iron door of the brothel was made by a fist, not a magical item. He was also quite vindictive, wanting to behead Climb and send the head along with a bouquet of flowers to Princess Renner.

Zero was very arrogant and confident in his strength and skills to the point of stating that he is the strongest in the Kingdom and will make Gazef and Brain kneel before him someday.
Background

At some point in the past, Zero met Davernoch and recruited him into joining Six Arms of Eight Fingers. In return for joining the criminal organization and to use his magical powers under his direction, he helps fulfill the undead's request. This was by having Zero introduced the undead to someone who was willing to teach it magic, and paid it appropriately.
Chronology

The Men in the Kingdom Arc

Main article: The Men in the Kingdom I
and The Men in the Kingdom II Arc

Zero, along with the executives of Eight Fingers, meet in an undisclosed location to discuss various issues affecting the organization. Zero offers to assist Hilma with his resources but was turned down. However, one of the executives, Cocco Doll, requested for his security services in order to reinforce his hold over his declining slave trade division.[1]

After learning that the brothel had been seized and that Succulent and Cocco Doll were captured by the authorities, he orders Six Arms to bail Succulent out, as well as gather information on those who were responsible for the attack on the organization and punish them in return.[2]

When Sebas Tian is told to come to a warehouse alone due to Tuare's kidnapping, four of the Six Arms were there waiting for him. They engaged Sebas in combat but failed to even scratch him, resulting in them all being finished off effortlessly by Sebas. The other two members were waiting elsewhere and encounter Brain Unglaus, Climb, and Lockmeier. Succulent had disguised himself as Tuare in an attempt to get them to lower their guard down but fails and is next defeated by Climb and Lockmeier. Zero and Brain engage in a fierce battle, but they are interrupted by Sebas. Not believing that Sebas could kill four of the Six Arms by himself, Zero puts his duel with Brain on hold and attacks Sebas with his strongest attack. It, however, does nothing to the butler and Zero dies from a powerful heel dropkick, leaving the spectators of their "fight" in disbelief.[3]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
After Eight Fingers collapse, Zero found himself without a job and switched his talents as a worker. At a bar he was approached by his old colleague Hilma who invited him to work at E-Rantel using her new position at the Pharmacist's Guild. Zero not wanting to be in debt to her refused and continued resume his criminal ways. Uninterested in starting his new career as just a worker, Zero intended to build a new organization with his comrades in Six Arms. In public he acted as an outstanding worker to build trust but behind the scenes he worked to build a new syndicate with him acting as the head. His nascent criminal empire started slow but was gaining momentum however he and his comrades lost their noble backers as the Kingdom was cracking down on all illegal activities as part of their concessions to the new Tripartite Alliance.

Though this set Six Arms back, it opened a new opportunity to head to E-Rantel as it was becoming the new center of the world. It was there Zero intended to make a comeback and prove to the world he was the strongest in the three nations.[4] Later in order to destabilize the Tripartite Alliance, Zero made a deal with Zurrernorn to complete their Death Spiral ritual. The criminal kept his comrades in Six Arms out of the loop of the plan, but they followed his direction and worked with him to guard the site of the ritual thinking it was just a normal job. He was the only member to escape when Blue Roses and their allies attacked.[5]

Blue Roses was assigned to capture the fugitive, but later he was found to be at a venue of the summit of the Tripartite Alliance having accepted an offer from Emperor Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix to join the Baharuth Empire and hence giving Zero immunity for his crimes. As part of a demonstration, he participated in a mock battle against Gazef Stronoff and Soi. He was defeated by Gazef in the battle.[6] Due to him gaining amnesty for himself and by extension his comrades, the surviving members of Six Arms were freed. They acted as a unit to train and lead a group of workers to fight against a horde of Chaos Beasts that were heading towards E-Rantel.

Zero was ordered by the emperor to lead the monsters into the Quarry where the imperial knights would box the Chaos Beasts and eliminate them. Zero followed his orders to the letter but when the reinforcements came, he expected them to join in the fray. They did not and Zero suspected something was off. He then called his comrades to get off the quarry floor. That action saved their lives as the quarry floor was broken apart by a mechanism activated by the knights, causing the workers and Chaos Beasts to fall into the Melting Pot. The trap dissolved everyone that fell into the pit killing them. Zero's friends who survived the trap watched in horror at the lengths of which the Bloody Emperor would use to achieve victory. On the contrary Zero praised the action as the best method worthy of a leader.[7]

Zero would return to Arwintar and be granted an audience with the emperor. Though he knew that the emperor used him and his workers as bait and caused many deaths of those under his command, there were no hard feelings. He also heard of what transpired in E-Rantel and how Jircniv was nearly executed by the Demon Emperor and was sympathetic having heard the rumors and new title of Bloodless Emperor that Jircniv had been smeared with. Still Zero wanted to be compensated for his part in helping the Emperor in his plan for culling the horde of Chaos Beasts. For his reward, Zero demanded to become one of the Four Imperial Knights as there was a position open with Nazami Enec's death. Though Zero's request for the position was not unreasonable, the emperor was hesitant to give it to him as he noted that the worker was not there when he needed him at the execution platform and that he wished to have another as his knight. Zero realized that this other was the "Dark Warrior", that the emperor had taken a shine to after being saved him. Seeing that he could not compare to such a warrior that the emperor was fixated on, Zero asked what he would have to do to be granted knighthood. Just so it happened Jircniv wanted to make use of the skill of the worker.

Apparently since the emperor's image had been attacked due to the scathing rumors of his cowardice at E-Rantel, several nobles had been conspiring against him. He requires Zero's help in corralling all the detractors which Jircniv first requires him to take care of the undead in the Katze Plains. From the emperor Zero is told to tame the Captain of the Ghost Ship that lurks in the cursed land and recruit it to be a new member of his latest incarnation of Six Arms. Zero then proceeds to gather his two remaining comrades in Six Arms, Malmvist and Peshurian and several other workers on a undead subjugation into the plains. The workers delve deeper into the plains, culling undead and seeking the Ghost Ship. Zero and his comrades make the acquaintance of two strong workers named Regi and Shizuni. All the workers hired by Zero, aside from Regi and Shizuni, survive by the time they locate their target. Iguva having become the new Captain of the Ghost Ship tries to kill the workers, but Zero defeats him. He gives the undead a choice to serve under him, and promises to grant him his wish to attain magical knowledge. Iguva faced with death agrees to the terms and becomes a member of Six Arms.

Upon the return back to Arwintar using the Ghost Ship, Zero hosted a small party at the hideout to celebrate Iguva's joining the ranks of Six Arms. Zero having taken an interest in the abilities of Regi and Shizuni, sends out Malmvist to evaluate them and recruit them into Six Arms. After the women accept the invitation, Zero he brings Iguva to the conspiring anti-Jircniv faction to prove that he has a means to safely transport the nobles through the Katze Plains by using the lich's abilities to pacify the undead. Though the nobles are initially wary of Zero's previous affiliation to the emperor, they accept his service believing that they effectively bought him and allow the worker to be incorporated in their plan to oust the "Bloodless Emperor". He learns from the nobles that they planned to establish a smuggling route to the Slane Theocracy and import weapons and slaves to bolster their forces in a coup to remove Emperor Jircniv.

Zero then leads the newly reconstituted Six Arms to the Katze Plains to confirm the safety of the smuggling route of the anti-Jircniv faction. Aboard the Ghost Ship, Zero is told by Iguva about the threat of the local Skeletal Dragons. Though the appearance of those monsters is rare, one appears coincidentally in front of them. Zero has a chance to see the powers of Regi and Shizuni and is satisfied with the results and direct the team to resume their survey of the area and route. A day later Zero at the hideout informs his team that the route will be in use and that they will act to dispel attacks by Chaos Beasts and Contaminated Beasts. Not only will they be escorting cargo but also the nobles in their carriages through the fog to meet their partners in the smuggling operation.

En-route to the rendezvous point with the Slane Theocracy, the convoy is intercepted by none other than the three remaining members of the Four Imperial Knights. The nobles unperturbed cockily believe they are at the advantage, until Zero reveals that he is a turncoat and sold them out. Six Arms and the knights quickly dispatch the rebels and arrest them. Zero seeing that he successfully rebuilt his team, admitted to them though he wished to gain the status of an Imperial Knight, he would have abandoned the idea for the former as he sees its stronger than ever.

Zero seeing that he fulfilled his part of the bargain asks about his reward. Nimble informs Zero he has the skill and ability to be an Imperial Knight, though he would still have to test his strength against one of the current members. Zero understanding asks for a duel but the knights requests at another time as the prisoners took priority. Though Zero was not promoted immediately as an Imperial Knight, he was congratulated by his old and new comrades. That in mind Zero is satisfied that he is closer to his goal, though feels that being a worker is not so bad content to lead his new Six Arms.[8]

When Regi and Shizuni were secretly snooping around Iguva's Ghost Ship in search of something, they were spotted by Malmvist and Peshurian who followed them. Their activity was reported to Zero, who then brough the two women to explain themselves. Under pressure the female workers admitted that they were looking for a mithril adventurer plate as they heard a rumor that the Adventurer's Guild were looking for one from a fallen adventurer and hoping to sell it for gain. From the information, Zero guessed that guild was trying to do a public relations stunt to honor the fallen adventurers that lost their lives. When he heard that the protagonist and his team of Darkness were searching for the plate, Zero wondered what would happen if he and his team snatched it first. He then led Six Arms to the plains to do their own retrieval, though left Iguva behind so they could split the reward five ways. The move turned to be a mistake as they ran afoul of a horde of undead forcing them to flee. Whilst in flight they ran into Darkness in the fog. Before Zero could engage the adventurer in combat the undead horde caught up to them. Though their history was chalked with conflicts, Zero proposed that they form a truce to fight off the undead, which the adventurers reluctantly agreed.

Once the undead were defeated, Darkness shared some information of their mission, revealing that the location of the mithril plate they were searching for was on a Skeletal Dragon and that the undead they caught the attention of where part of its thralls. Though Zero's teammates wanted to back down, not wanting to confront a dangerous monster, Zero to the surprise of everyone wanted to help. His offer was not one of charity, as after being told that there would be no reward for the plate since it was a work of charity, Zero wanted to claim the treasure hoard of the undead dragon and was willing to allow the adventurers to keep the plate so long as his team got the rest of the loot. The decision was agreed on after the Skeletal Dragon came out of its nest to find them, which the adventurers and workers eventually defeated through their combined efforts.

After the battle, Zero and his team were left exhausted. As part of their deal, they allowed the adventurers to take not the just the mithril plate but the other plates that the undead dragon collected. Zero and his comrades were found by Iguva who came to investigate the disturbance in the area and helped to load the treasure aboard his ship which would be divided six ways. The leader of Six Arms was left impress by the protagonist's strength as the hero was left unscathed even after the battle with their quarry.[9]

Zero and the rest of Six Arms were waiting for Regi and Shizuni to return from E-Rantel after they finished reselling daily household magic items there. Zero expressed some concern on the women as he was worried, they might jump ship. His long-time human teammates assured him if that did happen, he would still have them, with even Iguva reinforcing his oath to follow Zero. When the women returned, they revealed that their resale plan failed as they found out that the Sorcerer Kingdom was launching its own brand of unique magic items based on the legacy of the Minotaur Sage. They procured the Scented Moisture Fan as proof. Zero was ecstatic on the find as he believed he could use it as leverage to have the Bloody Emperor promote him as one of the Four Imperial Knights.[10]

While passing through the Great Lake to Arwintar, Lupusregina and CZ investigated the area for any odd occurrences. While patrolling Lupusregina mentioned that they could not stay too long else Zero would grow suspicious. Adding to that CZ mentioned that Zero had grown to care about the team of New Six Arms.[11]

In the aftermath of the Calamity of Cracks, Zero's teammate Shizuni was among those who had vanished. Some months after hearing from Regi that E-Rantel was hosting an event called the Greetings and Victory Festival and her intent to check it out. Zero became interested after learning that the Imperial Knights would be there to participate in the dedication performance, and decided to join in so as to impress the emperor who was attending so he could be knighted. Zero and Regi then took Iguva's Ghost Ship to the city.

Once there, Zero's appearance at the festival came as a surprise to adventurers like Blue Roses, but Zero assured him that he was only there for the mock battles and not to stir up trouble. He and Regi were in the second match of the dedication performance, fighting against the guests of honor of the event: Shall and Ku. After a heated battle, Zero and Regi lost. Despite losing, Zero acknowledged his defeat and the strength of his opponents in good sportsmanship.[12]

Some days later, back in Arwintar, Zero had Peshurian fetch Regi from her usual place at the Singing Apple Pavilion for a team meeting. When she arrived he complained that she was drinking too early in the day. That aside, Zero informed his worker team that they had a new job request from the emperor. This time to provide security for a Greetings and Victory festival for the imperial capital.

While Zero had no idea why the Empire was hosting the same event as in E-Rantel, he heard that the Sorcerer Kingdom had given its permission. Though Malmvist was confused as to why anyone would try and cause trouble and riot during a festival like this. However Zero told his team that he suspected that Jircniv was using the festival to eliminate some of the supporters of the Anti-Imperial Faction, given that the dissidents was disorganized and the event could lure them out.

Beside the tedious task of finding the dissidents who could cause trouble for the emperor, underneath Zero was worried for Regi as he saw she was not herself ever since Shizuni went missing. Before heading out her apologized for having Iguva sit this one out.

At Jircniv's orders, he had Regi brag about a job of supplies being delivered from the Sorcerer Kingdom in E-Rantel to Arwintar at the Sing Apple Pavilion. This was overheard by anti-imperials who then sent mercenaries to ambush the convoy, only to have Zero and his worker team waiting for them. The workers captured the dissidents and handed them over to the authorities.

The team returned to base and celebrated. Though Zero did not share their celebratory mood. To explain his attitude he told his companions that he felt that the job was too easy. At first he thought it was just a simple "fishing out" of the Anti-Imperial Faction by spreading false information and while they did succeed in capturing some of the dissidents, there were still other groups who were determined to cause a major incident. He was skeptical that this ploy by the emperor would have worked and now suspects that Jircniv was holding out information from them.

Some days later before the festival, Regi succeeded in acquiring a map of the know meet-up of a sub-faction of the anti-imperials who were plotting on attacking Jircniv as he was heading to the Grand Arena. On the day of the festival, Zero stood guard at the arena whilst he had his workers stand guard at key streets. Thanks to passing the intel to the imperial knights the anti-imperial's ploy failed and were captured.

After handing the criminals to the knights, Zero heard the disappointment in Regi of not being able to participate in the exhibition fights so he comforted her that there was always next time. Zero and his team then celebrated for two straight days. On the second day, Zero and his team receive more good news that Shizuni had been spotted in the Tob Forest having gotten lost there. Zero gave permission to Regi to go and bring her back. And while he tried to hide his feelings of being worried for Regi, Malmvist teased him about it to his annoyance but looked forward to toasting when Shizuni returned.[13]

On a slow day of working jobs, Zero hanged out with his team, minus Iguva=41, at the Singing Apple Pavilion. Despite the lack of work, Zero looked on the bright side of enjoying the peace. When Malmvist brought up the topic of the latest rumors regarding to what happened in the city of E-Rantel, he noticed Regi's keen interest assumed that the woman was looking for a way to profit off the situation.

Regi and Shizuni became interested in a bard singing a ballad about the emperor's brilliant plan in slaying a horde of Chaos Beasts, Zero dismissed it as he and his old team knew the truth of what really happened, and nearly died. This causes Regi and Shizuni to become more interested in the work of bards, and Zero provided him the contemporary role they played in society for their benefit as he was drinking. And seeing that they had aspirations to be bards, Zero in a drunken stupor encouraged it, jokingly hoping that they could get some skills in the profession and spread the name of their work team.

Much later at their hideout, he and all the male members of New Six Arms were examining a new item brought back by Regi and Shizuni, the electric guitar. While the others in his team dismissed it as a musical instrument, believed it could be applied as a weapon to disorient the enemy.[14]

Unknown to Zero, his former teammate Succulent was using his illusion magic to disguise himself as him whiling being the boss of an illegal gambling den in in order to play on the monk's reputation. Rumors reached Zero in the imperial capital from three workers at Singing Apple Pavilion that a former Six Arms member was operating the gambling den and using it as a front for smuggling. The monk suspected that it was his old comrade, and found it to be amusing as he never expected to hear rumors of his old teammate. He though Succulent's operation was bound to be foiled.

Though it didn't really matter to him if the operation was foiled, and his currently popularity was strong, Zero was not one to allow the name Six Arms be used since he already created New Six Arms. Shortly as he was making plans to retaliate, he heard rumors that the gambling den was busted, and Succulent went missing.[15]

At a mission to the Katze Plains, Zero had his team observe a group of former nobles who had opposed the emperor escape through the no man's land. This act was incredulous to the rest of his team, as they were confused as to why they were letting them go. Zero merely stated that they were just doing what workers do, make money. When Peshurian asked if Zero had given up on becoming a knight, Zero told his companions that letting the nobles go was all part of a setup that was requested by the emperor. Although the information only further bewildered his team, which Zero promised to explain in due time. For now, he directed them to help him clear out the undead in the area.

Later Zero was summoned by Jircniv asking for his assistance in finding someone to infiltrate a rally of the Anti-Imperial Faction in order to steal the Blood Oath with all the names of the conspirators. Zero eager to please Jircniv volunteered Regi and Shizuni for the task, having full confidence in their abilities to play the role as a noblewoman and servant at the venue.

On the day of the event, Zero, Peshurian, Iguva, and Malmvist laid in wait outside for when Regi and Shizuni would come running outside with the oath in hand. Zero seeing that there was no disturbance so far at the event noted that the women were doing well, and commented on the stupidity of the people at the rally to be so stupid for falling into a trap. When the women came running with pursers, the men and undead appeared from the darkness killing the guards and incapacitating the people at the venue. Having another success to their team, Zero took his team out for drinks.[16]

A year after the defeat of Enhela Read Gahi, Zero and his team became interested in two new strangers to Arwintar. They were two young women who acted as if they were workers and looking for work, though Zero was able to tell that they were new to the profession of workers, and yet also experienced fighters that had been through hell. Zero along with Regi and Shizuni decided to follow the pair, which led them to the Grand Arena where the women were currently employed.

However only Zero was able to get a ticket into the venue for the match that the pair would be fighting. The trio returned to inform the rest of the team. The team intrigued decided to make bets on the fight of the two newcomers. Since Zero would be able to see the match, Regi complained that only he would be able to see the outcomes. Though Zero told her not to complain and cited that betting was a custom...no tradition of New Six Arms to hone their competitive skills.

The monk betted on the pair to be losing much to the surprise of the others as they expected him to bet on them as winners. Zero reasoned that though the two newcomers seem to have been through hell, it meant that they don't always do things rough. So he thought they'd know that suddenly winning against the heroes of the Empire would cause trouble, meaning that they will intentionally lose. Of course he admitted that could be overthinking it and wanted to see what the opposing team of Silver Thread Bird would do.

The gathering was interrupted when Malmvist came to the hideout informing that they got a request to reduce the number of undead in the Katze Plains to ensure the safety of the area. The team figured it was for the delegates from the Quadripartite Alliance who secretly came to the Empire.

Malmvist suggested that they could direct Iguva's undead to attack the returning carriage and then swoop in to save it to make Zero look like a hero. But it was rejected by the monk as he wanted to avoid making a fool of him and make it seem like it was part of Jircniv's scheming. Besides since the delegation contained people such as Zanac from the Kingdom and Albedo from the Sorcerer Kingdom, he figured that the VIPs from the other countries would be smart enough to figure the scheme.[17]

Zero would have his team participate in the Chocolate Cup in the Grand Arena, not only to win the five-hundred Healthy Vermillion snacked but also to promote their team and gain more clients. In the competition, Zero's team faced off against the adventurers Shall and Soi. Zero fought Soi by himself while the other contended with Shall. The battle ended in a draw, but New Six Arms were declared the winners for their performance. Zero while not having much interest in the chocolate prize, accepted it as it came with sales rights for the product.

After his team sold some of the chocolate to the crowd and made a profit, the team returned to their hideout. There Zero lectured Regi and Shizuni on their fighting styles, asking them to tone it down, as the fights were no longer to the death at the arena. His reasons for doing this was to prevent an image of his team of being ruthless fighters, worried if their team fought with such intensity and won every match it would give the impression of them being cutthroats. Zero still had ambitions to become a knight so he wanted to display a knightly attitude.

Secretly to himself, Zero was a bit concerned about Regi and Shizuni's strength. And while he was confident they were not as strong as him, separately, if the two of them worked together, he was not sure if he can win unscathed. Worse if the women really went off the rails, people will be scared. Zero believes it would be fine, as it would do good for his reputation of being able to bring together strong people, but wanted to avoid clients disappearing from any unfortunate misunderstandings.[18]

Zero later appeared to be in trouble with the emperor, has he failed toe bring any results in his investigation report, which happened a day before Nazarick's second contact with the Mercenary Knights. Later in the conversation between the members of the Mercenary Knights and the Sorcerer Kingdom, according to the former a version of Zero existed in another world where his life path took a more different path than in the current world.

The leader of New Six Arms would give his permission to Regi and Shizuni to participate in a match at the Grand Arena, for publicity and try to earn back the emperor's favor by impressing him.[19]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Zero was a monk-class, close-combat specialist who used shamanic possession (channeled through the tattoos on his body) to improve his already formidable fighting power, which granted his fists the toughness of Oricalchum. This made him the strongest member of the Eight Fingers and one of the strongest warriors in the Kingdom, boasting sheer power that is estimated to rival adamantite-ranked adventurers. On top of this, as the leader of the Six Arms, he has the entirety of the Eight Finger's martial prowess in his beck and call. These two factors combined made the Eight Fingers a virtually impossible to stop criminal empire for a New World native, as anyone who tries to dismantle the Kingdom needs to get past him and his band of highly-trained professional warriors.
Known Classes

Monk
Shamanic Adept
Skills

Iron Skin: A Monk skill that renders the user's body as hard as metal.
Single Strike Kill: Simultaneously channeling every single one of the animal spirits empowering his shamanic tattoos (Panther, Falcon, Rhinoceros, Buffalo, Lion), Zero executes a tremendously powerful punch that, given the name, is likely capable of killing most New World inhabitants in a single hit if it connects.
Main Equipment

Monk's Black Belt
Armband of the Beast King
Boots of Speed
Relationships

Eight Fingers

The leaders of the Eight Fingers were aware of Zero's might and valued it highly.

Six Arms

Zero was the leader of the Six Arms and demanded their respect.

Spoiler Alert
Spoiler Alert: WARNING! This page happens to contain a lot of heavy spoilers that are all originated from the Overlord Light Novel series written by the author Kugane Maruyama. To every Anime-only watchers and Manga-only reader out there viewing this warning, please mindfully consider your decision first before choosing to expose yourself on reading the information below. If you're not currently up-to-date with the main source material in the official books, do consider staying away from the page for non-spoiler sake until you actually read it first ahead of time.




"Clean. What else is there? No one can clean so thoroughly as me. When I scrub the toilets, you can lick the bowl!"
-Éclair boasting of his duties.
Éclair Éklair Éklare (エクレア・エクレール・エイクレアー) is the assistant butler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Despite being a Birdman, Eclair has a very unusual appearance for one; he is a literal Rockhopper penguin, with blond hair. Due to his physiology, Eclair moves in shuffling steps, so he is always carried by another servant when he wants to get around.
Personality

Éclair has great pride in being the assistant butler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick to the point of arrogance. Carrying himself with an enormous ego of self-worth, one of his greatest desires is to sit upon the throne of Nazarick. Though Éclair understands this act is treasonous to the Forty-One Supreme Beings and likely due to him also understanding that his creator specifically made him to be this way, he still respects them highly.
Background

Éclair Éklair Éklare was created by Ankoro Mocchi Mochi. As a joke, his personality settings were set to have the desire to conquer Nazarick.
Chronology

The Dark Warrior Arc

Main article: The Dark Warrior Arc
Eclair reporting to Demiurge
Eclair reporting to Demiurge
After the teleportation to the New World, Sebas Tian and the majority of the Pleiades have ventured outside of the tomb on a mission, leaving the assistant butler in charge of Nazarick's upkeep. Éclair encounters Demiurge in the halls of the 9th Floor near Ainz Ooal Gown's quarters. After informing Demiurge that Albedo is inside, both exchange words concerning Éclair's duties. Eclair excuses himself and has his subordinate carry him away to continue his chores.[1]

The Lizard Man Heroes Arc

Main article: The Lizard Man Heroes Arc
Overlord II EP01 102
Eclair at the Bar
Éclair arrives at the 9th Floor of Nazarick in the restaurant of his close comrade Sous-chef. There he finds the Myconid entertaining an extremely depressed Shalltear Bloodfallen. He tried to provide a drink for Shalltear to cheer her up only to spill it on the bench and apologizing to Sous-chef for it. Éclair learned of Shalltear's predicament and sympathizes with her. He is offered a glass of fresh apple juice from the orchards on the 6th Floor. Éclair found the taste to be not bad but lacking compared to the apples in stock in Nazarick. He learned that a dryad from the outside had joined Nazarick.[2]

The Two Leaders Arc

Main article: The Two Leaders Arc
Overlord III EP01 024
Trapped in CZ2128's Arms
At the staff canteen on the 9th Floor of Nazarick, Éclair is plucked from the hands of his Manservants by CZ2128 Delta. Much to his humiliation, she cuddled him like a plush toy. His attempt to extricate himself from the Pleiades member only exhausted the butler. However, thanks to Lupusregina Beta's distraction with her sister, the penguin is able to successfully escape from CZ2128 Delta's grasp.[3]

The Pleiades Day Arc

Main article: The Pleiades Day Arc
Sebas Tian mentioned that he and Tuare would be meeting Éclair to continue the latter's maid training. He has been avoiding CZ2128 Delta due to his previous experiences with her. This avoidance from him caused the automaton to seek out cute animals on the 6th Floor.[4]

Ainz’s Ambition Arc

Main article: Ainz’s Ambition Arc
Éclair is one of the servants who provided comfort for Ainz during his vacation.[5]

The Dinner Is All Nazarick Members Arc

Main article: The Dinner Is All Nazarick Members Arc
Éclair attended a lavish meal prepared by the Head Chef. However, when he toasted to himself, everyone gave him a cold stare. Much to his distress, the Head Chef had an idea to use penguins in his cooking and wondered if he could use the Albino Penguins found on the 5th Floor.[6]

Ainz (Isekai Quartet)
NOTICE: The following section and subsequent subsections are considered NON-CANON to the Overlord Light Novels.


Mass for the Dead Arc

Main article: Mass for the Dead Arc
To get ready for guests coming to the Great Tomb of Nazarick on the Sorcerer Kingdom's National Foundation Day Ceremony, Sebas Tian mentioned the birdman to assist with the preparations.[7]

Éclair visited the bar on the 9th Floor, where he found Sous-chef serving a depressed Shalltear Bloodfallen, still distraught over the mind control incident. The birdman noted that the vampire had been frequenting the bar. He attempted to cheer Shalltear up when she disparaged herself for being a bad Floor Guardian, trying to remind her that she was keystone for the defense of Nazarick. And even if she had caused a great deal of trouble for Nazarick and Momonga, her role would not change.

When he words failed to brighten her mood, Éclair reminded the Floor Guardians should cheer up as she had been already forgiven by Momonga and it would be bad to go against his will. That touch a sore spot on Shalltear's overburden guilt, so Éclair then decided to put himself out for Shalltear, given he was a being who had repeatedly sought to usurp Nazarick.

Though Sous-chef pointed out his plots to take over Nazarick, were part of his creation, ordained by Ankoro Mocchi Mochi, to which Éclair was proud to be, and promised that one day he would be King of Nazarick and give Sous-chef a high position. When Shalltear verbally mused on wanting an active role in strengthening Nazarick's like the Pleiades, Éclair believed that the battle maids were hard at work in the human cities and decided to raise a toast to them.[8]

Éclair was present at the bar when Momonga, actually Pandora's Actor, and the protagonist came to visit the Bar. When he arrived the penguin offered the Sorcerer King to sit next to him at the cocktail bar. The Assistant Head Butler found it odd for Momonga to be coming to the Bar together with the homunculus, wondering if it was due to something special happening.

When it turned out not to be the case, Éclair asked if Momonga was tired of ruling, and offered to step to step in his place. Unknown to him the real Momonga who was invisible actually found the proposal nice. Though Pandora's Actor who was acting a body double merely silently stare at the birdman, causing Éclair to sweat and tell his liege to forget what he said.

Luckily the body double was distracted by Clavu's newest cocktail creation, White Porcelain Ruler and also the Nazarick cocktail for the protagonist. The group were then joined by Shalltear and her two Vampire Brides. In the midst of Shalltear enjoying "Momonga's" company, the birdman made another blurt of becoming a ruler, only to be silence by Shalltear when she made a face at him for such impudence. Though he did make one last attempt after Shalltear praised the Sorcerer King's attire which he intended to dress when he met with the representatives of the Quadripartite Alliance, but was cut off by Clavu. Even so Pandora's Actor in Momonga's appearance thanked the butler and the others for having him at the bar after he left.[9]

In a competition to decide a temporary replacement for the undead guards at E-Rantel for a festival celebrating the Quadripartite Alliance, Demiurge focusing on appearances, recommended Éclair and his Manservants. Who while not appearing too threatening made the perfect being to be underestimated by humans, especially since they would have Shadow Demons accompanying them. Éclair took the chance to promote being the ruler of Nazarick, but like always was not taken seriously. Momonga dismissed the idea as it would reallocate too much labor to the endeavor.[10]

The penguin along with Foire were known to inspect the bath of Momonga, to make sure the bathing attendant Miyoshi was properly cleaning it. Éclair praise the slime's work claiming the drain was clean enough to lick.[11]

END of NON-CANON content



Abilities and Powers

Éclair is an assistant butler who is left in charge of the upkeep on the 10th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick during Sebas Tian's absence. Unlike the frightening monsters that live in Nazarick, Éclair's fighting prowess is low, since his overall strength level is 1.
Relationships

Ankoro Mocchi Mochi

Éclair is created by Ankoro jokingly. He has considerable respect for his creator and the other Supreme Beings regardless of his intention. And like with all the other NPC's for their creators, Éclair's loyalty and respect for her is the strongest due to him being her creation.

Sebas Tian

No direct interaction between Sebas Tian and Éclair has been shown, however as Head Butler, Sebas Tian is Éclair's superior.

Sous-chef

One of Eclair's closest acquaintances on the 9th Floor of Nazarick. The two possess a bond where the myconid allows the Birdman to call him by his nickname 'Piki'.

Shalltear Bloodfallen

Éclair sympathized with Shalltear for her involuntary uprising, as he considered betrayal his function. Learning of Shalltear's betrayal, he attempted to recruit her into joining him in his conquest of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. However, his words have only cause Shalltear to sink more into her depression about betraying Ainz.

Aura Bella Fiora

Éclair is close enough to Aura to the point they refer to each other with nicknames outside of work. That is because the Supreme Beings who had made them were close to each other, and they felt similarly close to each other.

Mare Bello Fiore

Éclair is close enough to Mare to the point they refer to each other with nicknames outside of work. That is because the Supreme Beings who had made them were close to each other, and they felt similarly close to each other.

Yuri Alpha

Éclair is close enough to Yuri to the point they refer to each other with nicknames outside of work. That is because the Supreme Beings who had made them were close to each other, and they felt similarly close to each other.

CZ2128 Delta

CZ2128 is known to adore Éclair and cuddles him as if he were a plush toy. However, it is a nightmare to the penguin and tries his best to avoid being trapped in her arms.

Pestonya Shortcake Wanko

Éclair is close enough to Pestonya to the point they refer to each other with nicknames outside of work. That is because they've been created by the same Supreme Being.

Demiurge

Eclair shares a cordial relationship with Demiurge. He thinks Demiurge's wisdom is second to his own. The two would pay heed to each other's respective duty on the job. However, if the order was given by the Supreme Being, Demiurge would kill Éclair without hesitation and have no objection to it.

Homunculus Maids

In the Anime, while he has a cordial relationship with them as servants under Ainz, Éclair's declaration of becoming the future ruler of Nazarick left a displeased look among the Homunculus Maids.
